A monkey is a member of either of two known groupings of simian primates. These two known groupings are the Karamja monkeys and the 'harmless' monkeys.
A month or more? King Arthur could be in grave danger. Morgan Le Faye is involved and she is not one to be trifled with. One of the Sinclairs has already committed murder, who's to say another won't?
A month's supply eh! Well, I was going to take them to market and just concentrate on the cows, but I reckon that little Jimmy's neck is worth a few scrawny chickens, don't you?
A monument dedicated to the fallen.
A mouldy doll that was presumably once the property of a child. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
A mouldy wooden block that might have once been part of a toy. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
A mourner wouldn't be sent to tell me this. Go away!
A mouse runs out of the hole.
A mouse, a house? Would these change your mind?
A mouse? Fantastic!
A much better price? What's the catch?
A much nobler pursuit, to be sure.
A murder.
A mutual friend of ours, Ali Morrisane, wants you to supply his stall in Al Kharid with your garments.
A mysterious mage with no name who lives with some lizardmen. He sure sounds like an upstanding citizen with nothing suspicious about him at all.
A mystic?
A nagua? It has been a long time since I last heard of their kind...
A narwhal horn of the highest quality. You think you could probably fashion this into a knife.
A nearby guard spots you!
A necklace crossed my path a while back, and everything suddenly started to go wrong for me. It was as if I was haunted by some spiteful spirit.
A necromancer is going to bind the essence of an undead army into some bone seeds for me if I can get a container to carry them in.
A needle is required to remove this crafting kit.
A needle is required to work with this crafting kit.
A needle.
A net may be of use to you. Speak to me if you need one.
A net?! You want a net?! Are you serious?! Is this what I've been reduced to? Teaching people like you? I've had more intellectual conversations with that wall over there than this!
A new Royal Accord would require all five us to agree on the contents.

A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
A new evil rises in an unlikely place. But the rhythm will be her undoing.
A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time, but this one is different.
A new machine perhaps that could lift a whole load of earth and hold it over my head!
A new market could put me out of business! Why should I help fund it?
A new name?!? That is a strange request. What's wrong with [Fremennik name]!?
A new nylocas?
A new recruit? Excellent! Please talk to the squire in the courtyard for the required paperwork!
A new spear? Why?
A new tax!
A new top, please!
A new weapon? Interesting!
A nice family of three, out for a little picnic a bit too close to the Salve.
A nice pizza?
A nice religious cult that has an unhealthy obsession with the end of the world. They've never caused any major problems before, so we've mostly left them be.
A nice seafood dinner for two.
A nice sentiment, but we can't all live off the land.
A nice thought, but unlikely...
A nightmare that should not exist. A phantom of the beast that Jhallan took the form of. General Khazard called it a muspah.
A noble and rewarding past-time.
A noble cause indeed. One that I can sympathise with, for I myself am upon a quest. One that will allow Saradomin to be glorified even in these dark lands.
A noble purpose for two noble beasts! Did you succeed?
A noble sentiment, but Viyeldi is not alive! He is merely a vessel for the sacred water's power.
A note written by yourself for Livius. Seems you weren't very happy with him...
A note? How do you fix a bridge with a note? Go bring me some real rope.
A nudge that's brought a bit more colour to Gielinor.
A package? From who?
A pair of civilians.
A pair of ice gloves should do the trick.
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

texto: A pair of magical gauntlets that when worn grant your next magic attack of the same type a doubled chance of hitting if the previous attack missed.
A panel opens from the bookcase. The letter 'L' appears to be scratched into it.
A parcel? King Shayzien VII's journal was delivered in a parcel? Who sent it?
A particular bunny told me you're a dab hand at making things bigger.
A particularly harsh winter for Lumbridge this year. Still, we make the best of it. I hope all our new visitors aren't getting too cold.
A partisan.
A party like this cannot be rushed!
A party?
A passage hidden behind a bookcase. Leads directly from the backstage area to the wine cellar. Likely how the killer got to Livius.
A passage? I had no idea, but I suppose it's not too suprising.
A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
A passing performance.
A peace treaty... Do you trust him?
A peace treaty? Then you will not invade?
A perfect cabbage, obviously, a perfect potato and some perfect rosemary.
A perfect cabbage, obviously, a perfect potato and some perfect rosemary. Head over to the Farming Guild and grow them as you normally would, and you should find that Brassica has blessed you.
A performance?
A person interested in natural history is known as a naturalist.
A pestle and mortar will more than do the trick.
A pet ROCK!
A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
A pet? Are you crazy?
A petition you say? Continue, mortal.
A phantom? So it's not actually real?
A physical? What, are they going to examine my body?
A pickaxe can help you split off the essence from the amalgamations.
A pickle?
A pickled brain? What do you expect me to do with it - eat it with a packet of crisps?!?
A picture eh? Hmmm.... The only one I can think of is in a small portrait of Sir Vyvin's father... Sir Vyvin keeps it in a cupboard in his room I think.
A piece of Rogue equipment.
A piece of paper slides out between the crates wooden slats. You take it.
A piece of rope.
A piece of silver please.
A pile of half digested food spills out as you try to take the eggs.
A pint of Grog please.
A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
A pirates union? No, they would stab us in the back at the first opportunity.
A pit trap should do you. There are some appropriate pits to the east of here that you can use. Cover one with a few logs and branches, tease the kitty and then lead it to the pit. Simple.
A pity. Dorgeshuun food seems so dull now I've tasted surface food.
A pity; you'd look quite cute with rabbit ears. Perhaps I should have bribed [him/her].
A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
A place to sleep when darkness falls.
A place... A being... A power... They are one... and the same... It is everything... It is nothing...
A plague.
A plan?
A plant pot.
A player can choose to hold if they wish and not draw any more runes, but this runs the risk of the other player drawing more runes until they have a greater points total and win.
A pleasant thought. So, are you still against the plan?
A pleasure doing business with you!
A pleasure doing business with you, [player name].
A pleasure doing business with you. Now do you need any groceries?
A pole vault
A portrait
A portrait please.
A pot of flour.
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

texto: A pot of soup is bubbling away on the range.
A pot with a lid. Nothing more, nothing less.
A potion of invincibility? That is grave news indeed. If you can sabotage it somehow, you will be very well paid.

A potion of magic essence is made in the same way as any other potion, first you mix a vial of water with a base herb, in this case a Star Flower. Star Flowers are rich in magic essence and are excellent for curing
A potion of sealegs?
A potion? Oh yes, I make lots of those. Here's one I made for my mother - you can have it, since she didn't drink it all...
A potion? See if you can finish it off.
A potion? Sounds like my area of expertise.
A poultice! And hold it together with the tail from an embertailed jerboa.
A powerful magic seizes you and throws you from Keep La Faye.

A powerful staff that can cast two bolt, blast or wave spells at once. Prioritises casting spells that match your foe's elemental weakness and gives a 10% accuracy and damage bonus for Standard Spellbook spells.
A pox on ye!
A pretender.
A pretty babbling spring. The water bubbles with a strange effervescence.
A priest cannot also hold a knighthood, and so I am the one Temple Knight in a leadership role who doesn't have one.
A priest! thank goodness! My husband is very ill! Perhaps you could read him his last rites?
A priest!?
A priest? Hmmm...
A print of the key in soft clay and a bronze bar. Then, collect the key from Leela.
A prison where you keep meat fresh?
A prison? For who? You?
A problem?
A proposition eh? Sounds interesting!
A protection spell?
A protective sheath that favours the bow and arrow. An essential purchase.
A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.
A proxy? Interesting. I wouldn't have thought you would be one to hide away.
A pub.
A pumpkin dye, perhaps?
A purely for the sake of argument fifty-fifty split on this hypothetical treasure, should it exist...
A puzzle?
A quest isn't a type of fish!
A quest you say? Hmm, what an odd request to make of the king. It's funny you should mention it though, as there is something you can do for me.
A quest you say? Hmm... What an odd request to make of the King. It's funny you should mention it though, as there is something you can do for me.
A quest?
A quest? Well we don't have any of those lying around.
A quest? What a strange notion. Do you normally go around asking complete strangers for quests?
A question with many possible answers, my faithful servant.
A question? I do know many things. But as with all things, information doesn't come free.
A rake
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
A rake.
A rare carnivorous plant originally from Morytania. When grown, the plant becomes conscious and highly aggressive. They are truly fascinating.
A rat asked you to fill a folder?
A rather loud clank reverberates from the safe. It sounds as if you've gotten the combination wrong. You wonder how many more attempts you have before the safe permanently locks itself.
A rather rude, personal one?
A raw bass? You should know that is not a worthy offering, outerlander.
A raw shark, manta ray, or sea turtle should be sufficient as an offering.
A real historian would never steal!
A real pongy one, too.
A realtor who'd been assessing the house earlier
A reduction on sales taxes? Why, I am the only one in the Fremennik who may authorise such a thing. What does an outerlander want with that?
A reflection on a pool of water does not reveal its depth.
A rehoming event? That sounds like a party to me, and I absolutely love a party! Let's make this happen for you. Where were you thinking of hosting your event?

A remarkable race, but they are sadly very stubborn and stuck in their ways. There is an island in the Pearl Bank of great importance to them. They'd never allow an operation like ours so close to it.
A return trip to Dragontooth Island costs 25 ectotokens.
A reward of some kind for all my hard work, you're clearly reaping the benefits.

A reward will have to wait though, the tree is still dying! The guards are clearing Glough's rock supply now but there must be more Daconia hidden somewhere in the roots! Help us search, we have little time!
A reward?
A riddle.
A riddle? Clearly she doesn't want the message to be easily found. I'd appreciate it if you could look into this further.
A ride, where to?
A ring may be an appropriate gift to formalise your friendship
A ring?
A ring? I must see it.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: A rod you say? This sounds like it could be the weapon we seek.
A rolling pin and a saucepan. They'll make a loud scary noise when I bang them together.
A rope with which to tie Keli up.
A roughly permit sized favour?
A royal blouse & skirt, please.
A royal proclamation?
A royal tunic & leggings, please.
A ruin within a ruin? How exciting! We have found the odd thing that doesn't seem to be dwarven in origin, but it's still early days for us here, so we haven't been able to learn much yet.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: A rusty coin with some strange markings on it. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
A rusty old locket that's sealed shut. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
A sailor, then?
A sapphire amulet! He remembers! It's just like the one he gave me before he left.
A satisfying warmup. Collect your loot and let us continue.
A scary mage huh? Sounds like I could get KILLED!
A scientific dig... Where have I heard of that before?
A scroll appeared? Can I take a look at it while you look at the rotas?
A scroll?
A second category of spirit is made up of those who are not yet at peace. However, all that is needed is for their mortal remains to be laid to rest and they will join the peaceful majority.
A second colour?
A second dose of drink may let you remember where you moored your boat and how to teleport, but also make you forget about crabs a little.
A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
A secret one, I'm guessing?
A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
A secret tunnel, leading directly into Efaritay's castle. The tunnel was here, in this very graveyard. Once they were inside, capturing Ascertes was easy.
A seed dibber
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
A seed dibber.
A seed?
A selection of fun items for the best of adventurers! That said, be aware that I have little interest in the usual currencies...
A selection of items for those who partake in variety! That said, be aware that I have little interest in coins...
A sentient boat bottle?
A servant race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!
A set of large curved horns.
A shadow? Could just be troll superstition.
A shaman?
A shame to be sure.
A shame. As unlikely as it was, I did hope you might see reason.
A shame. Unfortunately, this something requires some understanding in that area.
A shame. Unfortunately, this something requires somewhat of an abyssal understanding.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
A shame. You're a good battle mage. I hope to see you soon.
A shame. You're better than this Arianwyn, I hope in time you will see that.
A shard of the totem. Too dangerous to use on its own, but with the power of this ring, perhaps I can make it safe.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: A sharp barb found at the tip of a ray's tail. You reckon it might be useful for shipbuilding.
A shave, please!
A shield? Sounds like my area. What do you need?
A shield? What kind of shield?
A shifting apparition appears in front of you.
A shiny, pointy stick is likely another weapon. Try the shops in central Varrock.
A ship with red sails? Curious... and concerning... Hmm...
A ship? She's trying to escape! Do you know which ship?
A shrine to Zamorak in the middle of Varrock?
A sign saying 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'?
A significant amount of mess and noise later...
A silver sickle? What's that?
A simple herbal remedy containing vodka. Lots of vodka.
A simple no would've sufficed.
A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratious service.

A single visitor. We called him the Stranger from Afar. He uplifted us. He showed us that life could be more than mere survival. You wouldn't think it now, but back then my brother was his biggest believer.
A siphon will solve this!
A sister... I had a sister. And my powers?
A skavid?
A skeleton!
A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.
A skilled warrior also am I. Harrallak mistakes does not make. Potential in my invention he sees and opportunity grasps.
A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.
A slayer creature!
A slayer creature? That doesn't make any sense at all! Besides, not even the slayer masters know how to kill a thingummywut!
A slayer master told me to
A slayer master told me to.
A slight accident?? Have you any idea how much time I spent rebuilding that statue?
A slight accident?? Thanks to you I have to rebuild this statue you so carelessly knocked over!
A slightly broken window. Could be easily shattered.
A slow but steady trickle of mud and filth is making its way to the surface and then disappearing into the ground again. It stinks!
A small box containing labels to be affixed to new wine jugs.
A small broken mirror. It doesn't reflect much now. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
A small jug was tucked away in a corner, almost as if someone didn't want it to be seen.
A small number of those will allow me to create runes from them, which I may then sell and get myself back on my feet.
A small parrot with a pink banana is sitting outside your window!
A small price to pay for such a fantastic cape.
A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies.
A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies. Now, if you'll excuse me.
A snake?
A solution to their blood shortages. Their reliance on your kind must end. Luckily for us, in the short term, my disciples are more than willing to provide their blood.
A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in it. There you go. May Saradomin walk with you.
A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
A song so loud that you only hear silence....
A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
A source of indescribable evil. A beast more foul than your dreams could imagine. It hunts the jungle for anything foolish enough to cross its path.
A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.
A spa business? Do you really think these Corsairs are the washing type?

A spare suit of plate armour need you will. Full helm, plate leggings and platebody yes? Placing it in the centre of the magical machines you will be doing. KA- POOF! The armour, it attacks most furiously as if
A special client has a little request for me. I will need [3/4/5] [item] in the next [15/20/25] minutes.
A special egg? All eggs are special.
A special kebab? What kind of special?
A species of octopus native to the island which I and I alone know how to catch.
A spider that took the entirety of my field of vision! Bigger and fuzzier still than the ones you get near here.
A spider? Oh no! I'm scared of spiders!
A spirit called Echned Zekin said I had to avenge his spirit by killing Viyeldi if I wanted him to unblock the sacred spring.
A spirit of sorts. Something far older than anything your people have bothered to remember. In any case, a deal is a deal. You may enter the city of Cam Torum.
A split gang and a split shield. My guess would be that the other gang has the other half.
A spooky wall lamp! They are to die for.
A sprinkle of sawdust... Gross. 3 -->
A squirrel?
A stain?
A steel mace
A step down from what I'm used to.
A sticky situation? What's happened?
A stone what...?!
A store room you mean?
A story of lies, no doubt. I don't know how you came to stand before me, human, but you are clearly no friend of mine. Leave now, before I bring down the might of the Ruinous Powers on you!
A story?
A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is one my dear old mammy told me as a pup...
A stout ceramic tankard with a Dragon Emblem on the side, the words, 'Ye Olde Dragon Inn' are inscribed in the bottom.
A stowaway, a jinx, AND a liar.
A straggler?
A strange attachment to an item that has no use after one's death.
A strange idea of balance! Thank you.
A strange man asked me to go into the Temple of Ikov and steal the Staff of Armadyl.
A strange object made of stone and vines found within the Fractured Archive. It looks like a key of some sort.
A strange wall which appears to have rubble blocking it, perhaps it can be cleared away?
A stranger in shadow with a black mask under their skin....
A string instrument. The string vibrates and makes a sound.
A strong cup of tea?
A strong cup of tea? What do you mean?
A sturdy looking cart for carrying barrels of rocks out of the mining camp.
A suit jacket?
A superpredator.
A surface goblin in the city? That's against the rules!
A surface goblin? What are you doing in the city?
A surfer at heart. That's where I got my start, but you can't take a cargo crate on a board, so being a sailor pays the bills!
A surgeon?
A sword with low quality is bad...
A sword? Why do you need me to make you one?
A symbol of death? You do not seem like a killer to me; perhaps some other symbol would suit you better.
A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
A sympathetic soul you are. I'm in real pain here.
A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
A tale!
A talented builder will see a vision there of the furniture they could build. Interact with that, and you should find you can build furniture.
A talisman linked to Zaros, so Terry says.
A talking skeleton? What is this?
A tanning vat? Ah, a shame. I used to stock such a product, before I knew the local tanner found it easier to just replace.
A teleport that could potentially take us to an ancient teleportation matrix. Persten reckons you might be able to use it to gain easier access to the runic altars.
A temple? There's an old dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle. Could this be what you seek, Bwana?
A terrible noise it made too!
A terrorbird is so fast, it can easily outrun any human athlete.
A test. Even back then I knew that Lowerniel needed to go. I wanted to see if a partnership with the Myreque was worth exploring.
A thick green mist seems to emanate from the water... It slowly congeals into the shape of a body.
A thingummy... what?
A thingummywut? Where? Where?
A thousand eyes... watching...
A thousand greetings, [sir/madam].
A thousand greetings, [sir/madam]. How can I help you?
A thousand greetings, madam. How goes your quest for ice cream?
A thousand greetings, sir.
A threat? But she's no danger to anyone. Why does he think that way?
A timer on your head-up display shows the remaining time before your gravestone will collapse.
A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
A tinderbox please.
A tinker doesn't get the respect that they used to... Gah! A thief took my bag in the night, they took everything.
A tiny, light-sensitive, transparent structure on top of the head that helps them regulate how long they stay in the sun.
A token bounces back out at you!
A touch of food poisoning perhaps.
A touch? Yes, I'll do that.
A tour to the rainforest, and then dinner in Tal Teklan.
A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
A toy doll
A trade? For a map of the best fishing spots in a hundred leagues? I will trade it for no less than a weather forecast from our Seer.
A trade? Yesss, that worksss well.
A trader in Ardougne
A tragedy, to be unequivocally certain.
A trait that is far too rare these days. More and more I find our work to be a beacon of light in this dark world.
A translation manual - yes, this should do the job.
A trap?
A trapdoor! Now what do you reckon the chances are that we can unlock it with that key?
A traveller passing through reckons he saw some of those goblins on the other side of the river playing with them.
A traveller? It's been a long time since I've had any company on this little island of mine.
A treasure hunt? That's exciting! Any tips to get me started?
A tree which is planted on Monday and doubles in size each day is fully grown on the following Sunday. On what day is it half grown?
A tree? No of course not! I am an elf, but through deep magic, I took on the form of a tree. It allowed me to hide, to stay safe.
A troll called My Arm wants a favour from you. He wants to grow goutweed and he thinks you can help.
A troll called My Arm wants a favour...
A troll child is named after the first thing they try to eat. This is tradition of troll people. My full name is Mother's Left One.
A troll?
A troublemaker? No, not necessarily. Had a habit of being in his own world a lot, wandering about unaware of a lot of things. Not a lick of survival instinct in him.
A true warrior.
A truly exciting tail of failing and needing to be rescued.
A truly marvellous invention, the likes of which you'll never behold again.
A two-eyed cyclops? Uh...wouldn't that be a normal giant perhaps?
A type of magic your people have forgotten, alongside many other things. I don't have time to catch you up on the history of the word though, so you'll need to learn more somewhere else.
A unique farming patch. This cave is the only place we've succesfully been able to grow a Hespori.
A unique password that I don't share, and 2 step verification on my email... got it.
A valiant effort!
A vampyre in the dungeon called Kroy was making infected Bloody Bracers. The local barkeep was then selling them to the townspeople.
A vampyre you shhay...?
A vampyre? This must have been a very long time ago.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: A vampyre? Well, I order you to do something about it at once!
A very fair point. My apologies.
A very good question. Anyone know?
A very honourable objective, but how do you suppose this will be possible?
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
A very small amount of steam seems to be coming out of the barrel.
A very wise choice, [sir/miss]. Don't eat it all at once, savour every morsel - that's my advice to you.
A victim dies and a murderer is punished. That is balance.
A victory earned. But there is room for improvement, is there not?
A vision? Curious...
A walk? Oh yes, that's what we're doing. We're just out here for a walk.
A wanderer?
A wandering merchant gave it to me. I never asked how he got it.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: A warhammer.
A warning to ya, too: annoy her and I'll haunt ya til yer hair turns white.
A warning traveller! The new world will rise from the underground!
A warrior in Rellekka
A warrior? Is that what you tell yourself? You killed him like he was a mere animal! A mere beast!
A watering can
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
A watering can.
A waterskin and a knife help you survive from the juice of a cactus. Use the chest to store your items, we'll take them to the bank. It's hot in the desert, you'll bake in all that armour.
A way or two.
A way to access the library?
A way to really get into the festive mood is to have delicious food that you only eat around this time of year.
A weakened, lame, old man.
A weapon perhaps, or an item of clothing?
A week ago he took a group of apprentice dark wizards and moved to Uzer, the lost city in the desert. We think he's going to use the city's ancient temple to summon the demon!
A week later about ten foot of tentacle washed up on the beach, with his rapier embedded in it to the hilt.
A week? He won't even last another day at the rate he's going!
A well executed retreat. You must be very practiced.
A well-placed frontline can turn a tide.
A what now?
A what?
A what? Come to think of it... That does sound pretty handy.
A what?!
A while ago, I managed to acquire the old journal of King Shayzien VII. I knew that I could use it to discredit Lord Shayzien and his family, so I made some arrangements.
A while back someone gave me an order to make a bunch of cyan dye, but they never came to collect it.
A while back, a group of travellers came through here, on their way to the dark lands of Morytania. They said they were from the College of Bards!
A whole land locked off for hundreds of years! Do you not want to be one of the first outsiders to step foot there? Think of the adventure!
A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
A wild goose? With a hat? Wait. Are you literally sending me on a wild goose chase?
A wine stained costume found in the backstage area. Apparently belongs to Naiatli, Livius' understudy.
A wise choice, little thing.
A wise choice, must be a first for you.
A wise choice. Go and see Harry at the fishing shop. He should be able to help.
A wise choice. It would seem that Brassica Prime smiles upon you.
A wise man knows when to step back.
A wise man once told me to never fear a drink... But perhaps I'm a little bias.

Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone but I am glad you like ze painting.
Ahh well, eet iz not for everyone.
Ahh yes someone did drop a statue on my head recently. Very nice workmanship, looks quite old and valuable too. I'm surprised someone threw it away!
Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell [madame/monsieur].
Ahh yes, it eez. Feel free to look around ze Museum some more.
Ahh yes, our resident magician from foreign lands created a most amazing gadget which can turn your own armour against you! It's really quite intriguing.

Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
Ahh yes, we've been meaning to make a display on that for some time. They sent us some information, too; I'm glad you reminded me, I'll get that done now. Display number 46, 5th Age, year 98.
Ahh yes. Taking samples. We've tried all the methods we can think of, but it seems to, well, change somehow.
Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'
Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. You can use bronze bars on the anvil outside with a hammer.
Ahh!
Ahh, I guess your right. Thanks!
Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...
Ahh, I see. But I warn you, stranger - extinguishing the flame of life is simple, but people rarely wish to face the consequences, and I doubt you are any different.
Ahh, I see. So where do I find this hammer?
Ahh, I see. The 'history' refers to that of the species - it doesn't necessarily mean it's died out. After all, we have human history and we're still here!

Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
Ahh, I'm hallucinating! Must cut back on sq'irks!
Ahh, [player name], it is useless to resist. Now we shall become as one.
Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
Ahh, a fellow sailor!
Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man a drink so that he may wet his throat and tell you of the strange happenings in this town.
Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man another drink so that he may wet his throat and talk to you.
Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
Ahh, der creature has dem... goodly, goodly. Now us can stick der chompy bird...
Ahh, farewell.
Ahh, good. Zis verse is from a poem by a most talented writer of ze poetry, Charles Baudelaire. My father would place me on 'is knee and read to me like zis...
Ahh, is this relating to that small museum near Ardougne?
Ahh, it is because I love the sea. The rushing waters, the endless horizon - it is beautiful! Also, I like the fresh fish.
Ahh, it is because I love ze sea. Ze rushing waters, ze endless horizon - it is beautiful! Also, I like ze fresh fish.
Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.

Ahh, my speciality. Being a historian, matters of the past are my passion. Collated on this floor and the one above are just part of my life's work. I am still working on updating and finding out more everyday, so if you find
Ahh, ok thanks.

Ahh, our saviour.
Ahh, salty I sea. You provoked me into this and now you'll feel the wrasse of my tongue.
Ahh, that hit the spot.
Ahh, that hits the spot.

Ahh, that's due to the numbering being done as we were constructing the cases and putting the displays in them, then shuffling them into the right places. We thought rather than renumbering them all - such a
Ahh, the Mother Mallum. Dear-oh-dear, this isn't good news at all.
Ahh, the Temple Knights...little is known of them.
Ahh, the flash mob phenomenon. Many have hypothesized that they are beings of great power sent to smite those who question the gods.
Ahh, the human shows signs of a brain. Why do you think that is?
Ahh, the penny drops. You got me to do your dirty work for you.
Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
Ahh, the shrine - the future, our destiny, our heritage.
Ahh, then this all makes sense. Yes, this is very good.
Ahh, there's nothing like a nice cuppa tea. I know what, I'll tell you a story to thank you for the lovely tea...
Ahh, those. We're slowly filling them up with the help of people who have their Earth Sciences exams completed at the Dig Site. If you have, feel free to give us a hand. We'd appreciate it.

Ahh, very clever. Well I'm sure I can let you borrow some, as long as you look after them. Just grab one of the cages from behind my house. You'll want some bird feed as well. I should have some in my cupboard.
Ahh, well you see...when you take hot liquid metal and cool it instantly, it becomes rock hard straight away. That's how blacksmiths make their weapons and armour.
Ahh, wyverns. The extinct lizards.
Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love. Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?

Ahh, yes, our token system is designed to allow you an appropriate amount of time with my discovery in the very top floor of the guild. I won't spoil the surprise as to what that is. Go up and see for yourself. Now, the
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
Ahh, you are very kind.
Ahh, you came to the right man; odd things, those trees. What is it you are needing exactly?
Ahh, you're a good egg... Happy Easter [player name]!
Ahh, you're back. Have you spoken to the princess yet, old mushroom?
Ahh, you've done a grand job on that sword. It's exactly what I need to help with that part of my painting.
Ahh.
Ahh. Right. No.
Ahh.. our guildmaster, Harrallak, went on an expedition there. He brought them back with him.

Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
Ahh... Stop, stop stop!
Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
Ahh... [player name]. Welcome to Tirannwn. I understand you've been sent here to rid us of that criminal Tyras. I offer my full support.
Ahh... adventurer. The repair work on the Well of Voyage has been completed. We're finally ready to move against my brother.
Ahh... good to see you back. Are you after more crystal equipment?
Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?
Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.
Ahh... the Stronghold of Security. It's down there.
Ahhh [player name], I knew you had potential when I first met you. My compliments on reaching the pinnacle of your achievements.
Ahhh good! I need to take it back to be buried!
Ahhh!
Ahhh! Smashin...urrghh...deal!
Ahhh, I new you were a big softie.
Ahhh, I see.

Ahhh, a true classic.
Ahhh, but not beans like this, young [player name]. No, not at all! These are 'magic' beans.
Ahhh, dummies.
Ahhh, feel the fresh breeze!
Ahhh, good day young adventurer. A good day indeed! Sylas is the name. It is lucky for you that you met me.
Ahhh, good day young adventurer. I can't stop to talk right now I'm afraid.
Ahhh, harvest day!
Ahhh, hello there my friend. You look like you could do with some assistance.
Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
Ahhh, hello there. How can I help?
Ahhh, how sweet. Kitty want a cuddle?
Ahhh, it no use, I too sad!

Ahhh, tea is so refreshing!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, the youth of today. So sure of their prowess. But who am I to stop you from walking into your doom, if that is what you wish to do!
Ahhh, two tentacles!
Ahhh, yer me besht mate... mate.

Ahhhh

Ahoy!

Ahoy, to fish, you click on the shrimp fishin' spot while ye'r carrying a net.

Ahrim's robeskirt

Airy Fairy?
Aivas!

Akka akka!
Akka!

Akthanakos set out from Senntisten on an unauthorised mission. Status unknown.
Akthanakos the Mahjarrat

Al Kharid?

Al Zaba Bhasim is a figment of your diseased imagination. Go look for him yourself and waste your own time if you think he still exists.
Alan hands over your purchase.

Alas friend, another day of hopelessness for me.

Alas!
Alas! Alas!

Alas, I am, quite unfortunately, not rich in money. What I do possess is a certain wealth...

Alas, I do not sense that you have been successful in your fishing yet. The look in your eyes is not that of the osprey.
Alas, I have no cabbages either...
Alas, I've hit a bit of a blocker. The scroll has led me here but as I don't really know the area, I'm not sure what to do next.
Alas, according to records, the party never returned and were declared to have perished in the field.
Alas, my spell is not very accurate, so it will deposit everything you have upon you into your bank, not just your armour and weapons.
Alas, my throat has dried up, and I cannot speak... perhaps another drink would help?
Alas, no. Focussed and determined in my trade as I was, I never found a suitable wife.
Alas, one of the guards has taken the key to the mines to be copied. Report in regularly and I will see that you get a copy as soon as he gets back.
Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
Alas, so far we've had no luck. We're also scanning for energy that matches what we observed during that earthquake he caused, but again, nothing has been discovered so far.
Alas, that openness is what ultimately led to disaster. The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name.
Alas, that was a long time ago. I've since passed away.
Alas, that was ultimately our undoing. We learned of a horde of barbarians pillaging across the land, hunting down and killing anyone who dared use magic.

texto: Alas, the influence of chaos had grave results. We lost control of many. Those that became corrupt had to be locked away, but by then it was already too late.
Alas, there is a small minority who will never be at rest. These have been slain in moments of insanity by their brothers or by adventurers.

Alas, they were trapped and could not steal the precious records. But before they could be defeated, the bravest of them took it upon himself to blast the writings into nothingness, destroying the library.
Alas, whatever happened seemed to cause them great pain, making them to go feral. They are now at peace though, thanks to you.
Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
Alchemists return the other day. Me turn them into animals.
Alcoholic? I'll have you know that I, Pavo, am most certainly not an alcoholic. Now scram.

Alert!

All I can offer in return is material wealth. Please take these coins as a sign of my gratitude.

All I can tell you about are the three individuals that I knew personally.

All I know is what the trees tell me. It will soon be time for me to pass the guardianship of the spirit trees to someone else. Maybe that person is you.
All I need from you is the spell that will teleport me to this essence mine. That should be sufficient for the armies of Zamorak to once more begin stockpiling magic for war.
All I remember is that I was working near the tents when I lost it.
All I wanted was sweets, but [player name] won't give me any!

As I say, being a navigator is a real skill - you really have to think on your feet!
As I say, my knowledge outside of this town is rather limited, and I know no more than this. Was there anything else you wished to hear tell of?
As I say, spinning yarn is just one of the many things you can do when it comes to crafting. I can't help too much with the others, but in time, I'm sure you'll end up learning more yourself.
As I say, the enchantment is very inaccurate.
As I say, the situation has been dealt with for now. Besides, the only reason that situation existed in the first place is because of these ruins.
As I say, when our order was founded, we were expected to take the best of the best, and it was assumed that anyone worth having on the team would have been a White Knight already, what?
As I see it, yes.
As I stand here, the healers toil to save the life of the Teokan of Ralos.
As I told your fool of a Spymaster, Neitiznot's militia are not going to attack you.
As I understand it Pirate Regulation number 445-328 required him to have been checking the sails.
As I understand it there's some kind of hidden treasure in these parts...
As I understand it, it was something to do with the Staff of Armadyl, and your refusal to tell Saradomin that it had been stolen...
As I was saying about a month ago I noticed that the yield on my prize rose bushes had dropped slightly. I immediately suspected Crown Gall, a disease that can be fatal to a Mister Lincoln.
As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
As I was tracking it, I was attacked and knocked out. When I came to, it was gone.
As I'm in an especially good mood I think I will let you have some. But you have to do something for me first.
As I'm sure you are aware, your father the King is seeking someone to rule the Kingdom in his stead. I have put myself forward, but in order for me to become ruler...
As I'm sure you have now guessed, he had discovered a portal leading to the mythical Rune Essence. As soon as he told me of this spell, I saw the importance of his find,
As I'm sure you will believe, I was most upset as the pendant was a gift from my mother. I simply must get it back somehow.
As I've already told you, I have little interest in this business of yours. Why should I help you?
As Ralos is the sun god, any normal bone just won't do. I'd recommend the bones of any dragon.
As Santa's delegate, I have granted you an Anti-Santa costume. Wear it and scare the pixies. With the Santa suit you got me, I will then persuade them that I have saved them.
As Saradomin has told us, 'a good deed is its own reward'.
As Saradomin was, yes. As Saradomin is now? Who can say?
As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.
As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.
As Taverley no longer seems to be safe, we've decided it best that we establish a base of operations for this new alliance at the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
As Tyras was the king of West Ardougne, King Lathas decided to cordon the city off to keep the rest of the world safe.
As TzHaar grow older we lose heat and begin to solidify. Drawing heat from the volcano allows us to prolong this process.
As Zulrah's skin is shed, the scales fall to the bottom of the swamp, where I believe the eels are permitted to consume them. Thus the eels become sacred, dumb though they are.
As [he's/she's] not known for [his/her] random touristic activities, you should try chatting with this [Turael/Aya]. [He's/She's] the Slayer Master near Burthorpe.
As a Hardcore player, you can't leave Death's office on this world. Please switch to a Hardcore world to exit.
As a Seer to the clan, I value intelligence very highly, so you may think of it as an intelligence test of sorts.
As a Temple Knight yourself, I have no doubt you understand that we sometimes need to make difficult choices for the good of this world.
As a bank employee, I suppose I could take the money directly from your bank account.
As a builder, in your own house, you can create your own rooms full of furniture. A house may start out very basic...
As a cook, you must have prepared a lot of nourishing meals. I need a memento of the Cooking process, and one for the Hitpoints restored by the food.
As a doctor I can tell you that sometimes a bad back can manifest as a headache.
As a famously experienced builder, perhaps you could help me, please. I need a memento of Construction, something to invoke the memories of training the skill. Perhaps a saw.
As a fellow actor, she had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar where Livius was having his pre- performance drink.
As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!
As a general rule, tougher monsters drop more valuable items. But even a lowly hobgoblin can drop valuable gems; it just does this extremely rarely.
As a gesture for my intervening on your behalf, I'd take it as a kindness if you would deliver a message to him.
As a holy man, you will surely be an expert on training the Prayer skill. Can you offer me a memento of your training, please?
As a human grows, they are taught to put childish thoughts aside. Yet the childish thoughts of a Gnome Child can far outstrip the shallow reckonings of humankind. Consider...
As a last farewell, I'll gather you some more food before I go.
As a little thank you for the help!
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
As a major enemy of the White Knights we have had him under observation for some time now, so it was pretty lucky that Solus decided to visit him.
As a mark of my gratitude for slaying my nemesis, the foul Troll King, I offer you my helm.
As a matter of fact - I do!
As a matter of fact I will! I'm not wasting my time on the likes of you!
As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
As a matter of fact, I do! However, it's the last in stock and I'm not likely to get more for a while so it's highly prized amongst the wizards at the moment.
As a matter of fact, I do! I was recently doing some research on cabbages. I was able to extract their essence and combine it with a t-
As a matter of fact, I do. I have one right here. I earnt my place here at the longhall for surviving over 5000 battles and raiding parties.
As a matter of fact, [player name], I do...

As a member of our gang, you now have access to our hideout and our weapons supply depot. The hideout is just through this door and the depot is two doors down from here. You'll need this key to get in.
As a memorial of that event, there can be no finer artefact than a blue party hat from the Wise Old Man.
As a navigator, the weather is extremely important for plotting the best course. Unfortunately the Seer is always too busy to help me with a forecast.
As a personal reward for your help, you can have this key to open the chest on the floor above.
As a reminder, I can't make you very many without risking an audit, so I'll have to stop at nine planks.
As a result of that action, the assistant was offered a job for life as head cook of Lumbridge, for himself and all his future descendants.

As a result, I had a wall built around West Ardougne to act as a barrier between him and the rest of the world. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.
As a result, Imafore ordered General Nemus to burn the entire valley to the ground to stop the Kourend advance. Many would have died on both sides, but Nemus refused the order.
As a reward, I suggest you keep the ancient goblin mace that you helped to excavate.
As a reward, I'll let ye use me full banking services!
As a reward, not only may you keep your disguise, but also, this giant candy cane, and a few other things.
As a starting point, you may wish to deal with the two humans that stand among you, unless of course you've all become so weak that you can't even do that anymore...
As a thank you for all that you've done, we'd like the two of you to be the first to enter Prifddinas.
As a thank you for looking after them, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
As a token of my own thanks, I give you access to the pass through Arandar. You'll find the start of the trail in the far north east of the woods.
As a way to challenge ourselves, when we were a bit younger, we would knit the most horrifying Halloween costumes, then wear them and scare passers-by out of their wits!
As a wyrd, I hunger far more than a normal vampyre. It... disgusts me, to be honest. However, it does mean I am a perfect test subject for Sugadinti.
As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...
As all things should be.
As am I.
As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.
As an Iron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
As an Ironman, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
As an Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman] you cannot use the bank.
As an accomplished collector I'd like to offer you a special reward.
As an added bonus, some of my assignments include creatures which are more lucrative than they normally would be. I'll point this out when offering your assignments, so keep your eyes peeled.
As an added bonus, you get to bring a plus one with you to the pub!
As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
As an artefact of historical importance, I can use its inherent powers to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories, where I reside.
As an outpost it was approved, so here our people moved.
As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.
As are many, my young friend. Is the king meant to leave Misthalin unguarded on the whim of some errant adventurer?
As are we all, but I really can't talk about them. It's not a subject easily broached here.
As are we. You've made a very good impression on us all.
As bad as you'd expect. I'd rather not talk about it.
As before, a piece of paper slides out between the crates wooden slats. You take it.
As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
As best as we can. He must feed. That is not something that can be avoided, but I have been making him potions to help him stay in control.
As captain, I was first envoy to the Moon Clan and took seat with their dignitaries and the higher ranking members of their tribe, the Oneiromancer, Baba Yaga and so forth.
As commander of the 'Royal Guard' your duty is surely to royalty, not to some Council.
As cute as they are, they cannot just stay here.
As dark as ever, my friend. The vyrewatch have doubled their efforts to find us since the death of Ranis and the citizens are being tithed more than ever before.
As did he. Impersonating a god bears the highest penalty imaginable, but I did not think that kind of justice would be delivered by the hand of an outerlander.
As do I. If it's not though, we'll make sure they remember us until the end of their days.
As do I...
As do we in Crux Eqal.
As do you, adventurer.
As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
As easy as a troll.
As everybody knows, time flows from north to south, so my freezing time means that this room has apparently stretched slightly along its horizontal axis.
As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
As expected, this is going swimmingly.
As far as I understand, the 10th squad were sent to oversee the decommission of Glough's shipyard in east Karamja.
As for an end goal... that information is only for senior members.
As for if I'll be okay when we find him? The truth is that I don't think I'll know until we do, so we may as well get to it.
As for imprisonment... Solus is a highly dangerous man not just because of his mastery of the magical arts, but for his uncanny resourcefulness.
As for me personally, I'm the current master of this guild.

As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
As for me, I'm going to keep studying them. I've learnt so much today, both from Isadora and from the ents themselves. I've already documented it all, but I'm sure there's more to discover!
As for me, I'm many things, and I admit, a lot of them aren't good. But I would never throw lives away like you did.
As for my progress, you can tell Lucien that the investigations would be greatly expedited if I weren't subject to all these interruptions!
As for our next move, I've got...friends...elsewhere who should hear of this information, but we have plenty of time. It's not as though they made a break through in their research or something.
As for resources, you'll need 2 logs, 2 pieces of tanned leather and 15 nails.
As for specifics, I can't cover every skill, but I can give you a few tips for some of the more common ones.
As for the Grand Library, it was a great archive of knowledge beneath Prifddinas. Pretty much everything there was open to all of elven kind.
As for the child, he grew to become a mighty hero. After defending the town from a goblin attack, he took on the name Arrav, a curse word in goblin tongue, for he had become the Curse of Goblins.
As for the forces of Lucien and Zamorak, we spotted a clash between the two factions in some of the deeper tunnels. An army of skeletons facing off against a group of Zamorakian mages.
As for the fragment of Seren... I wish there had been another way.
As for the grinding part, all you have to do is use a pestle and mortar on it, that ought to get it sorted.
As for the one who chooses to practise such dark arts... He will be punished. I will make it my life's purpose...
As for the remaining seeds, maybe you could visit another trader. I know there was one by a bank, but I can't remember where that bank was.
As for the scutes, they get shed quite regularly, so it shouldn't be too hard to find a few dotted around the island.
As for the second, I think it's obvious why Lowerniel wanted to put a stop to that. Just ask Ranis why that research maybe wasn't overly wise.
As for the top, you'll need to find a way to get it cleaned. Maybe you can find someone who does a lot of laundry. Someone who wears lots of white might be a good bet.
As for the vampyre, the priests of old would incapacitate the ones they'd trapped with the blessings of Saradomin. Perhaps there's a way for you do the same.
As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.
As for what this place is, it is my glorious still, producing the best quality 'rum' this side of Braindeath Island.
As for what those plans are, as I say, you'll need to ask Father Sugadinti.
As for when I knew for sure, I had a strong hunch, but it was just that until you led us to her.
As for where in Morytania, I can't imagine he'd have made it too far from Paterdomus.

As for where to sell things, that depends. The quick and easy way is to sell to a General Store. They're easy to find and will accept almost anything, but they're unlikely to give you the best prices.
As for who I am... Well, that is of no importance.
As for who I am... well. That is of no concern to you, human.
As for who I am... well. That is of no concern to you.
As for whose head... well, perhaps I'll let you impose your own artistic vision on it.
As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.

texto: As for you though, this is where you come when you die.
As for you, I'd say you've earnt a small break. Take whatever time you need to prepare, then meet me at the tomb once you're ready.
As for you, Robert...
As for you, what can you tell me about the chasm?
As for your part in all this, [player name], with this being a fancy party and all, I'm going to need a butler to help me fit in.
As good as all of that sounds, I do have just a few issues with it.
As good as can be expected. We lost a fair few, but it could have been much worse.
As good as can be, all things considered. I idolised my grandfather for years. They always say you should never meet your heroes though, now I see why.
As good as the palace guards are, I don't know if they're up to taking on a very powerful demon.
As he crawled forward two yellow slitted eyes appeared in the gloom before him. He froze in fear!
As he grasped the axe he realised it was a lot heavier than it looked! In fact much heavier indeed! He couldn't hold it or stop it falling off the wall!
As if I don't have enough work to do. Seems I don't have a choice.
As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
As if life in this city couldn't get any worse. Where am I going to find the money?
As if the cold weren't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus magi always look down their noses at the Shayzien armies, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
As if those 'clothes' you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
As if those clothes you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
As if to threaten me, their King, with petty tricks if I do not hand over treats!
As if you could do better!
As if you don't know! It's that dark city to the east where humans are kept like animals to feed those greedy evil vampyres!
As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
As in Dimintheis Fitzharmon? Sounds like I'd better pay him a visit.
As in nothing. It's just a load of rubbish. Why would Serafina have written this?
As in under the water!
As in, kill them, kill them?
As it 'appens, the bloke who sold me the 'untin' stock fer me shop wouldn' stop talkin', so I picked a bit up. Got some local info, or further out. Whatcha wantin'?
As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethren instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
As it goes, yes I have. It's a long story.
As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.
As it happens the principle is much the same as the backpack we made.
As it happens, I do.
As it happens, I have one right here.
As it happens, I'm carrying a note for enough rope on me right now.
As it happens, I'm carrying enough rope on me right now.
As it happens, a recent discovery of dragon limbs has allowed the creation of such a crossbow.
As it so happens I was on my way to the lower city to look into that very issue. However, on my way past, I heard shouting.
As it so happens, I do need some wooden planks!
As it turns out, no. Mudfoot here is actually trying to deal with the thieves as well.
As last task to proive you really are one of us, you need to go in Lumbridge and steal from human. Collect precious item for us.
As long as I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.
As long as I can remember. So far we've not found any way out of this place, and after all, we couldn't leave these poor humans to fend for themselves.
As long as I have my store, I'll keep selling my Crafting equipment! Would you like to buy any?
As long as I'm around.
As long as it contains only local crops.
As long as it is just the one favour...
As long as it isn't cold.
As long as it isn't poisoned.
As long as it keeps the crows away, most things should do!
As long as it maintains the balance in my stomach.
As long as it not tree, General Wartface happy.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
As long as the Sun in the sky gives me strength.
As long as they can buy us.
As long as they do not have their statuette of Elidinis to pray to, then we
As long as we remain vigilant and praise the Sun, all will be well.
As long as you are aware of how powerful they are, and that I can trust you won't lost it.
As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Fremennik.
As long as you're sure! I usually dig some snow from the snow piles that form around the city, and then roll that snow into snowballs.
As long as you're sure.
As long as you're up for the challenge of fighting them of course!
As long as your friend is a barrel full of rocks. I don't think it would be a problem at all! Ha ha ha!
As many different ones as you can find. Bring them here and I'll try them out.
As most lizards cannot maintain their own body temperature, two theories as to how they managed to survive have been proposed.
As most people know, cadava berries are quite poisonous. When used in the right quantity, they can put someone into a deep sleep. Use the wrong amount...
As much as I hate it, I know that sometimes death is the only option. I like to think we can consider alternatives though. It's what sets us apart from the enemy.
As much as I hate to admit it, I'm far too old to pass as a knight. It will have to be you.
As much as I hate to agree with a White Knight, he's right. We need to work together if we are going to survive.
As much as I love your costume, I'd like to see some other people's as well!
As much as I love your costume, why not show it to some other people as well?
As much as I need to protect the secret, I should not carry it to the grave.
As much as I respect your fanaticism, that was spectacularly unhelpful.
As my first assistant, you will always be welcome to use a balloon. You'll have to bring your own fuel, though.
As my kinsmen have mentioned, there is a foul beast dwelling in the caves on the northernmost isle.
As nice as that looks, I think I'll give it a miss for now.
As nice as this queue is, I am missing out on my daily steps.
As official tailor for Kourend, I can recolour this clothing, allowing adventurers to represent the city to which they are most loyal.
As outlined in subsection C, if you wish for your revenge to feel more 'real', I am willing to lift some of the restrictions placed by the original contract.
As outlined in your contract, he wishes them slain in particular ways.

As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
As previously discussed, I learned the importance of understanding others and my surroundings. That with this knowledge I can learn to help myself.
As promised, I have your Quality Violet Tulip seed. Just come back once you have room for it.
As promised, here's your Quality Violet Tulip seed.
As promised, your reward; my new invention!
As proof of all this, I want you to bring back the completed map and a token of the Kharazi's esteem - something we can put on display.
As punishment for their squabbling he banished his sons from his realm, ordering that neither should return until they had conquered lands of their own.
As ready as I'll ever be. What about you?
As ready as we'll ever be. Let's do this.
As soon as I get my axe back. It's with the blacksmith, but he seems too busy to even talk to me. Think you can help get it back?
As soon as I've figured out how to make it change the colour of the pumpkin...
As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
As soon as it's up and running, I can spin your clothes for you.
As soon as the monkeys arrived in Lumbridge, things started getting out of hand...
As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.
As soon as you get on the cart, it starts to move. Before too long you are past the gates. You jump off the cart taking Ana with you.
As soon as you mentioned it, I wondered if there might be a connection.
As soon as you're ready.
As soon as you're ready. From what I hear, the protest is getting close to breaking point. We can't waste any more time.
As soon as you've got somewhere to put it I'll hand it over. I'll keep it nice and holy until then.
As such, before any final decision is made, there's something I'd like to look into when it comes to Lord Shayzien.
As such, we'd be grateful if you could help us control their numbers.
As thanks for your help, young [man/woman/one], please take this amulet of mine.
As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
As that foul construct over there proves.
As the Attacker, you will be taking the poisoned yellow eggs from the Healer...

As the Defender, the only way to stop these Penance is to lure them towards traps on the floor. There is one each at the east and west edges of the arena.
As the Defender, you will be taking the spiked, poisoned yellow eggs from the Attacker...
As the Defender, you will have to stop the Penance Runners.
As the Healer, you will be taking the yellow eggs from the Collector...
As the axe fell, the poor gnome could not get out of the way in time and the razor sharp blade fell CRACK! And it killed him instantly.
As the best fisherman in the guild it is my duty to control who has access to the guild and to say who can buy similar skillcapes and the cape can even teleport you right inside the guild.
As the councillor responsible for public health and safety here in East Ardougne, I am in charge of dealing with this problem.
As the crystal touches your hands a voice inside of your head says... Bring life to the dragon's eye.
As the cultist dies, Attala arrives in the chamber...
As the day draws to an end, you suddenly feel very tired. You close your eyes...
As the final blow to our morale, Morgan turned Arthur into a granite statue before our very eyes. He was taken away by the Black Knights, for what purposes I know not.
As the fish lured by the fly.
As the furnace cools down, you dig through the coal and find a fully formed chromium ingot.
As the magical stones rotate they generate a magical current in the conductor cables, and that powers the light!
As the medallion and tablet are held together, a surge of power connects the two. After a brief moment, the tablet crumbles, and the medallion feels somehow different.
As the old woman drinks the cup of milky tea, enlightenment glows from within her eyes.
As the records chronicle more of your deeds here, you may find the Archive itself looks upon you favourably, Defender.
As the swallow carries the coconut, the body must toil.
As the two groups came together, the population of the region started to rapidly expand. This eventually led to the construction of Tempestus, and with it, the founding of Varlamore.
As the war drew to a close, they were called to one final battle. The enemy knew they were losing, and they fought more ferociously than ever before.

As the warlord falls to the ground, a ghostly vapour floats upwards from his battle-worn armour. Out of sight you hear a shrill scream in the still air. You spot the orbs of protection among his remains.
As the years went by, our numbers dwindled and many spoke of abandoning the town for safer lands. Then, Necrovarus came to us.
As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
As they passed me I felt a sense of dark foreboding, something I have not felt since the great enemy was nearby. I fear they are planning some great evil.
As they stormed his home, Lord Hazeel made preparations for his eventual return. We, his faithful followers, have been working to bring that about ever since.
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 750,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 900,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.
As time went on, folk started to go missing and I knew I had to return home and face this demon.
As usual, our lord was guarded well, but this was why Zamorak had brought his most trusted fighters with him.
As usual, you are restricted to certain regions around Gielinor - although you'll get to choose which ones.
As was our duty.
As we entered the house we were hit by a horrendous smell - it was quite surprising.
As we hunt the bonny shoals of herring.
As we progressed further, we became more experienced at creating the traps. Each one was more deadly than the last.
As we revere in the number six, let us recall that there are six elements to a tragedy. My favourite of these is Thought; I am pleased to stand on this dance floor indulging in it.
As we speak, my forces are dealing with the last of your rebels and rounding up your citizens. You have no way to fight, and nowhere to run.
As we speak, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
As we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
As well as any humans can. All settlements in Morytania must pay the vampyres in blood tithes, but the people of Slepe do so willingly.
As well as can be expected. However, he has decided it's best that we work with Vanescula.
As well as can be expected. My guilt is a heavy load. A lot of people died because of me.
As well as can be expected. You saw for yourself the horrifying effects the vampyrification process had on him.
As well as her, we have a tormented demon, only this one seems to be fully in control of its flames, lending it both greater power and durability.
As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.

As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.

He is rather vain, if you'll pardon my saying so; he will greatly appreciate any compliments on his poetry. He also has quite a sweet tooth.
He is safe and sound, thanks to you my friend!
He is short-tempered, arrogant and cares little about anything except outdoing Neitiznot's Burgher.
He is standing just over there. He will speak for the tribe.
He is surely plotting a new plan to defeat me.

He is the Director of the Red Axe. Ha, that old fool quite fancies his own head up on that statue, he thinks he can get away with that just because his company is one of the largest in the Consortium.
He is the head of the Legends Guild. His full name is Radimus Erkle. Would you like to talk to him about the quest?
He is the leader of the Knights of Varlamore, though I am currently filling that role in his absense.

He is the leader of the notorius desert bandits, they plague us daily. You should find them west of here. You should have no problem in finishing them all of. Do this for me and maybe I will consider helping you.
He is the real threat here. You can kill as many dragons as you want in this battle, but it won't be over until Zorgoth himself is dealt with.
He is too busy dancing to talk!
He is usually working just to the south of the town.
He is very capable, but he reminds me of some of the druids back home. The ones that ultimately led us to form Crux Eqal.
He is well. Defeating Jonas has really helped him return to normal. He even said he wants to go traveling now.
He is, he's the only family I have left. The rest of them died in his war. A war that will finally end today.
He is. But it's not just me this time. This time there's all of us. And Vanescula too, assuming she doesn't betray us.
He is. I told him about Rose.
He is?
He is? Aww man...
He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.
He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.
He keeps trying to sell me these barmy looking weapons he's invented. I can't see them working, personally.
He kidnap Chosen Commander? You must rescue her!
He killed them! It was like they were nothing! He killed them, and all I could do was watch!
He knew, you know! They all did. They were more than happy with my work while it was secret. But now they betray me without a second thought, just to protect themselves!
He left in a hurry one day; something in the shaft scared him to death, but he didn't say what.
He left our family home in Hosidius to hunt it down and...
He left this for you.
He left this for you. I'll leave it in the tent at my camp for you to pick up.
He left to explore the world. Learning by experience, or so he said. Me, I prefer a cold stout at home, but it takes all sorts.
He let you go? Why?
He lives in his brother's house.
He lives in the upper part of the city, but the slaves won't be there. He has a prison north of the Arboretum. That's where you'll find them.
He lives on a cliff at the very south end of Asgarnia, just south of Port Sarim. I can visit him again if you like.
He lives on a shipwreck to the east of here. He remembers you and wishes you well.
He lives quite a good deal closer to where the Imcando used to live than we do, so it is not unlikely. Tell him Hugi the librarian sent you and I'm sure he'll be happy to help.
He look dumb, but he kinda big.
He looked like some sort of mountain climber. He said he was setting out on some sort of journey that was very important to him.
He looks too sick to chat.
He lost his left arm to a canister round, but that didn't stop him much.
He lost his wife, his people and his kingdom. Now he's in a strange place, surrounded by strange people, helping to fight a war that he lost a long time ago.
He loves choc bombs.
He loves tangled toads legs.
He loves worm holes.
He loves you way more than he lets on. The other chest I gave you is actually from him, and the code to open it represents his feelings towards you.
He made a big deal about it to Mary the Maid, calling her useless and incompetent. I felt quite sorry for her actually. You'd really have to ask him though.
He makes a fair point, [player name].
He may be willing to share his plans with you, assuming you are disguised with a greegree, that is.
He may well have tried, but I bet we scared off a lot of his supporters.
He means Zanik.
He mentioned something about airships being built off the coast of Ape Atoll.
He might also know more about what Amascut is planning. I did free a guard from Amascut's control through combat. I could try that again.
He might be gone a while though. The nearest outhouse is all the way over on Fossil Island.
He might be in trouble, I could help.
He might have an opinion on that. You two are going to have to figure this out. Together.
He might have assumed you're good at climbing, since you actually live on a mountain!
He might not, but our host Constantinius does.
He might not, but we need to at least try to convince him.
He most probably got drunk and lost in the forest!
He must be gaining in power again. If you can defeat him he will be banished from this plane for a while. You will need this pendant to attack him.
He must be hungry by now!
He must be nearby. I'll go and fetch him.
He must be really tough!
He must be somewhere nearby. Get it planted on him and then get yourself back to Falador.
He must die!
He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
He must have been trying to protect his Diamond...
He must have done something very bad then.
He must have fought valiantly against the dragon because they say that, to this day, she has a scar down her side,
He must have gone back. I'll go and fetch him.
He must have had a ring of life! It looks like he got away from us this time, Zanik.
He must have stored one of his best spells in this tablet, perhaps he has some sort of device which could utilise it?
He needed you to open the vault.
