texto: He needs to improve his technique - but he does not heed my advice.
He needs to pay for what he's done though.
He never explained why, only said that it had to be that way.
He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
He never told us his name.
He old high priest in temple crypt behind me! He dead!
He once dyed a set green in an accident with exploding swamp toads. That was quite something.
He only left recently, maybe you can pick up his trail. Have a look around the hidden entrance to the village, by the wolves, and see if you can find anything out of place.
He opened the parcel, and out fell a toy doll.
He opened the parcel, and out fell a toy doll. Derek didn't want a doll, so he threw it to the back of his toy cupboard and left it there.
He opened the parcel, and out fell...
He plans to make a fleet of warships from the Grand Tree's wood!
He pray to his stupid god to help him. Means he protected. You do close up poke, he pray to stop close up poke. You do far away throw, he pray to stop far away throw.
He probably deserved it.
He promptly declared war, claiming the land of Etceteria belonged to Miscellania.
He pulled himself over to it. In his desperation he thought to himself, there's a sandwich here. A sandwich! Maybe the skeleton will eat that instead?
He put them inside stone! Big hole open in ground and they all go into cave.
He puts a lot of faith in his god. I don't necessarily fault that. As a loyal servant of Guthix, it would be very hypocritical of me to do so.
He quickly grasped the sandwich in his little hands. Strangely, in his panic-stricken state, he noticed that it was long and tubular shaped.
He quickly remembered that if he buried them he could get his prayer up and so might be able to cast a heal spell on his legs!
He ran his tests and discovered nothing. The plague... it doesn't exist.
He realised that neither of us have an army.
He really big though.
He really does have exceptional co-ordination.
He really knew how to swing a pickaxe, but where did that get him?!
He really shouldn't worry, I'm fine. I'll head home as soon as I've finished here.
He recently spotted Zemouregal entering an old fort near the mountain of Trollweiss.
He reckons he's too good for the likes of us.
He reckons his canoes are better than mine. He's never said it to my face though.
He reminds me of a story my father once told me. A story of a broken man.
He resides in our longhall; it is the large building over there, you should speak to him for he speaks for us all.
He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.
He revealed the truth to me, that King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth are in fact the evil ones. Together they intend to summon this Dark Lord.
He ripped his opponent in half!
He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please deliver it to him soon.
He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please, take this package of research notes to him. If all goes well, the secrets of the essence mine may soon be ours once more!
He said I had no business spreading the word of Saradomin anywhere near his home. He said it was an affront to his order, whatever that means. He then threatened to get violent if I did it again!
He said I should collect something from you and bring it to him, a report or something.
He said as much. So what can we do?
He said he needed a walk. I told him not to, but he insisted he'd be fine.
He said he was a tailor, but those scissors looked more like a weapon than something used for Crafting.
He said he was attacked by an unknown assailant.
He said he was on some kind of search for treasure, or gold, or something out in the desert east of Lumbridge. You might want to ask the traders there about him.
He said he was organising a Halloween treat for some children, and he's got me decorating the local church crypt for it.
He said he was planning to set up a magic carpet network, like our gliders.
He said he would be able to.
He said he'd be back in a minute. But never mind him - go to Falador and talk to this wizard!
He said it was because they stole his diamond! But they never did! They found it, and didn't know who it belonged to!
He said it would take some time for the city to open.
He said she was a threat to Ardougne.
He said something about fighting kalphites, whatever they are.
He said something about leading his forces into battle, but I didn't hear the Burgher use the word 'champion'.
He said something after he gave it to me.
He said that Tyras was taken by the Dark Lord while exploring the lands to the west. He claimed that the Dark Lord corrupted him by forcing him to drink from the Chalice of Eternity.
He said that he was sure Arposandra was somewhere between here and the edge of the world.
He said that if we disguised ourselves as soldiers, we could convince both the King and Queen that they were under attack. And it almost worked, too.
He said that the only new arrivals on the island were some teenagers, who came from Rellekka to visit their relatives.
He said to tell you, 'We of the blood are still loyal. Pavlov is the messenger.'
He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.
He said we need to make an offering at the altar and gave me a riddle... A riddle is provided depending on the day, a full list can be found here.
He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
He said you might know more about the missing goods.
He said, 'What's the point? Why do I defy such HOPELESSNESS? No-one will ever help me'.
He said, 'Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place? Feel my ANGER!'.
He said...
He saved me once you know. Some of Lord Iorwerth's men found me in the forest. There were too many for me to fight off, I thought I was done for. Without Arianwyn, I wouldn't be here today.
He saw a big axe leaning on the wall.
He saw a hole he could just fit through.
He saw a small sandwich on the floor.
He saw some bones lying in the corner.
He saw your weapon before the attack! Try again.
He say [Bentnoze/Wartface] is leader but real leader is [Wartface/Bentnoze]!
He say he see da strange shadow.
He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
He says he needs to know what the head of the statue should look like now that it's no longer going to look like King Alvis.
He says he's fine.
He says he's looking for his quest!
He says he's very sorry...
He says hello, and this is Kikazaru
He scratches his head...
He screamed 'Off with their heads' while flailing around with a Halberd...
He seemed very curious, and used to watch me do my researches. I liked the companionship – research is lonely work...
He seems convinced that the artefact you stole from him is responsible for him becoming cursed to be an invisible ghost.
He seems keen for you to marry Juliet.
He seems to be coming this way.
He seems to be filling a vial with water.
He seems to be in deep concentration.
He seems to be lost in his own thoughts...
He seems to be mining some tin ore.
He seems to be mixing a potion.
He seems to be okay. At least, as okay as anyone could be in that situation. He seems to still be focused, and he's not lost his sense of humour.
He seems to be picking some berries.
He seems to be picking some wheat.
He seems to be using a potion on the altar.
He seems to have a pulse.
He seems to have been researching something new of late. He's been sighted in many libraries all across the world.
He seems to have been somewhat enlightened.
He seems to have finished for the time being.
He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
He seems to know his way around some strange creatures too.
He seems to like you. Smol heredit is yours.
He seems to take great interest in the other two creatures. Maybe he is trying to keep a balance between them.
He seems to think his actions are necessary.

He seems to think otherwise. He claimed that a part of Seren still lives, trapped within the Temple of Light. Apparently, he discovered this by breaking one of the nine seals within the Grand Library.
He seems to worry a lot about you.
He seems too busy to talk.
He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.
He seems very lost in the world, but I hope his work will be a success for him.
He seems... friendly enough. I'm still not sure if I'm getting paid though.
He sees quite a bit of potential in your product.
He send commander to lead us.
He sent unholy creatures to demand that a blood-tithe be paid to the Lord Vampyre, as is required from all in the domain of Morytania. We had no choice but to agree to his demands.
He set off for the icelands to prove me wrong and, well, I expect you saw what happened to him.
He shan't get away with this, how do I get back to Zanaris? The Godfather shall answer for his crimes!
He should be able to give you some background information on this place and perhaps put you in touch with people of the same way of thinking as yourself... Hope that helps. See you around.
He should be at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.
He should be fine once I help him make a poultice for the wound.
He should be in Keldagrim, the city of the dwarves.
He should be in the roughest area of Varrock knowing him. He likes a good scrap does Jack.
He should be outside the palace. Go switfly, my friend.
He should do. Just tell him I sent you.
He should get the hint.
He should know that I could never hurt him. The first command in a golem's mind is that it cannot allow a human being to come to harm.
He shouldn't be too hard to find. He lives in the royal palace in this city. Tell him Aris sent you.
He shows you another called 'The Charlespendium of Sea Charts'.
He shows you the bow frame and the string and after some time and a great deal of effort, he strings the composite ogre bow.
He smells like the stray dog and always asks people for money.
He sold your slaves to Alexei Jovkai.
He sometimes comes to inspect the wine barrels. I like to inspect them myself sometimes.
He sometimes uses the launderer just to the north of here. Maybe you should try talking to him. Now, would you like a drink?
He soon reorganised the kingdom into the Varlamorian Empire, a controversial choice to say the least, though it soon became clear that controversial choices were quite popular with Imafore.
He sort of beat up Jack then escaped when Jack fled.
He sounds kind of boring...
He speaks to a lot of the villagers and has a good feel for what's going on in town.
He spends all his time giving out security books when he could tell you about security instead.
He spends most of his time recovering from his injuries in some tavern, east of Varrock, near the edge of The Wilderness. You'll probably find him there.
He starts checking the steering on the cart.
He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the icey ocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
He still lives to this day, under a different name of course.
He suddenly left her house one day, fully healed, and able to speak to us as though nothing had happened to him.
He suggested stopping it, but there was resistance from the rest of the village. We find it therapeutic.
He supposedly led countless charges into Morytania and ultimately perished somewhere within these lands. If that is the case, his followers would likely have buried him near the place he died.
He surely did, though he may not understand the significance of whatever items he used. Sadly he seems reluctant to speak to me himself, so I cannot enlighten his mind with my wisdom.
He takes another bite of the meat.
He takes out a strange looking object and hands it to you.
He takes the vial of ethenea from you.
He takes the vial of liquid honey from you.
He takes the vial of sulphuric broline from you.
He talked about increased demand from the nobles of Darkmeyer. Perhaps they have need for more blood than normal?
He talked.
He talks of all the nasty things they did to the people of Ardougne, which I don't care to mention! It looks like they were stopped by someone. But it doesn't say who.
He tells me that under his new laws my boat is forfeit.
He then points at you and falls over and plays dead, gets up and then shrugs.)
He thinks I'd be safer back with Drezel. I can't stay hidden away forever though. Drezel's teachings were valuable, but I can ultimately do more good out here.
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
He thinks Juliet is dead...
He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.
He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.
He thinks the ogres have cursed you all because he stole one of their sacred relics, and he wants me to take it back to them now.
He thinks you've stolen his brain and would like it back.

texto: He thought the colour would be a good base for some Easter decorations.
He threw some kind of smoke at me or something...
He told me that Zemouregal has his heart.
He told me you were looking after it for him.
He took his trials of adulthood, as you did, and has been a boon to our clan ever since. Someday I fear he may regain his memory, and leave us for his past...
He took only from those men that had brought about his downfall, was fair with his men, and generous with his loot.
He took the name King Hosidius IV in an attempt to distance the family from the breaking of the Royal Accord of Twill.
He took the parcel up to his bedroom to open it, away from his parents. Up there, he shook the parcel, and heard a sound...
He took the parcel up to his bedroom to open it, away from his parents. Up there, he shook the parcel, and heard the sound of childish giggling.
He took your boat?
He travelled the world, until his toes curled.
He tried to destroy this city 150 years ago. He was stopped just in time by the great hero Wally.
He tried, but I escaped.
He tried, but I was able to defeat him.
He tries to give you the vial of ethenea but you don't have enough room for it.
He tries to give you the vial of liquid honey but you don't have enough room for it.
He tries to give you the vial of sulphuric broline but you don't have enough room for it.
He truly is a master builder.
He turned up in the summer, raving about chocolate demons and interfering adventurers, and in a moment of pity I let him into my house.
He tuts to himself and starts checking the wheels.
He used to LOVE it.
He used to be one of the Knights of the Round Table, but he mysteriously disappeared many years ago.
He usually slinks about near the pyramid north-east of Sophanem. I expect he's trying to get some poor fools to steal things from that pyramid as well.
He very obliging, dis mortal enemy of Weiss. Must have been big favour he owed [player name]. Okieday, give coffin to My Arm, an' My Arm give him to Mother.
He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed.
He very silly!
He very strong, if he love Aga he will get Trollweiss.
He wants his slaves. When are you planning to deliver them?
He wants me to fetch something from a cauldron on Death Plateau.
He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
He wants me to wait until it's ready to unveil.
He wants to bring a new type of food to Varlamore: kebabs. We have them over in the east. Here, he sent one for you to try.
He wants to discuss the future direction of the gang.
He wants to kill us?! Well now I think we should overthrow humanity!

He wants to set up a rune-selling franchise in the markets of Al Kharid and he wants you to supply him with the stock.
He wants to try sunlight antelope cooked with redberries.
He wants to what?!

texto: He wants what?! The altitude must be sending him loopy!
He was Zaros.
He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
He was a dude, I was a guy, can I make it any more obvious?
He was a fool who could not cope with power! When Agrith-Naar makes us rulers of continents, I will find him and crush him!
He was a great warrior.
He was a kind boy, with a bright smile...
He was a mighty hero!
He was about to slaughter all of these people, but I stopped time so that you could protect them.
He was about twelve years old when he ran away with some pirates to be a cabin boy. I never saw him again.
He was acting a bit strange, like he'd taken a blow to the head or something. At the end of the meeting he announces that he's going to be renovating the shrine just west of the town.
He was actually a Mahjarrat in disguise. I got close to dealing with him, but he escaped.

texto: He was advised against it. She was unpredictable. Sometimes even violent. But he insisted.
He was against Zamorak's rise to power, but the last anyone knows of him was that he and Enakhra were thinking of forgetting their rivalry.
He was all I had, now the only thing keeping me going is the soft sounds of Gertrude's Cats.
He was always a fan of antiques. One day he bought some old flask from a stall in Lovakengj. He began drinking from the flask wherever he went, and it started to change him.
He was always obsessed with that rock.
He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.
He was an archaeologist. Well, more of a treasure hunter. When I was little he always used to bury items around the island and give me clues and maps to find them. If you're lucky you
He was an expert in old curses. He could see what was wrong with the King. He told Councillor Andrews and offered his help.
He was angry that you killed him. Quite natural, really.
He was captured by those blasted trolls! I don't know what to do. Even the imperial guard are too afraid to go rescue him.
He was carrying a large book. He started to head out into the desert, but then turned back and hid the book in one of the broken kilns in which my kind were created long ago.
He was deeper inside that cave. Those... things... they dragged him away!
He was deeper inside. Those... things... they dragged him away!
He was devastated when it was lost, and cried for a week thinking he had lost it!
He was doomed. With his illness he'd have soon died with or without our tithing. We saved him, just like she wanted. All for you to just kill him!
He was ever so noble. Something eating away at his conscience, no doubt. He wanted the money to go towards improved education in Port Piscarilius. He felt it would help with the crime levels there.
He was fine, up until last week! Thieves broke in! They stole his favourite sleeping blanket!
He was following me earlier. I'll go look for him.
He was going to follow me, but he must have got lost somewhere. I'll go and look for him.
He was going to try and recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses.
He was important once. Put criminals away... or killed them.

He was interested in 'Flaemtaer', the ruined temple to the North. I found this odd. A man of science studying a structure dedicated to faith and the struggle of good verus evil, another concept he didn't understand.
He was just here! Look, he's even left his drink on the table by those barrels. Must have nipped out to go to the toilet.
He was last seen entering a large cavern filled with some mysterious floating lights.
He was more lucid there. Is he recovering?
He was more than happy to oblige (cough). Here you are.
He was one of King Healthorg the Great's advisors during the Grand Migration. But he was exiled after the Goblin Wars.
He was one of the few humans Zamorak allowed to rise to a position of power amongst his rebels, possibly because he imitated those same qualities of Zamorak.
He was part of the group that summoned Delrith, but he left Varrock before you arrived and defeated the demon.
He was plotting to start a war between the Gnomes and humankind.
He was smart indeed, but even smart people do foolish things. He threw himself into a nearby water trough.
He was so focused on Eastdoor he didn't make the connection!
He was surprised to see someone like me in the Shadow Realm and I offered to give him assistance if he needed it.
He was talking to some shifty looking wizard the other day. I don't know his name, but I'd recognise him if I saw him.
He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
He was the one responsible for the device that was redirecting power from the Dark Altar, but I'm not totally sure what he was using the power for. That recent earthquake was also involved somehow.
He was the one that asked me to bring the weapons to you. He looked like a human though.
He was war itself! Flurry after flurry of blows he rained upon the Empty Lord, and the very castle walls shook and quivered with their power, but the Empty Lord would not fall!
He was your founding ruler! Surely you know your history?
He was, and still is. Ok, Icthlarin summoned Klenter's soul to torment you into returning the jar, the end result was that you were freed from the devourer's grasp.
He was, but now he's not. There was an unfortunate mishap.

texto: He was. You found the perfect match.
He wasn't a friend, to any of us. Everything he cared about he lost a long time ago.
He wasn't evil, not truly. He just became so obsessed with his goal that he forgot why he started fighting in the first place.
He wasn't there? This is highly irregular. Are you sure you looked properly? I expect he'd be hard to miss.
He watches over each of us, and when we die he catches us as we fall, and ensures we arrive back at Falador castle safe and sound.
He wearing [red/green] armour! [General Wartface/General Bentnoze] tell us wear [green/red]!

He went East. That's it? That's your 'information'?
He went away and left us. He probably didn't like me.
He went down easily, but I was left with a conundrum: What to do with the diadem.
He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.

He went running after the squirrel... nearly caught it too... it shot up a tree and he tried to climb up it, only got a bit tangled up with his axe cause he couldn't hang on to it at the same time... he fell out of the tree and it
He went to get help days ago.
He what!? Right, stay here, I'll sort this out.
He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
He who speaks in anger makes his anger heard, but his words forgotten.
He who uses the power of custard mixes it with his tears.

He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.
He will be in Canifis. He must be.
He will be made to pay, my friend, and I assure you, when the day of his reckoning comes, I will be there.

He will like that.
He will not be pleased with me...
He will not be sending any support, my King. He does not wish to start a conflict with the humans.
He will not let you pass unless he believes you are ready to perform on stage. Simply go past him and onto the stage and use your lyre, and you will
He will then offer you to join as a squire; You will then decline his offer, and ask if you can be deputised instead.
He wished to return to the Teomat. I advised against it, but...
He wishes to be alone. In the meantime, he asked me to speak to everyone.

He would never knowingly do anything that might hurt this ship or her crew in any way.

He'll be back, but not for a few thousand years, I'm sure.
He'll be back, just you wait!
He'll be in the Tower of Magic, north west of here.

He's been dealt with.

He's been out lookin' fer heroes like yerself to aid us in our peril.

He's been spending a lot of time in the Arceuus Library. He mentioned a librarian called Galana. Maybe she can help you.
He's been studying Agrith-Naar for years, but when he brought his group here we knew he was about to make his move.

He's clearly lost the plot.
He's cleverer than he looks, is that Waymottin.
He's creeping me out, standing there looking at me with that face. I need you to get the stuff he needs to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories, so he can go away.
He's da bad shot chompy sticker, no good at sneaky, sneaky part, he's more gooder at da 'noisy, noisy miss da chompy', ha ha ha!
He's dead.

If I could upgrade that device of yours?

If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
If it's jungle you want, look no further than the southern regions of Karamja.
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!

If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!

If you take a couple of carvings to my wife and son in the village over the hill and tell them that I sent you with them from a distant island, then I can wait out here for a week or so before returning.
If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.
If you take the path north east of Sangvesti, that should lead you right to it.
If you talk to me like that again, you'll promptly find yourself down one finger.
If you talk to the citizens of Etceteria, they will tell you exactly what happened.
If you teleport to the Rune Essence Mine from three different locations, the orb will absorb the energies of the spell and allow us to reverse-engineer the magic behind it.
If you tell me what you're doing here, I won't tell the generals.
If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.
If you then somehow lose your pet, you can reclaim it here for free also. The service used to cost Reclaim tokens worth 1,000,000 coins each. If you have any of those, I can refund you.
If you think I have any actual control in here, you'd be sorely mistaken. I don't think anyone could keep these actors in line. They're a... dramatic bunch.
If you think I'm coming quietly, you've got another thing coming!
If you think I'm going to talk, you're kidding yourself!
If you think I'm ready for it, Sir Tiffy.
If you think I'm small, you should see the rabbits in Tirannwn. They're so small most people don't even look at them.
If you think it will help, then of course.
If you think so, then I must be. Thank you for your help, I'll make sure that knowledge is put to good use.
If you think someone knows your password - change it!
If you think that's where she is, I'd recommend you go and check it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
If you think you can just buy my co-operation you're a bigger imbecile than I thought.
If you think you have enough, you should take it to Tamara.
If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Iron[man/woman].
If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a Hardcore Ironman.
If you think you will get to me...
If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
If you touch the wrong one, you will fail this task, and will be escorted back to Falador.

If you travel to the Mage Arena in the north-west reaches of the Wilderness, the battle mage Kolodion may be willing to let you learn to summon the power of Saradomin, should you be able to pass his test.
If you try to pick this cabbage using brute force it will probably shatter. A more delicate approach may be required.
If you try to pick this cabbage using brute force it will probably shatter. It needs thawing out.
If you use our special barbarian anvil here, you will find it ideal. Other anvils are not sturdy enough or shaped appropriately for the forging work involved. Make any of our spears and return.
If you use the wrong tool...
If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
If you value your life, young [man/woman/one], then flee!

If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.
If you visit a lot of ports, I take it you have some exotic stuff to trade?

If you visit the combat tutors south of the general store they may be able to help you with that. Failing that there are a few cheap weapons lying around in the world. For example, you can get an iron dagger if you
If you walk away, your cat will retreat from the fight to follow you. You may like to pass food through the curtain to support your cat.
If you wanna deal with the Phoenix Gang, they're involved in much worse than a bit of bribery.
If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs, that's your business.
If you want a challenge, Kolodion, the master of battle magic, has set up an arena deep in the Wilderness. There you will have the chance to learn some extremely powerful spells.
If you want a place to start, I'd suggest the bar at the Fight Arena. Places like that are always good for gathering information.
If you want a rough idea of how much something will sell for, show it to me and I'll try to estimate.
If you want any hope of defeating my brother, you'll need the proper weaponry.
If you want it back, I will sell it to you for 1,000 coins. That should discourage you from losing it again.
If you want it, you'll need to prove you've got the Halloween spirit! That means wearing at least three pieces of Halloween-themed clothing!
If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
If you want me to lock an item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness, show me the item.
If you want me to make you a machete we can do a deal if you like.
If you want my vote, you must pass my trial. It is as simple as that.
If you want my worldly goods, open my chests with my keys. Adventurers occasionally find my keys while slaying monsters in the Wilderness, on assignment from the witch Krystilia.
If you want out, it will cost you 500 coins, thief.
If you want planks, your best best is heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator. 79-->
If you want show me food den give me it. If you stuck, check notes u got.
If you want someone to show you round the castle ask Eohric, the Head Servant.
If you want that converted into a banknote, take it to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.
If you want that spooky pumpkin lantern, you'll need to prove you've got the Halloween spirit! That means wearing at least three pieces of Halloween-themed clothing!
If you want the enchantment that makes the keys, I'm afraid it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
If you want to applaud someone, [Fremennik name], I suggest you find my brother.
If you want to applaud someone, dear, I suggest you find my brother.
If you want to be let out, you have to pay a fine of five gold. Do you want to pay now?
If you want to be successful as a hunter you've got to be as stealthy as a kyatt, as quiet as a mouse and blend in like a, well, like a larupia, I guess!
If you want to become a [strongman/strongwoman], you need to get into shape!
If you want to chatter, you'd better talk to Thorodin over there. I'm working.
If you want to cheer someone on, [Fremennik name], I suggest you find my brother.
If you want to cheer someone on, dear, I suggest you find my brother.
If you want to enter the Legends' Guild, you'll be invited to complete a quest. Once you have completed that quest, you'll be a fully fledged member of the Guild.
If you want to escape, there's only one way. Anyone who survives in the theatre gets to leave. It's pointless though. No one survives.
If you want to get a job, talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. I'm sure he has plenty.
If you want to get to a port in a hurry then you can charter one of my ships to take you there - if the price is right...
If you want to get to a port in a hurry, then you can charter one of my ships to take you there, if the price is right...
If you want to get to a port in a hurry, then you can charter one of our ships to take you there, if the price is right...
If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
If you want to help deal with the strange casket I have upstairs, I think it also has some scroll cases as well.
If you want to help, you can get Kathy to take you up to the Colony. Herman's looking for someone to run an important errand for him.
If you want to keep practicing, you can change the speed of their gear changes by asking them nicely.
If you want to know more about it, ask Thorodin - he's working on the excavation right now.
If you want to know more, there's an observatory near Ardougne that you might want to visit. They've done some research into them.
If you want to know more, your best shout's going to be heading down into the cave on the island for a chinwag with Charles. He's the local expert on this sort of stuff.
If you want to learn about our history, I have a document here you can read if you'd like.
If you want to learn about the Final Dawn, Metzli would be the best person to speak to. She'll be around here somewhere.
If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
If you want to learn more, you should be able to find a book in the Grand Library about her.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're good enough at crafting, that is.
If you want to save on coal, you could try smithing your bars over at the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim.
If you want to save yourself an inventory space, you could always try binding the talisman to a tiara.
If you want to see the action around here you should visit the famous Khazard fight arena. I've seen some grand battles in my time. Ogres, goblins, even dragons have fought there.
If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
If you want to sell food in the market, you'll need to renew your permission from the council first. The councillor in charge of giving permission at the moment is [councillor].
If you want to smith something that you may not have the level for, you could try gaining some temporary knowledge in smithing from a boost.
If you want to stay healthy you'll leave now.
If you want to stop yourself from failing to smith iron, I suggest purchasing some rings of forging. Be aware that they will break after a certain number of bars are smelted.
If you want to talk, this isn't the place for it. Meet me in Varrock's Chaos Temple, by the rune shop. Unless you're here to buy something?
If you want to work with any other kind of metal, you'll need to find a better anvil. That shouldn't be too hard. For example, I know Varrock has plenty.
If you want to, you could add yourself a topping to the pizza too. Why not try some anchovies?
If you want to.
If you want unusual, Goat Poo says he see da weirdness down in mine.
If you want water you need to buy it off me.
If you want your banknotes converted, take them to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.
If you want!
If you want, I can speed things up a bit by teleporting you to Ice Mountain.
If you want, I can teleport you to Draynor Village.
If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
If you want, or you can look around the other rooms and see if there is anyone waiting around.
If you want, you can keep on taking pumpkins from the bin and carve them. Better that than them going to waste, although bear in mind they won't keep long.
If you want, you can use the boat to quickly get to Slepe. Should be faster than walking.
If you wanted to try your hand at making some jewellery, you'll want to get your hand on some gold and some kind of gem, with a mould to work with and a chisel at hand.
If you wanted to, my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle has a range you could use. You might find you burn even less on that range as its top notch.
If you wanted to, you could store the coins in the bank next to me.
If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
If you were letting Livius drink from your flask, it wouldn't have been hard for you to poison him, would it?
If you were looking for some way of keeping Lucien and his forces in check, killing a few of those demons wouldn't be a bad idea.
If you were magic, you would know why the sea is blue... are you magic?
If you were more interested in turning your hand to farming, you would have noticed it too.
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
If you were on a members' world you would also receive these strange goblin decorations and unlock the Cosy cabin wallkit!
If you were planning to bring any fertiliser for the stores, please try again later. The stores are very full at present.
If you were so nutty about nuts, maybe you would understand the great lengths we go to!
If you were stuck in a very dark cave for centuries you'd be pretty annoyed too.
If you were to cheer up those same children, perhaps we could turn Anti-Santa's own army against him, he wouldn't stand a chance against all that Christmas cheer.
If you were to insert that, the rat might eat it, and you would gain nothing.
If you were to move them quickly enough, I'm sure they could churn through anything frozen.
If you were to obtain some fragments from them, you might be able to make something to capture the runic energy needed.
If you were using the training sword for example, there are four different attack types. Stab, lunge, slash and block.
If you will not hunt, you will be hunted. One way or another, the blood needed will be gathered.
If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
If you win, I'll buy an Easter egg for you.
If you wish for the title, then claim it. You know what the Night of the Blood Moon is. If by the night's end you have the most kills, Lord Myrmel, then you will become our leader.

If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.
If you wish to confront the god it is your own affair, outerlander, but we will not be any part of it.
If you wish to enter, it is not our place to stop you. In the likely event of your demise, you will be mourned.

texto: If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.
If you wish to get back on board the boat you were on, please switch to world .
If you wish to investigate the crime scene, I won't stop you, but I'm not going to waste time telling you how to do it. I'm busy enough as it is.
If you wish to know about the lesser gods, you should speak with Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods. I suppose I could spare a moment or two to tell you about the main four though.
If you wish to learn more, you may well want to seek out one of the teoki in the temple to the south. Though of course, they may well have somewhat biased takes on their religious practices.
If you wish to learn more, you should seek out Servius or one of his Teoki. They will be better placed to guide you than I, for my duty is one of darkness, not light.
If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 1000 gold pieces. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
If you wish to see Arianwyn, this is the only way. Come find us if you change your mind.
If you wish to see how you're doing, you simply need to look upon yourself. I have a mirror here that you can use to do just that.
If you wish to speak with the Queen, please be quick. She is very busy and does not need you taking up too much of her time.
If you wish to tell me more stories, come out here first.
If you wish, I can return you to the central chamber.
If you wish, I will allow you to accept your defeat and walk away.

texto: If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaat I will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
If you would ever like to adopt one of these puppies yourself, just talk to Chase and he'll help you out.
If you would just go look in the crypt, youll see what I'm trying to say.
If you would kindly like to make your way to the beach, you can show the other crabs how it's done.
If you would like me to imbue any more capes, just bring me the remains of the respective creature.
If you would like more of that paint, just ask. We have... too much of it.
If you wouldn't mind...
If you wouldn't mind?
If you'd do a few more quests, you'd soon become a fairly noted adventurer yourself.
If you'd just try this milk...
If you'd like it so stuff like food and potions stay out of the keys so you can use them yourself, I can do that too.
If you'd like more Easter eggs, go up to my storeroom. It's still infested with the critters, but there are Easter eggs in there somewhere.
If you'd like more paint, please ask for it. I'm sure we can spare you some.
If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.
If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
If you'd like to put money forward for training more falcons, be my guest!
If you'd like to see someone fighting Zulrah, feel free to borrow my telescope.
If you'd like, I can explain the rules of Bounty Hunter to you.
If you'd like, you can build a new exit portal with these blueprints. Talk to Nigel if you need more.
If you'd prefer, I can change it so they will drop their bones as they normally would?
If you'd prefer, I can change them back to being noted instead?
If you'd prefer, if you give the bracelet to me, I can grant you the buff instead, but I'll only do it once for each charge you give me.
If you'd rather enjoy yourself, there's the party room just north of here! Or you might like to climb up onto the city wall - you can get a good view of Falador from there.
If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes that can drop rune defenders. Enter when you're ready.
If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
If you'll allow me to continue my friend...
If you're a Defender, you will find yourself with the blue symbol around your feet.
If you're a General can you help me meet the king?
If you're a barbarian you need to be able to drink like one. We barbarians like a good drink.
If you're a bit of a cheeky sod yourself, you might want to get involved in one of their trials. All of them are about speeding around and clocking the best time possible.

If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date
If you're a nightmare, would a male version of you be a nighthorse?
If you're a sailor, would you be interested in joining my crew?
If you're a security guard, let's talk about security.
If you're a vampyre, how did you cross the Salve?
If you're a wizard, are you doing anything magical?
If you're an explorer, I'm guessing you travel a lot?
If you're as skilled a fighter as you are a woodcutter, you may enter the caves. You should find Kai once you are inside, he can give you some more information.
If you're asking why it's here at all, it was a sort of prison. Bad people were locked here. But it's my home now.
If you're correct, I'll give you the treasure chest!
If you're determined to find the source, I will help as much as I can. First, you must overcome the curse of fear that blocks the cave.
If you're going Trick-or-Treating, first you'll need a Treat cauldron to put your treats in...
If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.
If you're going to be like that, it'll take more than flowers to make Lyra want to date you.
If you're going to bribe me, at least make it worth my while. Now, let's say 100 Gold pieces should we? Ha ha ha!
If you're going to speak to the Queen now, maybe I should join you?
If you're halfway from here to there, which is which?
If you're having a hard time finding her, she's behind the bar in the Burrow. Head down the stairs in the big tree. You can't miss it, and if you can, maybe you're not cut out for the Hunter Guild.
If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
If you're here to offer us a hand during the festive rush, please talk to the cook in the kitchen!
If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
If you're hoping I can help in some way, you're out of luck. I may be powerful, but that spell still took a lot out of me. You'll have to hope the others can do something.
If you're hoping I'll convert your armour into a different item for you, I'm afraid I don't do that sort of thing now.
If you're hoping to fight me for a piece of my armour, you've got to own a full set of the tier 1 armour first. Try fighting my subordinate.
If you're hoping to fight me for a piece of my armour, you've got to own a full set of the tier 2 armour first. Try fighting my subordinate.
If you're hoping to fight me for a piece of my armour, you've got to own a full set of the tier 3 armour first. Try fighting my subordinate.
If you're hoping to fight me for a piece of my armour, you've got to own a full set of the tier 4 armour first. Try fighting my subordinate.
If you're in a clan you can also access your Clan Hall from here.
If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
If you're interested in his expedition, the notes he made are in the library in the Exam Centre.
If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Ironman tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
If you're interested in the Fresh Start Worlds, you should know that you can't be an Iron Man on those.
If you're interested, I can give you a farming contract which tells you what to plant within the Guild. Complete the contract, and I'll give you some seeds as a thank you.
If you're interested, I can give you a farming contract which tells you what to plant within the guild. Complete the contract, and I'll give you some seeds as a thank you.
If you're into Mining, plenty! The dwarves have one of the largest mines in the world just under our feet. There's an entrance in the building just north-east of my house.
If you're leaving Morytania, do you have a safe way out?
If you're looking for dynamite, you've come to the right place, human.
If you're looking for fishing supplies, you've come to the right place.
If you're looking for fossils yourself, I hear there is a voyage to a mysterious island to discover new types of fossil.
If you're looking for something specific you should speak to Istoria.
If you're looking for stolen goods, I can get my hands on plenty.
If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
If you're looking for those kids from Rellekka, you'll find them in those dungeons.
If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.
If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!
If you're lucky you may last as long as me.
If you're lucky, you might find other things while mining there. We were not the first to build a home beneath this mountain. Sometimes traces of an older civilization can be found.
If you're not a ghost, why do I need an Amulet of Ghostspeak to talk to you?
If you're not buying anything, I have nothing to say to you.
If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!
If you're not feeling up to it, I'll leave you alone.
If you're not here for ore, then why are you here?
If you're not sure where to begin, chat to the urchins in my crew posted round the houses. They'll help you find the next one to plunder.
If you're not up for a little bit of danger, I don't think you've got anything to offer us.
If you're not up to a little bit of danger I don't think you've got anything to offer our gang.
If you're not willing to change your mind, why even bother to meet us?
If you're particularly worried about them, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.
If you're prepared to change something you must also be prepared to deal with the consequences! Now hurry up and fix this mess you created!
If you're really concerned speak to him.
If you're searching for luck, why are you dressed as a monk?
If you're serious about taking on Elvarg, first you'll need to get to Crandor, and to my knowledge, the only way to do that is by sea.
If you're struggling to find her, she's in Outer Fortis, near the south western gate.
If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.
If you're such a great witch, get me over!
If you're sure though, I'd recommend you go and scout it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
If you're sure you want in?
If you're sure.
If you're sure. Good luck.
If you're sure. Who are you?
If you're sure...
If you're sure... I guess I'll go and see this Dr Harlow.
If you're sure... Take care of yourself, Betty. We'll be in touch soon.
If you're sure.... passing up an opportunity of a lifetime you are.
If you're talking about Akthanakos, then yes!
If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
If you're the greatest salesman in the world, why are you still selling goods from a stall?
If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
If you're willing to help, enter her dream and fight to keep her at bay. Our only hope is to prevent her from growing too strong.
If you're willing to, it would mean everything to us. You're the only one who's actually cared enough to find anything!
If you're worried about my ability to work with you and the others, I promise you have nothing to worry about. Now, let us discuss something else.
If you're worried about your crops becoming diseased, most crops can be protected by the nearby gardeners, but they'll want specific produce in return.
If you's is good with da machete Bwana, you's can get's some thatching spars and put them to use repairing the run-down village fence.
If you've been assigned some by a slayer master, I don't see *hic* why not.
If you've fought the abyss enough to amass 1,500 abyssal pearls, that would be enough.
If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!
If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?
If you've lost your pet, it will be reclaimable here!
If you've met Drezel, then I've no doubt that he's told you the tale of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the Salve and saved Misthalin.
If your blocks are too big, break them with a chisel or a pick.
If your father listened to what you say, we wouldn't BE here.
If your helm does get crystallised, you should be able to break the crystals with three swift strikes.
If your hope is that I can tell you about a whole race, then I am likely to disappoint you, iknil. The masters were secretive individuals. They rarely divulged information that I did not require.
If your light source goes out down there you'll be in trouble! Are you sure you want to go in without a tinderbox?
If your lucky you might snag some goodies that you can sell for a decent profit.
If your only goal in life is to be liked by all, then you'll probably spend the rest of it chasing the impossible.
If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
If your time is so pressing then leave me be and go about your business!
If, however, you win this day, take heart that see the spring you may.
If... If what you say is true, how does it relate to Lord Iorwerth's claims?
Iffie angrily makes another pair of cat ears for you.
Iffie gives you a look.
Iffie had something she wanted to give you, you should talk to her.
Iffie hands you a (rather ugly, but reversible) halloween jumper.
Iffie hands you a pair of cat ears.
Iffie hands you the saucepan. It looks like it would make a good hat.
Iffie said she would wait for me to climb the trees.
Iffie should be able to help, she runs the clothing store by Varrock Square.
Iffie starts to work on the cat ears...
Iffie! ...I, I didn't know you felt that way!
Iffie!! Can you show your senior citizen card?
Iffie's favourite costume represented the Chaos Elemental. Mine was a fearsome three-headed dragon!
Iffie, I'm sorry, but... it's Death! Physical Death, how scary is that?
Iffie, it's ok, I've chosen you. You've got the job!
Iffie...
Iffie?
Iffie? Hello?
Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
Ig! Bidith ig!
Ig.
Ignatius Vulcan added a torch for lighting up caves and the Woodcutting tutor made it easier to find bird's nests and Martin the Master Farmer made it yield more herbs.
Ignisia appears to be quite happy with you.
Ignisia claims it's some kind of evil spirit.
Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith- Naar Tarren.

My Arm is good choice! He been to distant lands, met strange people, come back with new learnings for Stronghold. He obviously best troll for dis job.
My Arm is my friend forever. I will share the sorrows of life with My Arm, and I will share the joys of love with My Arm.

My Arm.

My Christmas dinner!

My Family and Other Zombies

My Glarial... She mattered more to me than anything else, but she was lost to me. The enemy took her, so I searched far and wide to find her again.

My Herblore knowledge isn't good enough to understand what they mean...
