texto: My appearance in this manifestation is merely a shape, and my reanimation of those skeletons is just a party trick, but my voice whispers in the minds of all living creatures.
My arena holds many treasures that I've acquired at great expense, adventurer. Their bounty can come at a price.
My arena is open to any high level wizard, but this is no game. Many wizards fall in this arena, never to rise again. The strongest mages have been destroyed.
My armour disappeared!
My arrow's magic won't work here gah! He'll have to go without this year.
My assistant Milkee is in the cavern, he should be able to help you make eggs.
My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb
My associates and I. Despite the best attempts of the Saradominists, there's still more of us around than they'd like.
My associates prefer to keep their intentions to themselves. However, if you were to assist us with another matter, I might be able to share more.
My associates would prefer I remain here.
My aunt lets people come in here to catch the fish. Sometimes they have trouble carrying enough stuff, so I help by holding onto spare drift nets for them.
My autumn is ending, and only winter remains. Soon, it will fall to individuals like you to protect the Anima Mundi.
My axe on his head would be more useful!
My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.
My axes are the sharpest around! They'll need sharpnin' eventually though. I charge 3% of the axe's original value, how much would I charge for repairing an axe that cost 300 coins?
My b-brains?
My baby sister can do puzzles better than that!
My back hurts!
My back is killing me!
My bad... I'm just very eager.
My barcrawl is still used to this day?
My bed won't go making itself. Best you crack on.
My beliefs are in accord with the teachings of Guthix.
My beliefs are in accord with the teachings of Guthix. Balance is power.
My beloved feline friend Fluffs. She's been purring by my side for almost a decade. Please, could you go search for her while I look over the kids?
My best guess would be some sort of magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
My best guess would be some sort of spell. Merlin is our magic expert. Ask him?
My best guess would be some sort of spell. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
My best guess would be using magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
My bigger chest was taken north to the pirates' ship - a brave adventurer may like to raid that one instead, if they can handle the perils of the north. I kept more wealth in that one.
My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!
My birth certificate. Now. how can I be of help?
My blessing is written on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
My blessings will entice nature to bloom in Mort Myre! And then with natures harvest you can fill a druids pouch and release the Ghasts from their torment.
My blood? Do they wish to trigger the Gathering?
My body is... under his control. I can sometimes manage to speak when Zemouregal's concentration is elsewhere, but even then, it's... painful. My mind, however... gahh...
My boy Marlo sent you? Oh yes, you've come to help with my furniture. It's in a terrible state. You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture.
My brain hurts...
My brain is no longer capable of sleep.
My brother comes down here periodically to collect blood from Safalaan. He must be stockpiling it.
My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
My brother in stronghold best cook.
My brother is Lord Shiro Shayzien. He commands the Shayzien Army. A luxury my husband doesn't have.

My brother is currently gathering strength in the lands to the west. If we are to stop him, we must find a way through the mountains. There is an underground pass that should lead through but it is full of danger.
My brother may be dead but the Dark Lord is still a threat. Until that threat is gone, the plague must remain.
My brother may not be the only threat you face. I hear the elves are currently dealing with a rebellion. The rebels likely won't take kindly to you working with their enemy so be on the look out.
My brother or sister.
My brother reckons I can't solve this puzzle. I can't have him laughing at me! Do me a favour and solve it for me.
My brother said you were going to give us each an Easter egg.
My brother was a great conqueror, make no mistake. But he is a poor ruler. And now, thanks to him, our society is collapsing.
My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.
My brother was chosen as a sacrifice to Zulrah, but now the priests say you're going to sacrifice yourself first. You ruined everything!
My brother was never meant to rule. The kingdom was mine by birthright! My father chose to give him half the kingdom, and he did a terrible job ruling it.
My brother was one of those people. He set out to unite all the clans as one, with him as their leader. He called himself the Lord of Vampyrium, the first true ruler of these lands.
My brother's private chambers are on the top floor of the castle. My guess would be somewhere up there.

My brother, Francois, says the Captain will make him second-in-command if he completes his mission. That's Ithoi's rank, but we don't need a navigator now we've settled here, and he can't do much else.
My brother, King Tyras, was always a bit of an explorer. He went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.
My brother, Steve, carved the steps to get up here. He was jealous of our cousin, Nieve, because she'd got a huge training cave where she could boss people around. So he made this place.
My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.
My business partner, Cassius. I don't know where he gets it from originally though.
My calculations and plotted course were expertly calculated, and there can be only one reason why the ship has failed to arrive at its expected destination.
My captain... My crew... They betrayed me. Stabbed me with my own spear and abandoned me to the waves...
My cat and I are adventurers. If you could teach us a trick or two I bet it would come in handy!
My cat has caught 100 rats!
My child, I would be delighted to have you as a travelling companion.
My child, you have suffered so much... All these years apart... All the time we've lost...
My children are hiding in there! Please find them! Please save them!
My children have always been popular with adventurers. They inherit their father's adventurous spirit. He's always travelling the world, when he can find some kind person to help him open doors!
My children! Someone help me find my children!

My children, I'm sorry for rushing you inside. Time was of the essence in gaining control of the vampyres. However, I have promising news. It seems that for now at least, most are willing to accept me as their ruler.
My chisel's gone blunt, buy me one!
My chocolatey powers make me the ideal agent to attack the Easter Bunny's chocolate eggs.
My chosen, back from the fray. Welcome.
My citizens have told me that items of theirs have been taken, and I'm sure that Vargas is behind it.
My citizens would like their items back, of course. One of my guards will deal with the items for you, and you will be provided with a suitable reward.
My client has asked me to find out where certain missing items have been going.
My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend. Especially when it comes to how it differs from the mainland.
My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend; how it differs from the mainland, per se.
My client requires... another simple task. He assures me that it will be the last. Take this orb. You must activate it beside the Dark Altar.
My client requires... another simple task. They assure me that it will be the last. Take this orb. You must activate it beside the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus.
My client will be most pleased.
My client's fingerprints could have been planted on it by another party.
My colleague and I can let you set up trade offers. You can offer to Sell items or Buy items.
My colleague inside the abyss may be of help to you as well.
My collection is not up for grabs! Go find your own!
My companion and I are the teoki responsible for the Proudspire obelisk, one of our most precious holy sites. However, the peak of the mountain is not overly welcoming, so we keep our camp down here.
My compliments, champion...
My condolences for the loss of your friend. He will be remembered.
My contract stipulates that I must follow you, you insufferable ignoramus. My contract does not stipulate that I must be polite, you ignorant buffoon.
My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.
My cousin was always interested in agility. He left our home in Rellekka many moons ago, so that he could pursue this interest.
My cover has been blown! Unless you are also an agent in disguise? What's the passphrase?
My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
My cows outside my house need entertaining, maybe with an emote? If they approve, I'll give you a Halloween Scarecrow.
My cows produce milk in the evening.
My crab friend on the beach is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him.
My crew and I just finished a long voyage.
My crew deserted and I was stuck with an adventurer mannin' me ship.
My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous boar. As big as a hut, so the songs say.
My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
My dad sells clothes in the Gnome Stronghold. The kit I'm selling isn't from Dad's stock, though. I got it from some dwarves. It's far more suitable for the beach.
My dad was trying to invent a time travel portal, so he could go into the past and meet mighty demons of the Third Age like Thammaron, and maybe control them.
My dad's never going to believe it when I make this happen!
My dad's old sword and shield! He definitely did not let me touch that before! Give me a second.
My darling Jossik knew nothing about Lighthouses when he first came here, so the council must have left him some kind of manual or something.
My darling, that is very thoughtful of you and you make a convincing point. Are you... absolutely sure?
My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
My daughter and top spy, Leela, can help you. She has sent word that she has discovered where they are keeping the prince.
My daughter can hit harder than that!
My daughter has gone missing. We have been looking for her and cannot go on without her.
My daughter was learning to cook this when I left.
My daughter.
My days of leading ended long ago. However, I will always be here to help where needed.
My dear [boy/girl], how do you think we did it?

My dear [sir/lady], I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
My dear fellow, if I wanted you dead, you ALREADY WOULD BE!
My dear husband... how could this happen? Will our pain never end?
My dear son. I know it's been hard for me to express my feelings. We've not always seen eye to eye and I'm the first to admit I've not always been the most understanding.
My dear squire, while very loyal and dedicated, is quite accident-prone!
My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
My decorations will fit on a little one.
My defenses won't fall for your tricks!
My destiny...
My disciples tell me that you have connections with the human lands to the west. I must ask you to travel there at once.
My disciples... They have already started making preparations for that eventuality. Whilst I attend to the final work needed for the portal, you may wish to assist them.
My discovery was this 'abyssal' space, and as a side effect, as documented in the research notes I have given you, I discovered the existence of these 'temples' used to create runes.
My distillator. I can't test any plague samples without it. They're holding it in the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.
My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I am stressed I tend to get ein little..
My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I am stressed I tend to get ein little...
My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
My duty is done. I hope the source brings you all that you hoped for...
My ears are still ringing!
My ears!
My ears! What is this?!
My egg is freshly hard boiled. The heat shrinks your low quality silk to powder.
My egg is hard boiled and will smash your egg into pieces.
My eggs and I are going to spread the Easter cheer to the fine city of Varrock.
My eighth is in nine, but not in eight, My last is in earth, and also in great.
My employer tells me it is an uncommon sort of tree called the Fyburglars tree.
My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.
My faith in humanity has been sapped again. Thanks for that. Here take the money and get out of my sight.
My faith protects me!
My faith pwns your faith!
My family and I have a peaceful existence here. That's mainly because I care not for the politics of the other houses. I instead devote my time to more meaningful pursuits.
My family consider what you did for us a great service. We couldn't possibly trouble you further.
My family has not always ruled Varlamore. In fact, it was the Tullus family who reigned for the majority of the kingdom's history.
My family have always been great explorers and seafarers, and I recently set off on my maiden voyage.
My family...
My father had a responsibility greater than most. At the time of his rule, our people were locked in a great war. To hold back the Ruinous Powers, our gods granted us immensely powerful weapons.
My father knew a lot about Prayer, Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer and Hunter, and I learnt some of his tricks... would you like me to share a little of my knowledge?
My father ruled during the great war. While the war was eventually won, many considered the cost too great. My father led us with the support of the gods, yet he was the one people blamed.
My father sent this key for you. Be careful not to lose it.
My father shall be so pleased.
My father used to be a judge you see. A lot of criminals would have considered him an enemy. Most likely one of them killed my family to get to him.
My father used to live on Crandor before it was destroyed. He was one of the many who were killed by Elvarg.
My father was quick to act, using himself as a conduit to channel what little power the Altar had left.
My father's friend Jerico is in communication with West Ardougne. He might be able to help us. He lives in a house south east of here, north of the chapel.
My father, 'e too waz ze critic of art...'e also saw ze poetry in ze painting. Zis reminds me of a verse 'e would read me - would you like to 'ear it?
My father, Jack. He's been murdered! The authorities are here, but they don't seem to care! I don't know what to do.
My father, King Ulthas, once ruled over a united Kandarin. I was his eldest son, the kingdom was my birthright! But my fool of a father took that from me.
My father, Mother, did not like me talking to My Arm. Whoever marries me will rule Weiss after Father retires or dies, and Father wishes that to be Don't Know What, the biggest sentry.
My father... he was good friends with a Shayzien captain, before they both retired. Captain Jensen is her name. She was one of the good ones. She can help us. I trust her.
My father? You have spoken to him recently?
My favorite!
My favourite colour is green!
My favourite colour is purple!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
My favourite thing to grow is tomatoes, but sadly they didn't quite fit the bill for what I was trying to achieve.
My fez? I got it from Ali Morrisane, it's a uniform of sorts, apparently it makes us more visible, but I'm not too sure about it.
My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate, My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate, My seventh is in plush, but not in place.
My finest piece of work, without a doubt.
My first assignment?
My first is in days, but not in years, My second is in evil, and also in tears, My third is in all, but not in none, My fourth is in hot, but not in sun.
My first is in days, but not in years. My second is in evil, and also in tears. My third is in all, but not in none
My first is in fish, but not in the sea. My second in birds, but not in the sea. My third is in mountains, but not underground. My last is everything, but not at all.
My first is in mage, but not in wizard. My second in goblin, and also in lizard. My third in night, but not in the day. My last is in fields, but not in the hay.
My first is in tar, but not in a swamp. My second in fire, but not in a camp. My third is in eagle, but never in air. My last is in hate, but also in care.
My first is in the well, but not at sea. My second in 'I', but not in 'me'. My third is in flies, but insects not found. My last is in earth, but not in the ground.
My first is in water, and also in tea. My second in fish, but not in the sea. My third in mountains, but not underground. My last is in strike, but not in pound.
My first is in wizard, but not in a mage. My second in jail, but not in a cage. My third is in anger, but not in a rage. My last in a drawing, but not on a page.
My first son is Tamayu. After him was born Tinsay. And after him was born Tiadeche.
My flail?
My flame burns low.
My follower?
My footwear is getting a bit worn out, so I need a few pairs of leather boots. Please bring me [#].
My fourth is in hot, but not in sun. My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate. My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate.
My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.
My friend Hild is cleverer than me...
My friend in Sophanem... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
My friend! Look him up, he's quite famous.
My friend, Amascut has heavily weakened me, but I know you can do what is needed. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way to the level below.
My friend, I have been on a most strange adventure!
My friend, I know your plight, but the cart must be sorted before I can do anything else. I'm sorry.
My friend, I must ask that you once again to pay a visit to the Tasakaal at Mount Karuulm. With their power, they will be able to determine if this Xamphur is the same one that served Xeric.

My friend, I will bless it for you and you will then be able to accomplish great things. Now then, I must cast the enchantment. You can bless a new sickle by dipping it in the holy water of the grotto.
My friend, for your efforts in freeing me, I offer you the gift of knowledge. We Mahjarrat were once granted powerful ancient magicks by our lord. I now bestow their power upon you.
My friend, it would be an honour. My sword is yours.
My friend, this is a matter that's very personal to me. I once lost a good friend under similar horrific circumstances. However, I first need to finish sorting out my racing cart.
My friend, we would like to have a word with you before you head back inside.
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
My friends, thank you for putting your trust in me. This kingdom has suffered through much of late, but now it is time for that suffering to end.
My friends, we cannot afford to lose hope now. The situation is dire, but one of our contacts recently reported in with information that may help us turn things around.
My friends.
My glassware got damaged when I moved here, so I need some new beer glasses. Please bring me [#].
My god...
My goodness
My goodness! This claim is for the reward offered by my father many years ago!
My goodness! This is for the reward offered by my father many years ago! I never thought I would live to see the day when someone came forward to claim it!
My goodness, those muscles are exquisite. I will definitely help a [man/lady] who shows that much dedication to their physique.
My goodness... it's full of stars!
My grandfather used to work in a mine, one day *Sniff* *sniff* actually if you wouldn't mind excusing me.
My grandfather's brother, my great uncle, was a priest of Saradomin and he would tell me stories of the wars with the Dagon'hai as a child.
My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
My granny can dance better than that!
My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. I notice that you brought the head wizard a special talisman that was the key to our finally unlocking the puzzle.
My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.
My greatest mistake. One that will finally be put right. At long last, the blood moon will rise once more, and when it does, we will finally reclaim the greatness that we lost.
My greatest respects Bwana, I have communed with my gods and the future
My guard dogs can do puzzles better than that!
My guards have secured a foothold within the easternmost caves.
My guards will beat you to your goal yet.
My guess is that one of them has some beliefs that don't quite line up with those of the Emissaries.
My guess is that some sort of magic is keeping it that way.
My guess is that this has something to do with the legend of Rashiliyia. But you need to speak to the Shaman in 'Tai Bwo Wannai' village to get more details about that.
My guess is that you will need some protection from Rashiliyia if you intend to enter her tomb!
My hands?
My hatred and bitterness corrupted me. I tried to destroy all life... now I am released. And am grateful to contemplate eternal rest...
My head hurts! I'll speak to you another day...
My head is a little achy, but not too bad!
My head! Did it work?
My head's spinning, I have to go for a bit.
My head... What happened? I thought we were going to set off on our voyage, [player name]?
My heart is an open book to you, my dear, and all the pages say yes... Yes!
My heart overflows with gratitude for your help, [player name].
My heart... He has it. That's how he... how he... arrgh...
My help is needed all over the place. What makes you suggest that I'm more urgently needed in Sophanem?
My help? With what?
My hope is the mastaba contains the answers we need. It was built to house a Pharaoh who ruled the desert thousands of years ago.
My hope is to blend ingredients from the east with ones from right here in Varlamore. The end result will be a mighty kebab just like you easterners make, but with a Varlamorian twist!
My hops still need fermenting, sorry.
My horns?!
My hounds! I'll make you pay for that!
My house is going to be ruined, why did I agree to throwing this blasted party?
My house. You have found yourself here because I deem it necessary.
My husband does not speak of the inhabitants of the isle of Jatizso much.
My husband is a typical Fremennik, being both headstrong and brave.
My husband is four times older than my daughter. In twenty years time, he will be twice as old as my daughter.
My husband is serving near the Lizardman Canyon. I'm worried that something might happen to him.
My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
My influence is currently limited, but it does still exist. I imagine the speed you now gather favour within each house will be substantially faster.
My internet provider.

My investigations brought me to our friend the princess down there, old pinata. She's related to this witch, as I mentioned. I was...you know...showing a bit of interest in her to get her to give me information.
My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
My job's supposed to be simple - I get chocolate eggs from the bird and tell the rabbits to deliver them in the springtime. That's all I should have to do!
My journal! That should help to collect my thoughts.
My key, where is it? You stole it?
My kind are struggling to feed themselves. They've currently got bigger worries than cracks in walls.
My kind believe in something called Mo Kal. It means that anything bad that could happen, will happen. The others may have forgotten this, but I have not.

My kind have the ability to relive our memories as if they are happening again. We can also relive the memories of others if we are able to make physical contact with them. I could show you if you want?

My knights train daily on the top floor of Camelot. There they test their skills and strength against each other. Because of all the help you have given us, I open this training ground to you as well.
My lady, as I've already said, we really should take you to my surgery in Darkmeyer. Whatever that nylocas did, it was no normal bite.
My lady?
My last servant died in here. His skull still remains and you must bring it out to prevent my next servant getting the wrong impression.
My latest project, for example, is to try and create a refuge where people can rest, ponder life and find themselves.
My leg! Someone please!
My legs and your legs, ha ha ha!
My legs are too old and worn to do much running around anymore, I'm afraid.
My liege. What must I do again?
My list of allies grows shorter every day, but you actually seem to care about what's happening out here. You also seem to know what you're doing.
My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
My liver has packed in!
My lord Vanstrom, there are precious few human settlements left worth collecting tithes from.
My lord, I cannot conjure items out of the air. You do not have any of those items in your bank!
My lord, Tyras is dead!
My lord, this course of action will lead to very severe consequences! Your interference in Morytania will likely upset the balance and could send the world into another cataclysmic God War.
My lord, what happened?
My lord... I'm... sorry...
My lord... We've finished our latest round of tithing. I'm afraid we haven't been able to collect the desired amount.
My lord?
My lords and ladies, there is something I must make you aware of.
My love for you seems cold,
My love has thrown a birthday party this year, but I cannot go, for her father keeps us apart.
My lovely blue hat is seen as an historic artefact? That is most gratifying! I had not expected that my... little shopping trip... would become such a renowned event in your culture.
My lovely neighbour is also really kind to me. She seems to care for me more than I can fathom.
My lower intestine!
My loyal disciples, the aranei. Their presence in Hallowvale has served two purposes.
My loyal followers, I have pride in you all. You have achieved a feat many would have considered impossible and returned me to this land.
My loyal followers. I have pride in you all. Never did I expect to return to this land and I see I have much to attend to.
My loyalty is to Seren, I will let her decide what is evil.
My machine is broken, and the house gremlins have run off with some vital bits.
My magic can be used to teleport someone through the defences and into the crystal. It will require great focus though, I will only be able to send one of you in.
My magic carpet is full of eels.
My magic transcends everything you know!
My magic won't affect you if you die in some fancy place like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; those places have their own magic trying to make you 'safe'.
My main function is to ensure that King Roald is apprised of all options, especially when it comes to any potential impacts on the righteous followers of Saradomin.
My maps are now only a few seas from completion. If you're able to help me, I will make sure you are well rewarded for your troubles. So, what do you say?
My master calls me... Thank you... whoever you are. I... urgh... I don't even know your name.
My master calls.
My master has no interest in leaving. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
My master is pleased by your interest in emblem-hunting, so I'll mark that task off on your diary.
My master prefers that his minions be killed with purpose.
My master summoned me to end this Easter foolishness. Humans seize any excuse to pretend a season is special, with frivolous gifts and unhealthy foodstuffs.
My master wishes to have the satisfaction of explaining that to you himself. For this, I envy him. I will make do with the idiotic expression you wear presently.
My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
My master, Death, has trusted me with seeking out promising adventurers for his challenge.
My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
My masters, however, felt differently. They fought for a world that was no longer their own. They believed in preserving these lands for those who would inhabit them afterwards.
My memory is foggy... What was I doing again?
My men and I prevent outlaws from getting out of the desert. And we stop the inexperienced from a dry death in the sands. Which would you say you were?
My men are going to deal with you!
My messenger pigeons help me communicate with friends over the wall.
My mighty yolk, do you think I'd look good in a top hat?
My militia are en route from Rellekka. Have you found out anything about Jatizso's plans yet?
My militia are still gathering in Rellekka. Have you found out anything about Jatizso's plans yet?
My mind is pure arcanery!
My minions will finish thee!
My mission involves leaving this island!
My mission is not against another man and I will not have it mocked.
My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
My mission must be successful!
My mistake [milord/milady], I was thinking yer be some other [fella/lass]! Take this swag, and we'll be saying no more about it! Yarrr!
My mommy always told me stealing is wrong, they would never steal from someone!
My mother could bail better than that!
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
My mother, Alice, tends to our farming shop in yonder farmhouse, while I tend to this small allotment. Passing trade has quite literally died off in recent years, and with it our income.
My mother? She still lives?
My mum says: A friendly look, a kindly smile one good act, and life's worthwhile!
My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
My my, that's a lot of goods your dealing with. What are your terms?
My my, you surprise me, you're not as dumb as you look.
My my. How things have changed somewhat since Glough's time... Now, what of the human?
My my... You've really outdone yourself this time.
My name Ak-Haranu. I am trader, come from many far across sea in east.
My name is '[player name] of Falador'.
My name is '[player name] of Lumbridge'.
My name is '[player name] of Varrock'.
My name is 11 1 14 5 12.
My name is Ali Morrisane - the greatest salesman in the world.
My name is Amergin and this here is my canoe station.
My name is Bob.
My name is Brew'ma. I'm here to assist adventurers like you with potion making.
My name is Brother Aimeri, I am a travelling monk from the distant land of Varlamore on a journey to uncover the secrets of this temple.
My name is Ceto. I used to be a carefree soul, but now that the twolegs are interested in these little bits of bone, I just keep my little fish farm going and the twolegs pay me a few squid.
My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
My name is David Andrews. I'm the Head Councillor of the Kourend Council.
My name is Dennis. I am the head dishop of the once mighty Church of Brassica, god of deliciousness, nutrition and cabbages.
My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
My name is Edward Cranium.
My name is Efaritay.
My name is Emma. I LOVE hair! There are so many cool things you can do with it.
My name is Ex Sea Captain Barfy Bill.
My name is Father Aereck by the way. Pleased to meet you.
My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.
My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.
My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.
My name is Gregg!
My name is Gura.
My name is Gwyna of the Hefin Clan. I'm a trial master for the Barracudas and I provide guidance and counsel to those who attempt this trial, the Gwenith Glide.
My name is Hagus.
My name is Hari.
My name is Horacio Dobson. I'm the gardener to Lord Handelmort. Take a look around this beautiful garden, all of this is my handiwork.
My name is Hotpheex, I am but a humble druid.
My name is Ignatius Vulcan. Once I was - like you - an adventurer, but that was before I realised the beauty and power of flame! Just look at this...
My name is Istoria. I'm the chief historian and curator of the Library Historical Archive.
My name is Jacques and I am the Museum's finest art critic!
My name is Jane, and I am the founder of the Farming Guild.
My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.
My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.
My name is K'klik. I am a Fairy Dragon.

texto: My name is Kaiquir, I look after this canoe station.
My name is Krato. I'm an assistant librarian for the Historical Archive.
My name is Lars, and I am the founder of the woodcutting guild. I originally grew up in a Shayzien camp, and was raised on the battlefield.
My name is Le Sabre and I'm the task master for the Morytania Achievement Diary.
My name is Liam, the Quartermaster. I don't engage in combat anymore, but I'm here to support others that do.
My name is Louisiana Jones, although most people call me Anna. I'm an archaeologist.
My name is Mandrith.
My name is Matthias, I am a falconer, and this is where I train my birds.
My name is Radimus Erkle. I am the Grand Vizier of the Legends' Guild. Are you interested in becoming a member?
My name is Razmire Keelgan, I run a couple of shops in Mort'ton but don't get much custom these days.
My name is Regath, traveller.
My name is Reldo. I'm the palace librarian.
My name is Rick and originally I come from Ardougne. I am a student who studies magical farming at the Wizards' Tower.
My name is Rick. I'm a wizard student. I used to study magical farming, but I don't like it anymore.
My name is Robert.
My name is Selim. Osman is currently on a diplomatic visit. I expect to be filling in for him for the forseeable future.
My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
My name is Thaerisk Cemphier and I lead a group of Guthixians called Crux Eqal. Our duty is a straightforward one: To safeguard this world from the chaos of imbalance.
My name is Twiggy O'Korn and I am the Mistress of all of the Achievement Diaries. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
My name is Ulsquire Shauncy, I'm the local teacher and priest around here. You've really come at a time when Mort'ton is in a terrible state.
My name is Valdez. I served my Lord Saradomin faithfully for many years, as an explorer of this strange land we had been brought to.
My name is William! And I'll tell you this, I'm the best crossbowman this side of White Wolf Mountain.
My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thank you to leave immediately!
My name is [Fremennik name], Your Highness.
My name is [Fremennik name], will you not let me through?
My name is [player name], and I have a couple of questions for you.
My name is [player name].
My name is [player name]. Perhaps you would see better if you took that pumpkin off?
My name is my own, adventurer. It's hardly important right now.
My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
My name isss unimportant... I live only to ssserve my massster.
My name iz Vlad. I come from far avay, vere the sun iz not so bright.
My name's Dominic Onion but you can call me Dom, or Mr Onion.
My name's Emilia. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
My name's Ileana. I'm just trying to make do I guess. The vampyres might not be a problem, but there's still no shortage of dangers around here.
My name's Sergiu. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington.
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington. You should come and see me when you're passing.
My name's Sorin. I'm just trying to make do I guess. The vampyres might not be a problem, but there's still no shortage of dangers around here.
My name's Spria and I'm a slayer master. You've had a nasty encounter with a Sourhog.
My name's Valeria. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
My name's [citizen name]. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
My name's [player name]. King Roald sent me to find out what was going on at the temple. I take it you are Drezel?
My name's [player name]. King Roald sent me to find out what was going on at the temple. I take it you're Drezel?
My name's [player name]. You're on Lunar Isle, in a cave.
My name, in your language, would be Bubrezankaldargarez'jk, but you can just call me Bub. This small plane is my home, here I study and ponder the mysteries of existence.
My name? Oh, how sweet, my name is Ana. I come from Al Kharid though we've only recently moved there. I was born, and did most of my growing up, in Varrock. I thought the desert might be interesting.
My nephew Steve *hack hack* is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. *cough* I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
My nephew, Steve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
My next task is to make peace with the King of Jatizso.
My niece Nieve *hack hack* is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. *cough* I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
My niece, Nieve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
My nimbleness is yours, master!
My no good son must be down the pub again, drinking away all our money instead of getting one simple item from the market for me.
My observational skills are not what they used to be after all!
My office is at the eastern side of the warren. Please come and help me.
My ol' mum say I clever enough. What you getting at?
My old butler, Higson, once followed them there. Unfortunately, the next night he died in his sleep.
My old butler, Higson, once followed them to their hideout there. Unfortunately the next night he died in his sleep.
My old friend Aubury sent me some runes in return for some books he wanted. Perhaps you'd like them?
My old friend Pete has very generously made an exception to his letter-only rule for my pumpkin seeds!
My only wish is that people would not judge the faith only by those who wield it with malice. Either judge the faith itself, or judge each follower individually.
My original plan came to me in a vivid dream when I was younger you see, I saw myself running a successful business from a great structure in a strange land.
My own quetzal?
My parents are gonna be so mad!
My parents though... they hate the people of Piscarilius. They said I had to become a soldier and bring honour to Shayzien.
My partner Badden and I have been observing the dark wizard Denath, who we believe has been preparing to summon the powerful demon Agrith-Naar.
My patience grows thin hero!
My people are afraid to stay in the village. They have returned to the jungle. I need to commune with the gods to see what fate befalls us.
My people are scattered and in hiding.
My people shall be so proud!
My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
My pet is still lost. Could you look again?
My pets will feast on your corpse!
My plan has only just begun! Even with this setback, those pathetic fragments of my father have still given me ample power. My strength is absolute!
My plan is flawless! Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!
My plan is to track the currents around Catherby to see if I can speed up the docking process, but there's a bit of a snag...
My plan might be too obvious if I equip my Giant Bronze Dagger...
My plans for today require some sets of bones, the normal-sized sort you get from goblins. Please bring me [#].
My plans? Hmm let me see now...
My pleasure!
My pleasure, [player name]. Be careful out there. Not all who go to see Eve return.
My pleasure.
My pleasure. And I best be off, I think I am going to put my courage to the test! I have a new goal to reach - the ultimate warrior!
My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
My pleasure. So what is this place?
My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!
My poor darling, why must these things happen to us.

Sometimes I amaze even myself.
Sometimes I do repair work as well. Or I send my assistant.
Sometimes I do, yes. Still not many people to share my solidarity with, as most of the religious men around here are worshippers of Saradomin. Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
Sometimes I even impress myself.
Sometimes I feel as though we Fremennik live in a prison that we have constructed for ourselves, and that WE are the outerlanders, out here on the edge of the world...
Sometimes I like to take a walk out to these shores and look for losers to laugh at.
Sometimes I think my life's nothing but a comedy, but I don't let it get me down. Why so glum chum?
Sometimes I travel to market fairs in distant lands, and I use my feminine arts to lure young farmers back to this land; then the vampyres come for them and I see them no more.
Sometimes I wish I could go travelling in cooler places, like all those adventurers I see passing through here.
Sometimes I wish this thing would just escape. At least we'd have something to do then.
Sometimes I wonder if I should have spent more time learning when I was a young boy. Maybe I wouldn't be here now, scared of Keli.
Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.
Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.
Sometimes I'm worried you'll attack me whilst my back is turned.
Sometimes a break from concentration will yield fresh insight. Our aim is to test you, but not to the point of frustration!
Sometimes a man has to follow his heart... and a second hand invitation saying there's a party at Villa Lucens tonight.
Sometimes bats come out of it.
Sometimes if I'm feeling adventurous, I'll make something like bread, or even a cake! For those kinds of things, you need to combine a few ingredients first, but then you just cook them as normal.
Sometimes it takes a while to find a matching trade offer. If you change your mind, we'll let you cancel your trade offer, and we'll return your unused items and cash.
Sometimes it will just be a person with such staggeringly bad luck that everything they do or say invariably leads them into trouble and commotion, through no fault of their own.
Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?
Sometimes it's hard to know what to say, right?
Sometimes it's nice to stretch the flippers and dry them out.
Sometimes just showing your own colours makes other people comfortable showing theirs, you know?
Sometimes people have to die for things to change.
Sometimes protecting history means taking... unconventional measures.
Sometimes the only correct move is a difficult one.
Sometimes the right move is the most apparent!
Sometimes they don't work very well, though. The light orbs blow and they have to be replaced.
Sometimes they tell me to shut up when me not even say anything!
Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
Sometimes you can be such a bore...
Sometimes you can see a dark shape in the sky, circling the island. That's when you have to sail on as quick as you can and pray it's not hungry. Every year, more ships are lost to that dragon.
Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios. I've recently enhanced them as well!
Sometimes you get lucky, sometimes you don't.
Sometimes you just need a break.
Sometimes you might find a particularly long, straight bone. That's the kind of thing I need; I'll give you 1,000gp for one of them.
Sometimes, but it's not all that bad. I hope you stop by more often!
Sometimes, goblins who know what tribe they come from, they come here and make tribal enclaves. They colour armour different colours to show what tribe they in. But not all tribes here.
Sometimes, oblivion is all I crave...
Sometimes, when the hall is empty, I like to stand up on the railing and pretend I'm singing at a stage in front of many people.
Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
Sometimes. They know it is necessary though. There was once a time when the land was shared equally. But then the great famine came, and Kourend did not have the food to last through it.
Sometimes...
Someway off mainland still. You'd better see if me old matey's okay.
Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
Somewhere brutal and nasty. I could do with a snooze, you see.
Somewhere hot, nearby? What's this business about me dying though - that's not so cool.

Somewhere in the village. It ought to be obvious. Now give me a moment.
Somewhere nice and quiet. I'm a bit behind in my snoozing schedule.
Somewhere out at sea. What does it matter? All the same, now you're here, isn't it?.
Somewhere to house the collective knowledge of the Old Ones. Thing is, it was never finished. Something happened that stopped them from doing so.
Somewhere we have no hope of reaching him. Hopefully that changes, but for now, there's not much we can do.
Somewhere where myself and a couple of friends could hold up for a while without attracting any vampyre attention?
Son of a nutcracker!
Son!
Son! Is that you?
Sona si Latine loqueris. (Honk if you speak Latin.)
Soon Big High War God send Chosen Commander!
Soon Gnome Cuisine will take over the world! Thanks.
Soon I be smart enough to speak to rocks!
Soon I will be free!
Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
Soon he will descend on this miserable lands and everything you know will be ash!
Soon me get revenge...
Soon now... So soon...

Soon we will all be together...
Soon we're gonna have the sacred ceremony and boy am I going to party. Lock up your daughters. Hee hee.
Soon you will be destroyed!
Soon you will be... Soon you will...

Soon you will serve Rashiliyia.
Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
Soon, all will be well again. Have no fear.
Soon, all will bow down before me!
Soon, creature be da ogre too like Rantz! Harr, har, har!

Soon, yes, I hope so.
Sooo...
Sooo... I guess this is the part where I say something...
Soooo...
Soooo.... Is it fun being a ghost?
Soooooo...... that would be a 'no' then?

Sophanem is a curious place, if you can get into the blighted place. There are several pyramids round here as well. Fascinating architecture, I've heard stories that some of them contain treasure tombs and mummies.
Sophanem is called the city of the dead because the dead are brought here. Death plays a rather large role in the beliefs of the people and, as a result, the business.
Sophanem?
Sophia Hughes. Going somewhere?
Sophia Hughes. You have called upon me. Those that oppose you will be judged in the name of Yama.
Sophia Hughes? The councillor?
Sophia wasn't always like that. Before she joined that cult, she was just like the rest of us. The only difference was that she had other beliefs.
Sophie.
Sorrow in what humanity did to this world, in the horrors they unleashed, in their cataclysm of despair, in the tens of thousands of species that will never walk or swim or fly again.

texto: The Accord declared that each house will, in turn, rule the Kingdom of Great Kourend for one decade in rotation, based on lots drawn.
The Accord declared that they would take over rulership of Great Kourend from the Council of Elders.
The Account security tutor hands you a Security book.
The Adventurous.
The Agitator will Homogenise the mixture.
The Alembic will Crystalise the mixture.
The Alliance has come together nicely.
The Alliance is lucky to have the Temple Knights' resources on its side.
The Alliance is struggling to hold off the threats to the Archive. And the records are eager to chronicle your deeds in this matter, if you are so inclined.
The Alliance's goals foster the justice I seek. That is enough for me. Now, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us deal with the remaining villains here.
The Altar is currently giving out a fraction of the power it normally would. The only thing keeping us alive is my father. His strength won't last forever though.
The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.
The Amlodd clan is a clan of mystics. Some sort of magic may be key to finding Lord Amlodd. You might also find this of use, Lord Amlodd gave it to me before we went our seperate ways.
The Amulet of blood fury is untradeable.
The Ancient Vault
The Anima Mundi gave me a choice, and I have made it. If this is to be my last winter, then I go knowing the world will live on to see the next.
The Anima Mundi granted me a glimpse into the future. I had one final choice to make, and I made it by saving you. We now walk a path that we cannot stray from, so listen closely...
The Ankou's are a lie.
The Apothecary busily fills the airtight pot and then quickly seals the lid.
The Apothecary gets out a jar of breathing salts.
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
The Apothecary gives you a pot of breathing salts.
The Apothecary gives you the breathing salts.
The Apothecary has given you a Doctor's Hat.
The Apothecary has given you a Nurse's Hat.
The Apothecary prepares the potion.
The Apothecary shows you the herbal tincture.
The Apothecary would be well placed to get us a memento for Herblore. His shop's in the south-west of the city.
The Apothecary?

The Arceuus house is filled with literary and magical scholars. Lead by the great Trobin Arceuus, as a leader, he assists in pushing the limit of our knowledge surrounding magical abilities, religion and the crafting of
The Arceuus house.
The Arceuus station is just next to the Arceuus Library, in the north of the city.
The Archive isn't the Library. You can't just borrow things. I doubt they'll let you take it.
The Archive?
The Ardougne Resistance?
The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.
The Arena is open only on PvP Arena worlds. Switch to one of those game worlds to play in the Arena.
The Ascent of Arceuus?
The Aspirant approaches! What will the records tell of you, I wonder?
The Attacker can use melee, ranged or magic to attack the...
The Augur may be gone, but we remain. We must stay true to her teachings.
The Balance of Guthix comes around!

The Bandosian forces are mostly goblins. You wouldn't think they'd pose much of a threat, but they've managed to build some sort of siege engine. If that weren't enough, they're being lead by a huge ork.

The Bandosian forces are mostly goblins. You wouldn't think they'd pose much of a threat, but they've managed to build some sort of siege engine. If that weren't enough, they're being led by a huge ork.
The Bank has already replaced all the stolen items that belonged to customers.
The Bank of RuneScape promises to pay the bearer, on demand, one Rune Pouch, provided the bearer is eligible to receive one. Use this Note on a bank booth to exchange it.
The Barrelchest has dropped its anchor! If you could get it fixed, then it would make a formidable weapon...
The Battleaxe
The Bedabin camp.
The Bernese Mountain Dog heads to the dog shelter.
The Big High War God happened.
The Birthday Event 2023
The Black Arm Gang had it. I managed to infiltrate their gang and steal it from them.
The Black Arm Gang.
The Black Guard camp is South of the Ice Mountain, the quicker we can get some ammo for this thing the quicker those Goblins will leave us be.
The Black Guard forgot to send instructions. I know I said that was the last favour, but...
The Black Guard sent Lawgof this cannon to help defend the mines against the goblins.
The Black Guard? What's that?
The Black Knights' Fortress? Could the Kinshra really have allied with Lucien?
The Black Knights? I thought Morgan did this to me.
The Blessing of Brassica will protect allotment crops for you in the Farming Guild. It will also let you find Seeds of Growth in seed packs. These will return you to the Farming Guild.
The Blood Moon Rises quest will become available later today.
The Blue Moon Inn is just by the south entrance to this city, and supposedly the name of the contact is Jonny the Beard.
The Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock. They have the best cook around!
The Book of Haricanto! I have no idea how you came by this, but well done!!
The Border Collie heads to the dog shelter.
The Boss?
The Bravery Potion bubbles with a strange effervescence, but it smells very strange, like oily burnt oranges. Are you sure you want to drink it?

The Bronze Pick is your basic tool of the trade. You can buy one from Bob's Axe shop very cheaply, that's north of here in Lumbridge, I also heard that exploring the castle walls may yield a surprise or two.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 10 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 80 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 510 points.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 480 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 1,660 points.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 100 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 510 points. The Steel Trophy cut-off is 2,000 points.
The Bronze Trophy cut-off is 2,500 points. The Iron Trophy cut-off is 5,000 points. The Steel Trophy cut- off is 10,000 points.
The Brown Engine is a gentleman only society, I'm afraid.
The Brown Engine. We are one of the eight major mining companies, and one of the finest if I do say so myself!
The Brown Engine. We are one of the eight major mining companies, but our standard is higher than that of all the others.
The Bruma tree is what keeps the Wintertodt weak. The prison was built here by Dinh because of its usefulness against the Wintertodt.
The Burgher does not require entertainment at the moment, jester.
The Burgher gives you a hard stare.
The Burgher hands you [number] helms.
The Burgher hands you his crown.
The Burgher hands you his helm.
The Burgher is both wise and perceptive.
The Burgher would like to talk to you urgently. Please talk to him right away.

The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thousands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.

texto: The Bush Patch
The Cactus Patch
The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.
The Calamity Coven are long gone now; some of their old possessions are even being sold as rewards. Now, we are here to prevent a resurgence in such crime. But is there something I can do for you?
The Calamity Coven were three brigands, followers of an ancient and derelict religion. Through their foul arts, they turned this Arena into a hotbed of corruption.
The Camulet
The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
The Cap'n!
The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
The Cape of Fletching can be searched for a mithril grapple and crossbow three times every day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
The Cape of Magic allows you to switch spellbooks five times per day. Now, would you like to buy some magic supplies?
The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?
The Cape of Ranging has been modified by Ava to function as one of her accumulator devices. Is there anything else I can help you with?
The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?
The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
The Cape of Thieving provides a nice boost to your chances of pickpocketing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
The Captain drinks the 'rum' as quickly as possible.
The Captain hands you a cape.
The Captain ponders a moment and then looks at you critically.
The Captain says no.
The Captain says yes.
The Captain starts rambling on about his days as a salty sea dog. He looks quite distracted...
The Captain takes the Slugling and stamps on it until it stops squirming, then hands it back.
The Captain's letting me command his boat now I'm fully recovered. Did you want to leave?
The Carnillean home does not belong to them. It was built long ago by the great Lord Hazeel, who once ruled over this entire region.
The Carnillean home does not belong to them. The builder of the house was Lord Hazeel, one of the Mahjarrat followers of Zamorak. Many years ago there was a civil war
The Carnilleans must have claimed it after my defeat. The fools would have had no idea of its importance.
The Carnilleans served the pathetic Saradomin. They considered it their duty to overthrow Hazeel due to his loyalties to Zamorak. They were fools, blinded by Saradominist propaganda!
The Cathedral.
The Champion had better arrive soon. We can't wait much longer!
The Champion strapped so much armour to himself that he fell straight through the jetty on arrival here and didn't even meet the Burgher.
The Champion!
The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
The Chaos Altar, I think.
The Chasm of Fire.
The Chicken King? Ok...
The Chieftain hands you the letter back.
The Chieftain told me that you saw some sort of disturbance outside your hut?
The Chieftain? Who is that?
The Chihuahua heads to the dog shelter.
The Christmas toy production will continue on schedule!
The Church of Brassica humbly requests your aid with matters of great importance. Meet me at my farm south east of the Farming Guild. Once read, please eat this message.
The Church of Brassica you said this was from? I'll have to pop over and visit Dennis some time and ask more about it.
The Church of Saradomin is looking into it now to see if it's true.
The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
The Clue Compass doesn't respond to that clue step.
The Combat Achievements for the Doom of Mokhaiotl are here!
The CommOrb must need calibrating, as I can register two life forms present at his location.
The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
The Consortium has yet to make a decision... all the companies are vying for the honour.
The Consortium, you say?
The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
The Cook gives you a shopping list. You glance over it quickly.
The Cook hands you a letter addressed to Sir Vyvin's squire, care of Falador Castle.
The Cook hands you a serving platter.
The Cook loads up your serving platter with the food.
The Cook presents you with a special cake. It looks inedible.
The Cooperative
The Core shakes its head.
The Corgi heads to the dog shelter.
The Corgi in the Christmas tree costume.
The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by right-clicking the entrance.
The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.
The Corsairs all think I'm sick too, even though I never ate the food. An' ye'll never make me prove that I'm healthy - I ain't gettin' up! So they'll keep believing in the curse.
The Corsairs moor their ship away to the west, beyond yon village of Rimmington. Ye should look fer him there.
The Costumer.
The Council care only for themselves! It's time for a ruler who cares for you!
The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
The Council didn't declare Rose mad right away. It wasn't until a few weeks after her father died that she was moved away.
The Council had them all thrown in prison, even the children. Lydia was distraught. Still, it didn't stop her joining the Royal Guard. She was always blind to the truth.
The Council have wronged you! It's time to make things right!
The Council is corrupt!
The Council must answer us!
The Council must be removed and a replacement is needed. I will gladly support the new Royal Accord. But first, we must focus on Xamphur.
The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.A.C.O.N. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a B.A.C.O.N. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.E.E.F. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a B.E.E.F. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the H.A.M. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a H.A.M. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the P.O.R.K. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a P.O.R.K. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
The Council wanted to remove me from power? They can't do that! It's not their right!
The Council. It never went that way though, did it? She never took the throne. Martin said they declared her mad.
The Councillor.
The Count seems happy enough with his presents already!
The Count takes the golden rings from your fingers one at a time as he counts them out, too distracted to notice the human hand.
The Crwys clan is a clan of woodcutters and farmers. The entire clan is close to nature, but none more than Lord Crwys.
The Crypt of Tonali is under attack! The Queen has already gone to help. You should go yourself at once!
The Cupboard
The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young [lad/lass], I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.
The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young lad, I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.
The Cyclopes up here will continue to have a chance of dropping rune defenders. Have fun in there.
The Dagon'hai?
The Dagon-what?
The Dark Altar can distort the dimensions, warping the fabric of reality as you perceive it, and even bridging the gap between life and death.
The Dark Altar is the treasure of Arceuus. Our forebears spent their lives - literally, in some cases - learning to unlock its secrets and wield its power.
The Dark Altar powers the Doors of Dinh.
The Dark Altar was the key to Xeric's power. Because of it, he was able to rule Kourend unopposed for nearly a hundred years. His reign was so dark, it became known as the Age of Strife.
The Dark Altar! The power it has given. Xeric, you cannot comprehend!
The Dark Altar. It felt the altar's power and wanted to consume it for itself. It wouldn't be the first time...
The Dark Altar...
The Dark Altar? Why?
The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity.

The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...
The Dark Mage casts a spell on the amulet.
The Dark Mage hands you an incantation.
The Dark Mage pauses for a moment, as if lost in thought. He then hastily pulls out a scroll and scribbles something on it.
The Dark Mage suddenly starts talking to someone else.
The Dark Mage turns back to you.
The Dark One will have their souls!
The Dark mage has given you a challenge scroll!
The Dark mage has given you another clue scroll!
The Deeper Lode.
The Defender returns! What can I do for you?
The Demon Slayer Quest

The Desert is a VERY Dangerous place. Do not enter if you are afraid of dying. Beware of high temperatures, sand storms, robbers, and slavers. No responsibility is taken by Shantay if anything bad should happen to you in any circumstances whatsoever.
The Devourer has all four of the lesser gods somewhere in this tomb. We have to assume she's already found the two weapons she seeks as well.
The Devourer made us her slaves. We want to help you stop her.
The Devourer was not the only member of the pantheon to wish ill upon our people. It is said that many years ago, Scabaras and his sect tried to claim these lands as their own.
The Devourer wishes to destroy every soul in existence, living or dead. As you can imagine, this has brought her into conflict with Icthlarin.
The Devourer?
The Devourer? It can't be!
The Devourer? You speak of legends and fairy tales.
The Diamond of Shadow is not yours to take!
The Disciples of Yama are a big problem. They need dealing with.
The Disciples of Yama once had no connection to Yama?
The Dockmaster has given you a challenge scroll!
The Dockmaster has given you another clue scroll!
The Doom Sayer seems happy enough with his present already!
The Doomsayer blows the whistle...
The Doomsayer has given you a challenge scroll!
The Doomsayer has given you another clue scroll!
The Doors of Dinh are safe.
The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smither, to imprison the Wintertodt.
The Dorgeshuun civil war.
The Dorgeshuun don't have quite the same attitude to the gods as you on the surface do.
The Dorgeshuun goblins have been good neighbors during my vigil here. They are a timid race, but not cowardly, and I am glad they have the peace they desire.
The Dorgeshuun live in the caves beneath the swamp. I made contact with them and now I'm giving Zanik a tour or the surface!
The Dragon Inn bartender signs the portrait.
The Drakan clan always disgusted us. Even by the standards back then, their ways were barbaric. Their Blood Moon festivals were the finest example of that.
The Drakans have been wanting you lot dealt with for a while now. We wouldn't want to disappoint them, would we?
The Draugen is an evil ghost from Fremennik mythology, that devours the souls of those brave warriors who meet their ends at sea.
The Drinks Store
The Drumstick Kingdom?
The Duke asked me to return to him after speaking to Zeke before trying to capture any monkeys.
The Duke asked you to investigate the damage in the cellar. I hope you can find the monsters that are behind this!
The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape. Happy 8th Birthday!
The Duke awards you a Cursed banana. Happy 8th Birthday!
The Duke brushes you off, returning his focus to the egg.
The Duke hands you a heavy orange shield.
The Duke hands you an air talisman.
The Duke hands you some coins.
The Duke hands you the shield.
The Duke hands you the talisman.
The Duke insists that it was an earthquake, but I think some kind of monsters are to blame.
The Duke invited me here to help show the citizens that not all outsiders are evil.
The Duke is a good man, directing you to me! I've been running the milk side of our farm for a while now.
The Duke is a little, different, he's never been very good at making decisions.
The Duke is his voice and he is the commander, he will lead us to eternal happiness.
The Duke loads you up with presents.
The Duke of Lumbridge sent me to find him. I have this talisman he found. He said Sedridor would be interested in it.
The Duke of Lumbridge sent me to find him. I have this weird talisman he found. He said the head wizard would be very interested in it.
The Duke of Lumbridge? And what could he have to do with me? To him I am but a simple scimitar salesman.
The Duke seemed to imply that there was a sapling growing somewhere on the castle grounds.
The Duke shows you a talisman.
The Duke writes a document and signs it.
The Duke's strange talisman.
The Dwarf Captain gives you six railings.
The Dwarf writes on a scrap of paper and hands it to you.
The Easter Bunny adds some chocolate chips to the milk filled frozen churn.
The Easter Bunny asked me to search for it, I think the egg mould will work if I can return it.
The Easter Bunny awards you a pair of bunny feet boots.
The Easter Bunny gives you a chicken head.
The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken feet.
The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken legs.
The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken wings. You can now do the improved Flap Emote, if you have unlocked it from the Stronghold of Security.
The Easter Bunny gives you the Unmixed Mixture.
The Easter Bunny hands you a rather large bucket.
The Easter Bunny hands you a replacement big bucket.
The Easter Bunny hands you another basket.
The Easter Bunny hands you some chocolate eggs and an egg shaped helm.
The Easter Bunny hands you the bucket of camel milk.
The Easter Bunny hands you the frozen churn.
The Easter Bunny hands you the ice cooler.
The Easter Bunny inspects the egg mould.
The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
The Easter Bunny mixes all the ingredients together to make what appears to be an unmixed liquid.
The Easter Bunny needs your help.
The Easter Bunny places both of the Easter eggs into your cooler.
The Easter Bunny places two new test eggs into your cooler.
The Easter Bunny pulls a giant Easter egg from his burrow and hands it to you.
The Easter Bunny said the Eastfloor spade had a special connection to the mould, perhaps I should use that.
The Easter Bunny seems happier.
The Easter Bunny shows you the churn you made. You say nothing.
The Easter Bunny walks over to the churn.
The Easter Bunny will know how to extract the mould.
The Easter bunnies are delivering eggs, but I can't find them.
The Easter bunny gives you a new cooler containing two test Easter eggs.
The Easter bunny gives you a rubber chicken.
The Ectofuntus and the power it emanates keeps us here as ghosts - some, like myself, content to remain in this world; some becoming tortured souls who we do not allow to pass our gates.
The Elite Void Knight hands you over some paint.
The Elite Void Knight swaps the void orb for a bucket of paint.
The Elite Void Knight upgrades your armour. Commendation points remaining: [number]
The Emir knows the benefits of showcasing the city of Al Kharid to a global audience at an event such as this, and has entrusted me to ensure everything runs flawlessly.
The Emir of Al Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
The Emir of Al-Kharid has decreed that his Arena should be guarded, to stop ruffians like the Calamity Coven from returning. But is there something I can do for you?
The Emir trusts me to protect the best interests of Al Kharid. So in answer to your original question, that's what I've been doing in Menaphos and Sophanem.
The Emissaries hide everywhere. I am no safer at the palace than I am here.
The Emissaries seem to consider it their singular purpose to bring about the Final Dawn. Nothing else matters to them.

The Empty Lord chose to ally himself with the dark creatures of this world, fully aware that their own natures would cause them to rally against his rule, and take every opportunity they could to betray him.
The Empty Lord is gone! He will not answer your prayers!

The Empty Lord was a powerful god, stronger than any of the others awake at that time, possibly even as strong as Guthix is, and Zamorak was but a mortal: A Mahjarrat warrior all the same, with all of the
The End of Things?
The Estate Agents can redecorate your house in different styles, if you want something a bit more impressive.
The Etceterian citizens said that Miscellanian soldiers came to their houses and demanded tribute...
The Evil Chicken
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

texto: The Evil Chicken! Many are the myths and legends surrounding this foul bird. Some say that it is the result of a mad mage's attempt to summon a demon, others say that it was once a
