texto: The Eye is what we know it as. After the recent rediscovery of the Temple of the Eye, we put a great deal of effort into learning more about it. However, we didn't actually end up finding much.
The Eye must have had a huge impact on their work. They named the temple after it and fashioned a symbol based on it.
The Eye of Ayak is charged with demon tears, and thus can only be charged with more demon tears. You must fully uncharge it to use runes.
The Eye of Ayak is charged with runes, and thus can only be charged with more runes. You must fully uncharge it to use demon tears.
The Eye?
The Eye? What's the Eye?
The Face
The Fairy Godfather has given you a challenge scroll!
The Fairy Godfather has given you another clue scroll!
The Fairy Queen gives you an XP lamp.
The Fairy Queen has given you a puzzle box!
The Fairy Queen has given you another clue scroll!
The Fairy Queen is extremely ill. She was in a battle with a Tanglefoot and her injuries have resulted in her being in a coma.

The Fairy Queen was in an enchanted deep sleep, because the Tanglefoot had taken the secateurs that contained her magic. I fought and killed the Tanglefoot and have given the Godfather the Fairy Queen's secateurs. She'll
The Farmer is definitely an enemy. High ranking too, I think. He might even be the King of Lumbridge in disguise!
The Farmer is harmless.
The Farmer is harmless. The sheep, however...now they seem pretty crafty.
The Farming Guild.
The Feldip Hills are under Bandosian control, but are of limited strategic value.
The Final Dawn approaches, friend. We will deliver Twilight's Promise.
The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world so that he and Ranul can build a new one.
The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl.
The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.
The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.
The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.
The Final Dawn? Don't you see? There never was a Final Dawn. There never will be a Final Dawn.
The Final Dawn? This is something I can help with, but first, to understand the Final Dawn, you must understand Ximoua.
The Fire of Domination will block teleportation magicks, and it also aids Mother in a fight. It makes him incredibly dangerous.
The First Mate..
The First Mate? No, that doesn't sound like him at all.
The Fisher King is the owner and slave of the Grail...
The Fishing Platform happened to it.
The Forge could be the key to Camdozaal's future, but it's going out. If it does, I fear it will never be lit again. I can no longer gather the fuel it needs. But perhaps you can?

The Forge will need powering, but normal barronite won't work for this. You'll need to obtain some imbued barronite. With that, provided the forge deems you worthy, you will be able to enter the Dream Theatre.
The Forsaken Tower, as it's now known, can be found west of Lovakengj.
The Fremennik Trials
The Fremennik are a very resourceful folk, your majesty.
The Fremennik council of elders? I am pleased to say that I am. My value as a huntsman is recognised by my position there.
The Fremennik council of elders? Why, of course I am. I am recognised as one the clans mightiest warriors. What is it to you outerlander?
The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.

The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
The Fremenniks? Pah! They are just too ignorant and stubborn to listen to anything we have to say - how can we possibly associate with a race that won't listen?
The Frostenhorn has been missing since the loss of the Pontifex Maximus. It was removed from Senntisten by unknown individuals. Status unknown.
The Frostenhorn has the ability to amplify power to potentially unimaginable levels.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Frostenhorn was one of three powerful items I was seeking. Together, they may have been my best chance to determine the fate of my lord.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Frostenhorn. I've no idea what it does, but it's a powerful Zarosian artefact that it seems quite a few people are searching for.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Gathering takes place behind a set of doors within the crypt. These doors can only be opened with the blood of the two Teokan.
The Gathering? What's the Gathering?
The General hands you a severed leg.
The General is a bit...cliché. Fish-men are fishermen. Now, away with you!
The General said I would find my reward near where the fish-men gather. I don't know what he means!
The General seems to have taken a liking to you. He'd normally kill imposters like you without a second thought.
The General sent me to find his four scouts, and now I've found all of you and delivered his message.
The Ghostly Gala is splendid and, of course, spooky! We do it every year around this time, you know?
The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'
The Gielinor Union of Undead Creatures, Plumbers and Allied Tradesmen.
The Gnome Stronghold is for gnomes alone!
The Goblins have been attacking Falador for over a week now and we need your help.
The God Wars are over! The gods don't intervene directly in the affairs of mortals any more.
The God Wars are over...as long as the thing they were fighting over remains hidden.

The Godfather has recruited an army of villains, whilst we just have the few fairies who escaped and although they would gladly follow you into battle, many are still wounded from their treatment at the tyrant's hands. I
The Godfather is ignoring you.
The Godsword? What's that?
The Grail castle... It's... hard to describe with words. It mostly felt like a dream!
The Grail? Ha! Frankly, friend, you're not in that league.
The Grail? That is truly a noble quest indeed. None but Galahad have come close.
The Grand Champion!
The Grand Exchange! I don't have that kind of money!
The Grand Exchange.
The Grand Library of Prifddinas, such a beautiful place. You will be the first to step foot there for hundreds of years.
The Grand Tree!
The Grand Tree's still slowly dying, if it is human sabotage we must respond!
The Great Conch, to the south east. I guess I'll join you on your boat.
The Great Conch?
The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.
The Great Guardian wants you to know that there has been a development in our fight against the Abyss.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Green Gemstone wants more [ore name]!
The Green Gemstone. We are part of the Consortium of mining companies that rule the dwarven realm.
The Greyhound heads to the dog shelter.
The Grim Reaper rewards you with a selection of Halloween-themed goodies.
The Guard Captain asked me to see if you have any... missing... wizards.
The Guardian of the Archive returns! The records speak highly of your deeds here, my friend.
The Guardians of the Rift didn't think you'd have any chance.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
The Guildmaster hands you a key.
The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
The Guthixian edicts prevent us from doing too much at this point, but this situation in Morytania requires some action. Unfortunately, this is the best thing I can think of at the moment.
The Guthixian edicts supposedly exist to ensure a balance is kept when it comes to religious and spiritual beliefs in the world. At the moment, things are considered to be in balance.
The Head Guard gives you some keys.
The Head Guard has them. He's the one with the big sword.
The Headless Gardener's neck twitches at you, but the lack of any head prevents him from speaking.

The Hefin clan are our religious leaders. They teach us to better ourselves, not just in mind, but in body as well. Lady Hefin used to lead some of the more vigorous training exercises of the Hefin clan.
The High Priest blesses you. You gain some Prayer xp.
The High Priest gives you a burial jar.
The High Priest gives you an uncut diamond!
The High Priest gives you an uncut emerald!
The High Priest gives you an uncut red topaz!
The High Priest gives you an uncut sapphire!
The High Priest gives you some banknotes that can be exchanged for herbs.
The High Priest gives you some coins.
The High Priest hands you a Circlet of Water in exchange for 10,000 coins.
The High Priest hands you a Circlet of Water.
The High Priest hands you over some paint.
The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
The High Priest is free.
The High Priest swaps the holy sheet for a bucket of paint.
The High Priest tries to hand you a Circlet of Water, but you don't have enough room for it.
The High Priestess has chosen me. I don't know how she decides these things, but perhaps you should ask her.
The High Priestess said I could offer myself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.
The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. I was so looking forward to meeting Zulrah.
The High Tree Guardian Daero is in charge of the training programme. You should know where to find him by now.
The Holy Friend? Bwana, it is sacrilege to feed these fish to Karambwan!
The Holy Grail drops into your pack.
The Homunculus is a bit better off now.
The Horrors, the Horrors!
The Horses!
The Hosidius house is filled with keen and skilled farmers alike! Lead by the incredibly efficient Kandur Hosidius, his intelligent resourcefulness ensures optimal agricultural production.
The Hosidius house.
The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild.
The Huey- what?
The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
The Husky heads to the dog shelter.
The IOU is written on the back of the combination! The stupid guard had it in his back pocket all the time!
The IOU says that Harold owes me some money.
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
The Imcando Hammer, one of my favourite tools for Smithing and Construction.
The Imcando dwarves, you say? Let's see...
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
The Incident!

The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Corps, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
The Iorwerth forces had the strength and safety of the city walls though. They slowly whittled us down until we were too weak to carry on. We had no choice but to retreat.
The Iron and Steel Picks are faster than the bronze pickaxe, but you will need to progress with your mining a little before you can use them. You can buy them from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
The Items Kept on Death menu tells you roughly what your items will do when you next die, including estimating gravestone fees.

The Ithell clan is a clan of builders and architects. Before her death, Lady Ithell was considered the finest architect of all the elves. This village was her final and finest contribution to our people.
The Jormungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other.
The Joy of Gravedigging
The Jungle Forester hands you the blunt axe.
The Jungle Forester takes out a scrap of parchment and some charcoal. [He/She] studiously renders another copy of your map.
The Jungle Forester takes out a strange looking object. It looks like a wooden pole, with string attached to one end. At the other end of the string is an odd-shaped piece of wood.
The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.
The Justiciar of the Unicorn bestowed it upon me to help with my work within this place.
The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
The Karamja monkeys are rumoured to be fairly cunning and intelligent creatures, although rumours that they have learned human speech is anecdotal at best.
The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
The Key Master repairs your soul bearer.
The Kharid desert
The Khazard stronghold has already been breached.
The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.
The King and she have never seen eye-to-eye, but I think if you approach her you may find her quite reasonable.
The King asked me to inform you that the Daconia rocks have been taken!
The King gives you another bark sample.
The King gives you another translation book.
The King has a real soft spot for Roasted Giant Snake stuffed with sliced banana and monkey nut paste.
The King has a throne in the base of the Grand tree.
The King has given you some twigs lashed together.
The King has taken my estate from me until such time as I can show my family crest to him.
The King himself died a few years later and was succeeded by Xeric, a tyrannical mage who made the King seem meek in comparison. Though of course, many believe them to actually be the same person.
The King ignores your protests.
The King needs someone to take over the rule of the Kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.
The King needs to sign a treaty, but is unable to because he lacks a pen large enough for him to hold. Could you make me a nib of the right size?
The King of Jatizso has requested that I take you to him, as he has an important task for you.
The King of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors.
The King reads the letter.
The King was cursed so that you had an excuse to kill him. It was never about the people, it was only about the throne.
The King was cursed!
The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
The King's a fool and a coward! He'll bow to me! You'll soon be back in that cage!
The King's advisor said I should talk to you. He said there have been some suspicious people arriving recently.
The King's axe!
The King's been dead for years. How come the auction only happened recently?
The King's daughter, Rose. If we can find her, we might be able to find out what happened.
The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.
The King?
The Kinshra are not your personal soldiers Solus!
The Knights of Ardougne. They claimed she was inciting rebellion against the king. Apparently she's been going around telling people that the plague isn't real...
The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
The Kourend Royal Guard are conducting the investigation, Tomas. Your presence is not needed.
The Kourend Royal Guard protect and serve the ruler of Kourend. As their leader, I am responsible for ensuring that the Royal Guard are well trained and well supplied.
The Lady Zay is certainly a big step up from my last ship anyway.
The Lady of the Lake is looking after it I believe... but I know not where she resides currently.
The Laughing Miner?
The League awaits you. Impress me.
The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.
The Library Historical Archive stores our most ancient and precious texts. You can find out much more about Great Kourend and our key historical events there.
The Library tells me that we have two visual recordings from SpyOrbs available to you, as well as a standard dossier.
The Little Shop of Horace.
The Lovakengj house is filled with incredibly skilled blacksmiths. Lead by Vulcana Lovakengj, her incredible leadership and intelligent material saving skills pave the way for future blacksmiths.
The Lovakengj house.
The Lumbridge Guide has given you a puzzle box!
The Lumbridge Guide has given you another clue scroll!
The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
The Lumbridge cook.
The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
The Lumbridge guide... I can't really rememember what I did to save him...
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

texto: The Mace
The Mage of Zamorak hands you a book and a pouch.
The Mage of Zamorak takes the strong cup of tea from you and immediately drinks it.
The Mage of Zamorak tries to hand you an orb, but you don't have enough room to take it.
The Mahjarrat
The Mahjarrat.

The Mahjarrat. It's fair to say they are quite the subject of fascination for me. Many of them once held dominion over huge parts of the world. Zamorak himself was a Mahjarrat, and he managed to achieve godhood!
The Mahjarrat? Not a lot to be honest.
The Maiden of Sugadinti. Such an ironic name.
The Marimbo Guard will kill you on the spot, foolish human!
The Master Farmers usually carry a few rare seeds around with them, although I don't know if they'd want to part with them for any price to be honest.
The Master Smithing tutor gives you a hammer.
The Mavis Merton?
The Mayor
The Mayor called a meeting of the town council. Nothing too strange about that, in and of itself.
The Meilyr clan is a clan of scientists and explorers. You'll probably need to do some exploring yourself to find Lady Meilyr. You may also find this of use.
The Menaphites
The Menaphites of the Kharidian Desert have so far remained neutral in the war.
The Miscellanian citizens said that the Etceterian army marched into their fields and demanded tithes...
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 1,770 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 5,270 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 10,820 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 18,000 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 28,000 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 42,000 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 5,475 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 15,575 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 31,980 points.
The Mithril Trophy cut-off is 6,480 points. The Adamant Trophy cut-off is 18,720 points. The Rune Trophy cut-off is 35,680 points.
The Molten Glass? Excellent!
The Moon Clan yer say? Ah, well I dinna know much about them folks, when everyone else went to that there big old feast I stayed aboard the ship...
The Moon Clan's reliance on magic is no more balanced than the Fremennik's hatred of it.
The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...
The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.
The Moons cannot be killed, but they can be distracted whilst I repair the seal. Enter their chambers here in Neypotzli and engage them in combat.
The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the bream scales, moss lizard tail and moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli.
The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli.
The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the moss lizard tail and moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli
The Myreque are already here in Slepe, Damien. The one that killed Ranis Drakan is among them. Your overconfidence has begun your downfall.
The Myreque are back!
The Myreque are back.
The Myreque are dead.
The Myreque are gone, Ivan!
The Myreque are gone. Do not speak of them, it will do you no good.
The Myreque are the only ones brave enough to stand up to them. They stay in the shadows though, lest the vampyres track them down!
The Myreque cannot fight this battle against the vampyres by themselves!
The Myreque will need to know all that you have experienced so far. You should report to Veliaf when you can.
The Myreque?
The Myreque? Don't tell me you're scared of that lot, Vanstrom? I thought you were made of stronger stuff.
The Mysterious Stranger hands you a cape.
The Mysterious Stranger pulls a coin out of their pocket and shows it to you.
The Mysterious Stranger shows you some eggs.
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of these lands to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of this land to see if any facts may be hidden within them.

The Nexus in the centre is the place where we establish our defences. However, a hostile automaton there does keep making that difficult for us. We can put it down for a while, but it just keeps getting back up.
The Night of the Blood Moon approaches, and while I have enjoyed this little diversion, I have more important things to focus on.
The Night of the Blood Moon? You would bring back that festival?
The Nightmare may have left my home, but I won't rest until I know for sure that she can never return.
The Nightmare pulls you into her dream as you approach her.
The Nightmare?
The Northern Allotment Patch
The Nutcracker has a FREE BAR!
The Nutcracker pub!
The Nylocas Queen? So that's what we were preparing for in the Theatre. But I thought you were developing weapons to use against her?
The Odd Old Man gives you another bonesack.
The Odd Old Man gives you another ram skull helm.
The Odd Old Man hands you a small object made out of bone.
The Odd Old Man starts working on upgrading your bonesack...
The Old Ones had some way to create runes, but we've never discovered how they did so. I'm guessing the dwarves did though, given they never seem to run short on them...
The Omlettesiah feels generous today, what do you want and why are you here?
The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...
The Oracle gives you some seeds.
The Oracle has given you a challenge scroll!
The Oracle has given you another clue scroll!
The Oracle resides atop Ice Mountain, between Edgeville and Falador.
The Order of Wizards over at the Wizards' Tower have been on the hunt for magical artefacts recently. I wonder if this might be just the kind of thing they're after.
The Overseer presents you with an Abyssal Bludgeon.
The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!

The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell
The Palace.
The Paladin gives you some supplies.
The Paladin tries to give you some supplies but you don't have enough room to take them.
The Pandemonium?

The Penance use a form of telepathic communication, which one of our elders has managed to tap into and relay to anyone. You are rewarded 'Honour Points' dependant on how well you fight, which can later be
The Pestilent Bloat. What a disgusting monstrosity.
The Phalanx only looks compatible with Osmumten's Fang.
The Phoenix Gang had it. I managed to infiltrate their gang and steal it from them.
The Pincers?
The Piscarilius house.
The Piscarilius station is south of the city, next to a small mine.
The Piscatoris Fishing Colony, somewhere north of the Gnome Stronghold, is under attack by sea trolls, and they've sent me to ask for an army.
The Pixie Foreman says they're striking cause Santa is on holiday and they can't have one.
The Pixie foreman hands over a bulging sack.
The Plain of Mud
The Plain of Mud.
The Plaza.
The Port Sarim pits are quite fussy, no lazy cats allowed in here.
The Prince Ali thing? We all shared a cell that time.
The Prince and Princess of Miscellania
The Prince and my counterpart wish to speak with you. You should go to them at once.
The Prince awaits you down in the crypt.
The Prince could have contributed.
The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
The Prince has been taken by a group of bandits led by the self-proclaimed 'Lady' Keli. They are holding him in the abandoned jail just east of Draynor Village.
The Prince is waiting for you. You'll find him in the temple to the south, on the other side of the bazaar.
The Principum Red, you fool. I could retire on the value of that wine. All I had to do was get out of here with it.
The Principum Red? Of course. Constantinius has a nice large container of it. However, I'm not sure if that's the most...
The Proudspire of course! I'm walking the Pilgrim Path.
The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
The Pyromancers do what they can to keep the Wintertodt contained but I fear it will not be enough.
The Queen and Vibia depart for Fortis, taking Furia with them.
The Queen asked me to bring you.
The Queen can't be beaten by normal combat or by normal eggs and hence, it is up to you as a team to change these yellow eggs into omega eggs.
The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.
The Queen herself? Such an honour. Don't think for one second that I'm going to tell you anything though. Even death itself doesn't scare me.
The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
The Queen is waiting, my child. Let us go and speak with her.
The Queen of Thieves?
The Queen will not dare put her son in danger. Your worries are unfounded. Besides, I've already made arrangements for him to be moved elsewhere.
The Quidamortem station is at the peak of the mountain, deep in the Kebos Lowlands.
The Recipe For Disaster Quest
The Record Keeper looks through the book.
The Records certainly whisper to a similar rhythm.
The Records quiver in anticipation for this knowledge.
The Red Axe has departed the city recently. Ill omens.
The Red Axe has withdrawn from the city to some unknown location. I believe Commander Veldaban has asked you to assist him in finding their secret headquarters?
The Red Axe is the largest and wealthiest mining company, we have all rights here!
The Red Axe will fire you for just about anything if they want to.
The Red Axe!
The Red Axe? You want to know about them, do you? Then let me tell you my tale. It is long and quite unforgettable...
The Red Reef isn't as red as the name suggests. Despite our best attempts, we've reached a point where it can no longer supply the amount of red coral we need. A new source is needed.
The Referee sighs, rolls his eyes and continues....
The Rewards Guardian doesn't respond. They presumably don't recognise the diary.
The Ring of Charos has many powers, but Fenkenstrain has bent them to his own evil purposes. Without the power of the ring, he will not be able to raise the dead from their sleep.
The Ring of Charos has now been opened to you, [player name]. You may use its power to charm the weak-minded, but it will only work whilst you are wearing it.
The Ring of Charos.
The Ring of Charos? What's that?
The Ring of the Elements has [number] charges. You can uncharge it at a bank.
The River Lum
The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world as you see it, but the three-headed Guardian keeps them safe.

The Royal Accord of Twill no longer plays much part in the rulership of Kourend. It was breached in the 13th decade when King Shayzien III seized control of the kingdom. It hasn't been honoured since.
The Royal Accord of Twill saw each of the houses take it in turns to do this, but we may want to take a different approach this time.
The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the heads of Kourend's five houses, known then as the Royal Lords. This was over a thousand years ago.
The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the rulers of each of the houses 139 decades ago, following the great famine.
The Royal Accord of Twill.
The Royal Accord?
The Royal Guard is composed of particularly elite soldiers who have proven themselves in battle. They are duty bound to protect the Grand Tree, its King and his interests.
The Royal Guard was established by King Byrne I. He felt that it was dangerous for Shayzien House to control the only military in the kingdom, so he decided to establish a small one of his own.
The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
The Sacred Forge is a strange beast, but with its arcane power, you'll see an improvement to the various activities you can do in the city.
The Sacred Forge is far more than a mere furnace! It is a powerful relic from a time when the gods still walked these lands.
The Sacred Forge of course!
The Sage has well and truly earned their place in my domain. Such squandered potential...
The Sage takes your voucher and hands you a Scythe of Vitur (uncharged).
The Sage takes your voucher and hands you a Scythe of vitur (uncharged).
The Sage takes your voucher and hands you a Tumeken's shadow (uncharged).
The Sage takes your voucher and hands you a Twisted bow.
The Sage tells all of us the names of those participating in their... event.
The Sailing skill is not currently available.
The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.
The Samoyed heads to the dog shelter.
The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks, they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
The Saviours of Kourend headquarters will be somewhere nearby. You might be able to learn more by asking around town.
The Scar
The Scar? But I thought this was meant to be a teleportation matrix.
The Sect of Ranul are planning a special Gathering to select their new Teokan, and we in the Church of Ralos have an important part to play. There is a lot to prepare.
The Sect of Ranul are responsible for maintaining the library here. That includes dealing with any forbidden materials.
The Sect of Scabaras?
The Sect of Uhld, the founders of this here guild. I may not have gained entrance to this guild in the usual fashion, but I'd expect that they'd at least inform new members of this guild's history.
The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.
The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
The Serpent himself. Why are you here?
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Shades keep knocking the temple down!

The Shades wish to forever possess the value of their tomb treasures and jealously guard them in death as they did in life. They are afraid of true death and so try to destroy anything which reminds them of it.
The Shaman holds out his gnarled old hand and reveals three largish green seeds.
The Shaman puts his head in his hands.
The Shaman takes the dagger and gives you a folded piece of paper.

The Shayzien Army is split into six regiments plus the Shayzien Constabulary. While the six regiments are jointly responsible for protecting Kourend from external threats, we deal with issues closer to home.
The Shayzien Crypts. They were built before the kingdom even existed. Some of the oldest Shayzien heroes are buried there.
The Shayzien Outpost.
The Shayzien house.
The Shayzien records say you've killed [#] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [#] were lizardman shamans.
The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.
The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills.
The Shayzien records say you've killed [X] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [X] were lizardman shamans.
The Shayzien station is east of the Shayzien Encampment.
The Shayzien troops keep them busy. They've not tried coming up this way.
The Shiba heads to the dog shelter.
The Shield Master hands you 'Leather Shields - Resource information flyer'.
The Shield of Arrav! Goodness, the Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a reward for it years ago!
The Shield of Arrav, eh? Yes, I do recall my father, King Roald, put a reward out for that.
The Shield of Arrav. We've discovered that Zemouregal intends to attack the city of Varrock with a zombie army. It was the shield that stopped him last time.
The Shield of Arrav?
The Shield of Arrav? But is it really any use? Despite our attempts, we've never been able to unlock its power. Could it be that the legends were exaggerated and that it's just an ordinary shield?
The Shield of Arrav? Sounds a bit unlikely to me, but I'll give it a go.
The Shield of Arrav? The Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a generous reward for its return!
The Shield of Arrav? Yes, I do recall my father put a reward out for that.
The Silent Choir. They had a church. They built it somewhere in the city. Somewhere hidden.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: The Silver Cog! A shining example of how a mining company should be run to join the Consortium.
The Silver Spirit Tree is dead!
The Sinclair family crest. It's shiny and freshly polished and has a slight smell of poison.
The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
The Sinclairs have disappeared, though I'm not sorry to see them go, but what worries me is the disappearance of King Arthur and his knights around the same time.

The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They bought the services of the Black Knights from
The Sinclairs stole our home, but Morgan struck the greater blow by stealing the Holy Grail, Arthur's most prized possession.
The Sires are the engineers of this living pocket universe known to you and I as the Abyss.
The Sisters Grime, Jimmy Dazzler, Hooknosed Jack...
The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
The Smashyhammer of Ashihama.
The Smithing apprentice gives you five golden rings.
The Smithing apprentice hands you five golden rings.
The Smithing skill allows you to make armour and weapons. Talk to the boy who smelts metal in the furnace, I'm sure he can help.
The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.
The Soul Wars minigame is not enabled on this world. You can switch to a Soul Wars world by using the World Switcher in the Logout Menu.
The Soul Wars minigame will be released on the 6th January 2021.

The only place I would recommend is the Cloak and Stagger. You'll find some pretty good drinks there.

The only problem I find is that the lighting's not very good, which means I make mistakes when cutting cloth.
The only problem is all the wood and flint are damp... I can't light a thing!
The only problem is that I have run out of ideas on how to do it.
The only problem is that those rottin' fiends have torn up and destroyed all but one of the Blindweed Patches.
The only problem is we have no way of seeing the future...

The only thing I can give you is a supposed magical cleaning potion I was given from a squire of one of the White Knights of Falador.
The only thing I can think of, is that the Mayor has asked them to help improve the shrine.

The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.

The only thing his skull would be useful for is Zamorakian heresy. I won't stand for it!
The only thing that cheers me up is looking over to Gertrude's house and seeing her kittens playing.
The only thing that gets out of here is the rock that we mine.
The only thing that is constant...

The only thing you can help me with is finding the nearest place to get a drink, I think...
The only things these oafs are breaking is my head with their silent stares and furious hand-talk.

The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.

The ornamental pickaxe is too extravagant to convert into an infernal pickaxe.

The other clerks and myself pulled straws and I was unlucky enough to be sent to this stinking death trap.

The other day I filed a book about ancient goblin tribes. It's somewhere at the west end of the library, I think. Maybe that will be of some use.
The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.
The other directors of the Consortium don't think so and are likely to expel the Red Axe completely anyway.

The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.
The overcrowding... The shutting down of the Haemalchemy Laboratory... I think he was intentionally pushing us to the brink. Putting us in a place where his plan seemed like the only option.

The penguins won't talk to me without some stupid secret phrase. These penguins are crazy!
The penguins, the penguins!

The people can express their concerns through the proper channels. Now, I must ask that you come with us at once.

The people had him executed.
The people have a right to know, my friend.
The people have passed their judgement, you are not a king any more.

The people here are ill, suffering from a deep sleep from which few wake. They call it the Sleeper Plague. The illness made these people easy prey for the Nightmare, so she made this place her new home.
The people of Arceuus don't get ill. We're immortal. We have been for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus. This shouldn't happen... This can't happen...
The people of Arceuus have had their time.
The people of Ardougne, the elves here, you've spent a lot of time helping them. Why? What drives you, [player name]?
The people of Burgh de Rott would not be happy if you dumped the rubble here.
The people of Draynor aren't usually a festive bunch, but this year everyone seems down right miserable.
The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have [number] buckets here, and [number] more in the bank. We require [number] buckets.

The people of Shayzien will thank you.
The people of this land... Their lives are built upon the truths presented to them. Ralos... Ranul... They put their faith in the gods they are told to believe in.
The people of this world do not have the strength to do what must be done. Ximoua will only come to be if we make it so.
The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
The people won't allow this to continue!
The people you killed were innocent, Betty. No one is to blame for what happened to your mother and sister. You've just never been able to accept that.
The people you see assembled here are the self-styled secret council of Gielinor.
The people you see here all dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.

The perfect environment for getting back on your feet!

The person who holds my token can summon me by rubbing it.

The place looked magnificent, gold lion statues, coffins untouched by anyone else and plenty of Hallowed marks compared to these floors. Although, the traps were significantly harder than the one below.
The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
The plague is a lie? What do you mean the plague is a lie?
The plague isn't cheap to combat. The king has decreed that new taxes be introduced to help with the funding.
The plague isn't easy to contain. New funds are needed to help the effort.
The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
The plague of course...
The plague was made up to hide their mining operation beneath the city.
The plague was the excuse he gave for the quarantine.
The plague? Tell me more.
The plagues mean that my master isn't allowed to leave. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.

The plan is that the chicken will operate the magnet to attract bits of iron and steel, maybe even your own recently fired arrows. There are plenty of totally lost arrowheads lying about in the fields of Gielinor, I bet.
The plan is, we swap out that first door we painted for this one. Then we decorate that first door, swap it out for another one, decorate, swap, repeat!
The plants make me happy! Not to mention, many of them are excellent for healing injuries.

The play will be starting as we speak. They'll all be up in the theatre.

The pleasure is all mine. As you've probably already guessed, I'm Spencer Brentwood, and this is the Zenith.
The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.
The pleasure's all mine! I've got a good feeling about you. I reckon you're going to do great things for us! You have a powerful aura. Sorry, that must seem really strange.

The ploughs are old and may become damaged after too much use, but I'm sure that won't be a problem for such a well trained adventurer like yourself.

The portal to our salvation. This is our destiny. Now, it needs power, and Lord Myrmel was merely the first to provide it, for at long last, the Night of the Blood Moon is here.

There's not much time left.

There's not really much going on here. I was hoping this would be a fun evening.
There's nothing I can do, it's fatal.

There's one right there. Maybe we can use it?
There's one that lets you keep a kingdom in your pocket, and one that lets you become a Slayer Master!
There's one thing...

There's only one murderer here!
There's only one of me, friend.
There's only one outcome for betraying the Augur...
There's only one sailor alive daft enough to go there. Old Ned, the ropemaker in Draynor Village. I can't think of any other fools just now. Except for old Jack Seagull there.

There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.
There's only one way to find out. Where do I start?
There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
There's only two tortoises here, that's hardly a regiment.

There's plenty more cloth by the fire. I also found the remains of a book...
There's plenty of barronite to be found within the reservoir, so it might be worth checking out. Be warned though: worshipping gods never did my kind any good.
There's plenty of gold coming from that rock now, surely you can lower the price somewhat?
There's plenty of options for us to move forwards. We'll still keep up intelligence-gathering operations within the local area. We'll also keep looking for weaknesses in the vampyres' defences.
There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.
There's plenty of rats around. Maybe you could help out with the work by getting rid of a few.
There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?

Therefore, any one of the Sinclairs who bought poison could have done their chore and poisoned Lord Sinclair as well. Just because my client was too lazy to do her chore doesn't mean she poisoned Lord Sinclair.

Thereof?

Theres something wrong with his head!
These 'affairs of state' you're dealing with...

These 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer explorin' on the island. I'll 'ave a word with some of the seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne, so they'll take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
These Fever Spiders carry a nasty disease, and ye'll need a pair of Slayer Gloves on to not catch it!
These High Priests always lack my experience on the battlefield.
These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.

These Penance Runners will start off at the far north end of the arena and make their way to the south end. This is a trick we are playing on them - luring them with the smell of their Queen - to test you.
These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
These adventurers reported seeing a wraith- like creature.
These ain't yer normal brand o' fish either. Some say that these are the tastiest fish ye' can get. Some even provide unique effects when ye' eat 'em!
These ancient capes were awarded to the archivists of this place. Today they are used to honour those who defend them.
These appear to be complex plans for Zemouregal's Base in Silvarea. Maybe Elias can help you interpret them.
These aquatic birds seem to spend the majority of their time eating and fostering their young.
These are a sort of sea-dwelling troll. They feed on the monkfish that live in this part of the sea, but just recently they've started invading my Colony!
These are dark times friend.
These are dark times, I must prepare for the coming darkness.
These are enchanted chocolate chunks. If I use it to make chocolate rabbits, then my plan to have them deliver themselves will still work!
These are exciting times indeed!
These are expensive, do not lose another pair!
These are highly favoured with our guards.
These are new ones. They are to help pay for the king's upcoming visit to Great Kourend.
These are no ordinary walls though. Long ago, they were reinforced by various enchantments to protect Prifddinas during the God Wars.
These are our trade secrets, you know.
These are questions to which you shall not find answers, adventurer.
These are specially good for getting your prey unawares, but you're not going to get the best out of them unless you've been taught the special technique.
These are strange times. I never dreamed that I would see the surface, still less that I would be on friendly terms with its people.
These are the Tunnels of Chaos.
These are the Tunnels of Chaos. They radiate with the energy of chaos magic. At the far end of the tunnel, you will find a portal to the Chaos Altar itself where chaos runes are crafted!
These are the masks of the Sisterhood. While symbolic, they also have practical uses.
These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.
These are the offices of the Blue Opal.
These are the offices of the Brown Engine.
These are the offices of the Green Gemstone.
These are the offices of the Purple Pewter.
These are the offices of the Silver Cog.
These are the offices of the White Chisel.
These are the offices of the Yellow Fortune.
These are the presents. Each present has a riddle on the nametag, figure out who the present is for and deliver it to them.
These are the stairs down to the mining caves. There are rich veins of many types down there, and miners too. Though be careful; some of the trolls occasionally sneak into the far end of the cave.
These are the up market slaves clothes doncha know!
These barbarians raided my home! They took me prisoner. I thought they were going to kill me!
These be dark times, though, [lad/lass]. See, a week ago we awoke to find ourselves beseiged.
These birds can be a lot of work... I'm not sure you could handle them, let alone to catch a fish!
These bones that trap me will block your path!
These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!
These books are full of scrawled notes. You open one at a random page...

These boots are a symbol of your exploration of the Fremennik lands. They can teleport you here once per day, Peer the Seer can now bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra
These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...
These citizens are to be protected. Ensure they do not enter the castle, but do not allow any harm to come to them.
These clients are quite indecisive about what they want their houses to look like though, I'm not complaining.
These clothes are awful, get me some others!
These clothes are too small for me, I might ruin them if I put them on. I'd better take them to the sculptor instead.
These crates are heavy! I could do with some help if that's what you're here for.
These creatures, they're made from the tears I collected?
These crystals are thought to be formed by the blessed water of the river Salve as it percolates through the rocks to the lower levels of the mine.
These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.
These days, I'm not much into the production side of things... All that moving up and down, pulling levers, carrying vials... These old bones ain't what they used to be.
These directions are from Ardougne. It would be much easier to find the place if I left from there.
These don't really need watering - the soil seems to be extremely fertile.
These dreams usually are.
These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
These dungeons are such a maze.
These dwarves have arrived from Keldagrim - the Chancellor has asked me to look after them, but they are eating all of our food and drinking all of our booze.
These dwarves have so much more advanced technology than us. Look at this train! We could never build something like this.
These dwarves sure love their drink.
These emissaries here are acting a bit strange... They keep putting their hands in their pockets.
These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
These fairies seem to be well versed in the powers of nature.
These feelings I have

These floorboards look a little weak near to the wall.
These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
These goblins fight all the time, Zanik. Come on, Wartface and Bentnoze are both in the big hut.
These goblins have so much more advanced technology than us. Take a look at their magical lights! We could never create something like them.
These goblins have taken me hostage! Please ask them to let me out!
These goblins told me that you killed them. What are they talking about?
These golems were very crude. They were mostly made from clay, of all things. We used our advanced Smithing knowledge to improve their form. Eventually, we were able to get them working again.
These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
These guardians should be strong enough to fend off those creatures. Head back to Tamara and see what we should do next.
These halls once bustled with life, but that was a long time ago. I'm the only one left now. The name's Ramarno.
These holes aren't that spooky.
These imps have now spread out all over the kingdom. Could you get my beads back for me?
These imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.
These little things seem to be everywhere these days! Perhaps you'd like them?
These magic stones will guide you to me!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
These monkeys are too busy arguing with each other to notice you.
These monsters have an intuitive defensive system that allows them to protect against different types of attack. This is good for them, but bad for you.
These new followers of yours, do they know? Do they know what you did? Do they know about the monster you truly are?
These night shifts just go on and on.
These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.
These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
These old things? I guess they've dried up... I'm getting old and I need caring for. I've chosen you to do that by the way.
These parties are always a bore.
These people... You speak of the Twilight Emissaries?
These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.

These potatoes seem to have been largely untouched.
These prisoners of yours, they were promised to Desmodus Lasiurus.
These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
These rebels had better get a move on and defeat Lord Iorwerth. Old ladies like me have a tendency to drop dead, and I'll be very annoyed if that happens before I see Prifddinas again.
These remind me of a pet I once had. Please... put them away.
These rocks appear to have shifted recently. Further inspection reveals faint tracks among the debris, although they aren't tracks you recognise.
These rocks look like they have been stacked uniformly.
These ruins are directly beneath the Teomat... I suppose it's possible there may be some links to Ralos and Ranul.
These ruins are mine!
These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
These runes are crafted from a highly unique material, and then imbued with magical power from various runic altars. Different altars create different runes with different magical effects.
These sails are blocking my view.
These salts in the mine - I invented ways to combine them, unlock their power. In a fire, they can work wonders.
These scratches? Don't worry, just a disagreement with a thorn bush.
These secret meetings are SOOO EVIL!
These secrets must, however, wait until you have mastered the basics.
These seeds have been germinated in pure sacred water and are ready to be planted in fertile soil.

These sensitive records are under my precise curation!
These sewers could be used to bypass the spells. However, surges of energy are periodically sent through the water there.
These should protect you from infection.
These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
These spirits are full of tricks. Take nothing as it first appears.
These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
These strange creatures have the curse of the Broodoo on them! They'll rise from their grave with their heads in their chests and move like crazy spirits of the afterlife.
These take ages to clear! If you pay me 2000 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
These taxes are not included in that agreement. They're new emergency taxes related to the plague.
These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.
These things could be yours.
These things don't come cheap... But if it'll keep you quiet, I'll let you have it in exchange for a good word.
These tokens are not transferrable by the way - this is just a bonus for hard workers!
These traps don't get any easier. But I'm alright, thanks.
These tricksters must have summoned you!
These vines are very precious indeed. I could not hazard the risk that someone would steal my grapes while I was away - they may be diseased, but they still contain Burthorpe Vine seeds.
These weapons look great! Many thanks.
These were recently recovered from within the Theatre. Take a look at them.
These worlds have their own economy, separate from other worlds. Hardcore players may freely trade others.
These worlds have their own economy, separate from other worlds. However, while on them, you only have one life.
These would be the mudskippers, right?
These, my friend, are the foundations of the stronghold.
These... these are exquisite! EXACTLY what I was searching for all of this time! Please, take my crest fragment!

Thessalia exchanges your token for a lamp.

Thessalia's Fine Clothes?
They absorb flesh and bone of their demon kin, weaving it into the fabric of these very walls. Here they have remained in deep stasis, asleep.
They act pretty shady...
They add a special, fishy texture to the drink.
They all have different theories about the curse.
They all have their reasons. They all seem valid reasons to me.
They all kept saying that the Doors were failing and I kept telling them that was rubbish. Did they listen? Of course they didn't.
They all live - we suffered no casualties.
They also have a lot of energy they need to burn off.
They also look as if they might fit in the slots on both of the machines. Maybe I should try it out?
They also now work in any place a ring of life would. Talking about rings of life, they can also act just like one if you configure them to be so.
They also use slime for protection. For instance, snails can use their slime to crawl over razor-blades without being hurt. It also helps keep away dangerous insects like ants.
They always play just south of here, there is a nice grassy area with some bushes and trees to climb.
They are a bit tricky, but very fun. Bet you had fun making them.

They are a great set of doors built by the legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.
They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
They are all dead, then. Even Velorina. I should have done something to stop what was happening, instead of running away.
They are always stealing, starting fights and disrupting the lives of the townsfolk.
They are an evil people, equally cursed and blessed by the magic in their blood. Beyond those islands, there is the large frozen wasteland we call Acheron.
They are ancient and powerful beings! They are very evil! It is said that they once dominated this plane of existence, Zamorak was supposedly of their blood. They are far fewer in number now.
They are arrogant! They think they know it all, and worst of all, they are non-believers!
They are at war with them after all.
They are bigger, badder, meaner, and have a howl that freezes the blood in yer veins.
They are birds that prey upon many of the other creatures here. However, their population is so great that they have been causing issues for Father Sugadinti's research.
They are broken down into two distinct species: achatina acidia and achatina acidia giganteus or, as they are more commonly known, the acid-spitting snail and the giant acid-spitting snail.
They are called Tchiki monkey nuts and require a very particular combination of soil and climate.
They are called the Temple Knights, and you are to meet Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park for testing immediately.
They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.
They are easter eggs. The Easter Bunny hands them out every year.
They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
They are impressive creatures aren't they - quite mystified they are by the technology we gnomes have invented.
They are in a secluded bay, near Etceteria.
They are in a secluded bay, near Miscellania.
They are in a secluded bay, near Rellekka.
They are in the hall, eating and drinking us out of food and beer. It's costing us a fortune.
They are known as the Makeover Mage. You should go and talk to them. I believe they live south west of the human city of Falador.
They are lazy, good for nothing codfish addicts. GO AWAY.
They are many, but they are not united. We will win because we found allies, and because we worked together.
They are members of the Twilight Emissaries cult. The cult wish to gain access to the Crypt of Tonali, but they require dwarven help to do so.
They are much more mobile than their smaller cousins and are able to jump rather high when attacking.
They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.
They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. I'm afraid I'm not an expert on nature.

They are not at rest and will attack those they blame for their tortured state. They are not known, however, for being able to determine this blame with any great accuracy, so should be considered dangerous to all.

They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.
They are not old, but are well made.
They are not quite the same as the one Hazelmere gave you, but they look similar in size and weight.
They are not the kind of people to let evil thrive. That is why we picked them.
They are one of many.
They are only 34 and 38, far too young to be left unsupervised.
They are organised! ORGANISED I tell you!
They are organising some sort of trade agreement. I don't know what they are trading.
They are ready now.
They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
They are remarkable plants with a will of their own. Not to mention their many unique properties...
They are so... nice... afterall!
They are still being excavated, and the dwarven architects are finding new caves as they go. There have been reports of odd sightings in these new caves.
They are still stumping me. Here are the notes; I really hope your head doesn't explode from reading them.
They are sturdy animals, and well protected by their shell. They can even swim! All we need to do is put a bit of fire in their bellies.

They are the disturbed spirits of those interred in the earth beneath Mort'ton. Their eternal spirits have been poisoned by the close vicinity to the evil nature of the inhabitants of the Sanguinesti area.

They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
They are very fond of bananas and bitternuts, eating them in huge quantities whenever they can get their paws on them.
They are, as you humans might say, the best of the best. As well as Sergeant Garkor, they have in their company a High Mage, two sappers and battle hardened foot soldiers.
They are, but how do you know that?
They are. But maybe there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
They are. I do not deny that their relationship with Sugadinti is complicated, and it is not one I totally approve of.
They are?
They aren't related to those Seaslugs are they?
They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!
They attacked while I was in the bath. What was I to do?
They attacked! I ran and ran. I crawled down here.
They began to mine these rocks, and set up transport systems to the various places of power that enchanted them.
They believe that the sheep have become infected with the plague.
They belong to nobody!
They belong to nobody.
They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
They best not end up in my lunch!
They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
They betrayed me! Before long, they'll betray you as well!
They both make a very metallic sound when moved. I want to double-check whether there's equipment in there or not.
They built great tunnels beneath the Elid and used them to attack our settlements. However, Elidinis stood against them. The sect was destroyed, and Scabaras was fittingly driven into isolation.
They call him the Dark Squall. He's super secretive! I don't know his real name!

They came to us. Two of them.

They can be pretty dangerous. They'll defend for a long time, then attack suddenly and seemingly without warning, landing three viscious attacks at once. This can be pretty lethal. However, the nail beasts themselves
They can be trained to associate people or places with food though, and, as such, a good falconer can get a trained bird to do as he wishes.
They can continue running their gliders into trees, and I'll keep my business going. Sooner or later it'll all work out in my favour.

They can do no more harm.

They can't have gone far, they'll probably be wearing the hat!

They caused the plagues? Why?

They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?
They claim it's a breach of privacy or something like that. My suspicions mean nothing without proof to back them up, but I can't get proof without losing my job.
They claimed the increase in castle tourism would make more money in the long run. A load of tosh! I knew it was just for them.
They colonise many areas of Gielinor, though most notably, sites of ancient battles and small dank caves.
They conceal their emotions behind a cheerful facade, eating and drinking to block out the fear and pain of everyday life.
They could be I suppose, but I'd rather you made sure.

They demanded agreement to some absurdly expensive export deals in exchange, and even exclusive rights to some imports from the mainland.
They destroyed many, coopted others, and in the space between necessity and carelessness, left some to grow as untended as any species could in the wake of their ubiquity.
They did a better job second time round, but the builder sure was annoyed.
They did look really out of place. I wonder who put them there?
They did not fear the pain, you understand. They feared the diminishment that comes with defeat.
They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.

They exist in a caste-based society, with the soft shelled larvae at the bottom, up through the workers, soldiers and finally the queen.

They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground. Years of work was destroyed.

They felt themselves far better than the knights and felt insulted at having to live in a stuffy mansion.

They first broke in months ago and stole a suit of armour. The strange thing is that they've broken in four times since but taken nothing.
They fled south, but some remained under its control. They brought it with them.

They hold, if by a single thread. But! It is a single thread more than our enemies possess.

They make us refine the daeyalt here. They use it to make more vampyres!
They marched down and razed Neitiznot to the ground while Neitiznot's troops laid siege to Jatizso.

They were always arguing with each other over the most trivial things - who was the faster runner or who was the tallest.
They were apparently created at the end of the God Wars to ensure that the world never sees a conflict like that again.
They were at first, but with how long it's been happening, I think everyone's run out of energy to keep searching.
They were bought by someone who went off to the Blue Moon Inn, so you should be able to find them there!
They were bound to it long ago. To use the Stone causes them unimaginable pain, and grants them immense power.
They were brutal. They even shut off the port from the rest of the city over fears of the plague getting in that way. Many of their own citizens are still trapped there.
They were damaged and couldn't be opened, but I think I've managed to fix them up.
They were fine before people started trampling all over my fields killing them for their hides and meat!
They were grown here back when this place was still known as Hallowvale. The Saradominist Queen of the region used them as weapons against the vampyres.
They were kind, but filled with sadness. As you know, they summoned me after another of their kind unleashed the Moons of Peril.
They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.

They were once friends but a difference in their beliefs meant they fell out. One chose to follow the god Zamorak, whilst the other chose Saradomin. But finding themselves in this extreme situation at the top of the
They were once, but not anymore. You're one of us now.
They were our lands! And... hang on... what is this human filth doing here?
They were powerful warriors in service to Saradomin himself, back when the gods still walked among us! This temple must be ancient. Imagine if Saradomin himself once stood here!
They were probably just firestarters. That's what I found outside.
They were probably talking about someone else anyway. I don't think many surface dwellers remember the dwarves who lived in Camdozaal.
They were reluctant, but they admitted that the people of Arceuus were useful to them.
They were shown the error of their ways through fire and blood.
They were some dance moves I was trying to remember.
They were still allowing citizens from Sophanem to return at that point, but I foolishly chose to stay. I was scared of catching the pox.
They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.
They were such a problem that the Council had to get Lord Shayzien to send some soldiers in to deal with them. Lydia was one of them. This was before she joined the Royal Guard.
They were teenagers from Rellekka who were trying to prove themselves as adults, by starting a war and then bringing about peace.
They were the first to fall. It corrupted them and made them its own. They undid the work of those that tried to resist. Harbingers for what was to come.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: They were the ones who disguised themselves as soldiers!
They were to oversee the decommission of the shipyard.
They were willing to help out some random stranger with a good enough sob story, so I smacked them with a bottle and rowed them over.
They were... It wasn't an actual bird was it?
They weren't Etceterian soldiers after all.
They weren't just mindless husks... It's like... they were still in there.
They weren't very tough.
They what now?
They whisper of a dream to climb across the moon supreme, I know, I know, oh oh oh
They will always be remembered, my friend. I've already made arrangements to have statues built in their honour. Everyone will know of their bravery, and their sacrifice.
They will be able to send you any useful data about Solus directly through it for your perusal, dontchaknow.
They will be given some fine ale and meat.
They will be given some party hats and balloons.
They will be given some potions.
They will be gone soon! The Imperial Guard will use a secret way that starts from the back of the Sherpa's hut to destroy the troll camp!
They will be if they're found guilty.
They will be made aware. But only after I have reviewed the discoveries first.
They will be ready in two days.
They will be ready tomorrow.
They will find out! As soon as you stop bothering me, I plan to tell them myself.
They will have to wait. There is only one question of importance at the moment: Are you willing to help us?
They will help with the ghost problem!
They will hold the line whilst we work on clearing the foremost ones. We are relying on you to take one side whilst we take the other.
They will last for 6 months, after which your account will be transfered to the main game and you can carry on playing as normal there.
They will mend in time.
They will never agree on one. Perhaps I should get them some of each colour.
They will never be forgotten, [player name].
They will pay, or we will cut his hair off and send it to them.
They will quickly learn of what happened here. They must be reassured that we are no danger to them.
They will regret not picking me!
They will replace the knowledge you previously had, but you may switch between them by praying at the altar in this room at any time. May you use them well.
They will send a search party, won't they?
They will suit different commissions better...
They will surely be heading up the Proudspire... I promised my son we'd go up there together one day, but we never found the time...
They will then feed until they are completely full, sometimes doubling in size!
They will then set them free, dropping your jar on the floor. So, if you're quick, you may be able to catch it again.
They will try to kill me, though, and I can't fight back!
They will, but most of them are not true vampyres. They are Drakan's creations. They will not know me, nor will they recognise my scent.
They will. And they will do so willingly, because they know what will happen to us all if they don't.
They won't drink it straight from the bottle...
They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
They won't have a choice. Lord Shayzien commands the Shayzien Army, and I command the Royal Guard. They'll have no one to protect them.
They won't ignore me for much longer!
They won't listen to me!
They won't. It's a very difficult quest, and only I know the location!
They work by our very own Dorgeshuun magic!
They worked for centuries attempting to escape the pull of the Abyss but as food resources began to deplete they knew that their only chance for survival was to construct this Nexus.
They worry about Shayzien having too much power. It does mean we'll have big problems against any enemy navy, but on their heads be it I suppose.
They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
They would get fat and lazy, be much worse at hunting and would show you up as a really poor cat trainer.
They would have each flown a Gnome Glider.
They wouldn't be big enough for what we need.
They wouldn't take these, apparently, and I can't even open them to empty them! They are locked and the key my mother gave me isn't the right one.
They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
They'd do well to find a better source of hope, but I suppose that isn't important now. There is a lot to be done, but first, my son needs tending to.
They'd understand my actions... I'm just trying to preserve history.
They'll almost certainly pick his son, but Argenthorg is just as bad as his father. If he becomes King, he will only appease the humans!
They'll be a pain in your backside soon if we don't get fed.
They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!
