texto: They'll be imprisoned. It will be for the new ruler to decide their fates. As for that, we'll aim to hold the vote Lady Piscarilius requested as soon as possible.
They'll be in Prifddinas of course. With the city restored there's not much reason for them to come out here.
They'll be in the Underground Pass, preparing for the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
They'll be up to the task, but you'll need to rally them up.
They'll give you their strongest drink and sign your card. When you've done all that, we'll be happy to let you in.
They'll have been a soldier of some sorts, fighting here in the war. I'm guessing they were quite important. Very few people would have been afforded a burial in those times.
They'll review the evidence and hopefully give me permission to take a team to Camelot. It shouldn't be too difficult to get to the bottom of this.
They're 750,000 coins each for new ones.
They're 900,000 coins each for new ones.
They're KGP agents sent from the Iceberg to collect information on Farmer Fred and his sheep.

They're a bad bunch, always starting fights down in the Asp and Snake. Word on the street is that they're led by some deranged priest. Nobody's ever seen them though - they do all their deals through Ali 'the
They're a bit maze like in structure, but I'm sure you'll have no problem finding your way.

They're a bit of an interesting one. It's been argued that they're not actually completely essential for charting the sea, but Steve thinks otherwise. Probably best you talk to him if you want to know more.
They're a bit of an interesting one. On your travels, you may spot some sealed crates floating in the sea.
They're a bit short, ain't they?
They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.
They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
They're a good crew and have served me well!
They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
They're a group of rebels fighting against the vampyres that rule over Morytania. They're known as the Myreque. Some people call them terrorists while others call them freedom fighters!
They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
They're a way to experience Old School RuneScape as if it were new, today!
They're afraid of treespassing.
They're after an Old One keystone.
They're all a lot of bullies if you ask me.
They're all already married.
They're all being controlled by the sea slugs.
They're all gone! [player name], you've saved our Halloween!
They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.
They're also the only buckets I have.
They're always looking for hidden knowledge about souls and spirits, when any sensible person would just trust in Saradomin.
They're always trying to find ways into that place.
They're an army belonging to Zemouregal.
They're barbaric even without the festivals. Just look at how they've treated humans here.
They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
They're both you!
They're called disguises, brother.
They're cheering! Why are they cheering?
They're claiming that two of the cultists are Ralos and Ranul reborn. They believe that once the two of them reach Mokhaiotl, the world will be destroyed and then remade once more.
They're coming! Build some defences!
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.
They're cute little creatures, aren't they?
They're dancing, all of them, hee hee.
They're definitely top suspects, but we don't have any actual evidence linking them to the crime. Until we do, this Evelot lead seems like a safer bet.
They're done! They're so cool!
They're draining my blood, that's what they're doing!

They're dwarven engineering at its best. If you've got enough skill in crafting, smithing and fletching, you can even make them yourself. You can buy some of the parts here and make the rest yourself.
They're finally gone. Come with us, little guy. We'll keep you safe.
They're fish. Do I look like a fisherman?
They're for eating, silly! What else can you do with a monkey bar?
They're for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site; sorry, but you can't go through.
They're from the far east lands.
They're going to fight Drakan? If that's the case, then I will join them.
They're gone... All of them... He killed them, like they were nothing!
They're gonna eat you alive in there, but best of luck!
They're great thanks, and it was no problem. Hopefully those adventurers can get their Easter eggs now!
They're great, aren't they? I don't know their name, if they even have one, so I just call them Rifty.
They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!
They're hiding on the south-west coast near the bank. They'll be hidden, but should be easy to find now you know they're there.
They're hiding upstairs in the bedroom. They've left us in charge.
They're in a chest in the cell opposite this one, but the cell is locked. My sword is in there as well.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: They're in a clan, they're going to fight you!
They're in that box-crate by entry.
They're insane!
They're insulated boxes filled with icey water. I just keep them open and they cool the crate down nicely.
They're invisible, or a myth, or a figment of my imagination. Can't remember which right now.
They're just a bit long really. It's quite hard to remember a fourteen word name. I was thinking more like one or two words.
They're just chocolate eggs, not cursed omens.
They're just upstairs, but do be patient with them. They still have quite a bit of recovering to do.
They're just various rogues and thieves.
They're just walking around, Larry.
They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
They're largely made of barronite now, so they're a good source of the stuff.
They're listening to us.
They're looking after the victims in this church here. I'd recommend you make that your starting point.
They're looking for a quest.
They're lucky to have you as well, you're our last hope.
They're made out of granite! I don't have enough money left to make granite cannonballs though. But see!
They're making a break for it!
They're mine and the last thing I'll do is part with them!

They're monsters, I know that much. I've never known anything else, but I have a feeling it might be nice to not have to live in fear the whole time. Worrying if I'm going to make the next blood tithe quota.
They're nice, but the ones they have in Port Sarim are even better.
They're not easy to come by... and I believe you already have one?
They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...
They're not fooling me though. The next one that crosses me is going to regret it!
They're not for me... I need them for Olaf.
They're not for sale.
They're not going to be able to sniff whether I was successful or not unless I bring my cat with me.
They're not going to eat anything you've got there. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
They're not going to eat that. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
They're not going to eat that. Use the ingredients provided here.
They're not heirlooms at all, we have crates full of the things hidden away in the basement.
They're not his slaves. They belong to Alexei Jovkai now. He'll be keeping them in his prison north of the Arboretum.
They're not in it! They can't fish if their lives depended on it!
They're not my Slayer target.
They're not normal!
They're not stupid. They study at school and everything.
They're not the enemy. I thought they were, for so long, but they're not.
They're not there anymore though, thanks to me. Another vampyre has them now. One that I don't imagine will show any kindness to them.
They're not very valuable arrows, but I need them to do my job. Could you get them back for me?
They're not wrong though. We did fail to report a murder to them.
They're nothing but a useless bunch of weaklings who won't survive an hour once they're out on patrol.
They're old and dirty, I don't want to eat those!
They're on a bookcase in the Exam Centre.
They're organised little devils. Don't underestimate them.
They're out there right now? How will they get back in time?
They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
They're pretty hard to come by... But I might be able to exchange some, for any other kinds of crystal seed you might have.
They're primarily for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site, but you can go through if you want.
They're probably long gone by now.
They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
They're quite hard to come by, and I believe you've already got one.
They're quite poisonous to cats, how was I supposed to know, I'm not a cat doctor...
They're quite rare around here.
They're really good.
They're really heavy, and they weigh me down.
They're really that good?
They're resourceful folks, that's all I'm saying. The leader of their group, Veliaf, looks after them well.
They're right, you are mad.
They're ripped and full of holes
They're ripped and full of holes.
They're safe. They chose to stay and help the Guardians of the Rift keep the rift closed.
They're saying something about... they're planning something... something about a machine...
They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
They're so expensive, but so much fun!
They're some kind of crazy cult who dress all in black, and hang out near the cave entrance in the forest south of here.
They're starting to bend!
They're still there? I thought they would have cleared off after I killed their demon...
They're stolen goods, now give them here!
They're stronger and faster than many well trained soldiers, and twice as bloodthirsty.
They're the family of vampyres that rules all of Morytania. Lowerniel Drakan is the head of the family. Every bit of misery in this place is caused by him.
They're the family that leads the vampyres. They're the ones to whom the blood tithes are paid. Too much I have told you already!

They're the guardians of the source of the river Elid, they'll know of our curse, seeing as it's related to water we bring from the river. It's said that nothing happens on the river that they don't know about.
They're the local currency Bwana, it's used in Tai Bwo Wannai, there's usually some odd jobs that need doing around the village which you could do to earn some trading sticks.
They're the only ones who control the actual sailing of the ship.
They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No-one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it came out of the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
They're tougher than just metal on its own, plus it's the only such resource naturally available in this region.
They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
They're tougher, stronger and faster than other variations of cat, they can catch butterflies and kalphite larva and are far superior to any other type of cat at hunting.
They're upstairs recovering. They need some rest, but they'll be okay.
They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...
They're very nice, but you seem to have been chopping some down.
They're zombies and skeletons, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful.
They're zombies, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful.
They're... er... Very passionate.
They's no' wha' they once was. Tha cap'ain o'the Guard spends near all o'the time drunk in yon pub.
They've also agreed to let me move into the city. That tiny house in Ardougne was becoming a bit tiresome, and there's so much for me to learn from the Meilyr elves.
They've been a problem for a while, but they haven't been deemed dangerous enough to be properly dealt with. Councillor Hughes' influence, no doubt.
They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!
They've been bypassing the quarantine? How?
They've been living very quietly, a nice change from the norm. But almost too quietly. I always thought they'd get into more trouble. No good will come from them, let me tell you!
They've been ripped up by something with small teeth.
They've been stealing your tea?

They've come down with some strange disease that I've never encountered before. I've tried everything with them, but nothing seems to work. If it carries on like this I will lose all this year's crops.
They've done well to keep up the fight for this long.
They've found a reef near the island. They want to start dredging it for red coral, but they need you gone from the Little Pearl first.
They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
They've got six legs... SIX!
They've left the city! They were already boycotting the trade floor, but now they've completely left the city.
They've not been used to keep prisoners for a long time. But since the war ended, we've had more people visiting the island.
They've run away. I must go confront those alchemists downstairs.
They've taken her...
They've walked right through our defences!
They?
Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
Thief!
Thief! Thief!
Thief! You stole from me!
Thieves were picking people's pockets with impunity, and killing them on the streets in broad daylight!
Thieves! Thieves everywhere. Come to think of it, they always look remarkably like you! Adventurers running about stealing our things, get out of my sight.
Thieving

Thieving lets you steal items from various people and stalls. Be careful, as people won't take too kindly to you going through their pockets, and might call the guards on you, or may take matters into their own hands.
Thing is, he's gone and locked the box to make sure the goods can't be stolen, but hasn't told me how to unlock it again!
Thing is, it's hard to tell if it's working so far. They've been awkwardly standing there for quite a while now.
Thing under the bed
Thing?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
Things are very well thank you. Prince Itzla has tasked me with keeping an eye on the remaining Emissaries.
Things aren't easy for the family, especially since they never got closure. They're getting through it, though.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Things aren't the same here now that Sir Ceril is gone.
Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.
Things got a little heated down there, but we all made it out alive, right?
Things like food and drinks.
Things like that is why we must ensure the people keep believing in the plague though. One of the things we do to keep up the lie is to fool old Farmer Brumty into believing his sheep are infected.
Things might have been different, but I have made my choice, and it is up to you to prove that I made the right one.
Things were a bit hectic at first, but once I started preaching about the glory of Saradomin, a wave of calm and understanding came over this poor fellow.
Things work simply in the Ardougne ratpits.
Things? There's more than one now?
Thingummywut. Thin... gummy... what?

Think about it. However this investigation goes, you'll be seen as biased towards the Council. I'm a neutral third party with no ties to the Councillor or the protesters. I'm in an ideal position to help out here.
Think about it. Lowerniel Drakan is supposedly the most powerful vampyre in existence. What vampyre would dare cross the humans that killed him?
Think back to your earliest memories.
Think fast [player name]!
Think it through. There are fairies who control everything natural from the weather to the seasons.
Think not dishonestly.
Think nothing of it. I'm looking forward to seeing what you've produced for the Al Kharid market.
Think of all that we believe to know. All those words we have read. How many were the truth, I wonder.
Think of all the places you can visit when you get out!
Think of the Varlamorian children who won't get to see this artefact.
Think of the motherland!
Think of the poetic irony of the situation!
Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?
Think you can navigate us a course on this ship that isn't a BIG STUPID CIRCLE?
Think you could give me any hints?
Think you've got what it takes to join the College of Bards?
Think?
Thinkers must die!
Thinking about it, I vaguely remember someone mentioning something to me about a certain Gilbert near Varrock that helped them.
Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually.
Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually. You may have heard of the Phoenix Gang. I hear they have a very nice weapons stash not too far from here.
Thinking mode?
Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
Thinking of cheating my test, outerlander? I don't think so! You drink that keg fairly, or not at all! Don't let me catch you cheating!
Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
Third and Fourth
Third question. True or false: Goblin leaders should be good at planning in order to win battles.
Third right, seventh left. Got it. I'll get going then!
Third, avoid them lightning clouds! Even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
Third, remember that them rarer shoals don't just stay at one depth. Yer gonna find 'em swimmin' up and down. Ye' gotta pay attention and make sure yer net matches their depth.
Thirdly, someone needs to keep an eye on the temperature gauge. They should tell the pumper to start or stop so that the temperature stays in the right range.
Thirdly, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
Thirdly, trim your sails frequently to build up even more speed, but be careful! While it's important to go fast, doing so can make it harder to navigate around the fetid pools.
Thirdly, you need saltpetre. There are some natural deposits in the Hosidius woodlands, near the juniper trees.
Thirty one years ago, the moon eclipsed the sun and a false night fell across the land. That day marked a beginning, for it saw the birth of a pair of twins.
Thirty seconds???
Thirty years ago, Crandor was a thriving community with a great tradition of mages and adventurers. Many Crandorians even earned the right to be part of the Champions' Guild!
Thirty years ago, an adventurer descended into the caves beneath Crandor. There he discovered the dragon Elvarg.
This 'Eye'... did the book say what it looked like?
This 'draconic visage' had the power to channel dragonfire. Now, if I could attach the visage to the front of this shield...
This 'wall' has some disks set into it showing a picture and some levers. I should try pulling the levers to see what happens.
This 'wood' is an odd material. It's heavier than bone but it doesn't seem to be as brittle. It would be good for making crossbows out of!
This Ancient globe seems to show new constellations. What a discovery!
This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
This I did not foresee!
This I have to see.
This I know. But I don't see how it leads to money or promotion.
This Is Just To Say
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Combat Masteries to enhance your chosen combat style's strengths.
This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Demonic Pacts that let you choose new combat effects and improvements.
This Mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
This Royal Accord seems like our best bet. A clear document signed by all of them that determines the future of Kourend.
This Sage seems to be my hostage. You seem to be at my beck and call.
This Stranger from Afar... did he support that?
This Stranglewood place is supposed to be really dangerous. I should probably get myself some sort of protection before heading there.

texto: This Strength potion should be a suitable reward.
This Temple has been abandoned for some time. Maybe the creatures within have destroyed the tome while looking for food. You may have to kill them to recover the pages.
This Trailblazer tool is too extravagant to convert into an infernal pickaxe.
This Trick-or-Treating business.
This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.
This Wartface's fault.
This [man/woman] has gathered the remaining ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants.
This a catastrophe may become, as difficult it may be to fish while the trolls outside are waiting, and our bellies soon shall rumble loudly!
This adventurer was unwittingly helping me test it.
This ain't a museum! Leave now!
This all seems oddly specific.
This all seems very deep.
This all sounds very far-fetched.
This all sounds very immoral, and I don't want any part of your seedy little schemes.
This all sounds very odd. You're not possessed, are you Bwana?

This allowed me freedom amongst their camp, for it was always easy to point the finger of suspicion at some unsuspecting necromancer or foolish Mahjarrat if it seemed as though my activities had been discovered.
This altar, it seems to give off the same power as the Dark Altar.

This amulet is a symbol of your exploration of the Kharidian Desert. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 10 charges, Simon Templeton will purchase artefacts in banknote form and Desert goat horns are
This amulet is giving off abyssal energy. I need you to cast a spell to tell me where it came from.
This and that... But mostly, I'm looking for a good place to mobilise my army.
This appears to have been a shipment of ammunition.You take what you find inside.
This appears to have been a shipment of construction supplies. You take the ones not damaged by water.
This appears to have been a shipment of farming goods. You take what's left of the seeds inside.
This appears to have been a shipment of metals. You find a piece that looks unweathered.
This appears to have been a shipment of potions. You take the one that is still corked.
This appears to have been a shipment of runes. You take what's left of them.
This appears to have been a shipment of treated animal hides. You find a piece in good condition.
This appears to have been a shipment of weapons. You find just one left in the crate.
This area closed to JalYt.
This area is off limits to you!
This area is restricted, leave now!
This area is restricted. Leave now!
This area is very unstable. That's why we put markers on the wall showing the safest path.
This area of rock doesn't quite seem to match the rest of the cliff face. There appears to be a thin vertical slot in the middle of the rock, with what appears to be a carving of a feather above it.

This armour is a symbol of your exploration of Varrock. You now have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to coal and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to steel, when using the Edgeville
This armour... is for restraint, not... protection...
This artefact doesn't belong to you! It belongs to Varlamore!
This artefact... The Eye?

texto: This artefact... you mean the Eye?
This assassin must be found. I will remain here and ensure no one enters or leaves. You will search the rest of this dungeon and see what you can find.
This attracts many more Karambwan, but they still break free of the net.
This axe feels a little much for unfamiliar hands to wield it.
This balance is what we serve.
This bank booth is in an awful condition. There's a lot of broken glass and most of the wooden structure of the booth has been destroyed.
This bank is for new adventurers only, you cannot access it as you've already started your Group Ironman journey.
This banner is a symbol of your exploration of the Western Provinces. You now have a 25% chance of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will provide you with 25 free ogre arrows every day.
This barrel contains absorption potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have [X] doses of potion stored in here.
This barrel contains absorption potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have no potion stored in here.

This barrel contains super ranging potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have one dose of potion stored in here.
This barrel has been recently ransacked.
This barrel is quite big, but you may be able to carry one. Would you like to take one?
This be Hector's key. I believe it opens his chest in his old room in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
This be a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Ye may have heard of us.
This be your last chance, [player name]!!
This bee dealer is leaving a lot to be desired.
This big important secret meeting that Franizzard cooked for is held here in Lumbridge castle every 10 years, and tonight will be the tenth anniversary of it!
This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.
This bit of wall is fine. I don't need to mess around with it now.
This bit's all up to you, [player name].
This blade once belonged to my grandfather, but I believe its path now lies with you.
This blasted Karambwan just falls off the spear! My life is becoming such a grind...

This blessing is a symbol of your exploration of Great Kourend and the Kebos Lowlands. You now have a 2% chance of catching two fish at once while using the blessing. It also provides 3 daily teleports to the
This blue dragon smells like it's been dead for a remarkably long time. Even by my standards, it smells awful.
This boat looks pretty broken and is in need of a serious overhaul.
This boat looks pretty broken.
This body feels itchy...
This book has some very enlightening points to make, but you are at a loss to know how anyone without a head could possibly read it.
This book implies that the vampyres immunity isn't perfect and that it can be overcome. It seems they were trying to improve this immunity.
This book leaves you contemplating vegetarianism.
This book seems far too complex for you. Maybe Safalaan will know what to do with it.
This book seems to have been read hundreds of times, and has scribbles and formulae on every page. One such scribble says 'None good enough - have had to lock them in the caverns...'

This book uses very strange language and some incomprehensible symbols. It has a very dark feeling to it. As you're loooking through the book, you notice that one of the pages has been torn and half of it is missing.
This book will help you to start building your house.
This bookcase is full of old scripts, scores, and performance pieces.
This bravery... This defiance! It brings back a taste that's become all too absent back in Morytania. To finally find it again, here in Vampyrium... How fitting indeed.
This bridge will hold a thousand marching soldiers once I'm done with it!
This brings me back to the reason I'm stuck here of course, and the reason I need your help.
This brings us to a fun little fact. After his death, Imafore was succeeded by King Mezpah Arkan. One of his first acts was to call for the beheading of every statue of Imafore in the kingdom.
This bush is fake, and there's a hole underneath it!
This business has been stimulating local economies for over one generation, and represents a core pillar of every community in which it operates.
This cabbage is too firmly rooted. Only a sharp blade will be able to free it.
This calls for one thing and one thing only...
This can be rectified, simply bring me another Amulet of Catspeak and five death runes and I will enchant it for you.
This can only be done close to the water on the shore of the lake, just to our north-east. You will recognise the correct places by the ashes to be seen there.
This can't be good...
This can't be happening... This can't be happening!
This can't be real... This is a dream... Tell me this isn't real!
This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?
This cannot stand! It's a complete outrage!
This canopic jar should be able to preserve Arrav's heart!
This cape marks me as someone who has mastered the art of sailing. Only those who are skilled enough and brave enough to face anything the seas throw at them are allowed to wear one.
This cart is being unloaded into this section of the mine. Before being sent back to another section for another load.
This cart is full of eggs!
This caused you to fly... ingenious.
This cave is quite fascinating. We could really be on to something big here.
This cave leads to the Mining Guild, home to the finest mining site around. Is there anything else I can help you with?
This certainly seems like a hare-y situation, where did you get them all?
This certificate proves that we have accepted Dunstan's son for training in the Imperial Guard!
This chair is... moving? Perfect! Exactly the kind of spookiness Fred needs.

This changed as people learnt to grow crops and breed animals, and now there are very few of the old nomadic tribes. There's at least one tribe roaming between the Troll Stronghold and Rellekka, though.
This changes everything.
This charade bores me!
This chest has [X] loads of plunder inside.
This chest has been recently plundered.
This chest is full of plunder.
This chest is securely locked shut. There is some kind of balance attached to the lock, and a number four is painted just above it.
This chest, was there nothing else inside?
This chisel's rubbish, get me another!
This chute looks to be in pretty poor condition.
This chute looks to be in pretty poor condition. You don't think you'll get the boat down it in this state.
This city holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?
This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.

This cloak is a symbol of your exploration of Ardougne. The Citizen in West Ardougne will buy cats for 200 death runes each, some drops in the Tower of Life will be noted and the cape can teleport you to the
This coffin here contains one of those vampyres. The Zamorakians must have dug it up and brought it in here with them.
This coffin here contains one of those vampyres. The Zamorakians somehow found it and brought it here with them.
This cold wind blows right through you, doesn't it?
This concept of 'love' confuses and infuriates Arrg.
This concludes the advanced combat training. I must return to my duties now - King Awowogei has put me in charge of the guard to replace Kruk.
This contract will unlock the ability to choose Demonic Skin (red) during a makeover. Would you like to hand it in?
This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.
This conversation is pointless. If you want my support, this is the price. Now go and talk to Mori. I hear she spends most of her time in the Arceuus Church.
This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
This could be our only chance to kill Lowerniel Drakan. Surely that makes the risk necessary?
This could be very useful during battle.
This could be worse I guess. Oh wait... No it can't.
This could be worth looking into.
This could destroy your reputation! Everyone will think you're a thief!
This could quickly get interesting, but you need to do whatever it takes to get them back at that table. If even one of them walks away, we'll end up with a big problem on our hands.
This course will truly test your capabilities as a sailor. You'll find yourself alternating between navigating narrow spaces and vast wide open ones with the required speed and grace.
This court is now in session.
This coward here killed her, just like he killed her father.
This crate currently contains [amount] logs, [amount] oak logs, [amount] willow logs, [amount] yew logs and [amount] magic logs.
This crate has been recently looted.
This crate is full of ... spare controls!
This crate is full of... bananas. Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... bronze scimitars! Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... chisels. Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... crafting thread. Do you wish to take some?
This crate is full of... hammers. Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... iron scimitars! Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... magical monkey talking dentures! Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... monkey amulet moulds! Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... needles. Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... slimy gnome eyes! Do you wish to take one?
This crate is full of... tinderboxes. Do you wish to take one?
This crazy sailing... Think it could be the navigator's fault?
This crest will mark you as a representative of the Queen herself. Show it to them and they will not refuse.
This crew were all so very willing to get me where I wanted to go.
This criminal is a very dangerous fellow, and has some very dangerous friends.
This crowbar can be used to pry open crates full of drinks while out at sea. You can then add them to your sea charts by sampling the drinks.
This crystal ball thingy is kind of nifty. Can I have another one?
This crystal seems to glow and has a mystical aura about it. It seems to be vaguely heart shaped.
This dagger has been made for one purpose only... thank goodness you brought it to me.

This dates back to the times when there was much in- fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that

This dates back to the times when there was much in-fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that
This day is the worst. Fine, I'll head over there soon.
This decision was already made and was for the best. Goodbye, my friends.
This decision will forever change the future of Kourend. If we go forward with this, the Hosidius family will be the new royal family of Kourend.
This definitely isn't what Gujuo intended for me to do with this.

This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.
This didn't stop Mord climbing the wailing tower, on his side of the channel between our isles, to sing to me every night.
This discovery does bring about an intriguing question though.
This dish turned out horrendously.
This diving equipment works in place of the non- upgraded version. Higher level dives whilst charting the sea floor with mermaids will require this upgraded equipment.
This does not feel like the route I had expected. I would prefer not to go much further.
This doesn't frighten me, I've fought the queen of the Kalphites!
This doesn't give us anything more to go on though. We have our suspicions, but we still don't know for sure why they are doing this.
This doesn't look like a factory.
This doesn't look like grog...
This doesn't look safe... Good job my backpack magically stops things from breaking!
This doesn't look too bad, actually. I should show this to the Easter Bunny.
This doesn't make any sense, it's all jumbled up! Sort it out, will you, don't torment an old dwarf with nonsensical drawings!
This doesn't make sense! They've never attacked the Pearl before!
This doesn't make sense. Why can't you be more... clear?
This doesn't seem like a very good offer.
