texto: This doesn't seem right...
This doesn't seem to be the right magnet to open this door...
This doesn't sound good at all. Should we tell someone?
This doesn't sound good. I'd better let that sergeant know.
This doesn't sound good... Can you wait here for a little while? I get the feeling I'm going to need to be well prepared for whatever you have to tell me. I'll be back as soon as I can.
This doesn't sound like something I can help with. Good luck.
This dog has just the right amount of fur for its size: Too much of it! Just what I need to practice haircuts!
This dog is perfect! A dog this size will command respect with my cows, and the coat should keep it warm in winter.
This dog is perfect, thank you so much!
This dog looks like it will try to herd my knights. That's my job. Maybe another dog would work better.
This dog looks quite distinguished, but will need more grooming than I can commit to.
This dog?
This door appears to be locked.
This door appears to be securely locked.
This door is locked.
This dream not like other dream. It so real.
This drink has been sealed in a crate for an unknown amount of time. It could do anything to you, good or bad. Are you sure you want to drink it?
This duck can be used to chart the currents of the sea. Place him in an area where you wish to chart currents, then collect the duck from wherever he ends up.
This dungeon contains colourful transition effects that can be distressing to some players.
This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
This end... comes...
This ends here, Metzli. No more running.
This entrance looks dangerous. I probably shouldn't go in here without a good reason.
This exclusive concoction has been tested on all known forms of life and been proven to kill them all in varying dilutions from cockroaches to king dragons!
This eyewear will protect you from the spitting attack, allowing you to fight the monster on equal terms.
This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
This fearsome beast has huge claws, wicked teeth and a penchant for shiny objects. It is a very tough animal with a thick protective hide and an ill temperament.
This feature is not currently available on a Leagues world.
This feeling in my head - it is so strange - and it is a feeling I have felt before, although I cannot explain it. If you are trying to use some unnatural power over me, you have failed.
This feels a little mean-spirited, but I'll give it a go.
This feels like the banana, this should do the job.
This field looks so colourful! How did you do it?
This fireplace looks pretty old. It certainly hasn't been dusted recently. You see a loose tile and some scratch marks where a sharp instrument has been used.
This fireplace looks pretty old. It certainly hasn't been dusted recently. You see a loose tile with an empty compartment behind it.
This flask?
This floor was built some time ago and is not as accurate as it once was.
This floor was built some time ago but due to popular demand and some recent contributions the floor below has also been opened up for display.
This fortress belongs to the order of Black Knights known as the Kinshra.
This fractured crystal doesn't seem to fit right in this pillar.
This furnace is not hot enough to smelt elemental ore.
This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
This gate is locked.
This gate's sister...
This geyser looks a little small. I'd probably do a better job heating this rock in a larger geyser!
This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
This gnome needs your help.
This good stuff!
This good!
This good, Carol likes this!
This graveyard is no normal graveyard. It was once the private graveyard of the Hallow family. Every member of the royal family was buried here.
This graveyard is one of the last remaining examples of what Hallowvale was like. I bet there's a lot to discover here.
This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
This guy doesn't seem in any state to have organised grand theft eggo.
This guy gets on my nerves.
This guy is unbelievable!
This guy looks official. I'd better do the greeting before I speak to him.
This guy seems a little down on his luck. Do you want to help him?
This had better not be some kind of trick.
This happened to a cow earlier, and although I could mime it again, I'd really rather not.
This happens every time!
This happens every year....
This happens to be my office. Now explain yourself before I run you through!
This has always been the nature of evil. Perhaps he thought his power could prevent such treachery?
This has been highlighted in Falador by Wyson the Gardener who, after using some Malignus Mortifer's Super Ultra Flora Growth Potion, managed to create Gielinor's only known species of giant mole.
This has been known to turn the face and give the impression of severe illness.
This has been such a great day! I'm in the Realm of Memories, and I've even finished my apprenticeship. [player name], thank you so much!

This headgear is a symbol of your exploration of Kandarin. It functions as a light source and you now have a chance of receiving an extra log when cutting normal trees. You can get the flax keeper to convert
This helm needs to be made from an ore you can only get from the mine on this island. You'll see some stalagmites that you can mine from.
This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
This herb is very poisonous, however, so handle it with care. Also, be on your guard in that cave. Who knows what monsters may be in that awful place...
This here is Don't Know What, loyal bodyguard and chief sentry. He like a son to Mother.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
This here is the Warrior's Guild, a place where the strong may train. I'm the one who decides if you are allowed in or not.
This here was once our largest birthing pool. We use it for experiment. We increased the depth at which eggs are incubated. Over time, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
This here's the richest seam of ore I've found in all my days. After I built a contraption for washing the pay- dirt, the dwarves let me run things down here.
This house holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?
This house is a bit cold, so I could do with some normal logs to burn. Please bring me [#].
This human helped to rebuild the statue. [He deserves/She deserves/They deserve] this honour, surely?
This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly.
This icon denotes a Spinning Wheel on the world map.
This incantation will hopefully work.
This includes all of your stats and items and this process is irreversible. Your main save will be unaffected.
This includes that of the future king or queen. It is yet too early for me to decide which of my children should inherit the throne.
This intrigues me. How do you know me? You look familiar but I can't place it.
This is Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Basically, it's just a shop with a fancy name; you can buy various weapons and traps here.
This is Bridgelum, in the land of ScapeRune. I am Duke Oicaroh, and these creatures around you are my cows.

This is Daimon's Crater. Once, it was home to a group of demons who set up a fortress inside this dormant volcano to mine rare minerals. However, their activity reactivated the volcano, resulting in their demise.
This is Deepfin Point. Here, my workers and I have set up the finest mining operation you'll ever find. If you wish to do any mining yourself, you are more than welcome to.
This is Gizmo, a dear friend of mine.
This is Iestin Edern, head of research for Lord Iorwerth, and my informant within the Iorwerth clan.
This is Mill Lane Mill. Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
This is My Arm, yes. We'd like to borrow your boat, so we can visit more trolls in the north. My Arm is going to teach them to farm.
This is Rellekka!
This is Saradomin's wisdom.
This is Sarei, by the way. Apparently the two of you have met before?
This is Seers Village! We're an organisation of mystically gifted people with the power of foresight...we see things that have yet to come to pass.
This is TzHaar terminal chamber, TzHaar rest here to draw warmth from the volcano.
This is War! Fairness is a luxury of the weak.
This is [Fremennik name], your majesty.
This is [player name]. They've been helping out in Lovakengj recently.
This is a Sailing Alpha, find out how to get there yourself!
This is a Skillcape of Farming, isn't it incredible? It's a symbol of my ability as the finest farmer in the land and wearing it increases my herb yield!
This is a Skillcape of Firemaking, so bright that wearing it lights up caves! I was given it in recognition of my skill as the greatest firemaker in the lands! I AM the Master of Flame!
This is a Skillcape of Woodcutting, wearing one increases your chance of finding bird's nests. Only a person who has achieved the highest possible level in a skill can wear one.

This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!
This is a bad idea as if someone happens to find out your bank PIN on Old School RuneScape, they then have your real life bank PIN! Never use personal details for passwords or bank PINs!
This is a bad idea.
This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.
This is a blindweed patch. The soil has not been treated. The patch needs weeding.
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We don't really have too much need of it ourselves, but it's quite useful for tourists and such.
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
This is a contest, isn't it? I'm not going to tell my secrets, if that's alright!
This is a dangerous fight, you will lose your items on death.
This is a dark day for the Myreque.
This is a dark place we've come to. Fitting I suppose, for this is to be our darkest hour.
This is a disaster! I knew that teleportation matrix was too good to be true. I should have stopped this, but I was blinded by my own desires for that matrix!
This is a disaster! What about your secret weapon?
This is a disgrace!
This is a fundamental extract. Use it to enhance creation of air, water, earth and fire runes. I believe it also works for mind and body runes.
This is a furnace for smelting metal. You'll learn how to use it soon.
This is a great gift, [player name/fremennik name], which I humbly accept.
This is a great map, thanks for letting me have a copy! I'm excited to explore more of the jungle.
This is a lie! It has to be! The human is showing their true colours once again!
This is a long way from Burthorpe. What you doing out here?
This is a lot like a conversation I had with some goblins on the surface.
This is a lot to take in. I don't know if I like any of it.

This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
This is a nice pub you've got here.
This is a pet insurance bureau. I'm not insuring that.
This is a piece of map that you found in Melzar's Maze. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
This is a piece of map that you found in a secret chest in the Dwarven Mine. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
This is a piece of map that you got from Wormbrain, the goblin thief. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
This is a place of meditation, where a novice may contemplate the mysteries of the Dark Altar - without venturing too close to its power.
This is a portrait of Sithik, signed by the landlord of the Dragon Inn saying that he saw Sithik and Brentle Vahn together.
This is a powerful scroll. Perdu, the dwarf, can use it to help lock certain items to their owners, so that the items aren't destroyed on death in deep Wilderness.
This is a practice area?
This is a restricted area. You can only enter under the authority of King Lathas.
This is a sad, sad day. I can't stop you from doing it, but I wish with all my heart you wouldn't. You'll be aiding a murderer.
This is a size-[9/8/7/6/5/4/3/2/1] star. A Mining level of at least [90/80/70/60/50/40/30/20/10] is required to mine this layer. It has been mined [#]% of the way to the next layer.
This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.
This is a task of upmost importance. I intend to lead the infiltration myself.
This is a very strange request!
This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
This is about that ship isn't it? The one with the red sails? You know that ship, don't you?
This is about the bank robbery, right?
This is about your LIES and your BAD behaviour!
This is all a disaster! The plagues were bad enough, but now we've got hypnotised adventurers plundering tombs! I've only just started this job as well!
This is all a lie! I've been framed!
This is all my fault. But I didn't mean to upset her. I just thought we could be friends. Now I must have upset her, and she's cursed us all!
This is all very confusing. You go find this cat of yours. I need to sit down and clear my head of all this weirdness.
This is all very interesting, but I've got to get going.
This is all very interesting. The citizens of this town are Zamorakians and willingly give their blood to the vampyres. Why would Damien need the Sleeper Plague?
This is all very odd. Do you know where he keeps the journal?
This is amazing Bwana, the level of detail is incredible. Where did you find it?
This is amazing news! So this means I can finally deliver Easter eggs into the desert. Those adventurers will be so happy!
This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
This is an Anima patch, the only one of its kind. Here, you can grow Iasor, Kronos and Attas plants.
This is an Ectophial. If you ever want to come back to Port Phasmatys, empty this on the floor beneath your feet, and you will be instantly teleported to the temple - the source of its power.
This is an Imcando favourite, cooked to perfection.
This is an adaptation unique to terrorbirds that appears to aid in running. Their legs are powerful enough to kill even large animals.
This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
This is an amazing revelation. We must include it in our report. Thank you, we'll mention your bravery.
This is an ancient artefact!
This is an anvil used for smithing. You'll learn how to use it soon.
This is an elven bank. The magic in this place allows you to access your account here in the western lands.
This is an impressive map! I'm amazed, it's just great! Do you mind if I make a copy of it? I'll give you my Bullroarer in return.
This is an odd-looking bank.
This is an old place, [player name]. Older even than much of what we dwarves remember.
This is an old villa. Apparently it once played a role in some smuggling operations a long time ago. I could see them having a few secrets to help them with that.
This is another vampyrification lab... What have you done?
This is around the time my wares ripen and sell for their highest price.
This is awful! Yes, yes of course, we must do something!
This is bad... I will put the troops on high alert. And... Well, we do have someone else who may be able to help...
This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.
This is boring. Let's go.
This is brilliant! Amazing stuff!
This is brilliant! I'm sure you won't regret this!
This is burnt meat.
This is clearly an artist's impression of some moment in Morytania's history.
This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
This is defeanin... definitely a sword...
This is delicious! Where did you find such a excellent cuisine!
This is dire news. I must speak to the Queen at once. Is there anything else I should be aware of before doing so?
This is disastrous! Things seem to go from bad to worse! You will have to communicate this information to our leader, Safalaan. He needs to know as soon as possible.
This is due to a very thick and tough hide, made from thousands of thick scales. Most people who claim to be hunters have a very hard time trying to dispatch lizards.
This is enough for you to become Regent; I should talk to King Vargas if I were you.
This is exactly what our friends overseas were looking for. Here's your cut. Let me know when you're ready for more work.
This is excellent news, [player name]. Where is Nieve?
This is fascinating, but I have to be...
This is for Dobbie!
This is for [player name], not you.
This is for helping out with that bull. Our cows are much happier these days.
This is for my wife, Ingrid. I'm sure she will love it. Tell her it's tribal or something.
This is for you to decide, visitor.
This is for you. Take it! Take it!
This is fun!
This is getting both surreal and repetitive.
This is getting very tiresome!
This is going to be a very difficult grab, try moving a little closer.
This is going to hurt, isn't it?
This is going to sound crazy, but do you have any fishing bait that I could use to fish in a desert oasis?
This is going to sound silly...
This is gonna taste sooo good
This is good news indeed, [player name]. That should stop anyone from entering for another thousand years.
This is good news indeed. Lord Iorwerth will be very happy. You should go and let him know.
This is good news, give it a few days and the slave pens will be full again.
This is good news, in case you were wondering! Access to a teleportation matrix like that will be life changing when it comes to my work!
This is good to hear. It put me at ease to know she is in my grandfather's home. I will rest even easier once it has been consecrated.
This is good! I wonder what's in it? Actually... I'd rather not know.
This is grand news indeed! You'll forgive me if I'm a little apprehensive about this, but I take it you do have proof?
This is grave news indeed!
This is great news!
This is growing boring. Shall we spice it up?
This is growing boringly repetitive, Veliaf. For the last time, if I wanted any of you dead, I'd have done it by now.
This is hard work!
This is hard work, but we must make up for our wrongs.
This is hardly a good moment, fool. Meet me south-west of the Falador Party Room instead.
This is hardly the Shayzien Prison. These walls are rotting away! There must be a way through one of them.
This is highly irregular! But I suppose I should.
This is highly irregular.
This is highly irregular. Please wait...
This is how it'll work: When you die, you'll respawn right here in Ferox Enclave, just outside the pub we've set up. You will lose your items as normal of course.
This is how your subjects are distributing their effort.
This is incredible Bwana.
This is incredible!
This is incredible! But where's the other half?
This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
This is indeed a bad omen, Bwana. I've never known the sacred pool to dry up before...
This is indeed an important issue. They've gone too far this time. A major company willingly leaving the Consortium has never happened before.
This is indeed strange. I must commune with mighty Guthix and the forces of destiny.
This is insanity! Guards! Arrest them at once!
This is interesting news. I will send an envoy down to speak with them. We must ensure all access into the temple is secure.
This is intolerable! How could this happen?
This is it! Get to your place in the circle and say the words!
This is it! The plague of West Ardougne has gone on for long enough, today is the day of plague's end!
This is it, this is what we've spent the last thousand years fighting for. Today, it will finally all be worth it.
This is it. This is our chance to finally find some answers. To finally find out the truth behind Elvarg. Are you ready to go?
This is it. This is the day we've spent so long fighting for. Myreque prevail.
This is it. This is the end.
This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.

This is just the beginning! Gnome breeders and trainers are already working to expand the number of units. Soon we'll have hundreds of these beauties, nay thousands! And they will not only carry mages and
This is just the start! The completed fleet will be awesome!
This is just what I needed for my special secret... err... I've said too much! Take this and get out of here quickly!
This is likely not the true version of events. Guthixians also claim that it was Guthix himself who made the world. Obviously, that is not correct.
This is likely to be screaming. There's bound to be a good spot somewhere in the troll prison.
This is literally the head of a dead bear. What is wrong with you?
This is madness.
This is marvellous! It's exactly what I need. With some decorations, these rooms shall be...
This is more than just a place of spectacle. You stand in one of the holiest sites in all of Varlamore. Each drop of blood spilt here is a glorious offering to Ralos.

This is most concerning though. If someone deliberately sabotaged the Altar, who knows what else they might do. I'll have someone recover the remains of this device. Maybe we can work out where it came from.
This is most fortuitous!
This is murder on my hay fever you know...

This is my home for the moment. I'll probably move on at some point, but I'm in no rush. Humans like yourself stop off to do a bit of fishing or woodcutting from time to time, but it's otherwise nice and peaceful here.
This is my home, mundane human! What do you have in your pockets? Something tasty?
This is my home. I'm off-duty.
This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
This is my latest experimental arena. I... designed it to make people feel and accept the pain of life.
This is my spinning wheel! Look at the way it goes round and round and round...
This is no easy task, [Fremennik name], but glory awaits you if you succeed.
This is no game anymore!
This is no life for anyone. The truth is, Rose died long ago. All that's left now is an empty shell.
This is no ordinary rat. It is a magnificent creature of evolution, forged by the unwitting contributions of adventurers who entered its cave.
This is no place for sight-seeing. Don't you know there's been a plague outbreak?
This is no time for humour.
This is no time to linger. The King must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical moment for Ardougne.
This is not a democracy, Operative! Panther already exists and he's working on a mission in Al Kharid. It's my way or the highway.
This is not a good day for me.
This is not a good place to be, go and prepare for the coming darkness.
This is not correct.
This is not good news. Did you find anything else down there?
This is not good. That relic wasn't just for show! It was once part of a powerful artefact. You must report this to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
This is not part of the Agility course! Go EAST for the next obstacle.
This is not really the time to dance.
This is not the Karamja rum we are looking for.
This is not the Karamja rum you are looking for.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Fernahei requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Kaleb Paramaya requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Obli requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Seravel requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Vigroy requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not typically possible, because accessing Yohnus requires completion of Shilo Village.
This is not up for debate. I have made my will clear. Return to us once you have something, adventurer. Not before.
This is not what I had in mind for this time of year.
This is not where I wanted to obtain a cabbage. I asked for one from the cabbage field south of Falador. The big field, perpetually laden with brassican goodness.
This is one of my personal seed pods, handed down through the generations of my family.
This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
This is one of the lairs of those foul lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
This is one of your human banks. We set it up here to help your kind serve the balance with us.
This is only 75 coins, I can't let you have a ticket for that.
This is only the beginning though. There's much work to still be done. I may well call on your help again. Or maybe I won't, who knows. Now take these and go.
This is only the beginning; you can't beat me!
This is our Sacred Grove. It is a place dear to all tortugans, but I'm afraid I can't allow you to enter.
This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
This is our birthing pool. TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in this large pool here.
This is our home. In your tongue, it is known as Mount Karuulm.
This is our local shrine to She.
This is our outpost. From here we send launches out to the nearby islands to beat back the invaders.
This is our purpose.
This is our town! We live here. It's called Burgh de Rott, and you ain't coming in!
This is our town! We's live here. It's called Burgh de Rott. It aint much to look at, but it's our home.
This is our vinery. My father's cracked the secret of viticulture, and although our climate's too cold for most grapes, we've made a working vineyard here.
This is outrageous! I'm warning you, The Red Axe will boycott the Trade Octagon!
This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!
This is perfect! Thanks a lot, miss!
This is pointless. I should be stealing things.
This is pretty scary...
This is private property! Please leave!
This is purely slaying for the love of slaying.
This is quite a small bank.
This is quite possibly one of the best opportunities we've ever been given. Ranis Drakan is brother to Lowerniel Drakan himself and is one of the most senior figures in vampyric society.
This is quite surprising, as most domestic camels are happy eating nothing but vegetables.
This is quite the dilemma.
This is quite the group you've gathered here.
This is quite the tower.
This is really important though!
This is really important!
This is really it, isn't it? Grubfoot's dream was just that, a dream. All Yu'biusk is now is an empty wasteland.
This is really quite embarrassing, but...
This is sacred ground. This is most obviously a shrine built by emissaries of Ranul.
This is scary!
This is so awful...
This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!
This is so fun!
This is so much better than being cooped up in that camp.
This is some comfort to be sure.
This is some party you've got going here!
This is someones name. Have a look around the Al Kharid inhabitants.
This is sounding like a great opportunity to be heroic, shall I go get her for you?
This is split-bark armour, it's special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
This is starting to feel like my retirement!
This is starting to sound a little bit dodgy, and I do appreciate I'm in a hive of scum and villainy as I say this.
This is starting to sound a little tricky, can't you make it for me?
This is starting to sound familiar...
This is starting to sound hard.
This is stealing! Thieving! Taking what's not yours!
This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go help little Frankie.
This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go tell Herr Caranos.
This is taking longer than I expected!
This is tedious, I've lost interest.
This is terrible! I was just trying to get into the Halloween mood, reading something scary from that antique book of Rituals and suddenly the crypt shook and a THING appeared!
This is terrible! Surely the magical influence of the Salve should be preventing that? What if the vampyres are able to cross as well? Drakan could start a full onslaught!
This is terrible! The stones must be recovered!
This is terrible, terrible news! They have found a way to get across the Salve!
This is terrible, you must do something!
This is terrible...
This is the Abyss.
This is the Bank of Dorgesh-Kaan! Since surface dwellers began coming into the city, we've made an arrangement with the Bank of Gielinor on the surface, so we can act as one of their branches.
This is the Barbarian Assault arena.
This is the Champions' Guild. Only adventurers who have proved themselves worthy by gaining influence from quests are allowed in here.
This is the Dorgeshuun Council chamber!
This is the Easter Bunny. I'm stuck in my office, and I'm having to use my emergency broadcast system to talk to you.
This is the Ectofuntus, the most marvellous creation of Necrovarus, our glorious leader.
This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.
This is the Emir's Arena. Fighters come from far and wide to arrange fights against their friends and rivals. They can fight in 1v1 Tournaments or Duels.
This is the Emir's Arena...duh!
This is the Grand Exchange, the best trading spot in the land! People come from all across the country to buy and sell every item under the sun.
This is the Hosidius Kitchen. Here, under my expert eye, we prepare the food that feeds most of the population.
This is the Hosidius Mess. It was set up to help feed the soldiers from the Shayzien Encampment. Much better than anything they can cook over there.
This is the Keldagrim Carts-station, human.
This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
This is the Legends' Guild!
This is the Library Historical Archive. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
This is the Lumbridge branch of the Bank of Gielinor! Would you like to access your account?
This is the Marim branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Now that our people have more contact with the lands overseas, we have new business opportunities. Can I help you?
This is the Nightmare Zone!
This is the Rabbit Hole.
This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
This is the Shayzien Administration. The city of Shayzien is run from here.
This is the Skullball Course.
This is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The first and only time that Ralos appeared to us, he did so here on Ralos' Rise. The Teomat was built here as a result.
This is the Teomat. Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul are based here, though given us being atop Ralos' Rise, the location holds far more importance to the Church than it does to us.
This is the big one. We believe we are now in a place where we can move against Lucien.
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat.
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat. We can sell you very reasonably priced water...

This is the champions' arena. The champions of various races use it to duel those they deem worthy of the honour. If you find a challenge scroll in your travels, bring it here to face your challenger.
This is the costume, what do you think?
This is the creed of Zamorak.
This is the demon-slaying sword Silverlight, the only weapon that can kill Agrith-Naar!
This is the dense essence mine. The essence we gather here is used across Arceuus, and indeed all of Kourend. If you wish, you are welcome to mine some yourself.
This is the end of you!
This is the entrance to the Hemenster fishing competition. It's a high class competition. Invitation only.
This is the famous Party Pete's wicked birthday bash, how can they not be enjoying themselves?
This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
This is the fight cave, TzHaar-Xil made it for practice, but many JalYt come here to fight too. Just enter the cave and make sure you're prepared.

This is the fight pit, TzHaar-Xil made it for their sport but many JalYt come here to fight too. If you are wanting to fight then enter the cage, you will be summoned when next round is ready to begin.

This is the finest wizards' establishment in the land. We have magic portals to the other towers of wizardry around Gielinor. We have a particularly wide collection of runes in our rune shop. We sell some of the finest
This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.
This is the headquarters of Supplies's Supplies, a global chain of world class equipment providing outposts that effectively synergise with local corporate needs.
This is the headquarters of one of the most dangerous crime syndicates this city has ever seen! The Phoenix Gang!
This is the headquarters of the Phoenix Gang, the most powerful crime syndicate this city has ever seen!
This is the home of Sir Ceril Carnillean of the noble Carnillean family. You're welcome to look around, but I'm afraid I'll have to keep an eye on you.
This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a shortcut through your home?
This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Once you've formed a recruitment group, you'll be able to control it there, via the PvP Arena options.
This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
This is the icon for the summary panel. Within it there is a section for Combat Achievements.
This is the kind of thing that's best carried in buckets.
This is the land of snow... there's tons of it out there.
This is the last night you'll spend alone.
This is the law of Armadyl.
This is the main facility of the Alchemical Society. We're an organisation who fuse the forgotten teachings of the Old Ones with traditional Gielinorian Herblore practices.
This is the marketplace of Hosidius. To the north west there's my sister's pub, and in the south is my grandfather's fruit farm. Do you need to buy anything while you're here?
This is the northernmost reach of Kourend. Beyond these cliffs you will find the Doors of Dinh and the prison of the Wintertodt.
This is the official residence of the Blue Opal.
This is the official residence of the Brown Engine.
This is the official residence of the Green Gemstone.
This is the official residence of the Purple Pewter.
This is the official residence of the Silver Cog.
This is the official residence of the White Chisel.
This is the official residence of the Yellow Fortune.
This is the one Ranis. This is my new Queen Nylocas. All that work has finally paid off.
This is the one thing I can give. My family have honoured me with this spear. But the honour is truly yours.
This is the only help I may give you...
This is the only land border into the Kingdom of Varlamore. We're here to make sure no one enters without permission.
This is the pass of Shantay. I guard this area with my men. I am responsible for keeping this pass open and repaired.
This is the place where I met me' maker.
This is the port of Land's End!
This is the port of Piscarilius. Home to Kourend's finest fisherman, but beware of the thieves!
This is the power you are abusing!! I feel it now - it emanates from the ring you wear, a festering fountain of corruption that appalls my very soul!!!
This is the principal station of the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Once it's running, our people will be able to travel rapidly all across the city.
This is the prison of Zalcano.
This is the reason why the lack of communication from him bothers me somewhat, although I am sure it's nothing too serious. Nobody would dare to try and attack our kingdom!
This is the reason why the lack of communication from him bothers me somewhat, although I am sure nobody would dare to try and attack our kingdom!
This is the restricted section!
This is the right one?
This is the same thing I just gave you!
This is the schematics board. It's used to upgrade core parts of your boat, such as the hull. However, you have no reason to use it right now. You should focus on building your cargo hold instead.
This is the scroll I gave you. I don't know how to solve it I'm afraid. Maybe look for someone named Bob?
This is the strangest place I have ever been.
This is the tale of how the outerlanders came about; through stealing from the gods, and from betraying our ideals. This is why we show them no trust.
This is the tankard I found on the remains of Brentle Vahn!
This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
This is the treasure which you seek???
This is the truth, but there is more to the story than that. The answers
This is the voice of your conscience! You've been a very naughty boy haven't you?
This is the voice of your conscience. Hand all your money to [player name]! Wooo wooo!
This is the worst event I have ever seen. Where's the chaos? Where's the misery?
This is the worst hangover ever...and I didn't even get drunk!
This is the wrong sort of cabbage!
This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
This is too big; you need a spit roast for this big bird.
This is too confusing, I'll see you later.
This is too much for just us to deal with. We're going to need some help.
This is too weird. I...caaannooot....uuunnnnderstaaaand...youuuu!
This is training soldier. If you want fun go make some cocktails.
This is tricky. I think it was showing the importance of being able to know your own abilities and having confidence in them. You need this to beat opposition in whatever form that
This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
This is true, I'm sycamore paperwork.
This is true, but it has brought us so much more in return, so much more.
This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?
This is true. However, in the future, I will have my own entire floor of the Museum with paintings galore!
This is truly amazing...
This is truly fantastic Effendi!
This is truly incredible bwana... So these are the remains of the dread Queen Rashiliyia?
This is turning into a lot of work...
This is unconscionable! I am not an object! I am a sentient creature with hopes and dreams!
This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
This is useless, all of these flavours are terrible! Thanks for nothing, get off our island!
This is very amazing. I will make note of it in my mission report.
This is very important, we have to make sure we test thoroughly!
This is very impoten... important...
This is very impressive Bwana, I'm quite surprised at your ingenuity. This should be a good protection against Rashiliyia if you ever find her Tomb.
This is very sad. To see such information desecrated in this way.
This is very sad. To see such religious scripts desecrated, it's blasphemy!
This is very troubling [player name], very troubling indeed. While it's permitted for learned members of our order to research the 'dark arts', it's absolutely forbidden to make use of such magic.
This is vital for the cold-blooded lizards who have no means to regulate their internal temperature.
This is what Big High War God say:
This is what Felix found.
This is what I get when I ask random strangers for help...
This is what you be needing...
This is where Elvarg made her home. There must be something here to point us in the right direction. Have a look around and see what you can find.
This is where I live, human.

This is where we launch our landers to combat the invasion of the nearby islands. You'll see three landers - one for novice, intermediate and veteran adventurers. Each has a different difficulty, but they therefore offer
This is where we truly became who we are now. Art... Culture... The things my brother now hates. They all came from him.
This is where we want to be! Let's see if we can find some sort of intelligence. Maybe some maps or similar.
This is where you ask 'What's the catch?'
This is why I am looking for an exceptional soul to be regent of this fair kingdom of Miscellania.
This is why I eat the grain in that sack over there. It's specially grown out here in the desert. Once harvested, it goes through a preparation process of several years that...
This is why I spend my time searching through these few remains we have left from the glorious old Tower. I hope someday to find something that will tell us once more of the mysteries of
This is why the Abyss is so useful. It can be used as an effective hub for teleportation. In fact, all teleportation that we know of uses the Abyss, you just don't realise it.
This is wonderful!
This is wonderful, I shall have a display made immediately to go with the staff model. Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.
This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click]/[Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click]/[tap] it again to deactivate it.
This is your bit, [player name]! Take the helm when ready.
This is your garden?
This is your last warning adventurer: keep your nose out of our business.
This is your spell book, this contains all the spells you can cast. To cast a spell, you will need to have the required magic level and have the right amount of the runes used to cast the spell.
This is your what?
This is... a piece of paper?
This is... quite something. Here, you'd better see for yourself.

This island is being invaded by outsiders and the Void Knight over there is using a ritual to unsummon their portals. We must defend the Void Knight at all costs, however if you get an opening you can destroy the
This island is covered in crabs. I am sure I could find a way to get that info out of you.
This island is too small though... They won't be able to see it.
This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.
This isn't a grannies' tea party, let's see some sweat human. Go! Go! Go!
This isn't a house, it's a... Actually, human, it's none of your business!
This isn't a struggle for land or title. It is a war for life, all life. If Iorwerth and Lathas manage to summon Zamorak, we all die.
This isn't allegory though, you're just avoiding my questions!
This isn't already the case?
This isn't ballet soldier!
This isn't exactly the first odd occurrence when it comes to Veos either. A while back I helped him with some strange client of his.
This isn't funny!
This isn't good [Fremennik name]. The prison has already been breached.
This isn't good!
This isn't good, iknami. We don't think there's any way we can put this egg back together again.
This isn't good, it will only be a matter of time before they discover the temple.
This isn't good.
This isn't good. I need to get back there!
This isn't good. I'd better get back and tell the High Priest.
This isn't good. I'd better get to Varrock right away!
This isn't good. I'd better head into town and try to find some help.
This isn't good. If Vanstrom thinks he can use this creature against us, I have no reason to disbelieve him. He's proven time and time again that he should not be underestimated.
This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.
This isn't how I was meant to die!
This isn't over yet [Fremennik name], the Jormungand is weak from his imprisonment! We can still stop him!
This isn't over!
This isn't over! I will find proof!
This isn't over, Vacu.
This isn't real! I know this isn't real!

texto: This isn't right... We've made a mistake. We need to leave now!
This isn't so scary after all!
This isn't spooky, this is obscene.
This isn't the best conversation ever, I have to say.
This isn't the can-do attitude we need, [player name], but fine, we'll go back...
This isn't the end by any means. The Iorwerth forces are still at large and we are not strong enough to stop them. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.
This isn't the last you'll see of me, human. Mark my words - the monkeys are listening.
This isn't the place to talk. Visit me in Varrock's Chaos Temple if you have something to discuss. Unless you're here to teleport or buy something?
This isn't the right way! I'm going back to the pub!
This isn't true! Someone must have set me up!
This isn't... the last... of me...
This junction is blocked. I'd better go back to the start and find some way to make it go left or right.
This keg is filled with horizon's lure. A keg of horizon's lure gives a 2.5% boost to all Sailing experience gained.
This keg is filled with kraken ink stout. A keg of kraken ink stout improves the chance of random encounters spawning at sea by 4%.
This keg is filled with perildance bitter. A keg of perildance bitter increases the max hit of your cannons by one.
This keg is filled with trawler's trust. A keg of trawler's trust gives a 5% chance to catch an extra fish whilst deep sea trawling.
This keg is filled with whirlpool surprise. A keg of whirlpool surprise gives your crew a minimum of 2 Deckhandiness and 2 Helmsmanship.
This kind of thing happens a lot when I take My Arm out to places.
This kingdom will never be safe while the Council rule!
This knife doesn't seem sturdy enough to have killed Lord Sinclair.
This knowledge? You mean immortality?
This ladder looks like it's missing the top part. It looks too dangerous to climb down from here.
This land has seen better days, but I have no doubt that Father Sugadinti will guide us into making it a new paradise.

Use tools.

Use yer loaf! Why'd I be in the tub fer that. I'm brassic ain't I!

Use! Your! Hands!
Used to take on anyone and everyone who stood in me way, and made myself a small fortune doing it too.
Useful how?
Useless corpses... Give me your strength!
Useless fool! Return when you routine is more polished!
Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the Centurion myself!
Useless! Utterly useless!

Useless... completely useless.
Using Bank deposit boxes.

Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.

Using the bank itself.

Using the enchanted amulet is easy; open up the amulet and you'll see a cat's face, use the whiskers to rotate the cats nose. You'll see the nose move and the new direction highlighted. When the nose points in the
Using the knowledge from the waterlogged journal you found on the Pandemonium, you assemble the Medallion of the Deep!
Using the stained underpants as kindling, you light the boiler. As the house warms up, you hear the dripping of icicles melting in the room above.
Using wrong tool. We should be using the grindstone.

Ussse the key I gave you. That will get you inssside. But be cautiousss of the Yo'kal ahk human. He isss very dangerousss.
Usually Varrock is full of Easter merriment by now...
Usually Wartface give up by now!
Usually a strong creature of some sort will be guarding the bones and it is not to be tackled lightly.
Usually my little brother would follow up on them, often coming back with a big pile of loot.

Usually you can't, but with poorly-made clothes, it's possible to remove the dye. Even then, it's a very tricky process involving a special ingredient found in the gut of the Hemenster Whitefish.
Usually...
Usually? You don't any more?
Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant! (May barbarians invade your personal space!)
Utterly amazing! So much better than I imagined.
Uuh, I mean, I was told to come here... after I hopped out of the portal.
Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
Uurrggh! Get zat horrible tsing avay from me! How do people like to eat zat stuff? I can't stand even to be near it for tsen zeconds!
Uuuhhh!
Uuummmpf...
Uuuurgh...
Uuuurrrrh! Hate you!
UwU?
Uwogo, have a messenger fetch him from his post.
V sailed his mighty longship,

V's Shield?
V's Sigil is, well... in the shape of a V.

VERY bad luck.

VTAM, got it.

Vacca foeda. (Stupid cow.)

Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
Valdez? Who be that? Some foul necromancer?
Valentine's Day
Vampyre
Vampyre slaying, right?

Vampyres!

Vanar! Maradar! Dominar!
Vanar! Septinar! Filinar!

Vanescula said it was because of his icyene blood?
Vanescula!

Vanescula, please. This veil of lies is thinner than the humans you feast upon.
Vanescula. What do we do?
Vanescula. You're still in your vampyre form?
Vanescula...
Vanescula?

Vanligga Gastfrihet puts 5000gp into the tax bag.
Vanstrom Klause.
Vanstrom attacked the Myreque in Meiyerditch!
Vanstrom!

Vanstrom.

Vanstrom?
Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer. I believe they were all Zarosians.

texto: Vargas, you irritating fool. 'Warmongering harpy', indeed!

Various words are also carved into the plaster. Below the dark creature the words 'silver', 'garlic', 'harralander' and 'red eggs' are caved. As well as this, the word 'silvthrill' is carved by the figure.
Varlamore might close their lands again after this.
Varlamore might never let you and your colleagues visit again!
Varlamore, the kingdom to the south. Our two kingdoms were in conflict less than a hundred years ago, and relations remain sour. It would take very little for that conflict to be reignited.
Varrock
Varrock Herald, now only 50 coins!
Varrock Herald, on sale here!

Varrock forever!
Varrock has an interesting history when it comes to zombies. Tell me, what do you know of Arrav?
Varrock is a fairly long way north-east of here. The church is at the eastern side of the town, near the Palace.
Varrock.
Varrock?
Vegetable patches are growing fewer vegetables, bushes are producing fewer berries and everything that is planted seems to be more prone to disease!

Vegetarrrian...?
Vegetate!
Velam, step forward.

Veldaban is in my employ.

Veldaban, Commander of the Black Guard in Keldagrim, presenting himself to the Consortium with a guest.

Veliaf Hurtz.

Veliaf gives you your flail.
Veliaf heads back to the Hollows.
Veliaf leads this group. We operate throughout Mort Myre and the surrounding villages. He reports to Calsidiu who is the head of our resistance.
Veliaf thinks it would be useful to have a priest to advise him. I think he also wants me further away from harm until I'm more experienced.
Veliaf told me about Ivandis.
Veliaf!
Veliaf! Are you okay?
Veliaf! It has been far too long my friend.
Veliaf! You've...

Veliaf, about earlier...
Veliaf, my friend, you and I will not be around to protect Ivan forever. We have guided him to this point, but maybe it's time for him to start looking after himself.
Veliaf, the leader of their Mort Myre group, is an old friend. I imagine they'd appreciate the help of someone like you, if you can find them.
Veliaf, what do we do?
Veliaf.
Veliaf...
Veliaf... You lied about Calsidiu and the other Myreque?
Veliaf?

Veliaf? What are you doing here?
Veliaf?!

Velrak reaches somewhere mysterious and passes you a key.
Ven, estella infernus

Venator (Formerly)

Venom is pretty good at dealing damage, imagine how useful that would be.
Vent...

Veos, this isn't funny anymore... Are you alright? I did all that your client asked for me...
Veos, this isn't funny anymore... Are you alright? I did all that your client asked of me...
Veos?
Ver Sinhaza is home to the Theatre of Blood. Maybe they were just there as spectators?
Ver Sinhaza, home to the Theatre of Blood.
Verily I urge you, my friends to take up your spades and farm your farms to feed our people in this blessed sanctuary.

Verity will be glad to have another one ticked off. Thanks. Here's your reward.
Vertida and I will begin forming a plan of action. In the meantime, do you remember that book on haemalchemy you found for us?
Vertida gives you a message.
Vertida gives you some notes.
Vertida leads you through the ghetto.

Very amusing, Your Royal Highness. How can I help you?

Very big.
Very bizarre.
Very briefly.
Very busy, my friend. We have a lot of repairs to be doing, not to mention that there will soon be a new Gathering taking place here.
Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.
Very careless of you, what? Here, take another, but be careful of this one!
Very careless of you, what? Here, take another, but be careful with this one!
Very clean indeed. You didn't tell my squire that I know about the armour did you?
Very clever. How long do you think it will take?
Very clever. It might also serve us well to remind Narnode of Bolren's situation.
Very clever. Now get out of my sight.
Very creative.
Very crunchable. Me have more?
Very deep! Excellent, I'm glad you learnt something. I shall send you back!
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!
Very far, although it will not reach the whole way down the river.
Very far, but not the whole way, best keep swinging that axe of yours.
Very few humans are ever given this power, but you've proven yourself to be a friend to feline kind.
Very few know of the secret mine under the Grand Tree. If you push on the roots just to my north they will seperate and let you pass.
Very forgetful, why can't I remember? Hmm... you could help me! Then I'll attend that birthday bash.
Very funny Johnathon, I can't help but laugh...
Very funny, [player name].
Very funny, human, but I find that hard to believe. Go and offer yourself as a sacrifice again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
Very funny, human.
Very funny.
Very funny. Har, har.
Very good peasant, thank you for showing one that, but one has given you a job to do. Do it.
Very good then! I'll have no guilty conscience in offering it to other adventurers that frequent my shop then. Many thanks for your time and good day to ya sir.
Very good work, human!
Very good!
Very good! Come and eat this cake I baked!
Very good! I'll happily exchange some treasures I've found in return for your findings!
Very good! Let's get started then.
Very good! Very good! A positive first step indeed! We'll give it a bit longer to make sure it properly kicks in, and then we can start on cleaning up that wound.

Very good! You really are too kind! It seemed like the injury prevented the gryphon from flying, so you hopefully won't have much trouble picking up its trail. I suggest you start in the middle of town.
Very good, Arrg was getting hungry.
Very good, Bwana... this is indeed a friendly gesture. However, you've come at a bad time.
Very good, [sir/madam].
Very good, [sir/madam]. [Sir/Madam]'s tea will be ready shortly.
Very good, adventurer.
Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
Very good, but you haven't learnt anything yet?
Very good, iknami. In that case, I'll be here once you have some tea for me.
Very good, let me know when you discover something.
Very good, let's see if your power compares to mine.
Very good, my child. Let me know when you are ready to go in.
Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.
Very good, that'll be 200 coins please!
Very good, very good. Its good to taste real gnomish flavours.
Very good, you have made a new conductor - now get up on the roof and repair it before this storm passes!
Very good, young apprentice.
Very good, young one! Very good indeed!
Very good.
Very good. Death would be pleased with me for bringing you in.
Very good. I have achieved everything that I set out to achieve.
Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
Very good. I suggest you give it a read.
Very good. I'd say our mission to establish a new hideout has been a great success. All thanks to you, of course.
Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.
Very good. In that case, complete the tasks you have been presented with and we can arrange some appropriate enhancements.
Very good. In that case, let us begin.
Very good. Let me have a look at it.
Very good. My advisor, Aeonisig, will teleport you back. The best of luck to you.
Very good. Now I need you to get it turned into a costume. Thessalia ought to be able to help. She runs the Varrock clothes shop.
Very good. Now let's try this again. Go right!
Very good. Now she needs help in getting Klenter's soul so she tricks some gullible fool into helping her.
Very good. Now, can I help you at all?
Very good. The spirits of my family will watch over you. And now, I would that you also accept a small token of my appreciation.
Very good. Well, it has been some days since last I heard from Drezel, the priest who lives there. Be a sport and go check in on the silly old codger for me, would you?
Very good... Very good... Okay, I'm satisfied. Welcome to the Phoenix Gang! I'm Straven, one of the gang leaders.
Very gruff. almost animal-like in fact.
Very happy. They saw an opportunity for a new business relationship. In return for giving us the land, we now give them favourable rates on what we mine here.
Very helpful as they collected my belongings. Eager, even.
Very high level guards patrol every major city and bank. They will kill anyone who has a skull. Getting yourself a kill is only half the battle.
Very impressive! It's time to do a different form of special attack now.
Very impressive, slayer. I'm glad that the goggles served you well.
Very impressive. Good work.
Very impressive. I had a feeling you would have what it takes.
Very insightful...
Very inspiring...
Very interested!
Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.
Very interesting. If you suspect potions may be involved then I believe the apothecary in Varrock might be your best point of contact.
Very interesting. See what you make of this.
Very interesting. So there was a great battle at the outpost. Then one of the survivors became king, and the other started the market place. Good work.
Very interesting. That's very helpful.
Very interesting. Unfortunately I don't think I have any giant eagle costumes in stock at the moment.
Very interesting...
Very kind ob you, [player name]!
Very little is actually known about the sea slug, as we have, as yet, been unable to procure a sample for observation and study.
Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to them as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
Very little is written about the tribe of the Mahjarrat. They are believed to be from the realm of Freneskae, or Frenaskrae - the spelling in this tongue is only approximate.
Very little. It was David... Sorry, Councillor Andrews, who he contacted first. The rest of us didn't meet him until much later.
Very little. It's not as if there's much to it... I might try to set up trade with other islands.
Very much so! Thanks again. What was it, anyway?
Very much so. Furthermore, I know that the hats were very precious in that era, but they are different nowadays. May I please have it?
Very much so. I was lucky to find this charming corner to set up the clan hub.
Very nearly there!! Only 1 more signature to go.
Very nice rosebushes you have here.
Very nice to meet you!
Very nice! Just hand that over to the port master and he'll sort it out. Come let me know once you're done.
Very nice! Now, use the gangplank to hop back up here and we can get going.
Very nice! That's us all squared up then. You ought to pop back once you've got a bit more experience with that raft. By then I should have some new vessels for sale.
Very nice, adventurer. You're supposed to make it into the statue's body.
Very nice, but I'm not sure what use it has.
Very nice, dearie, but that belongs to Fairy Nuff. I should put it back on her wall before she misses it if I were you. You wouldn't want her to think you stole it now, would you?
Very nice, thank you. It's a remarkable island you have here.
Very nice. Although, a sterilised one would be better.
Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
Very odd coincidence, but I don't really have time to look into it now.
Very odd. Have you any idea how it got there?
Very perceptive, Kovac.
Very pleasant, the snakes are a nice touch.
Very rewarding, thank you Maria.
Very sensible! Did you make these yourself?
Very serious. Now, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.
Very silly. Puppy too weak. We wait 'till puppy big, strong.
Very simple. I'll have to make a few modifications to my cannon so that it can fire a human, and you'll need a golden helmet of course.
Very soon!
Very sorry, I misunderstood.
Very stylish! It really suits you!
Very stylish, but it doesn't seem to be his colour.
Very tempting, but I shouldn't really start drinking at this time...
Very true! As we expand and grow, nature refuses to adjust to our ways. The only other option is to destroy it to make room for growth.
Very true! Until next time, friend.
Very true, and certainly an opportunity I wouldn't want to miss.
Very true, poor guy.
Very true.

Very true. I'll leave you to prepare.
Very true. See you later.

Very true...
Very unlikely! But maybe I will take a peek. The good thing about being pessimistic is that you're happy when you're wrong!
Very unusual, outerlander, but we have not seen him yet.
Very valuable. Have a nice time!
Very well

Very well anticipated.

Very well my friend, come back if you change your mind.
Very well my friend, let me count out your reward.

Very well thank you. I can't decide if I want some gingerbread gnomes or mulled wine!

Very well!

Very well, I'll return to Veliaf. Farewell.
