We are the exalted Guardians of one of the King's biggest secrets.
We are the faithful servants of Ralos. We serve in a variety of roles across the Church of Ralos.
We are the guardians of the staff, our fathers were guardians and our fathers' fathers before that. Why dost thou seek it?
We are the prince's elite troops! We keep Burthorpe secure!
We are the righteous ones in his eyes alone.

We are the spirits of the river Elid, many ages ago we used to be mindless wandering spirits, with little mind or purpose, we were here even in the first age. Then great Elidinis came to the desert and bound us to her
We are the tower guards - our business is our own!
We are to investigate the disappearance of the 10th squad of the Royal Guard. Am I right in suspecting that you, Lumdo, are a member of the 10th squad?
We are true knights who fight for honour. Those Black Knights didn't fight fair, so we were unprepared. Most unchivalrous of them.
We are trying to win, don't aim for me!

We are very in tune with magic as you have no doubt observed, but we have yet to meet one Fremennik with the perspective that this is of any value. They are always picking at us to reveal our secrets, but why
We are waiting for you to join us.
We are worried about trusting JalYt to take on this task for us.
We are, whether we like it or not, the blood legatees of humanity.
We are. It's team building.
We are?
We arrived at that number through trial and error, and the errors were not pretty let me assure you.
We arrived at the right time.
We ask that you lead our militia against this brute and return with the beast's head as proof of your heroism.
We asked them to go and see what help Undor needed at the Doors of Dinh.
We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
We beat those monsters well and good, didn't we?
We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.
We become more fractured by the day. Earlier I heard someone claiming that Ennius and Furia weren't actually Ralos and Ranul reborn at all!
We believe a mortal to be involved.
We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!

We believe in only using those runes that were given to us in the first place. We have one such depository of runes that we have used ever since Guthix's kindness. We won't allow you to use runes that are no doubt
We believe so. Ivan has been keeping a close watch. The disappearances have mostly taken place further up the pass, however, so it's taken a while for him to find any leads.
We believe the food is contaminated with the plague. This is for your own safety.
We believe the meeting is about to start imminently.
We believe the meeting is in progress now.
We believe the meeting will start in about [number] minutes.
We believe the spells are gifts from the gods. The charge spell draws even more power from the cosmos.
We believe the temple lies beneath this city. That is why we are here.
We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
We bite! Yeah we is biting and...and...er...
We blocked up our tunnel behind us and ran back here. Then we did what cave goblins always do when there is a problem: we hid and hoped it would go away.

We breed them. The originals were found by gnome explorers back in King Healthorg the Great's rule. On their discovery King Healthorg authorised a small party to go there and transport a breeding pair back here. He
We bury king under rubble soon enough.
We buy directly off Lubufu, a local fisherman. He seems to have a monopoly over Karambwan sale.
We call it 'Guthix's rest'.
We call them the Old Ones. They understood the importance of passing on their knowledge. So much of what we know, comes from them.
We call this magical process...repairin'.
We came here to fight. But I don't know who for. It's like it was moments ago, but also a lifetime in the past.
We came here to find something... I think. A tomb! We unblocked the entrance, and she went inside. There were others with her.
We came through a dungeon to get into the one in Morytania. If this one matches that, then I bet that's where Safalaan is.

We came to celebrate longevity yet, as time passes, the end may draw nearer, bringing the ruination of all. But let us cheer; today we are still alive, and together we can defy the perils of the future.
We came to put an end to this. To put aside our differences and stop this war before more people die needlessly.
We can afford to take a little bit of time to ensure everyone has resupplied so feel free to come back later if you're not ready yet. Just don't take too long.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
We can but hope Thorkel.
We can discuss this more when you have the rest of the escape kit.
We can enter Prifddinas!
We can fight again, or you can leave using the portals on either side.
We can fight! Lord Iorwerth doesn't win until he gets into the Temple of Light! We can still stop this!
We can fix this faster if we work together!
We can flickedy flam these stones better than anyone else! A-boom-boom-boom!
We can get through this if we work together, [player name]. But I can't get too close to the guards or they'll see I'm not human.
We can give you any past spooky things you don't already have. If you've lost something, Diango in Draynor Village can also help out!
We can grow a little food underground, but most of it comes from the extensive steamcart network that runs beneath the earth.
We can has Christmas every day?
We can have our men remove the 'infected' citizens and sent into the mines.
We can help reinforce them.
We can hope. If you do ever hear any more about him, be sure to let us know.
We can make presents but now we have no one to manage deliveries and shipping... you've ruined Christmas!
We can meet up with Veliaf and the rest of the Myreque in Burgh de Rott. Once we're all together, we can travel to Paterdomus and cross the Salve into Misthalin.
We can mine away the blockage for you.
We can only assume she's still in Yu'biusk somewhere. Problem is, I haven't been able to get the fungus ring machine working again.
We can only guess one day he will want to scale up into the city himself. We are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices for him to feast on.
We can only stay in the village and there's precious little food in here, just rats to live on! Not very appetising.
We can pick up a couple of combat mementos in the sword shop, just west of where you & I met.
We can put other metal thing in too, like sword and armour.
We can rest for a time.
We can securely move pretty much anything. Animals, valuables, bulk cargo.
We can stand here going around in circles all day, you won't change my mind.
We can start the process for you to leave. The process will take 7 days to complete.
We can still make this right. We can still stop the Council.
We can talk once you bring back the Menaphites' full peace offering.
We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.
We can't be far off now. Stay alert.
We can't determine which one.
We can't discuss it here. We need to be somewhere more private.
We can't discuss it here; there are too many spies. Let's leave the iceberg and then I'll tell you my plans.
We can't even get out of these dungeons while it's there.
We can't get any news in this field! All these humans keep trying to shear us!
We can't give up Islwyn. If we do, then he died for nothing.
We can't give up!
We can't give up! There must still be a chance to stop him.
We can't give up, Ivan!
We can't give up, [player name], come back when you've got more information.
We can't go into the HAM lair yet! I'm not wearing my disguise!
We can't have him declaring war all the time. Even if it would give us a chance to show off our military might.
We can't hire you for that kind of work now, but perhaps you could do me a little favour instead, if you're willing. I can pay!
We can't hope to fight the power of the vampyres alone. We'll need help from Misthalin by the bucket-load if we're to stand a chance against them.
We can't just leave that machine there for someone else to complete! We should smash it beyond repair before returning home!
We can't keep the authorities out of this, Betty. But... maybe I could take a look around first. I could at least make sure we know what happened before we speak to them.
We can't let Bob see him like this!
We can't let something like that happen again. I can take you and your puppies somewhere safe, if you'd like?
We can't possibly make a plan without knowing Lord Iorwerth's intentions. While unlikely to be true, this stuff about the library is all we have to go on.
We can't rule anything out.
We can't talk about it here. I need you to meet me at Xeric's Lookout.
We can't undo what's been done, but we can still put an end to all this.
We can't use that. That's my friends name!
We can't. I already tried, but the doors are sealed. There's a circular indentation in the middle. Maybe it's a keyhole.
We can...
We can... but no refunds.
We cannon them stupid guards and cover them in sticky paint.
We cannot afford to make these mistakes. The spy should have been restrained.
We cannot fail!
We cannot move on until we find the chieftain's daughter, and we do not generally move far inland. But perhaps you can search for it.
We cats talk, you know.
We ceased experimentation immediately, there are enough things in this world to haunt a Temple Knight, we did not see the need to create anymore.
We certainly did! Gielinor is once again safe from that monster!
We certainly do! I and my crewmen have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?
We certainly do! My crew and I have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?
We certainly do! We have access to items bought and sold from around the world. Would you like to take a look? Or would you like to charter a ship?
We cleanse our minds in prayer, and hone our bodies through agility. You can join us if you like. Feel free to reflect at our altar, or take to the roofs on our agility course.
We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
We could always do with an extra pair of hands on the dock. See Frankie, the fresh fish trader, if you're looking for work.
We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.
We could do with an extra pair of hands, but you're better off speaking to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock museum if you'd like to get involved.
We could do with something for you to sit on.
We could do with, er, more girl leaders.
We could get them all together. Put pressure on them with some accusations and see who breaks?
We could have a good guess.
We could have an overlong theological debate now, but let's instead get to my point. Destruction has a place, so maybe the Devourer does as well. However, she has taken it too far.
We could have balloons and decorations, and maybe even nibbles.
We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
We could not leave someone to the cold death of the ocean, even an outerlander, so we fished him aboard. He muttered continually, but his words made no sense.
We could not stand by and watch.
We could offer to bonk him on the head with a big hammer.
We could scare them off!
We could try to sneak out.
We could work together to make a new totem pole - but I'm afraid it won't be easy. We carve them from the trunk of the sacred Yommi tree.
We dance round and round like a loon
We dare not leave the town for fear that the vampyres might spot us and force us to pay a blood tithe.
We deal harshly with thieves around here!
We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour. Brown get boring after a bit. We want change.
We decide to experiment more. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there.
We decide to experiment. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them.
We decided to move forward with our three-way assault.
We decided to move immediately, before anyone got cold feet, or any other parties could interfere in our work, and made haste towards the castle where our Lord lived.
We demand that you hand over the secret of the Karambwan.
We did a good job there, come and meet me over by Gilbert, west of Gertrude's house, so we can debrief.
We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.
We did have a creature from down in the caverns try to come up here at one point. Presumably they've been disturbed by recent events. The warriors quickly dealt with it though.
We did have an idea. With the plague, lots of people are worried for their health. We could take advantage of that.
We did it Iffie!
We did it Jarvis!
We did it for the good of the kingdom...
We did it!
We did it! Now we'd better get out of here!
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
We did it! We beat Surok!
We did it! Well done!
We did it, [player name]! My city is safe! Now we can follow that tunnel south back to the mines!
We did it. A Homunculus!
We did what we had to...
We did, but you did knock me out.
We did.
We did. Before he died though, he helped us. In return, he asked us to help his family.
We did. His adviser though, Aeonisig, encouraged him to refrain from military action.
We didn't contractually agree upon any rewards before you agreed to help, and I'm not even certain that you did help.
We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
We didn't have many choices.
We didn't mean it to go wrong, you know...
We didn't order any Pizza. Get lost!
We didn't see any others... It was just us and Antos...
We didn't want to hurt her, but we couldn't risk her telling anyone. This was the only way.
We didn't want to kill her. She didn't deserve that. The mage gave us a potion. He said it would stop her revealing the truth.
We disciples keep track of how many units of power have been produced. Just talk to us once you have generated some and we will reimburse you with the correct amount of Ectotokens.
We discover things here that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
We discovered that the majority of herbs in the world can be broken down into three alchemical reagents: Mox, Aga and Lye.
We distract guards for you. If we see them, we attack them so you get past while we fighting!
We do have a sacred pool which contains pure water. I don't know why Ungadulu would need it, though. Maybe you should talk to him again and get more information.
We do have more copies if you need another.
We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
We do have some gingerbread gnomes though
We do have stories about a war between the gods. I had always interpreted them as symbolic of the spiritual war between light and darkness in our hearts.
We do hope we are not too annoying!
We do not allow the uninvited to pan here.
We do not barter with your kind!
We do not disclose his majesty's business.
We do not employ outerlanders.
We do not hate them, outerlander, but we do not approve of their ways either.
We do not hide like you do. We came alone.

texto: We do not know what it is. All we know is that it threatens to snuff out every flame in this land and plunge the world into eternal darkness.
We do not know where he came from. All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno.
We do not know. Initial reports spoke of a large atoll populated by monkeys.
We do not need to do this dance, [player name]. I understand that where you come from, there is a certain art to holding a conversation. We do not bother with that here. You may be direct.
We do not need your sympathy, outerlander.
We do not recognise the council of Rellekka and want nothing more to do with them. We live on rock and stone now, pure and hard.
We do not require any dense essence from you at present. Thank you for your support.
We do not talk to the warm-bloods.

We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to
We do not use these fish quite as you might expect. When you return we can speak more of this matter.
We do not wish to enter war with the outerlanders and their strange magics, so we limit all unauthorised communication.
We do not, if the truth be told. This hangar was part of Glough's contingency planning. Had the attacks by land and sea failed, he would have turned to air.
We do that by taking from those who would lord themselves over the people. We remove their power and give it back to those who keep this kingdom alive.
We do this in order to keep Gielinor in balance, as Guthix requests.
We do this with a special talisman. Here, take it; it will let you track the Draugen while it's invisible, and when you defeat it will absorb its essence.
We do, however, continue to 'enlighten' our neighbours in Neitiznot. Unfortunately, some of the Islands are infested with trolls.
We do. But some we take because we have to, others because we choose to.
We do. Drakan's tyranny finally ends today.
We do. Unless anyone has any complaints. [player name]? You've been very quiet throughout this. What are your thoughts?
We do. Your task is to seek out and recruit three legendary Slayer Masters: Turael, Mazchna and Duradel. Alongside them, we'd also like you to recruit a great warrior called Cyrisus.
We do?
We do? This is going to take some time getting used to.
We don't always get along, but I'm sure he's a nice guy at heart.
We don't always see eye-to-eye, but she understands my art better than our father.
We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.
We don't care who you are. Indeed, pirates and customs officers can enjoy a drink here, side by side. Savvy?
We don't care. You probably want our food then, so you ain't coming in!
We don't get many visitors here. Are you sure you wouldn't rather be somewhere else?
We don't give up though. After all, all that is required for evil to survive is for good people to do nothing.
We don't have a basement room... but I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
We don't have a choice, Veliaf, you know that. If we don't go, she'll kill us all.
We don't have a choice. You need to get out of here, get over to Captain Jensen's house and then investigate whatever has happened there.
We don't have a ladder...but we do have a lot of knights.
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
We don't have an army, you see.
We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!
We don't have any other option. The rest of you stay here. Get the other parts of the mechanism fixed, and make sure Safalaan is kept safe.
We don't have any other options. We have to try.
We don't have any ribbons as such, but we do have some offcuts you could make some out of.
We don't have any thanks! Bye!
We don't have anything to discuss with you, you Zamorakian scum!
We don't have enough room to show everything in our collections. If only we had the funding...
We don't have forever.
We don't have good days here anymore. Curse King Tyras.
We don't have long before the pride march to get these done... the stress doesn't help.
We don't have many murders here in Gielinor and I'm afraid we wouldn't have been able to solve it by ourselves. We will hold her here under house arrest until such time as we bring her to trial.
We don't have much time. I'm talking to you from the Imcando Dream Theatre. I need to know how to use your shield.
We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
We don't have time for this!
We don't have time for this! Why don't I take both warriors?
We don't have time for this, Bob could be in trouble! Tell her to get on with it.
We don't have time for this, Efaritay!
We don't have time for this. Whatever we do next, we can't stay here. Let's get across that bridge.
We don't have time to waste here. After you, [player name].
We don't have time! I'm heading up there now!
We don't joke down here friend...
We don't just let anyone join our gang. If you want in, you'll need to prove your worth.
We don't know her, [player name].
We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.
We don't know how to build bridges, we're traders.
We don't know it was the Council.
We don't know of any gang meetings scheduled at the moment. Try again in a few minutes. Crime never stops in this kingdom.
We don't know what Vargas might be planning next!
We don't know what the eggs of Ayaster are really like.
We don't know yet. These goblins are dressed up as ghosts, they think they're dead and... It's all very confusing.
We don't know, but we're hoping to find out!
We don't like bright lights. They hurt our eyes.
We don't need any help.
We don't need to be deciphering inscriptions to know that we shouldn't be here. I mean look at that... whatever that floating thing is. This place is dangerous!
We don't need to go there. I've got a gout tuber.
We don't need to rush. I've gained Spencer's trust and he has tasked me with coming up with a plan for getting you off the Little Pearl. That means time is on our side.
We don't need to win, we just need to buy the dwarves enough time to seal that tunnel. Do we know how long they'll need?
We don't need your help. Run along now, go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
We don't need your sort round here!
We don't serve that sort of brew here, this is a high class establishment!
We don't serve the likes of that thing in here.
We don't spend enough time in the Abyss!
We don't talk to strangers.
We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
We don't want it! We just want to keep this place safe!
We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
We dragonkin are not as flimsy as you. I'm afraid you failed.
We dug smelly hole in prison so Mother's prisoners wouldn't go all over floor, but it not very convenient. Trolls like things convenient.
We dwarves don't know much about fishing, but a couple of our brothers at White Wolf Mountain want to win the competition.
We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
We either let his finish transforming, or he dies...
We elves use equipment formed out of crystal itself, far superior to your human weapons. However, the crystal does degrade with use and will eventually revert to seed.
We enter the temple, free our goddess and with her by our side, reform the city of Prifddinas.
We escaped from the vampyres. They had us trapped in Meiyerditch to drink our blood! Yuck!
We even have the relevant materials as well. Between them and the knowledge we now have, my associates should be able to begin work on new weapons and techniques to use against Verzik.
We eventually came back here though. We knew we couldn't leave the people here to the vampyres.
We exist... We observe... We don't... intervene...
We fashion our own arrowheads and dart tips out of them.
We fear he can't be defeated, but maybe we can hold back his creatures and keep city safe.
We fear not. But we hoped you, with your fancy JalYt weaponry, would be able to help hold back his creatures. You proved your commitment by sacrificing your fire cape.
We fear they are a punishment sent by the gods. Perhaps we have displeased Icthlarin in some way. Maybe I am to blame. All this only started after I became High Priest.
We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?
We feared the worst, but we never anticipated something like this.
We feast on the bones of our enemies tonight!
We fell back into the Underground Pass, intending to return to our kingdom in the east. Lord Iorwerth sent his forces in after us, hoping to wipe us out.
We fell in love when we were young, but as there was a war between our isles, we were ordered to stop seeing each other by our parents.
We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.
We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
We find that it is easier to just use your language when your kind are around.
We find this tunnel, use it to enter the castle, take Drakan's portal to Vampyrium, rescue Safalaan, then return through the portal, closing it behind us.
We fix tools...
We flew here on a military gnome glider. Is that not proof enough?
We flower-traders talk, you know!
We fooled you easily enough.
We forget about that every year.
We fought against the Wintertodt until we managed to lure it behind Dinh's great Doors. Our task did not end there though, for we always knew that the Wintertodt would rise again.
We fought our way to the granary and have barred the doors. We stored our now brainless bodies downstairs in case we can be put back to normal.
We found 'em first. They're ours.
We found Glough hiding under a horde of Daconia rocks!
We found Kent stranded on an island.
We found her while we were searching for you. We also found this on her. It is not a substance that occurs naturally here. We assume she obtained it at some point during your escape.
We found the door to the prison, and we found someone trying to open it.
We gave it our best, but I fear we have failed.
We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
We get signal!
We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
We get you next time!
We go back a few centuries, after all, he and I are both skeletal figures in black, and our work leaves us with relatively small social circles.

We go back a few centuries, so I was tolerant, but the situation is now unacceptable. He smells like a corpse, forever rambles on about his conspiracy theories, and now he's eaten all the trapped souls in my refrigerator.
We goblins lost all trust in all you stupid humans! Get away from us!
We got good game, [player name]!
We got him!
We got him, [player name]!
We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
We got some cold beers, some warm stews and some 'rum'.
We got some impromptu visitors to the park. They came out of nowhere and made an awful mess of the place.
We got them the seeds so that they could plant them together, thinking maybe the shared activity would nudge them into taking the first step!
We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
We got us a jammed wheel!
We gots grog and we gots food. Here, take a look.
We granted them knowledge.
We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.
We grind sword against stone...
We had a falling out after a, uhm... dig, went wrong.
We had a look in there after you killed the abomination that used to live inside.
We had a plan, Maisa. You were ordered to stay in Menaphos. Now your recklessness has cost us dearly.
We had already committed to saving Arceuus.
We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.
We had no choice. This vault was sealed with magics that prevented beings like ourselves from opening it.

texto: We had someone passing through recently who said that Arhein in Catherby was looking to track some currents. I'd suggest you go and speak to him.
We had the numbers back in Vampyrium as well. All those aranei he killed...

We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to
We had to drive them out, in case their condition infected the rest of the troops. Their wives will be given a full widow pension when we return home.
We hadn't thought of that.
We hatched eggs in there and it was not a good decision. They were so different, bigger, stronger and fought each other for dominance.
We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
We have a Sacred Forge. You will find none other like it in all the world. Some of the greatest weapons of legend started life here.
We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.
We have a contact who lives in Outer Fortis. She stocks the best of the best when it comes to fabrics. That'll be where he went, but knowing Fox, he won't have gone directly there.
We have a fantastic one here on Aldarin, if you're interested. I can't say discussions are effective, but sometimes the wealthy do come to the table!
We have a few things to finish here, but then we'll head back up into the city. Please join us there.
We have a front company who's keeping Jorral on retainer.
We have a gnomic device that fires fat dye parcels that rupture on impact.
We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
We have a new stock of dragon halberds. Would you like a look at what we have?
We have a new winner! The heroic-looking person who was fishing by the pipes has caught the biggest carp I've seen since Grandpa Jack used to compete!
We have a saying, 'Curiosity killed the cat'. But cats aren't clever enough to understand what they find. Gnomes are.
We have a union, mate! There's always sand to sweep.
We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
We have a...
We have already helped you.
We have an agreement with them, yes. It took some time to work out.
We have an array of ingredients available all over the island, what flavour are you looking to create?
We have another leg, just below the center of our body that we use to move across solid surfaces.
We have arrived at the island.
We have been at war with neighbouring Etceteria for hundreds of years; however, I think both of us have rather lost our appetite for hostilities.
We have bigger problems right now!
We have bowls of treats we keep to treat Trick-or- Treaters. We left the bowls outside the shop so the Trick-or-Treaters wouldn't come in and frighten the customers.
We have broken your feeble spell! Begone!
We have built or found many tunnels such as these. This is not the only one. Rest assured, there are many more of us around.
We have company!
We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My, assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.
We have considered this, but every entrance seems to be excessively guarded.
We have dental!
We have discovered that we are not contagious. You must let us pass!
We have everything I need to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories. Let us return to the top of the Wizards' Tower, where the portal is.
We have failed.
