texto: We have followers of Lucien, Zamorak and Bandos to deal with. Evidence also suggests there are other foes yet to fully reveal themselves. For example, there have been reports of a lone knight.
We have found that when applied to arrows, the sap makes them more powerful.
We have found the cause of your problem.
We have four names: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: We have gangs?
We have liaised with the Bank of Gielinor. It's healthy to keep a bit of trade going with the human population, you know.
We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
We have locations at every major settlement on Wyrmscraig and a diverse portfolio of other business interests in the area.
We have loose animals in there that may be dangerous to an inexperience hunter like yourself.

We have made a deal. Once Drakan is dealt with, I will allow the Theatre to remain open. However, rather than false promises of freedom, the Theatre will be a place where the strongest may choose to test themselves.
We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.
We have more important things to think about than a brooch right now. We must prevent a war!
We have never tried this before, but some joker put something in our food not too long ago that gave us all symptoms akin to those of the plague.
We have no idea where he might be now... His magic is too powerful for us, I do not know how to stop him...
We have no part in this.
We have no time to lose. Fridleif, please guide [Fremennik name] through the traditions laid down by our ancestors.
We have no weapon to use against the vampyres. And with Flaygian gone, that won't be changing.
We have not seen Jatizso's militia yet, but some of my scouts have reported hearing distant fighting in the tunnels.
We have opened the way for you, my friend. Any other day, I would have joined you in the fight against Amascut, but this one is up to you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
We have other powers, not clear to you. Anyway I'm moving away from the story.
We have plenty more. No real harm done. That said, I do think I might have a way for you to make up for it. There'll likely be something in it for you as well.
We have reason to believe that enemies of Varlamore are operating within Cam Torum.
We have received word from one of our scouts that the evil Solus Dellagar has returned to Asgarnia!
We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.
We have storage chests in the factory, you should start there.
We have strung the close sky with life.
We have suffered for many generations and the blood of our ancestors grows weak.
We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.
We have the clan elders, their combined power is an army in itself.
We have the numbers, but the mourners are better trained and better equipped. You should make sure you're ready before we begin. There will be bloodshed, on both sides.
We have the orb, and the elders are securing the Temple of Light as we speak. That fragment of Seren should no longer be a concern.

We have the original Royal Accord of Twill safely stored here. Although it's not available for public viewing, there are copies available within the Grand Library. Is there anything else I can help you with?
We have things under control. That said, if you think you can contribute, you might want to speak to Sergeant Hudson. He's in charge here.
We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.
We have three more heroes that we'd like you to recruit to our cause.
We have to do this. It's the only choice we have.
We have to go back?!
We have to prepare our defence against this threat. I recall something that might well help...
We have to stop Glough! Get back to the Stronghold and warn the king before it's too late! I'll get the rest of the 10th squad together and we'll meet you there.
We have to. There is no other option.
We have travelled in a way that no man has travelled before! The next step will be to go where no men have gone before.
We have vambraces, chaps, cowls and coifs.
We have weaponry. We have the Ivandis Flail.
We have work to do, adventurer. Don't be gone too long.
We haven't been doing too bad. Even out in Mort Myre, the impact of Ranis' death can be seen.
We haven't been ruled by a king for many a year... that statue was long overdue for replacement anyway. You're not under arrest, I merely wanted to talk to you.
We haven't been yet. We have to wait until later since dad wants to come with us.
We haven't finished there actually. Do you think you could teleport us there again?
We haven't gone in yet.
We haven't gone yet.
We heard rumours of a strong one... but the altar was nowhere to be found.
We here have a lot of respect for the Sphinx. However, you should be careful of her words. She does not know the gods like we priests do.
We hid the egg mould near a drain. If you want to know more you'll need to ask my brothers.
We hide it in their beer, Bloody Bracer. They've no idea what it's really doing to them!
We hope your experience was a positive one, but if you do have any feedback, I'd be more than happy to provide you with the relevant form.
We humans have a saying, Vanescula: If you play with fire, you're going to get burnt.
We in second week and phase of Goblin advances.
We increased the depth at which the eggs are incubated. Over time this worked, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
We infiltrated the Twilight Emissaries together. We discovered Metzli to be their new leader, with Ennius and Furia at her side. She's claiming the two of them are Ralos and Ranul reborn!
We insult the food!
We interrupt this harrowing scene with a soothing picture of a kitten. Please do not think about what happened to Ulina - she found peace.
We interrupt this insult to bring you this soothing picture of a kitten. Normal service will be resumed shortly. Thank you for your patience.
We invade when we agree that colour for armour is green.
We is fire risk! Yeah dat's it! We be burning down your housey and stealin' all ya shiny gems. Oh, and da beads!! Mmmm, beads.
We just cut out their heart while it's still beating instead.
We just don't know. Perhaps it's the weather. Perhaps it's something in the food. Perhaps it's just that time of year.
We just fell through the ground into some weird temple!
We just need Brother Cedric to return with the wine.
We just need to know if it looks like they're preparing for anything. But if you do this, you're on your own. If anything happens, I won't be able to send help.
We just need to visit Cyrisus's dreams and come to a solution.
We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
We keep all these old toys to train our children with, but if people will part with coins for them, then they are theirs!
We keep an eye on yer loot for ye. Leave yer valuables with us if ye want to keep 'em nice and safe.
We keep ships because we still need trade in Phasmatys. Every trader that comes to Phasmatys is made to worship the Ectofuntus, so that the Ectopower doesn't run out.
We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
We keep the first sword simple.
We kept pushing with the golems. Many of them we imbued with magical energies. We started with mind and body energy, but eventually moved on to chaos as well.
We killed a lot of trolls.
We knew this battle would come, ever since the day our king died. We've been prepared for a long time.
We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
We know all too well.
We know not why.
We know that name.
We know the Council to be corrupt. We feel it only right that all of Kourend know that. The people have a right to the truth.
We know they were sealed by the power of earth and streams. This magic presumably originates from somewhere within these ruins. I also wonder if these talismans I found might be connected...
We know you attempted to arrange the murder of the Teokan of Ralos. Do you have anything to say about this?
We know! Some goblin find it, give it back here.
We learn how to use our magic to its fullest and how to channel the forces of the cosmos into our world...
We learnt of a group of Lizardman Shamans causing trouble on the surface. I led a taskforce out to drive them back into their lair.
We leave the mountain alone and it lets us live peacefully, out of sight of any passing boats.

We left Rellekka because we wanted to live closer to nature. We feel that the people of Rellekka have grown complacent and rely too much on their tools rather than their skill. And while they share our view on the sanctity
We leprechauns have a shed where we keep 'em. It's a magic shed, so ye can get yer items back from any of us leprechauns whenever ye want. Saves ye havin' to carry loads of stuff around the country!
We like cheese. Just cheese.
We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
We listen to whatever she say!
We live for tales!
We live in a world where giant lizards with wings fly around and expel highly combustible fluids from their throats, but you never considered a frog could talk?
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: We lost contact with Silif shortly after he entered the Black Knights' Fortress, so I'd suggest you start there.
We lost it. Can we have another?
We lost some good people thanks to your underestimating.
We lost the autographed flyer.
We lost the chart.
We lost the recipe book.
We lost the seventh one.
We lost three diving parties that way!
We love Uncle Eric!
We love items.
We love tales!
We love you Pete!
We love you lots. Mum. P.S. The dog misses you too.
We maintain trade links with many powers in the world and have moved beyond some traditions to take advantage of modern advances.
We make it, of course! We have the ingredients already, we only need a churn to make it in!
We make the hard choices to spare others from having to.
We make you dance one day, somehow...
We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
We managed to escape from Meiyerditch where we were being farmed as food for the vampyres.
We managed to recover this paint gun from a dead Goblin, so we're using their weaponary against them.
We managed to waylay him on the journey here, and steal his I.D. papers. Now all we need is to find somebody willing to impersonate him and take the deputy role to get that key for us.
We may be pirates, but we're all surprisingly well- mannered!
We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.
We may have further use for you.
We may have gotten away with it!
We may have to monitor that lair from time to time to keep their population in check.
We may make it through this yet...
We may not all like each other, and some of us have a checkered history, but we will work together to destroy this enemy.
We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?

We may not have been able to save Arrav today, but thanks to your discoveries, we now have a lead to follow. It will take me some time, but once I have something on this heart business, I'll be in touch.
We meant no harm! Please tell the ruler of the above- people that we want to make peace.
We meet again, [player name]!
We meet again. Not a chance encounter I see, for it is clear that you want something.
We meet outside Molch. I think he lives in the temple there, with the lizardmen.
We met at entry gate, remember? Boulder sent you away, 'cos we not trust humans here in Weiss, an' also you sound crazy. But you our friend now, an' you always welcome.
We might dock at Mos Le'Harmless once in a while, as well, if you catch my meaning...
We might just be. We should look around and see what we can uncover.
We might need to get some ice ready!
We mortal beings - troll, human, goat - we are our bodies, and our bodies are us. You human got dumb ideas 'bout mind/body dualism.
We move on to another part of the mountain slope when the rough land cannot sustain us anymore.
We moved on. We tried various other methods, all ending in disappointment. In the end, we came here. Our largest facility yet. Here we began work on what would become our masterpiece.
We must also transform your body so that you may pass amongst them unnoticed.
We must amass our troops immediately. We must be ready for Neitiznot's army to attack us.

We must avoid everything, because the balloon is very fragile. Even clouds will be dangerous! But if my calculations are correct, we will be able to squeeze through some surprising spaces, if you pilot it well.
We must be missing something. This can't be it...
We must be strong, adventurer. Be strong for Mother.
We must both be outlanders. We all look the same you know.
We must build on that. We will strengthen our forces, and find new allies to join our cause. When Lucien dares to rear his head again, we'll be ready.
We must cleanse the temple!
We must ensure no power vacuum is left. As soon as he is dealt with, I must immediately step up as the new leader of the vampyres.
We must find Lucien and stop him by any means necessary.
We must find a way to fight back! To throw those villains out of our homes.
We must find out where Lucien went! Turael and Duradel must be avenged!
We must find the rest of Clarence, I've sent some wizards out to some of the sandpits, would you please check the Entrana sandpit?
We must find...
We must get away from here before we discuss our plans. We don't want to be overheard.
We must go after them!
We must go and ready our forces. We will see you inside.
We must go now and meet Waydar. For security reasons I must ask you to wear a blindfold.
We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
We must inform the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque of these events. Please go as fast as you can back to the Meiyerditch hideout and forward this information to them.
We must inform the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque of what we have learnt. Please go as fast as you can back to the Meiyerditch hideout and forward this information to them.
We must leave this place...
We must remain here for all eternity, even unto the very end of the world.
We must return to the village now.
We must visit Bob, who can be found in the Lumbridge axe shop. He is an incredibly important figure in Gielinor, and I seek his autograph.
We must visit Draynor Village and obtain the party hat of the Wise Old Man. Please take me to him.
We must visit Lumbridge, and obtain the navigational chart of a man named Hans. It is a unique chart that has steered his life for many years now.
We naturally mighty warriors.
We need [number] bars of [bronze/iron/steel/silver/gold/mithril] in the next [number] minutes.
We need [number] pieces of [copper ore/tin ore/clay/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] in the next [number] minutes.
We need [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] for Keldagrim's merchants.
We need a few items, and then we combine them using a secret recipe. I have the recipe here, but sadly none of the items.
We need a gold bar, a monkey amulet mould and something to do monkey speech.
We need a source of wood, but one which is spiritually active and can regenerate itself. That will save you some axework in the future.
We need an easy way across.
We need as much time as we can get. Even if I can make a small difference, it might be the difference between success and failure.
We need blood stains on the walls! Can you go to the farm south of Falador? They slaughter their own livestock, and I'm sure the shopkeeper there will be able to supply some cow blood.
We need darker colour, like blue.
We need it back.
We need more [ore name]!
We need more decorations in here. There ought to be cobwebs on the walls.
We need more mithril!
We need more rain. I don't suppose you can do anything about that?
We need more rift guardians!
We need more strays to rescue. If people know they can find a companion here, they'll come.
We need people to see the king for what he really is. They're clearly not going to believe us when it comes to the plague, so we'll have to resort to some dirtier tactics.
We need seeds for a Beautiful Yellow Pansy, a Tenacious Indigo Iris, and a Quality Violet Tulip.
We need seeds for a Legendary Red Rose, a Gorgeous Orange Lily, a Beautiful Yellow Pansy, a Tenacious Indigo Iris, and a Quality Violet Tulip.
We need shield barriers up before anything comes through that rift!
We need some accurate plans of the castle. Please make some careful sketches starting from the north side, moving to the west and finishing off with a sketch from this view.
We need some help freezing this bucket of camel milk!
We need some kind of monkey remains as well as an authentic magical monkey talisman.
We need some material to perform!
We need some more information about what the Red Axe is up to.
We need someone to herd these sheep into a safe enclosure, kill them quickly and cleanly and then dispose of the remains hygienically in a special incinerator.
We need someone worldly to bring back stray dogs for us. Would you be willing to help us?
We need the body of a diseased Fever Spider!
We need the key, or we need a copy made. If you can get some soft clay then you can copy the key...
We need to assemble rift guardian before those creatures arrive!
We need to avoid outright aggression. The safety of my son cannot be risked. I understand you were able to infiltrate the Emissaries and gain access to their temple?
We need to be going east.
We need to be going north.
We need to be going south.
We need to be going west.
We need to charge all of the pillars using our prayers!
We need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?
We need to consider every possible thing which could help us!
We need to deal with these souls!
We need to do something!
We need to do something, the magician on the other side of the por....
We need to fill each part of the mould...
We need to fill it with three dwellberries and a ring of life. I'll get started right away.
We need to fill it with three dwellberries and a ring of life. I'm working on it right now.
We need to find Rashiliyia's resting place and learn how to put her spirit to rest. You may find some clues to her resting place in Ah Za Rhoon or Bervirius' Tomb.
We need to find a way to get that golem working.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: We need to find a way to reach this portal that Drakan has made. I reckon it's a pretty safe bet that it will be somewhere inside Castle Drakan.
We need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
We need to find out what Serafina discovered about the vampyres. Talk to Safalaan, he should be able to help you.
We need to find the others. If Veliaf is with them, he'll have taken them somewhere safe.
We need to find who or what has been jinxed and remove it from the ship immediately.
We need to get across the bridge. We can't stay here.
We need to get after him!
We need to get back to Darkmeyer.
We need to get closer to the penguins. Infiltrate them. Learn what they are doing.
We need to get everyone back in here! We need four more people to perform the ritual!
We need to get everyone back in here! We need three more people to perform the ritual!
We need to get into the inner section of this place. I'll follow your lead.
We need to get some people down there urgently! The barbarians have Phileas Rimor prisoner.
We need to get through the cell door, but I haven't got anything to open it. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
We need to get to that well. However, the immediate problem is that I'm trapped in this cell.
We need to go into the dream again.
We need to harvest the incorrect pumpkins.
We need to identify that the place you have found is indeed Ah Za Rhoon.
We need to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and confirm their guilt. I've done some digging, and rumour has it that they're on a bit of a recruitment spree at the moment. That's our way in.
We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
We need to plan our next move, but now they know both our scents and might come after us!
We need to plant the correct seeds.
We need to power up the Great Guardian!
We need to power up this big guardian somehow, but I need a way to capture runic energy. Tamara said you might be able to help.
We need to prepare for the return of this Forebearer Janus. We'll need a way to restrain him and something to knock him out with. Let's have a look around and see if there's anything here we can use.
We need to protect the Great Guardian!
We need to punish them, but you have commanded me to wait...
We need to put more distance between us and the castle. Once we're far enough away, we can double back and hopefully make a new portal.
We need to recruit people into our resistance so that we can overthrow the king. Elena can tell you how many people we've recruited.
We need to see if Baxtorian left anything of use behind. Maybe that book will be of use.
We need to send a message to the Vipers to let them know that their days are done.
We need to talk about this Royal Accord.
We need to till the soil to prepare it for crops. Head outside and operate the ploughs along the fields.
We need to travel through Mort Myre Swamp to Burgh de Rott. We may encounter all kinds of evil on our way, so you'd probably best prepare to fight.
We need to try and follow the trail left by those zombies.
We need to try and pick up the trail left by those zombies.
We need to unlock Bob's memories from his old life as Robert the Strong. We were hoping that we could use a shared dream.
We need you to find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clues they left behind.
We need you to find a way into the Sanguinesti region. Once you're in, you need to try and make contact with any members of the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque.
We need you to grow [a/some] [plant(s)]. I'll reward you once you have checked [its/their] health.
We need you to grow some [plant]s. I'll reward you once they've been fully harvested.
We need you to make it seem like people are ill with the plague. It will help keep the lie alive and also give us an excuse to abduct some more slaves for the mines.
We need your help. The final fight against Lord Iorwerth is nearly here.
We need... a permit.
We needed access to West Ardougne so we needed the support of the king. Once we found out about his hidden worship of Zamorak, it seemed like an obvious lie to tell.
We needed to show them the truth. We needed to show them that Argenthorg was weak. My advisor said he knew how...
We needs 20 Limpwurt roots for pot.
We needs 20 rooteses!
We never got the chance to look over his new discoveries before the attack. However, I did recover his notes as we left.
We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
We never question what is fact.
We never worked out a way before. He never regained the memories he lost.
We no even rob you! You be nice, or you never get back things that we no rob.
We no longer had the strength in numbers, but we still outmatched the Iorwerth troops in skill and experience. We fought back while we retreated. Both sides suffered huge losses.
We normally meet regularly around our tribe's totem pole. Unfortunately, ours has been polluted by an evil spirit, and now we are all afraid to approach it.
We not know what she have to say. But in case she Chosen Commander, we let her speak. Speak, Zanik!
We not trust humans. Also, your human keep talking about its arm, and we not want mad human in our town. But now Mother knows human is your servant, we let it come and go freely.
We noticed and removed the curse. Hopefully they
We now perform the ancient dance of love...
We now significantly outnumber the mourners, we should be able to drive them out of the city. The main focus will be their headquarters. Without their leadership, they'll soon retreat.
We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
We obey.

We occasionally manage to plunder small samples of this 'essence' and we have recently discovered these temples you speak of, but I have never heard of these talismans before, and I was certainly not aware that this 'essence'
We of Arceuus have learnt, through the power of the Dark Altar, to move beyond the need for such a flesh-temple to house our souls.
We offer him me. Ever since our last encounter I am sure he wants some revenge.
We offer sanctuary to those seeking the guidance of Saradomin.
We offer strength in numbers and our island would serve as a northern platform for defence. All that we ask for in return is peace.
We often find that they are too weak or too slow to be of sufficient use.
We often go adventuring with bards for precisely this reason; No matter where we have ended up we can return safe and sound to home.
We only search for answers.
We ought to talk to some of the HAM people. That's what we're here for, after all!
We ow you gonna chop dem troys? I can give yow a bronze axe, but nowt more.
We owe you a great debt for freeing us from that dungeon.
We pick their pockets of course. I 'ave some of my crew in the bazaar. If you fancy gettin' involved, they might help you out every now and then.
We play here.
We polish them every day to get them nice and clean.
We prepared for such an outcome.
We priests are glad that we could help make up for our errors. Apologies again, hopping one.
We probably have. I'm very forgetful.
We pushed it too far! JalYt would not understand. The memories, we needed them. Now big Inferno.
We put the things we'd taken somewhere safe, so we could get them back when we made peace again.
We really need those sketches showing the plans of the castle. Use charcoal and papyrus in order to make the sketches. There are three sides to the castle that need to be sketched.
We really sh'mashed that.
We recently found a small crevice on the western face of the mountain. It seems to be manmade and appears to be older than the rest of the caves around here.
We refilled again and this time hid very carefully. For a while nothing happened. Charlie came by, but he only took a couple of sweets before strolling back.
We refilled the bowls and waited, but we must have been too visible. Everyone was behaving perfectly. We went to sit back and the sweets vanished once again!
We represent one side of the sphere too much. Order, justice... They are in a similar space. Even I myself lean outside of my usual balance due to Lucien.
We rest upon their shoulders.
We rob house of stupid wizard. She very old, not put up much fight at all. Hahaha!
We run ships all over the place. Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point and Port Khazard are just a few of our many destinations!
We run ships from Port Phasmatys over to Port Tyras, stopping at Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point, Port Khazard and more besides!
We salvage shipwrecks of course!
We saved the monastery!
We searched far and wide, desperate to find her. At times it felt like we were close, but the enemy always managed to elude us.
We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
We seek wisdom, but find platitudes. We seek the far north, but find latitudes. We seek leadership, but find attitudes.
We seem to be dealing with a lot of uncertainties.
We seem to be making progress, [player name]. Keep it up.
We seemed to be getting somewhere, but we're right back where we started!
We send launchers from our outpost to the nearby islands. If you go and wait in the lander there that'd really help.
We send our shaman, Ungadulu, to confront the spirit... but he has not returned.
We sense that there are other beings around her, smelly creatures, and some sort of presence is watching over her.
We sent some samples to her old teacher, Guidor in Varrock. He ran some tests and found out that the plague isn't actually real. I confronted the king on this and he admitted it.
We sent word to them earlier. They have agreed to meet with us at the bridge. If all goes well, this quarantine will soon be behind us.
We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
We serve Great Kourend! You are all in violation of the laws of this kingdom!
We serve another power.
We serve the balance.
We serve the finest fresh fish Piscarilius has to offer.
We serve this balance.
We served Lord Iorwerth because he was our leader. We may not have agreed with all that he did, but that didn't matter. He was in charge and we were not.
We set up an observation SpyOrb in a known Zamorakian shrine in south-east Varrock, but he moves between there and the wilderness just north of Edgeville quite frequently.
We shall learn what we can, but feel free to find some use for it.
We shall make a wizard of you yet. I will hold onto the enchanted flour for you until you need it.
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

texto: We shall meekly go! No...no...it needs to sound grander. We shall cautiously go...
We shall not be taking the Easter Bunny's eggs away any more.
We shall overcome!!
We shall see about that!
We shall see about that.
We shall see if it is enough.
We shall see, Bwana.
We shall see.
We shall see...
We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
We share a common goal.
We share many common enemies, you and I. Enemies that infest Hallowvale like a disease.
We share this floor of the palace with the other companies of the Consortium. And trade with them on the Trade Octagon.
We should be able to manage this by getting each of them a different loving owner and some proper training.
We should be back at the College of Bards already, but I'm sure they'll understand why we got delayed.
We should be getting a new stock soon. Would you like a look at what we do have?
We should be weary of trusting the words of a nagua, my Queen.
We should discuss it in private. It involves the Kourend Council. It's also connected to the recent death here.
We should do something about that old man.
We should get back to the graveyard. I'll meet you there.
We should get to work.
We should go and see Bob now Unferth is feeling better, he should be back by now.
We should go tell guard man that nasty thieves have gone dead.
We should have a wicked birthday bash more often - see you around!
We should have killed them both when we had the chance.
We should have known it was too good to be true.
We should have questioned him! Now we have no idea who he was working for!
We should keep an eye out for this place. In fact, it would be great if you could look for it for us. Keep the message. It may help you to locate the laboratory.
We should keep looking for that passphrase.
We should keep looking.
We should let him rest.
We should let someone know about this.
We should look for him.
We should make our way to Burgh de Rott and meet up with Veliaf and the others.
We should not waste any time. However, we must first deal with the human.
We should probably go and find out what's going on...
We should really be trying to deal with the trolls, but the King tends to get a bit preoccupied with his cousin, the Burgher of Neitiznot.
We should relocate it.
We should see if this works before we tell anyone else. Now, I think I can create some apparatus to provide power to the fungus ring.
We should split up and try to solve the next riddle. I'll regroup with you at wherever it leads us.
We should split up and try to solve the next riddle. I'll regroup with you at wherever it leads us. Be careful though. Who knows if the Council will send another assassin.
We should split up and try to solve the riddle. I'll regroup with you at wherever it leads us.
We should split up. The Council could be watching us, and I don't want to make anything too obvious. Let's see who can solve this thing first.
We should start by raking it.
We should visit Aubury, in his rune shop in the south- east of the city.
We should wear green armour!
We should, but first, you have some explaining to do. You knew him.
We shouldn't have need to disguise ourselves. We shouldn't be here at all. This dwarf can't be trusted.
We shouldn't leave this entry unguarded. The Devourer still has plenty of servants out in the desert who we won't want coming in after us.
We shouldn't say, but-
We shouldn't speak about that now!
We shouldn't waste any more time here.

We shouldn't. Make no mistake, [player name], he has his own reasons for wanting Vanescula out of the picture. However, that doesn't change the fact that she is our enemy. She has always been our enemy.
We simply consider men to be weak and inferior.

We spent time gathering enough wood to fashion two boats. The Sergeant took the rest of the 10th squad in the larger of the boats to explore the island and to search for potential glider launch sites.

We split up into several small groups to search the island for potential gnome glider launch sites. Whilst we knew the island to be inhabited, we did not expect its occupants to be quite so ... militant.
We stand before the most important, the most significant, the most powerful artefact to ever be discovered in Gielinor, and it's all thanks to me!
We start when you have your keg of beer with you, and finish when one of us can drink no more and yields.
We stick to bronze and iron for this sword...
We still do not know what happened, but evidence suggests they were blown far off course to the south.
We still don't know why Keli and her bandits took the Prince. I'm hoping I can find out. The place where they imprisoned him seems a good starting point.
We still have a problem with local louts, though. Poisoning my fish, spilling my compost all over the place and causing a nuisance for the dear count.
We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
We still haven't been called upon yet. We may as well mingle with these other potential recruits while we wait.
We still leanin... learning.
We still need an authentic magical monkey talisman.
We still need some kind of monkey remains.
We still need something to colour the Prince's skin lighter. There's a witch close to here. She knows about many things. She may know some way to make the skin lighter.
We still need the gold bar and something to do with monkey speech.
We still need the gold bar.
We stop Drakan! Stop him before he can begin this festival of his!

We stopped the research as it was too dangerous to be practically useful, but our initial studies showed that we could use the entire dimension as a kind of scrying glass to see a precise point where we wished to teleport
We strive to become the best.
We suffered many losses but we've now managed to trap them in this cave.
We sure did! I was very afraid to start off with, but once I saw how you dealt with combat I felt sure I could do it too.
We survived! Is that all the puppies?
We suspect them to be the group responsible for destroying the Wizards Tower all of those years ago, as well as other more recent acts of sabotage.
We suspect there's a Goblin uprising on the horizon and the Goblins are sending spies to seek out weak spots in the city.
We take Lumbridge!
We take Varrock!
We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.
We take it so goblins happy. It great honour for Big High War God!
We take risks every day though, don't we?
We talkin' the same language yet?
We taught selves to be mighty!
We tell you get blue armour.
We tell you get brown armour.
We tell you get orange armour.
We test your knowledge of Herblore and see if you can fit in with the rest of us. If you pass, then we let you become an initiate.
We thank Saradomin for the end of that violent Age, and pray that he will continue to defend us from the evil other gods.
We then will follow these up by improving your attack and defence techniques.
We think his goal is the city itself. Lots of TzHaar memories here for him. Luckily, he is trapped in prison down there, and we are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.
We think it's a magical weapon from the surface. Can you decipher the symbols on it?

We think the Farmer may be an agent for the other side, trying to have us assassinated by all these foolish humans. If you investigate him for us, we can finish our mission report and you can go on your way.
We think you are... or used to be... Robert the Strong!
We thought some nice flowers might help things along a bit. They've both loved Quality Violet Tulips ever since they worked a stint on the same farm together.
We thought we knew how powerful Lucien had become. We thought we'd prepared appropriately...
We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
We thought we'd lost you back there, [player name].
We thought you'd rat us out to the authorities, so we came out here to hide.
We took an unnecessary risk back in Meiyerditch with Serafina. Look how that turned out. Flaygian, Mekritus and Andiess. All dead because of that risk.
We took up arms against the Nightmare because we had to, not because we wanted to. We are a peaceful race, and most were all too eager to lay down their weapons once the Nightmare was gone.
We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
We trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
We travelled by boat along the coastlines, never taking more from the land than could be regrown by the same time in the following year.
We travelled eastwards over many oceans.
We travelled to the jungle and a battlefield and encountered many dangers before meeting some knights of Falador.
We tried a few styles, and it turns out the beard just wasn't me. But this new hairstyle? It's powerful yet manly.
We tried.
We trolls are named after first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
We trolls are named after the first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
We trolls. Them not trolls. 'Nuff said.
We try hard to keep this town protected.
We try to convert them instead.

We try to ensure the location of the hangar remains a secret. If you must know something, then know that it lies directly beneath the Gnomeball pitch. However, I cannot reveal the location of its entrance.

We try to, but it's like herding cats! We at least like to keep an eye on what they're hunting and point them in the right direction. It prevents us from losing track of too many creatures... or people.
We turned our backs upon them, and let them know they would never be welcome back to our tribes until they had released themselves from the rocks.
We under attack!
We underestimated them. We believed our weapons would be enough to keep us safe. We were wrong.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: We understand this power.
We upgraded last week.
We use fossils to try determine several things: information about what fossil belonged to, what the environment was like, and try to uncover secrets of Gielinor's past.
We use it a lot for Construction back in Keldagrim as well.
We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
We use them alongside our spears, but for a being of your size, wearing them on your back would work best.
We used the armour fragment you unearthed to reconstruct the shape of the original armour, and with it the shape of the goblin who wore the armour.

We used to be in Seers' Village, far to the west, but we had to move - the seers were complaining about the noise level, and the knights of Camelot got it into their heads that the Party Room knights were making fun of
We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
We used to run cart trips down to Shilo Village in south Karamja. Since the troubles we had we've had to stop them though, too many people got killed.
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
We usually lose some equipment when he does so, but it's a small price to pay to be hale and hearty again, what?
We voted on this, and decided that it was in the best interests of the tribe to leave these strange rocks where they lay, for the gods can be spiteful and cruel,
We wait until the most opportune moment for you to show your support. Yes, you must really come along to one of our meetings.
We walk in the light of Tumeken. Gone he may be, but his fire burns on through all who remain. For some, the fire heals. For others, it destroys. This is as it should be. It is all part of the plan.
We want a King!
We want a cowbell and a set of bongos.
We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
We want answers!
We want things you people want. They are tasty to us! The more you want them, the tastier they are!

We want this man caught, for the good of the country, and if we need to fool a few people into thinking you're nothing to do with us, and you have to do a little extra walking, then that's what is going to happen, what?
We want to interrogate them and find out what they're up to!
We want to use mould parts that match collisi... commission Kovac give you.
We want use mould parts to fit condi... commission... so when setting up mould, find parts that match.
We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
We went through all that just for a bad pun! One day no-fur, one day I'll get you back.
We went too far... way too far, we need the memories. JalYt would not understand.
We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
We were about to go to Lumbridge to speak to a Cook there who has a lot of eggs!
We were about to go to Thlessia's... Thasselio's... Thlessaloa's...
We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request, we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request; we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
We were at war with the Menaphites for a long time. As Spymaster for Al Kharid, I know that no war is ever truly over.
We were attacked by some bloodvelds. You used your powers to kill one.
We were both a bit nervous about going any further west than the steps.
We were completely off course, [player name]. Talk to the lead navigator to try again.
We were defending ourselves. You threatened to destroy us all.
We were discussing gnome magic...
We were driven mostly to the coastlines, where we could escape by boat when attacked. Remember, at this time we had no real way to defend against constant attack.
We were going to use it to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
We were going to use them to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
We were hoping you could hypnotise Bob again so we can learn more about his past.
We were hoping you might have some ribbons that we could use as decorations.
We were investigating the tunnels where you found Kruk, and discovered an entrance to a much deeper cavern.
We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
We were looking forward to some lovely easter eggs, weren't we sweetykins?
We were losing you to Iban's influence...
We were lucky that a different by-law she'd already introduced clearly stated that the mayor serves until death.
We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
We were never going to attack you! YOU nearly attacked US!
We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.
We were on our way to decommission Glough's old ship building facilities in eastern Karamja, as you probably know. However, we obviously chose the wrong season to fly.
We were on the home stretch lad why did we turn back?
We were once drinking fellows. The things I've seen him drink without even breaking a sweat...
We were one gnome to a glider, so each was extremely light. Like leaves in a wind, we were blown south before we even landed on that island.
We were overwhelmed in numbers. Some of us managed to escape, but the rest were taken captive.
We were recently sorting through some of the things stored down in the cellar, and we found this old talisman.
We were supposed to meet here, at the tree by the pool. I think if I wait long enough maybe she will show up again.
We were told a curse had been placed on us. If we left the mansion we'd be struck down in an instant.
We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
We were told to follow the rats and they led us to this tomb.
We were told we had an audience with Pharaoh Kemesis, but when we arrived at the palace he wasn't there. It was just this woman.
We were very happy... until Lord Drakan noticed us.
We were warned not to trust your kind, and I can see why.
We were watching! You really ruined them!
We were, my child. It is my hope that I can offer her enough to join with us willingly. However, from what we've seen of her, it is clear she has rather lofty ambitions of her own.
We were.
We weren't sure what t' do with it. Figured you'd have an inkling as you've been digging around the place.
We will all need to accept compromise here, my child.
We will also mix the order up a little to make things interesting for you!
We will automatically collect the resources and bestow you with our elven mining knowledge.
We will be here once you are.
We will be here.
We will combine two special attacks into a deadly combination. You'll notice you have an Armadyl godsword and a granite maul.
We will conquer all!
We will discuss the nitty-gritty of the work I have for you later. First, let's get these fixed. I'll get this one sorted and then deal with the one to the east. Do you mind fixing the northern one?
We will do that!
We will fly quietly into the night...and destroy them all!
We will have it dealt with. For now, take another. However, I suggest you take more care this time.
We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
We will have to see how their new king fares. He is young and inexperienced, but he may still have potential...
We will have to talk more later my friend. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.
We will help them. But first, you will serve us.
We will hold back the troll forces while you cross the bridge to the south of the cave.
We will infiltrate the cult and gather any information we can. Once we have confirmed their guilt, they will be eradicated.
We will lay our eggs in your brain and you will not die until it explodes and a million kalphite emerge to make a grand hive of all the world!
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
We will meet at dat village, yah?
We will need a special potion to be able to safely enter the crystal seed. We'll also need to be able to bypass the defences around it as well.
We will need to recover some of those eggs for ourselves. With them, we may be able to find further relevant memories.
We will never follow you, Drakan. Return to Vampyrium if you wish. Take those foolish enough to still believe in you as well if you like. The rest of us will remain here. This is our home now.
We will now dim the lights and bring the missing statue back in.
We will secure the house and prepare a trap to capture this cultist leader upon their return. As we don't know exactly when that will be, I suggest we move quickly.
We will send him a messenger confirming this. He will offer you the opportunity to become his squire, you are to decline, and ask if you can be deputised instead.
We will stay here, under her protection. With our new food supplies we will be able to stay here for many years more.
We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We'll...
We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
We will take your group to Castle Drakan as our prisoners. Once inside, my vyres will ensure no one enters while we deal with my brother.
We will talk later. You have my word.
We will, Drezel.
We will, my friend. With people like you fighting for our cause, Lucien has no hope.
We will.
We will?
We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
We won remember, it was a win win!
We won! The Council are out, and we have what Kourend really needed. We have a king!
We won't actually be using a real sword, just a prop, so it doesn't need to be made from metal. Gather some normal logs and carve the sword using a knife.
We won't be able to do it alone. The Council still holds the power in Kourend.
We won't be able to stay here now that Vanstrom knows where we've been hiding. We have some time though. He'll expect that we're all dead. We'll use that time to form a plan of action.
We won't be denied!
We won't let you down, Persten.
We won't permit surface-dwellers to mine here until there is peace between our peoples.
We won't take any resources from your successes, the resources are all your own.
We won't!
We work for the Shayzien Constabulary. It's part of the Shayzien Military. We investigate crimes all across the kingdom.
We work in a factory making Christmas presents, we used to love our work but this year our boss has turned into a corporate machine and is making us work crazy hours.
We work together to help hone each other's skills and test our mettle through challenges called Barracuda Trials.
We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
We would be able to pass over into the next world but Necrovarus has used his power to create a psychic barrier, preventing us.

We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
We would never do that! We don't tunnel upwards and we're very careful not to damage human cellars.
We wouldn't be asking for anything special though, just the common resources are what we require.
We wouldn't have been so cold if Armod had more diary pages he'd let us use!
We wouldn't have this problem if we were in the Shadow Realm!
We'd all be killed in our sleep! And it would be my fault!
We'd also like you to befriend a Kharazi tribesman, and bring back a token of the tribe's friendship. The Legends' Guild has allies in all corners of the map, and we could always use more.
We'd appreciate it if you could donate any materials you find on your adventures.
We'd be throwing lives away...
We'd be willing to let you take one of Gielinor's most powerful weapons from Yama's vault in exchange for it.
We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.
We'd better change into those robes.
We'd better do the ritual!
We'd better get back to the platform so we can see what's going on.
We'd better get going. Good luck.
We'd better get on with the ritual. Let's get this over with!
We'd better get over there then.
We'd better get to Shayzien right away. We need to tell Sergeant Hudson about this.
We'd better get you out of here before that thing returns.
We'd better go!
We'd better keep a close eye on him.
We'd better keep going, [player name]
We'd better keep going, [player name].
We'd better keep moving. It probably won't be long before someone comes to check in on things here.
We'd better take Furia here to my mother. She'll be the one who decides what happens to her.
We'd hate to disappoint. It's over Damien.
We'd have found another way.
We'd have passed the trials and we'd be proper adults!
We'd like you to kill Conrad King, one of their senior members. The man has been a thorn in our side for far too long. Besides, his murderous ways make us look like paragons of virtue in comparison.
We'd need to find him first.
We'd need to get them all on board.
We'd spent so long out there on Ape Atoll I was starting to doubt I'd ever see the Grand Tree again!
We'd still need the blood though.
We'd tend to bring our own, although I did sometimes let him have a bit extra from my flask.
We'll all end up in a watery grave!
We'll be back in full production in no time!
We'll be doomed!
We'll be here when you're ready.
We'll be leaning heavily on you once again, [player name]. Our forces will do what they can to lift your burden, but our enemies are powerful, and you have more experience than most.
We'll be ready to perform the ritual soon, but you need to find two more people.
We'll be there once the thieves are dealt with. It won't take us long.
We'll beat him.
We'll beat them zombies yet! Arr!
We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
We'll bring him back safe.
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
We'll carry on as normal with the store. Business as usual!
We'll come looking for you if you're gone too long. It's not like there's anywhere for them to escape to!
We'll consider it.
We'll continue our investigation back at the Shayzien Administration. We have some leads to explore and a person of interest to question further. We'll let you know if we learn anything.
We'll dat's da fing wiv da hatsies, dey's many hatsies for da many chompies dat you stick. But you's godda get at least this many for a hat. ~ Rantz flashes fingers at you, you think he means 30. ~
We'll defeat the Bunny next time!
We'll get right to it!
We'll get to work at once.
We'll get you next time, fox!
We'll get you out of there soon enough.
We'll go sometime after that...if none of the other guards are on holiday. There are only four of us, ya know.
We'll have quite the tail to tell...
We'll have to change that!
We'll have to confer.
We'll have to do something about them. Henja, I think its time for Plan B.
We'll have to leave. We should be able to sneak out of Meiyerditch using the same route you did.
We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but you can tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
We'll have to send people down to collect them later, then.
We'll have to talk about that later. It's time to pay a visit to the Council.
We'll have to try something else, perhaps a new gift could make her feel differently.
We'll have to worry about that later. For now, you'll need to take out these dragons.
We'll head there now.
We'll hold on to it for you!
We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only archaeologists use!
We'll join the five leaders and head to the castle. There, we'll tell the councillors everything we know and present Rose's Accord to them.
We'll just have to decorate it ourselves! But first, we need something to decorate it with.
We'll just make a scarecrow. We'll need logs, and 10 sheaves of wheat for stuffing.
We'll keep an eye on everyone for you.
We'll keep the breach secure, [player name]. You should head to the crash site to make sure Glough is dealt with, once and for all.
We'll keep the knights busy until you're done.
We'll leave that lead for now then. What about the other one?
We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.
We'll look for someone who wants to buy those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the cash here, or at any bank.
We'll look for someone who's selling those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the items here, or at any bank, along with any left-over cash.
We'll make do without her, I'm still here!
We'll miss you, but this is your chance to go and find yourself out in the world. You'll always be welcome home but I get the feeling it might be a while before you're back.
We'll need a boat to get to Lithkren. Jardric should be able to help us. See if you can find him. He should be somewhere on the island.
We'll need a boat. Find a dwarf called Jardric. He should be somewhere on the island. He's an old friend who owes me a favour. He should be able to get a boat for us.
We'll need a magnet next, one with purely natural fields and made from a carefully selected iron bar. A firm impact when the iron is parallel to Gielinor's field will stabilise this field in the rod.
We'll need something stronger. Who knows what could be inside the ruins. There could be traps, or even monsters!

We'll need to get some proper cages, but I have nothing like that here. You'll have to go and see my friend Horvik in Varrock. He's a pretty well known metal-smith and he's done me a few favours in the past.
We'll need to harvest all the incorrect pumpkins and plant new ones. However I don't think we can fix anything without dealing with the crows first.
We'll need to move fast. He's probably already planning his retaliation.
We'll need to power it up I guess. Let me see what I can do.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: We'll need to use the donations from the congregation. We were hoping to use that money to build an orphanage for those who lost their parents to the plague.
We'll need to wait for the guards to change shift, but don't worry, you'll be out soon...
We'll need two sets of full robes: shirt, robe, hood, cloak, gloves, boots and badge.
We'll need... a ritual!
We'll never keep on top of the crime in this kingdom at this rate. Maybe you could help deal with some gangsters while you're in Kourend.
We'll overload it using the power contained in this very Archive!
We'll quit while we're ahead!
We'll reconvene once you have the cell open.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: We'll see about that!
We'll see about that.
We'll see them desiccated soon enough.
We'll see what the Captain has to say about that.
We'll see what they have to say about that!
We'll see!
We'll see.
We'll see. I saw that raft you rocked up in. If that's all you bring to the table, then you have some work to do.
We'll see. Sounds pretty tough.
We'll see. Where can I find him?
We'll see...
We'll send you to Jimmy.
We'll set [him/her/them] a task, see how it goes.
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
We'll smell your cat, of course!
We'll soon be doing battle with one of the most powerful beings in existence. How are you feeling?
We'll split up. I'm going to try and learn more about these vampyres at the manor. While I do that, I want you to try and find the source of the illness.
We'll start planning what our next steps should be right away. You can leave that to us though, you've earnt a break.
We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
We'll start you off hunting [monster name], you'll need to kill [number] of them.
We'll start you off hunting cows, you'll need to kill [X] of them.
We'll starve without it though! You can't do this!
