Well when there's threats of the world being remade, you can't be too careful. It is wise to be cautious. After all, wisdom is one of Saradomin's greatest strengths.
Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...
Well when you have it all I'll fix that thing, but please don't tickle me any more.
Well when you put it like that...
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: Well when you're ready, plant the seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains. With it in place, she will rest in peace.
Well whenever you're looking to mix a potion or two, I've got what you need!
Well where did you get your red and green dye from?
Well who knows what would happen if we stopped? It would probably be fine, but can you really be sure?
Well who's this then?
Well whoever Serafina was, she is gone. There is no freedom in that Theatre. No hope. Just lies. If freedom is truly what you want, there is another path.
Well why am I going to reward you for that?! Might wanna contribute next time. I am not standin' out here for nothin'.
Well why are you showing it to me then?
Well why did you try and haggle with me then? You'd better go and get some - you're not using the blast furnace for free.
Well why didn't you just say so?
Well why didn't you say so?
Well why didn't you say so? I've got a ton of these things. Go ahead and take the bell.
Well why do you have one?
Well why not show me both greetings?
Well why not?
Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?
Well with Iban and his lot gone, we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.
Well with how white your robes are, I assumed that you'd know a thing or two about keeping clothes clean.
Well with the moral standards of this town lately, I'm hardly surprised.
Well with the suitation outside dealt with, I now need to keep an eye on this expedition. Any mistakes made in these ruins could bring the ground out from beneath our city!
Well would you be interested in having a leader?
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
Well ye canne remember everything I 'ave to say about this wee 'ouse without that, can you? Come back when yer 'ead's not all fried!
Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
Well ye take the big defence shield in both hands and watch the catapult. My assistant will fire different things at you and you need to defend against them.
Well yeah, but maybe you have a rough idea.
Well yeah, but this was the only place I could think of to store the cats.
Well yes I suppose I am...
Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
Well yes and no, it's a ghost goat.
Well yes, I am a gnome, but the riddle wasn't about me!
Well yes, I do. I've done some research about this, and I think our best hope is to get hold of an experienced adventurer.
Well yes, I just came through there-
Well yes, actually I would like to ask about something else.
Well yes, actually.
Well yes, but at least I tell you about account security as well.
Well yes, it came as something of a pleasant shock. I only hope he will let me visit it soon.
Well yes, of course it is. We supply rope to all of the rope traders in Gielinor. Its an excellent business.
Well yes, you're doing a painting of it.
Well you ARE a persistent one, aren't you?
Well you already gave me one, but I won't say no to another, thank you kindly!
Well you are on the wrong island. You should return to Rellekka and ask Mord to take you to Jatizso.
Well you better go then.
Well you can either go through them or leave them alone.
Well you can either make them, find them or buy them.
Well you can leave via the manhole in the middle of the city.
Well you can see me wearing it. It's an iron chainbody and a medium bronze helm.
Well you can think that all you like! Those cowards dare not leave Varrock. Out here, I'm toughest. You can tell them that! Now get out of my sight, before I call my guards.
Well you can think that all you like. I know those blackarm cowards dare not leave the city. Out here, I am toughest. You can tell them that! Now get out of my sight, before I call my guards.
Well you can't come in anyway.
Well you can't go believing Councillor Orson! He's clearly just jealous of Councillor Unkar's success.
Well you can't let them in...
Well you can't put a price on art.
Well you can't really do that. You see, when I say at peace, I kinda mean...dead.
Well you can't.
Well you could have fooled me! Good people don't rob from the dead!
Well you could make me an airtight pot!
Well you could stock the store for us. We'd really start looking like a town then.

Well you could try asking some of the other goblins in their village for ideas. You should be able to find it just to the North of Falador, unless they've decided the sky is the wrong colour there or something.
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

texto: Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.
Well you definitely look the part. Those guards will be totally fooled. Now get yourself down to the prison and see if you can find a way to free Elena. You'll find it beneath the castle.
Well you did it. It's been a while since I've seen the leaders of all five houses together. They're downstairs waiting.
Well you didn't do too badly, but you didn't make it nearly as far as others have.
Well you do not look like you have the right skills to make a canoe at the moment. Try using your axe a bit more first.
Well you do seem to have a moustache growing.
Well you don't look happy.
Well you don't really expect me to believe you're just here to embarrass Verzik do you? What's really going on?
Well you don't think they end up those ridiculous colours naturally do you?
Well you enjoy it!
Well you for one, and besides that we get quite a few archaeologists from the dig site passing through to examine the golem.
Well you go tell them that I'll only negotiate with their leader.
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: Well you had better get going, you've a fair bit of travelling ahead of you. Unless you want to make a small purchase from me first?
Well you have Radigad Ponfit. He was a mercenary from Asgarnia but he joined up with the Myreque to settle some mysterious score with the Drakans.
Well you have Slepe just north of here. It's mostly a quiet place, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
Well you have come to the right place. I am a master of animal detection.
Well you have fun with it.
Well you have helped me in the past. That said, I can't just go running off to Xeric's Lookout for no reason.
Well you have our support. For better or worse.

Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
Well you have to. You just have to.
Well you just let me know when you next need me.
Well you know I suspected that all along, but does anyone listen to me anymore? No! Well I'm impressed you've come to the same conclusion as me, maybe I underestimated you.
Well you know where I am if you change your mind.
Well you know where I am if you reconsider.
Well you know where to find me if you get lost!
Well you know where we are if that changes.
Well you know where we are if you change your mind.
Well you may well be in luck. We had a new arrival at the Digsite recently who claims to be a Zarosian expert!
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Well you might need to meet with them some other time. You're needed back at the palace.
Well you need to be making your Lunar clothes.
Well you need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
Well you need to find out. Go to Phileas Rimor and retrieve this parcel. I need to see it for myself.
Well you never actually made me that tea...
Well you never know, now can I get back please?

Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Well you proved that you're probably not a zombie.
Well you really are useless, aren't you?
Well you say that now, but I wonder if you can measure up.
Well you see my dear [boy/lady], the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
Well you see, Mawnis Burowgar is a superstitious man. He lost a Champion, several years back. It was really embarrassing...
Well you see, guv, I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...
Well you seem quite scary.
Well you seem to know everything else so I'll not lie. Yes.
Well you should as soon as possible. He'll be down in the pyramid by now.
Well you should be able to get some coal tar from that poisoned lake to the south. As for the rest, I'm afraid I don't have the chemistry knowledge to understand it.
Well you should be very experienced in the art of fishing, own the proper attire, and be recognised by your peers as a great fisherman.
Well you should just need to add the enriched snapdragon to a regular truth serum. Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time.
Well you should look in the sewers beneath us. There you'll find the Warrens, where the Saviours make their home.
Well you were so good at helping us write them that surely you could also support us as we deliver them. Give us a moment to write some... Instructions.
Well you will need to leave them on the surface. They are so full of air that they will stop you diving properly.
Well you will not hear that from me, White Knight dog!
Well you won't be getting it from me!
Well you won't find anything too exciting here I'm afraid. Just farming.
Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! DIE!!!
Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! Die!
Well you would say that. I'm sorry but I'm not having this. Come back when you have the head of the beast.
Well you'd better find it again. These books are very valuable.
Well you'd better find out where. If they've escaped you'll probably find them harassing people again. Check the information on that list I gave you.
Well you'd better get a move on.
Well you'd better get back there and fix it!
Well you'd better get on it then. We need him out of the way.
Well you'd better get them, we've got to perform for the Easter Bunny soon.
Well you'd better get used to it. This is where you'll spend the rest of your life, however long that ends up being.
Well you'd better go and get it. I'll be here when you are ready.
Well you'd better hope for your sake that it never floats back!
Well you'd better hope for your sake that this Karambwan is never caught!
Well you'd better hope for your sake that this shark is never caught!
Well you'd better investigate it then. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.
Well you'd better retrieve them as soon as possible. Our enemies may extract sensitive information from them.
Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.

Well you'll be pleased to know we were able to track down Jones. He's already admitted to being part of that cult. For that alone he'll be going away for a long time. However, he's staying silent on the murder.
Well you'll find him in the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment to the north.
Well you'll find our language is quite a simple one. Our names are a good example of how it is used.
Well you'll have to be catchin' me again when yer are, elephant!
Well you'll have to be quicker than that, my friend!
Well you'll have to do something. You'll need to send us some support.
Well you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
Well you'll just have to make another then. That was the only one I had.

Well you'll need to get an emerald and attach it to the sickle. You'll be needing a chisel to do that. Once you've attached the emerald, you should be able to enchant the sickle using an enchantment spell.
Well you'll need to let me see the proposal before I can agree to anything.
Well you're here now and you still have a chance to right your previous wrongs.
Well you're no hero either. You blindly served Lord Iorwerth right to the very end. You're lucky the other elves pardoned you.
Well you're not going to find him up here. I'm afraid I'm too busy to chat right now.
Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!
Well you're not on the list so you're not coming in. Go away.
Well you're probably best off doing that then. I'm sure I'll have it ready by the time you're done.
Well you're right about that. Turns out King Lathas was lying about that as well. But I'll get to that in a minute.
Well you've been a big help and no mistake.
Well you've clearly been quite busy. I've also made some progress since we last spoke.
Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?
Well you've found one... Say, you don't look much like a pirate.
Well you've found us - what's left of us, that is.
Well you've found your man.
Well you've got some odd stuff, but it's all legal. Now you need to pay a boarding charge of 30 coins.
Well you've wasted your time. My soul is long gone, along with my compassion.

Well young one, you have entered the Magic Training Arena. It was built at the start of the Fifth Age, when runestones were first discovered. It was made because of the many pointless accidents caused by inexperienced
Well your ability to disappoint is one of your few talents, so I'll let it slide. However, I must insist that you give me the orb.
Well your accent for one sounds a little funny, and you seem to have a little more colour than most dwarves.
Well your best bet would be somewhere on the rough side of Varrock, the east side if I remember correctly.
Well your surname is Prysin. It matches the name of an elder called Khom Prysin.
Well your surname is Raispher. It matches the name of an elder called Dathero Raispher.
Well your surname is Ravitz. It matches the name of an elder called Ramone Ravitz.
Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
Well your training with me is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
Well your two hours ran out a long time ago. Anyway, where did you disappear off to during the fight?
Well!
Well! Did I get the wrong end of the stick about that whistle... this is wonderous! This is... magical!
Well! How extraordinary! I'm definitely in, but only really good at doing armour and weapons on big statues - is that of use?

Well! You don't come from around here do you? The Tenti's are the nomadic people west of here. They live in tents, so we call them the Tenti's. They have great pineapples! I'm sure you get my meaning?
Well' [lad/lass], it seems the fumes from that first batch of me 'rum' did strange things to me brain.
Well, 'bye then.
Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
Well, 'stick' your head in again if you change your mind.
Well, 'tis a good job I saved a little, isn't it? Now get rid of something so I can give it to ye.
Well, 'tis technically a volcano, but ye get the general idea.
Well, 75 percent is more than a passing grade so we can't be too unhappy there.
Well, Aggie only mentioned the one colour of dye so we're stuck there.
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
Well, Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
Well, Bob mentioned to me the other day he wanted to get rid of the bees in that hive over there. I think I saw him buying poison
Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
Well, Burntmeat need big important job doing, and you bin helpful before. You fetch Burntmeat tasty human for stew that time.
Well, Bwana, I would guess that you would need to get some bronze metal and work it into something that could be turned into a necklace?

Well, Bwana, this is no laughing matter. We need to take this very seriously and act now! If you have found any items at the tomb that you need help with please let me see them and I will help as much as I can.
Well, Bwana, when I am looking for someone, I find it helps to think about where they may be. If your friend was travelling this way, he is surely between here and the place where you last saw him.
Well, Council or otherwise, the assassin is dealt with. Now we need to get this panel open and get out of here.
Well, Darkmeyer is always in need of more vials of blood. I am also willing to help those that show they've contributed to controlling the stymphike population here.
Well, Effendi, you do need to be careful of what you say to people. Or they may take it the wrong way. Thankfully, I'm very understanding. I'll just let my guards deal with you.
Well, Father Sugadinti has been using their sap in his research, but it also has other benefits that you might appreciate.
Well, Gillie seems happy with that!
Well, Hamal asked me to bury her with some of her possessions. But he doesn't have any anymore.
Well, Hassan told me to meet him here. Guess I'll just wait...
Well, I *hic* ...disagree.
Well, I AM the head wizard here...
Well, I abandoned you apparently! Maybe I was never the person you thought I was!
Well, I actually own a home here on the island. Perhaps I can be invited next time!
Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...
Well, I agree now they're up to something. The question is what...? I don't think we're going to find out much from the alchmists, though.
Well, I always fancied that I could be a great draper, but the way things are looking that's not about to happen any time soon.
Well, I always knew someone would have to. Make sure you're careful about it; there should be a cattleprod in the barn you can use to herd up the sheep.
Well, I am a traveller myself, and I have set up this hostel for adventurers and travellers who are weary from their journey.
Well, I am also on a top secret mission.
Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...

Well, I am not familiar with this particular language, but the similarities inherent in the pictographs seem to show a prevalent trend towards a syllabary consistent with the phonemes we have discovered in this excavation!
Well, I am not just some helpless girl! I have pretty good agility, so you will only need to use two planks to make a ledge that I can balance along.
Well, I am quite impactful. So, what is this ask?
Well, I am scared half to death out here.
Well, I am somewhat of an expert in the field of magical traps.
Well, I am sorry you feel that way outerlander. I cannot vouch for you until you prove to me you have some skill that will benefit our clan somehow.
Well, I am the oldest son, so by the rules of chivalry, I am most entitled to be rightful bearer of the crest.
Well, I am very busy at the moment, but I guess I can take 5 minutes off for my favourite student.
Well, I am very busy, but I could fit you in sometime next month.
Well, I arranged with all my friends to have a party at his place.
Well, I ask because I am currently doing the Fremennik trials so as to join your clan. I need seven of the twelve council of elders to vote for me.
Well, I assume you've got a job to do through all this... It did seem quite obvious.
Well, I believe the Duke of Lumbridge requires an errand running for him. You can find him upstairs in the castle. Just talk to him to get the details.
Well, I believe the play was actually intended to be a comedy. I'm hopeful they have an understudy who can fill in for today.
Well, I believe there is a chemist in Rimmington that has a small still that you could use.
Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
Well, I can assure you nobody else has come to me for advice yet. That fish will almost certainly be all you need to attain victory.
Well, I can buy the ones you want but I don't have any on me.
Well, I can cure plain cowhides into pieces of leather ready for crafting.
Well, I can get you another piece but you're going to have to pay for my time... 200 coins I'll want.
Well, I can hear something now you mention it...
Well, I can offer you a teleport to Barbarian Village. It is a fine place to be checked! However, I can only do this once!
Well, I can see how that might be a cause for concern, but right now our priority is Solus, right?
Well, I can see you have a tinderbox already, but I can give you an axe to go with it.
Well, I can see you have an axe already, but I can give you a tinderbox to go with it.
Well, I can see you have some items in your inventory. If you want to join my crew you will need all of it free so you are able to work as hard as everyone else.
Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me 4 balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
Well, I can tell you I have a valuable prisoner here in my cells. I can expect a high reward to be paid very soon for this guy. I can't tell you who he is, but he is a lot colder now.
Well, I can tell you about rewards or customisable load-outs. Which would you like to discuss?
Well, I can think of a few ice spells I could use, but they're all a bit too dangerous for a bucket of milk.
Well, I can turn the enchantment that creates the loot keys on and off for you. Won't cost you anything to turn it back on again, either.
Well, I can understand that.
Well, I can't blame you for that. All the best.
Well, I can't diagnose the problem without knowing the symptoms. You'd better go and find that list, or get Fairy Nuff to give you another one.
Well, I can't go any cheaper than that mate. I have a family to feed.
Well, I can't go any cheaper than that mate. I've got a family to feed.
Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
Well, I can't really see YOU.
Well, I can't say I blame you, since I need to tax you again.
Well, I can't say I wasn't profiting from it. Although I do admit that he'd become a little... excessive with his spending in recent times.
Well, I can't say no to a bit of treasure. What do I need to do?
Well, I can't see any more candy-hungry adults. I should return to Henja and Angel.
Well, I can't stand around here all day. I've got some things I need to take care of.
Well, I can't take you diving if you are carrying more than 27kg worth of equipment.
Well, I can't think of any other way to check. If you come up with a better plan then feel free to tell me.
Well, I can, err, cook a bit...
Well, I can, um. I can cook meals and make tea and everything, and I can even take things to and from the bank for you. I won't make any mistakes this time and everything will be fine!
Well, I cant say I agree with this...but I do appreciate that he's likely the only person that knows his way around the inside of someone's skull.
Well, I caught this fish. What do you reckon?
Well, I climbed down the vines, and found a big cave filled with terrifying ogres!
Well, I completed the tower and I still have no idea what it does, and then as soon as I tell Effigy of my hard work, he doesn't say one word of thanks and legs it off into the tower!
Well, I could become a guard of Varrock.
Well, I could benefit from your point of view. You seem the independent type.
Well, I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
Well, I could dump this bucket of water over him. That would sober him up a little...
Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...
Well, I could try and ask her to let you out, perhaps? You know, get her to listen to reason.
Well, I could try and get her to listen to reason, I suppose.
Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.
Well, I definitely know what doesn't work...
Well, I did give you the last one for free...you're not getting another one for free, even if it is my mess that you're trying to clear up! You shouldn't be so careless to leave things lying around!
Well, I did have a member of the Phoenix Gang help me... Maybe they can find the other half.
Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to approach you for trivial matters now that you are a member of the Temple Knights.
Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to-
Well, I did have the mayor, but I appear to have misplaced him.
Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.
Well, I did some rooting around in my house and found this really neat hat.
Well, I didn't do much...
Well, I didn't really manage to do anything, I left straight away.
Well, I didn't think so by itself, but lots of other people seem to find it very interesting.
Well, I didn't think you wanted to send shoes, frrriend; this is a meat shop. What I mean is, what KIND of meat do you want to send?
Well, I do actually have a bounty available at the moment that you might be interested in. 1,000 coins to whoever can bring justice to some thieves that robbed the General Store.
Well, I do always like a gift. I was wondering though, do you know why these totems are so important to the ents?
Well, I do happen to have another one here that you can have. Please try and be a bit more careful with this one!
Well, I do have a love of 2nd Age pottery.
Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.
Well, I do have an idea for a reward... hand out some eggs for me and I'll sort you out with something. Will you help?
Well, I do have my own personal reasons for wanting Will and Anne dealt with. Maybe I could try and find them.
Well, I do have one spare, but it doesn't look like you have room to carry it.
Well, I do have plenty of trinkets, but I suspect you've gotten all the use out of anything I could give you.
Well, I do have the means to get us there - a magic whistle!
Well, I do have the means to get us there - wait, let me go get the magic whistle!
Well, I do know Frank bought some poison recently to clean the family crest that's outside.
Well, I do know a bit about crafting. I'm sure I can teach you a thing or two...
Well, I do know that Elizabeth was extremely annoyed by the mosquito nest under the fountain in the garden, and was going to do something about it. I suspect any poison she bought would have been
Well, I do make hats too.
Well, I do not know what they are, but they are very strong! They hurt me badly enough to trap me here, and I have been fearing for my life ever since!
Well, I do pity you, and wish you the best of luck!

Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw. He said it allowed him to build devices more complicated that even he was capable of constructing. The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
Well, I don't - but I happen to know someone who might!
Well, I don't actually have a ship yet.
Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
Well, I don't claim to have a lot of knowledge about the ways of magic, but there's a strange protection spell on there.
Well, I don't know if it's related, but I heard from that Poison Salesman in town that he sold some poison to one of the Sinclair family
Well, I don't know of any suspicious people... Advisor Ghrim can be rather paranoid about these things sometimes.

Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to
Well, I don't know who would ever eat this, but it's certainly exciting and exotic!
Well, I don't know, but how can I trust you?
Well, I don't know. Perhaps some amazing treasure!
Well, I don't know... the way I'm breathing could give it away.
Well, I don't know...if you were a werewolf, I can see you would strike him as THAT sort of person.
Well, I don't like leaving a mystery unsolved.
Well, I don't mean to brag, but I guess I am with my level 99 magic...
Well, I don't necessarily believe I have much of a choice!
Well, I don't need a real dragon. Just something small, with 4 limbs and wings. Just so I can get the idea of a baby dragon. Hmm, perhaps we could put wings on you.
Well, I don't need to do that. Just tell him that a friend has recommended you to him. It makes him feel important.
Well, I don't really swab the deck with... Oh, never mind, please do go on!
Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
Well, I don't suppose it would be a problem to give you another. Here you go.
Well, I don't think I'll be much use without it...
Well, I don't think I'll have much luck infiltrating the Black Arm Gang now that I've joined their rivals, but maybe someone else will be able to.
Well, I don't think it was.
Well, I don't typically find myself in need of that sort of thing, but if that ever changes, I'll keep you in mind.
Well, I don't understand how a Slayer Master would even have the power to affect creatures in the way you do.
Well, I don't usually have many shoes in stock here in my little clothes shop... I will be able to make you up a pair if you are really desperate though?
Well, I don't want them to see you deliver it.

Well, I don't want to go flinging out unfounded accusations or anything, but I have a strong suspicion that somebody at that feast did something that resulted in the Moon Clan getting offended and causing this jinx
Well, I doubt it was left here by accident...
Well, I dunno... I s'pose nobody else has caught anythin' yet.
Well, I dunno... The village is kind of on the fringe out here, I dunno how up to date the stuff I hear about is...
Well, I expect it will still be waiting up there for you when you go back up. It's highly unlikely anyone would risk going up there to steal it.
Well, I expect you to offer him your full assistance in whatever he needs.
Well, I figured that with Glough being gone and all...
Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.
Well, I forgot to mention that. It was indeed pink, but it's not anymore! And I did help him with it!
Well, I found a hat that might belong to Keenan.

Well, I found out more about the Staff of Armadyl from a ghost. It seems that Zamorak was a mortal when he got hold of the staff, and he used it to, well...spear Zaros, and somehow ended up becoming a god. It was
Well, I found the first page, but I still have two to go.
Well, I found the key to his cell and unlocked it, but there's a vampyre in there stopping him leaving.
Well, I found the key.
Well, I found this...
Well, I get all of mine over at the clothing shop in Varrock. They sell them cheap there.
Well, I grew up in Ardougne. Erm, I quite enjoy Fishing.
Well, I guess I be lookin' fer a new opportunity.
Well, I guess I shouldn't shoot the messenger.
Well, I guess I'll leave you to it.

texto: Well, I guess I'll talk to the navigators and offer both up to the crew to see which they'd prefer before I go gathering them up! Thanks!
Well, I guess congratulations are in order.
Well, I guess it could be... Seems a little strange for him to do that though.
Well, I guess it could have been an intruder, but with that big guard dog of theirs I seriously doubt it. I suspect it was someone closer to home...
Well, I guess it would be rude to say no...
Well, I guess she could be considered attractive...
Well, I guess so.
Well, I guess some of us never grow up!
Well, I guess some people will do anything for a bit of fresh seafood.
Well, I guess that depends on what is involved.
Well, I guess that proves he's well enough to get up! And apparently he knows some magic too.
Well, I guess that would be logical conclusion. I don't really know where the statue was thrown. Awusah might know.
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.
Well, I guess this explains why the Cabin Boy's been acting so suspiciously... I'd better go and have a word with him!
Well, I guess you can consult with Isadora on how to carve the totem. While you do that, I'll get to work on rebuilding the pole.
Well, I guess you could join my crew.
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Well, I guess you don't know anything useful.
Well, I had a look in the library and I found this old journal. Have a read of it and see what you reckon.
Well, I had better be going for now. Good luck.
Well, I had better go back to the park. Thanks again, [player name]!
Well, I had hoped that you would go and look for 'Jimmy the Chisel'...but it looks like you've had other 'more important' things to do!
Well, I had quite the fun run in with them myself. They had me help them salvage an old shipwreck before throwing me overboard.
Well, I had that held safely away from the others! I'll give it a try now...
Well, I had the feelin' ye might have run off when ye realised how much of a task ye had ahead of ye.
Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.
Well, I have a contact on the other island. Are you interested in obtaining some produce?
Well, I have a little food left, although it's a little briny.
Well, I have a missing cat, if that's what you mean...
Well, I have a number of fine pieces of clothing on sale or, if you prefer, I can offer you an exclusive, total- clothing makeover?
Well, I have a page that should give me the instructions on how to eliminate what could be the source of the sea slugs.
Well, I have a witness...
Well, I have access to a lot of old stuff that's fallen down under the water, so I'm sure I could reward you in some way.
Well, I have always felt like a failure as a cook, and that my job here is down to the skills of my ancestor.
Well, I have an incredibly important banquet that I have to prepare for, and I am using an ancient cookbook to recreate the meal my famous ancestor made a hundred years ago.
Well, I have baked a loaf or two in my time as well.
Well, I have but a simple test. This building behind me is my house. Inside I have constructed a puzzle.
Well, I have heard that some call you 'bard' in Rellekka. Your lyre-playing reputation has carried this far.
Well, I have it in the bank.
Well, I have many things to think about. Why are the Arposandrans spying on us, and what are they planning?
Well, I have my doubts.
Well, I have my methods.
Well, I have my moments.
Well, I have one of your boots... if that helps?
Well, I have plenty of them under the tap, getting sluiced off. When you have space for one come and see me.
Well, I have plenty, but you seem to have no space for it. Come back when you do.
Well, I have seen people get them from panning occasionally.
Well, I have some cutlasses.
Well, I have some rather nice things I've found. I collect fossils, infact you might say I'm obsessed with them. Large or small, but especially the small numulites.
Well, I have some water from the Salve here.
Well, I have something that could help you out.
Well, I have sought an audience with you for several days now.
Well, I have this feeling there is some better treasure inside that pyramid, and I needed to put the diamonds in to gain entrance.
Well, I have this jug of wine...
Well, I have this one piece of ore...
Well, I have this one which I can use to club people.
Well, I have this.
Well, I have to return him to his employer, she's very worried about him, so if you could just hand him over...I'll be getting out of your way.
Well, I have to say I enjoy a laugh at someone's expense now and again... so let's have a bit of fun.
Well, I have to say, I am pretty peckish, but thankfully, I don't eat humans... often.
Well, I haven't been wrong yet, have I? And as long as that's true, I'll be in the business of slayin' for years to come!
Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while. I don't get out much.
Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so I'm probably not. Will you take me with you?
Well, I heard of your name from a mage called Dhalak, and I'm trying to find out what exactly caused the curse to befall him, and you as well apparently.
Well, I heard some human knocked over the statue of King Alvis recently. You know anything about that?
Well, I heard that Farmer Fred could use some help. You'll find him on the farm just north of here. Talk to him and see if he needs a hand.
Well, I heard that Father Aereck could use a hand. You'll find him in the church just here. Talk to him and he'll give you the details.
Well, I heard that a chap called Veos needs help finding some treasure. Last I heard, he was looking for assistance in the pub just north of here. Talk to him and see if you can help.
Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
Well, I heard there was some commotion in the swamp to the south. Might be worth looking into.
Well, I heard there'd be a fishing contest 'round here, so I came to win it.
Well, I helped deliver some research notes to Sedridor at the Wizards Tower, and he teleported me to a huge mine he said was hidden off to the North somewhere where I could mine essence.
Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.
Well, I hope it's not too long before I see you again!
Well, I hope one finds you soon.
Well, I hope so.
Well, I hope the two of you have a good time. Try not to make too much mess.
Well, I hope things start to look up for you.
Well, I hope you find a new crew soon.
Well, I hope you find it soon.
Well, I hope you get better soon.
Well, I hope you now know that not everyone is like that.
Well, I hope you will excuse me, but I need to get back to my studies.
Well, I hope you're not expecting an apology. You all knew what you were signing up for.
Well, I imagine a company like this always has need of people who can solve problems, and I myself am something of a problem solver.
Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.
Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now. 1-->
Well, I infiltrated one of the gangs here in Varrock...
Well, I just dispatched TzTok-Jad. Pretty tough! I'm now on my way to the desert. I'm going to see if I can hunt down this Kalphite Queen everyone's been telling me about.
Well, I just ran past them as fast as I could.
Well, I just thought it would be a bit more civil.
Well, I just wanted to ask you about that big feast on Lunar Isle you went to...
Well, I just wanted to know where I could get some kind of jewellery around here.
Well, I just wonder... what if we had even more bones!
Well, I killed its avatar. I'm not sure what happened to the demon itself.
Well, I knew such a weapon would be of great value to...
Well, I knew you were going to say that! Here you go...have another one!
Well, I know David said that he was going to do something about the spiders' nest that's between the two servants' quarters upstairs.
Well, I know I wouldn't want anyone to find out I had a habit like yourrrs, but still...
Well, I know how to rig up a handy set of breathing gear that can allow you to keep air inside the fishbowl.
Well, I know iron and silver. What other ores are there?
Well, I know most of the town has given up on finding them. Most are just dismissing the disappearances, assuming them to have run away or had an accident.
Well, I know of him.
Well, I left to go to the outpost against the wishes of my wife. I promised I would return to her, but obviously I did not as I died there. She's a ghost nearby, but won't listen to my apologies.
Well, I look forward to visiting it.
Well, I loved to sit by the lake, with my toes in the water and shoot the fish with my bow and arrow.
Well, I loved to sit by the lake, with my toes in the water. I'd shoot the fish with my bow and arrow.
Well, I made my way to Morytania in search of a place called the Ba... Barlows? I've heard it's a great way to earn gold.
Well, I makes me way to the closest tavern I knew of that catered to my sort of people...
Well, I managed to catch this tiny fish, but I'm not sure it'll win me the contest.
Well, I may have a mission for you, but it seems you are not quite ready for it yet.
Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.
Well, I met Rat and he asked me to fill his folder, and I got mixed up with Surok....
Well, I might be able to retrieve it from the slow-teleport!
Well, I might have done a thing or two to push Juliet into throwing it.
Well, I might have run out of wood after I tried my hand at a little Construction, so I got my workers to take a little wood from Draynor Manor...
Well, I might have something for you, but I need to see you've got the right enthusiasm!
Well, I might post you outside it sometimes. I prefer to be the only one allowed inside however.
Well, I might still be able to be of use from here. These look like pressure plates. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.
Well, I most certainly am not lonely!
Well, I must be getting on now.
Well, I must be off again.
Well, I need a blurite ore and two iron bars. The only place I know to get blurite is under this cliff here, but it is guarded by a very powerful ice giant.
Well, I need at least five! Come back when you've got that many!
Well, I need every vote I can get in the council of elders, but this certainly sounds impossible to do...
Well, I need some spy work doing but it's quite dangerous. It will involve going into the Black Knights' fortress.
Well, I need the Sherpa to show me a secret way up Death Plateau so that the Imperial Guard can destroy the troll camp! He won't help me till I've got the spikes!
Well, I need the feathers to make my bed more comfortable. A comfortable bed will help me sleep. Obvious, really.
Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.
Well, I need to have all the bones I'm going to use here, and placed into some sort of order.
Well, I need two. Come back when you have them.
Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human, but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - even if most gnomes won't recognise it. You humans are not as stupid as I first thought...
Well, I never imagined you'd be quite the actor!
Well, I only asked you to do me one small favour...
Well, I only have so much space to carry things.
Well, I only really know what the Great Guardian told us. This is the Temple of the Eye, or at least, what's left of it. It was built long ago to house the Eye, a powerful Saradominist artefact.

Well, I prefer to use a skewer stick, you can make one from a thatching spar using a machete. Or, if you're stuck, you could always use an arrow shaft, though they tend to be useless once you've finished eating the
Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most family trees, but he himself has none!
Well, I read a book once...
Well, I really don't know why it might have happened. Maybe Ghaslor has some ideas. He's very wise and old and is the town's archivist. He lives in the northeast corner of town.
Well, I recently defeated Delrith, a demon! I did it by using a sword called Silverlight, which is apparently the only sword that could do it. I can give you a description if you want?
Well, I reckon I'm prepared to go there now. Beam me there, or whatever it is that you do!
Well, I s'pose that was me...
Well, I s'pose we'd best...
Well, I say Miscellanian, but it's actually brewed on the mainland.
Well, I say helping... he takes his merry time to do his chores, my son does.
Well, I say strange, but I'd never left Lunar Isle at the time and this place was very hot and dry, unlike anything I'd seen before.
Well, I see poor Romeo wandering around the square. I think he may need help.
Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words!

Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words! I met some [man/woman] earlier wot called [himself/herself] [other player's name].
Well, I sent him to Lumbridge to get some supplies and he hasn't come back! He left about two days ago and I've seen neither hide nor hair of him all that time.
Well, I serve our clan as a navigator. The seas can be a fearful place when you know not where you are heading.
Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
Well, I should thank you for finding my kitten that time. I have a terrible time keeping track of them, and I never know how many Gertrude has managed to sell.
Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...
Well, I slipped and dropped a fossilised leg bone from something in the pool. It... well it kind of ate it away.
Well, I split this rock in your camp in two, you see, and I'm going to give half of it to Brundt so he will speak to you.
Well, I spoke to both the Captain and the Navigator, and it seems to me it must be the navigator's fault that we're sailing in circles.
Well, I started to notice something about three weeks ago.
Well, I stuck your spider in the hopper, what now?
Well, I suppose I can give you a few hints. First up, Death himself has plenty of creepy decorations. Next, the moving chair can be found in Draynor Manor, if you've got the spine to search it.
Well, I suppose I can let you keep that! It's always brought me luck!
Well, I suppose I can't say no to that.
Well, I suppose I can. I'll be back soon.
Well, I suppose I could have left you in there to be eaten...
Well, I suppose I could help, but I am getting on a bit now. I'm not quite the warrior I used to be.
Well, I suppose I could spare a little time.
Well, I suppose I could.
Well, I suppose I do keep getting captured by the trolls and thrown in prison...But they always release me in the end, I'm far too old and skinny for their tastes.
Well, I suppose I do. Seeing as you're such a good guardian of cats, I'll give you one. Be careful with it, though.
Well, I suppose I have ended up learning a bit about crafting as part of this job.
Well, I suppose I never thought about that.
Well, I suppose I should be able to find my way without it, after all this time, so I don't mind letting you have it. But will it actually help? It's never led me to any other realms.
Well, I suppose I'd better have a look.
Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
Well, I suppose anything is worth a try.
Well, I suppose as long as the cat is all right, it doesn't matter what it looks like.
Well, I suppose if I give you the recipe, you can make it yourself.
Well, I suppose if you've already nosily rifled through the princesses personal memoirs, I can tell you a little more.
Well, I suppose it is.
Well, I suppose it wouldn't be exotic for you, since you're from the surface.
Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to try, old socks! What would you say?
Well, I suppose it's not much of a bustling port. Still, I hope you find a crew soon.
Well, I suppose so.
Well, I suppose so. [player name], this could be VERY dangerous. Do you feel ready to fight?
Well, I suppose so... But for them to curse our entire boat?
Well, I suppose that answered both questions then.
Well, I suppose that's not surprising.
Well, I suppose that's possible. Scribe Eggulomunus the Lazy wasn't known for his eggsacting detail...
Well, I suppose there is Traitorous Ali.
Well, I suppose there's no harm tellin' you.
Well, I suppose we could find some arrangement for their freedom... hmmm?
Well, I suppose we could treat the soil with compost first.
Well, I suppose we do have all the time in the world...
Well, I suppose we don't need a navigator these days, and he's not very good at anything else. But I don't see why that's got anything to do with the curse.
Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.
Well, I suppose you can. But first, you should make some room to carry it.
Well, I suppose you could pray to other gods... but I don't know why you'd want to. What could any other god possibly offer that Saradomin does not already provide?
Well, I suppose. Can't see why not.
Well, I sure am glad you were there to lend a hand. Thank you!
Well, I surely cannot deny you the cape now. There is of course a fee...
Well, I tell you what, now that you're here, maybe we have a chance to escape!

texto: Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
Well, I think I may have found who was responsible for upsetting the Moon Clan.
Well, I think I might be able to help with that.
Well, I think I will let you decide that.
Well, I think I'll start keeping a stock of mayors on standby from now on.
Well, I think I'll stay out of this one. Good luck with your protest.
Well, I think I've done it, take a look...
Well, I think I've missed the first way, but how can I get the council of elders to vote to let me join your clan?
Well, I think it looks amazing! Really suits you. Anyway, did you want anything?
Well, I think it's a positive step in my career as a courageous adventurer.
Well, I think it's about time you sort yourself out with an upgrade! You should check in with Jim. I'm sure he'll have something fitting. Now, avast!
Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
Well, I think that's everything...
Well, I think the best thing for you would be to go to the docks and ask to join one of our longboats on a journey.
Well, I think there might be one onboard.
Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
Well, I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...
Well, I thought I'd try out this place called the Wilderness.
Well, I thought it'd be nice to go on a little vacation. Get away from all the rabble.
Well, I thought you were going to use that spell I gave you to free Petra from the rock face?
Well, I tried my best...
Well, I tried to hack the trees with my axe, but it just bounced off the trunk! It did all seem all-too-convenient to work on the first try.
Well, I understand the First Mate snuck out in the middle of the feast...
Well, I understand you're a thief...
Well, I understand. Perhaps you can search for it another time? Come back when you think you're ready. Excuse me now won't you while I return to my studies.
Well, I wanted to access the Third Age of Gielinor, but that's not what this is. Instead, the Realm of Memories recalls how the world used to be, back when things were different.
Well, I was a sailor. I've not been able to get work at sea these days, though. They say I'm too old.

Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien, but instead, I helped the guardians of the staff and banished Lucien from this plane of existence, so that he could never again return.
Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien. When I returned it he grew in power unimaginably. I held the staff and can describe it to you if you want?
Well, I was collecting bones for you... but then you killed me! Then we were in some sort of asylum... with this creature you'd been building! I managed to kill it though.
Well, I was cooking dis adventurer...
Well, I was doing a lot of walking that day... Oh yes, that's right - we were studying ceramics in fact, near the edge of the digsite.
Well, I was experimenting with these blue runes, the ones you call 'law' runes. They have a strange property of being able to move instantly from one place to another.
Well, I was going through some ancient documents recently, expanding my knowledge of our great ancestors...
Well, I was hoping you could help me with something.
Well, I was hoping you could tell me how to make one?
Well, I was just going to ask what you're doing, but I'm starting to regret it.
Well, I was just thinking the other day that I'm feeling sort of unfulfilled in my life.
Well, I was just touring the desert looking for the nomad tribe to the West. And I was set upon by these armoured men.
Well, I was just wondering where the book came from actually and try to get some more information about it.
Well, I was making me merry way along, having just pulled off a glorious jewellery heist from a bunch of stinking dwarves...
Well, I was meant to be delivering eggs, but I left it a bit late again this year...
Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.
Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
Well, I was quite a catch in my day you know!
Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
Well, I was wondering how you get the blood stains out of your clothes?
Well, I was wondering if you could do me just one small favour? Please could you go and fetch him back again for me?
Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...
Well, I wasn't just going to sail on by! When I get the chance, I'll drop you off at a port.
Well, I went to the temple and spoke to... Drezel. He asked me to kill a dog in the mausoleum.
Well, I will assume that 'anything' includes weapons and armour. So come back when you've got rid of them.

Well, I will not allow this ignominious incident to sully this otherwise resplendent day. Now, I beseech thee, be gone with alacrity. I wish to partake in beverages without the trouble of your presence.
Well, I wish I could be more happy, but I've just had some bad news.
Well, I wish you luck, because it is very unnerving to think that I'm sailing on a cursed ship!
Well, I wish you the best of luck.
Well, I won't entrust you with my piece of the crest until you have brought me a necklace of perfect gold with a red precious stone, and a perfect gold ring to match.
Well, I would appreciate it if you could hurry.

Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.No line from the player in this case.
Well, I would give you another, but apparently you don't have any room.
Well, I would give you the key, but apparently you don't have any room.
Well, I would have thought picking the lock was really the best way, but I don't have the knowledge or tools to do it.
Well, I would hurry. Trade information tends to be rather time-sensitive.
Well, I would suggest going to collect it. That information could be very time-sensitive!
Well, I would, but I ran out of stock. Business wasn't helped with that stuff that happened up at the Sinclair Mansion much either, I'll be honest.
Well, I wouldn't count on it.
Well, I wouldn't describe it as a quest, but there is something I could use some help with.
Well, I wouldn't even try the front... but maybe you'll have some luck getting in from beneath.
Well, I wouldn't go as far as that – it is only through Brimstail's and my researches that we have established this is going on.
Well, I wouldn't have put it quite that way...
Well, I wouldn't mind a few shark and swordfish steaks as back-up you know.
Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
Well, I wouldn't put it that way...
Well, I'd appreciate a bit more o ya help! Ain't got two bees t'rub togetha' and now we got wasps squattin' in me 'ives!
Well, I'd be able to fix more if you had more.
Well, I'd be careful of making assumptions, my child. Itzla said the ruins were meant to be an archive. A centre point for all the knowledge of the Old Ones.
Well, I'd be glad to have you along! So, will you show me the puzzle?
Well, I'd be lying if I said life was suddenly perfect, but it's nice to no longer live in constant fear of the vampyres.
Well, I'd best give you what you came for then.
Well, I'd better be going then.
Well, I'd better carry on with my research then..
Well, I'd better get back to treating. Happy Halloween!
Well, I'd better sort my new room out.
Well, I'd feel terrible! Wait...
Well, I'd like a supply of Burthorpe Vine seeds.
Well, I'd like to say that you're welcome. But I heard that you led Vanstrom straight to their hideout. I feel so guilty.
Well, I'd like to say that you're welcome. But what does it matter now? The Drakans killed the whole lot of them.
Well, I'd like to. I really would, but I wouldn't be able to concentrate while worrying about my friend so much. I tell you what. If you could do me just one small favour, I promise to help you!
Well, I'd love to be able to help you for free again, but I'm afraid I don't have the spare materials lying around this time.
Well, I'd love to let you sail with me again, but I don't think I'm ready to hire a crew yet.
Well, I'd not be doing a very good job of it, if I was, considering you're not asleep.
Well, I'd prefer to wait it out, but if someone doesn't deal with these things soon, I may have to.
Well, I'd prefer you did it elsewhere, Crombwick is busy entertaining his guests.
Well, I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey. Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!
Well, I'd say they've well overstayed their welcome here anyway, so maybe it's about time we cleared them out.
Well, I'll be a rabbit in da eyes of a fox! Best ya chase after 'im then and get us our dosh! Don't you do a runner, now!
Well, I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
Well, I'll be happy to give you the net once you have the cash, but not before!
Well, I'll be here if you need anything.
Well, I'll be off then. Have fun spending the rest of your life in jail.
Well, I'll be on my way now.
Well, I'll bless something for you if you need it, but just don't spread it around that I'm giving out freebies.
Well, I'll do my best.
Well, I'll have a look, at least.
Well, I'll keep my fingers crossed for you. I'm sure you'll be able to find one another soon!
Well, I'll leave you to it.
Well, I'll leave you to your planning.
Well, I'll let you get on with your work then.
Well, I'll need it before I can send over these supplies.
Well, I'll need some time to find something appropriate to perform.
Well, I'll put something special to one side for you.
Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
Well, I'll see what I can do.
Well, I'll see you again sometime maybe. Sorry I couldn't get you any treasure...
Well, I'll tell ye the story, but it'll take a great deal of convincin' for me to sell you this rapier.
Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.
Well, I'm Lady Servil. I was travelling to Ardougne with my husband, Justin, and son, Sammy, when our cart broke on some rocks.
Well, I'm Nama, one of the elders who specialises in dealing with the gryphons.
Well, I'm a butcher, I'll be 'appy to perhaps trade you, that I would.
Well, I'm a trader by nature and I was on the way to Varrock with my cart here when I was set upon by outlaws! They ransacked my cart and stole some very important papers that I must get back.
Well, I'm a...
Well, I'm actually here to recruit the three of you to help uncover an old teleportation matrix. The only issue is that Traiborn won't let you leave until the puzzle is solved.
Well, I'm actually wealthy enough to be a homeowner myself, but not on Aldarin unfortunately.
Well, I'm afraid I have lost it.
Well, I'm afraid I'm going to have to put a stop to that. Whatever it is you're doing... it ends here!
Well, I'm also here to visit a friend, Jake O'Niall.
Well, I'm an adventurer. There must be something I can do for you in return.
Well, I'm as entertaining as a juggler with a bag of ferrets down his trousers.
Well, I'm back. And he said no. Again.
Well, I'm called Ali and I'm from here. Are you looking for me?
Well, I'm confused, any tips?
Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least. 127-->
Well, I'm glad it's going well for you.
Well, I'm glad the pub is doing well, but I was actually asking about you.
Well, I'm glad this is almost over, see you around.
Well, I'm glad to hear all is well. Until next time.
Well, I'm glad you're happy. Can I have that map now?
Well, I'm going to have a look around anyway, if you're not involved in this whole thing, you won't have anything to hide.
Well, I'm going to talk to the servants and see if I can learn anything new from them...but other than that, I don't really know what I'm doing.
Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
Well, I'm here about a treasure trail...
Well, I'm here about an axe...
Well, I'm here now! Maybe I can go and get the seeds for you?
Well, I'm here to claim it.
Well, I'm here to have a look around. I'll see what I can find out about them.
Well, I'm looking for something and I think he might have it...
Well, I'm no expert when it comes to witches, but... with how long she's been around, people are speculating that she might be dead.
Well, I'm no expert. Maybe you should speak to someone who knows more about such technical stuff.
Well, I'm not actually sure if I should go in there, you see.
Well, I'm not averse to a little academic collaboration. I just need some proof that there's something strange here.
Well, I'm not entirely sure what else I expected.
Well, I'm not giving you anymore!
Well, I'm not going back down there until I get a drink buddy! Come see me if you find me a keg, I pay good money!
Well, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So, leave me alone.
Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
Well, I'm not much of a history buff... But I'll tell you what I know.
Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for these lands when it was built there.
Well, I'm not one to gossip, but as it's for your investigation... What would you like to know?
Well, I'm not really sure. This was all before I was born - and no-one talks about what happened to Glouphrie these days.
Well, I'm not really sure; I guess I should see what I can find around the site.
Well, I'm not risking my hide running around the Wilderness! We need a better plan.
Well, I'm not sayin' anything to anyone unless they have decent cookin' skills.
Well, I'm not scared of big, nasty rats.
Well, I'm not sure I could if I tried, but that is not why I have come to you.
Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.

Well, I'm not sure, but by all accounts, he is a slippery fellow. The Captain has been trying to capture him for years. A bit of a waste of time if you ask me. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.
Well, I'm not sure. Brother Maledict has asked me to find some pages that were torn out of his holy book.
Well, I'm not sure. Could you take a look at the roof and then look at the walls. Once you've done that come and have a chat with me.
Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
Well, I'm not sure. We might be able to find out with this shield though.
Well, I'm not the type of gardener you think I am. Just leave me alone please.
Well, I'm not too familiar with the fine details, you'll have to go and speak with Traiborn in the Wizards' Tower. He'll know what you need.
