texto: Well, I'm not unseeing that any time soon.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
Well, I'm on a treasure trail...
Well, I'm one of the militia, we try and keep the rest of the pirates in line.
Well, I'm pretty sure it involves a blast furnace...
Well, I'm pretty sure it was the Cabin Boy.
Well, I'm ready and waiting to get going. Do you know how long it will be?
Well, I'm running a bit low on raw supplies. Can you get me [X] [item]? Within [X] minutes?

Well, I'm seeking some kind of settlement between your clan and the Fremenniks. I understand there has been a dispute for a great many years and being a member of the Fremennik clan I wanted to come as a
Well, I'm sorry about that...but I just can't work when I'm feeling so ill.
Well, I'm sorry luv, I'm not giving away any of my secrets.
Well, I'm sorry to hear that.
Well, I'm sorry to say you missed the fun. They got away, Attala. I wasn't able to stop them in time.
Well, I'm sort of doing him a favour.
Well, I'm special! I bore down a little so I'm nice and cosy with my herbs exposed to the sun, it's all very interesting.
Well, I'm still a bit unsure about getting this glue.
Well, I'm still in one piece. A good start.
Well, I'm still wet, still cold and still waiting on that nettle tea.
Well, I'm sure Hugi the librarian in West can help you along.
Well, I'm sure I'll find some way to keep myself busy. But yes, this has been my last quest. My swan song.
Well, I'm sure if we put our heads together we will think of something.
Well, I'm sure she's harmless. If you go back that way you should see a group of men in red cloaks. Head past them and you're back in the cave that will lead you to the surface.
Well, I'm sure that your magical research skills will help you there. Good luck!
Well, I'm sure the palace guards can deal with it, then. Thanks for the information.
Well, I'm sure the two of you will find each other soon. However, I do suspect that might happen sooner if you considered looking by some other trees...
Well, I'm sure you remember the drill. I'll supply the wing of rat, tail of frog, ear of snake and horn of dog... and you need to bring me some Cadava berries.
Well, I'm taking a huge gamble on this artifact being valuable. I'm willing to offer you a share of its final sale price.
Well, I'm the Regent of Miscellania. The King asked me to take a look-
Well, I'm the only one left... all the others gave up. Said it wasn't worth their while anymore. Wouldn't have a good return profit on their time investment.
Well, I'm the steward here at Lumbridge Castle. It's my job to make sure the Duke has everything he needs to keep things running smoothly.
Well, I'm trying to fight TzTok-Jad at the moment.
Well, I'm trying to find a new supply of food for your people. Any ideas on where to start?
Well, I'm working on it, have you got any suggestions?
Well, I'm...
Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
Well, I've actually come here on a diplomatic mission. I want to try and settle some of the disputes between the Fremenniks and your clan.
Well, I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need myself.
Well, I've been known to be powerful from time to time. What can I do for you?
Well, I've been with them for years now. We have multiple groups in Morytania but I only really know about those of us based here.
Well, I've built the coffin.

Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village in the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.
Well, I've come to change the deal!
Well, I've done a lot of research into Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers and it seems to have paid off, but answer me this one question. Why are you asking me this rather than the Gnome?
Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
Well, I've found all of you now.
Well, I've found four diamonds.
Well, I've got a Kelda hop seed right here! Pashed down generation after generation in my family...
Well, I've got a letter here from your friend in Keldagrim.
Well, I've got one here you can have for 1,000 coins if you'd like it?
Well, I've got some sailing experience myself. Hopefully I can get us there without too much trouble.
Well, I've got the ridiculous costume on again.
Well, I've had a few people bring me some interesting giant shells. They say they came from giant snails and giant tortoises.
Well, I've heard my friend the cook is in need of a spot of help. He'll be in the kitchen of this here castle. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.

Well, I've heard that all kinds of dragons and even basilisks can drop mithril axes, if that's why you are delaying. Most of these creatures are silly enough that you can even hide behind something and plink them to
Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.
Well, I've held it a few times in the course of my work, but I'll give it a go.
Well, I've just spoken to Effigy about this tower. He tells me he hired you to work but you're on strike. Something about an extended tea break?
Well, I've left a list of all the ones I need just on the wall there. Do check it if you need a reminder of which ones you still need to fetch.
Well, I've managed to find half the shield!
Well, I've managed to get her into the cage.
Well, I've misplaced me, I mean my, ID card.
Well, I've not earned a new nickname since starting practice. We'll see how that works out.
Well, I've recently acquired an interesting artifact in a trade and would like to have it examined by a specialist at the Varrock Museum.
Well, I've sat down and had a good chat with the Homunculus.
Well, I've seen better...
Well, I've travelled from the frozen wastes in the Wilderness to the pyramids of the Kharidian Desert. I've lived with the monkeys of Ape Atoll and dined with the TzHaar under the volcano of Karamja.
Well, I, er, just want it.
Well, I...
Well, I... Err... Have come a long way to be here, Sir and... Err... Oh, who am I kidding. I've never defeated a criminal. I couldn't even tell my dad to his face that I was leaving home.

Well, King Arthur's statue wouldn't be trusted to mere guards. Only fully-fledged Black Knights will guard it. So you'll need to disguise yourself as one of them if you want to get access to the statue.
Well, King Narnode tells me you've already visited him...
Well, Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. Perhaps he can shed some light on all of this. He's downstairs.
Well, Miscellanian soldiers came and asked for tribute.
Well, Murphy used to bring in Giant Crabs occasionally. He hasn't had any of them in for a while though.
Well, My Arm know 'bout goutweed farming.
Well, Ned's an old hand when it comes to crafting, and with two extra pairs of hands it just flew right by.
Well, OK.
Well, Ok then. We need to get this organised. First off, we need to get some proper cages to get them chickens transported. I've never normally transported chickens in such large quantities before.
Well, Ok, I'm going to need a pigeon cage to convert it, plus some money for my time, say [a 100 gold/100 gold per cage]?
Well, Peter Potter's Patented Multi Purpose Poison is a product of such obvious quality that I am glad to say I managed to sell a bottle to each of the Sinclairs!
Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
Well, Radimus Erkle is the Grand Vizier of the Legends Guild. He's a very busy man. And he'll only talk to those people eligible for the quest.
Well, Santa left me a message that Diango has the key to his grotto, so firstly, please fetch the key, then we can see what kind of job awaits us.
Well, Sir Vyvin is a good guy to work for, however, I'm in a spot of trouble today. I've gone and lost Sir Vyvin's sword!
Well, Slayer Masters sell these highly volatile potions for killing underwater creatures.
Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
Well, Ye shove them in the Pressure Barrel in the attic.
Well, Zemouregal the Mahjarrat sent his zombie army against Varrock. However, we figured out how to stop him.

Well, [Fremennik name], that's why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you'll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
Well, [Vampyre name], welcome to the essence mine.
Well, [player name], how did it go?
Well, [player name], welcome to the essence mine.
Well, [player name], what can we do for you?
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: Well, [player name], what is Viero's request?
Well, [player name], whether you believe it or not, know that none of my men will be going on this expedition unless you can ensure our safety from the curse.
Well, [player name], you certainly seem to have had a very close call. Thanks for letting me know all of this. It's all highly interesting.
Well, [player name], you've been a great help in making my wish a reality. Let me reward you. I hope you like pumpkins, because I have a lot of those going spare.
Well, [vampyre name], you're wrong. No one can go in the Arboretum, by order of the Drakan family themselves.
Well, a 'Dirty Blast' is a freshly made Fruit Blast, but then for some reason you add ash at the end!
Well, a fine adventurer such as yourself would be a perfect candidate as a deputy in my eyes, but fortunately this can only be done in a time of crisis, and all is currently well.
Well, a friend of mine did show me a spell once. I'll see if I can remember it, but I'm making no promises...
Well, a ghost called Kharrim directed me towards you.
Well, a lot of us dismissed her as a myth, but there be plenty of superstitious folk here who were keen to make sure the tributes continued.
Well, a most productive trip on all accounts!
Well, a standard Black dragon has one, the King has three so inbetween must have two?
Well, a top-notch fellow like yourself is just the right sort we've been seeking for our organisation.
Well, a while back I was out in the field observing penguins. I worked for the Ardougne Zoo then. I was just quietly observing them when suddenly there was an avalanche.
Well, actually I hid it in his bed so it would nip him. It was a bit of a surprise gift.
Well, actually I just sort of washed up here.
Well, actually I would like to know what happened to you to turn you into an invisible ghost.
Well, actually my name is Ranulph, not funny man...
Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
Well, actually, I was a monkey for a bit.
Well, actually, I've lost it, could I have another one please?
Well, actually, if you don't mind... question then.
Well, actually, it wasn't a spirit at all - it was Nezikchened!
Well, actually, now that you mention it...it would be a real help to us if you could organise some chickens in exchange for young Jimmy's release.
Well, adventurer, do you have the treasure yet?
Well, adventurer, it seems I owe you an apology.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Well, adventurer, this report has given me quite a bit to consider. I can certainly say you've more than earned this bait.
Well, adventuring's thirsty work as well.

Well, after I climbed out the vent, I snuck aboard a passing trade ship that dropped me at Catherby. From there, I returned to Camelot and used the Sinclairs own secret entrance against them. I used some of my
Well, after I got the invite to this party, I thought for a bit, and I realised that I would like a dog, but if I was going to get a dog, I needed to make sure I could take care of it.
Well, after [player name] here was ambushed outside the temple a while back, Ivan and I decided to keep a closer eye on things.
Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.
Well, after bringing me my favorite food I guess I should give it a go. What sort of sword is it?
Well, after joining the Barracudas, I discovered a fascination for different cultures. This is just a small step in my personal journey to understand more about the world!
Well, after that cake it probably doesn't matter. As long as they keep baking from now on.
Well, after the poor man passed on...
Well, after this year, when I've amazed my niece and nephew with the best Halloween treat ever, no-one will call me boring again! But I need these chambers to be more atmospheric first.
Well, after you've gone and accepted a task or two, you'll want to keep your captain's log handy. It's good for keeping tabs on what jobs you're currently grafting away at.
Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.
Well, ain't that the question on everyone's mind, sailor? But to answer, it depends on what materials you'll be wanting.
Well, all I can say is that I am from a small, cloistered order of monks from a tiny island nearby, and that we have a problem with undead pirates...
Well, all good captains need to have a strong understanding of the weather out at sea. However, it requires a fair bit of skill to do it well. I'd suggest you wait until you're more experienced.
Well, all great plans start with knowledge. Let me bring you up to speed with the situation. What do you want to know?
Well, all the drinks are behind the bar, not back here in the kitchen.
Well, all's well that ends well.
Well, always happy to help another budding farmer out!
Well, an adventurer like you may find them very useful in battle. They can make you stronger, letting you defeat powerful enemies with ease.
Well, another Asgarnian Ale would be greatly appreciated. And stop calling me Boss.
Well, any time you need black market yak produce, you know where to come.
Well, anyway, I used a fusion of various drinks from all around the world to create the greatest cocktail ever made!
Well, anyway, we need to get some wool. I think three pieces would be enough.
Well, anyway...
Well, apart from the fact I ain't scared of no ghost, I am here because I have spoken to Valdez.
Well, apparently after you have done the above then by adding ashes you create a unique new drink.
Well, apparently he slipped away in the middle of the feast, so my guess is he was up to something when he did that.
Well, are you ready to set off again? Let me know and I'll get the crew to take another dose of this potion of sealegs.
Well, around Christmas we tend to focus more on giving rather than receiving. We call it the gift of giving.
Well, arrangements have now been made to allow outsiders like yourself to enter Varlamore. However, this is an inhospitable route into the kingdom. I'd suggest you find an alternate way to travel.
Well, as Captain I have certain responsibilities that must be fulfilled, so I would greatly appreciate a little assistance in tracking down this jinx...

Well, as I have mentioned, I am from an island called Jatizso, while my wife is from another island called Neitiznot. Neitiznot is a far less sophisticated and successful island which will not see reason with Jatizso.

Well, as I headed on me merry way, hoping the foul odours that lingered in me nostrils would soon pass, I see in front of me this explorer fella, all decked out in in his fine clothing, and carrying some long package
Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
Well, as I say, the king sent me to make sure everything's okay with you.
Well, as I say, you should talk to him about that. Knowing the little runt as I do though He'll probably do it for the cash.
Well, as I were saying, young [lad/lass], I be in a spot of bother, and I thought ye might be able to help.

Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.

Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best you can get - if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 5 ectotokens. Coins are of no use to me.
Well, as a matter of fact, I picked up an interesting book on one of my travels, from a quite out of the way dwarven outpost.
Well, as a matter of fact, I will not have to organise anything, there is a particularly vicious and dangerous criminal currently at loose!
Well, as a travelling merchant I have roamed these lands for many years...
Well, as if it's any of your business, I'm an associate of Hammerspike. He's a great dwarf you know. You could learn a lot from a dwarf like him.
Well, as in line as we reckon they need to be.
Well, as it happens I've been practicing making rings recently! Why?
Well, as it turns out, I have yet to manage to grow a beard. Not for fault of trying, you know. I hear some people try their whole life and still can't.
Well, as it turns out, Mudfoot here is actually trying to deal with the thieves as well.
Well, as long as I can keep myself safe first!
Well, as long as he hasn't caught anything from that evil chicken.
Well, as long as it's not just me.
Well, as much as I'd like to toss them into the dirt and all, I think it's best if you came back later with an empty backpack.
Well, as much as it saddens me to say so adventurer, Lord Saradomin's presence has not been felt on the land for many years now.
Well, as much as this is an interestin' break, why don't ye head back to the ship and we'll see if we can beat them this time?
Well, as official Fremennik bard, it falls within my remit to compose all music for the tribe. I am fully versed in all the various types of romantic music.
Well, as qualified as you undoubtedly are, I believe we're going to need a truly expert adventurer if the Colony is to stand a chance.
Well, as quick as you can then.
Well, as soon as they're ready to display it again, they can have it back!
Well, as the name suggests, mate, it's all about salvaging old shipwrecks from the sea. Keeps the place nice and tidy, and allows you to snag some swag from those that don't need it anymore.
Well, as the name suggests, trawler's trust is the drink you want if you're planning to head out trawling. It's said to improve both your sailing and fishing abilities.
Well, as the official sponsored drink of Castle Wars it might be worth looking around there.
Well, as they say, it's always sunny in Gielinor.
Well, as those fiends pointed out to me with delight, as I am the descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it will likely recognise the smell of my blood.
Well, as we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
Well, as you can see we have recently expanded a great deal to cope with the influx of finds from the Dig Site. Also, of course, to prepare for the new dig we're opening soon.
Well, as you helped me I suppose I could. We'll have to be careful. If I get caught I'll be in the cage!
Well, as you keep pointing out, there's a high chance of us dying here, so we might not get another chance.
Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.
Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!
Well, ask what you want to know then.
Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
Well, at least I got him to agree to ship the crate for me.
Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!
Well, at least give me the map like you promised!
Well, at least he died doing what he loved.
Well, at least sailing still lets you enjoy the sea when you're not surfing.
Well, at least that's that as sorted as it can be.
Well, at least we're makin' the best o' a bad job.
Well, at least you're alive.
Well, at some point I hope to be hiring a crew of my own. When that happens, you seem like you have all the... qualifications... needed to join.
Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself, but I'm not really ready for that yet.
Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself. I don't think I'm ready for that kind of thing yet though.
Well, at some point I hope to hire a crew to sail with myself. Maybe you'd be interested in joining me once I'm ready for that sort of thing?
Well, at some point I plan to hire a crew of my own. I'm not ready for that sort of thing yet, but when I am, maybe you'd be interested?
Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
Well, at the very least you succeeded at keeping the vampyres out of the Sepulchre. From what I have seen, none of them have been able to enter.
Well, aye, but it's the 9th year since we decided to start countin' here!
Well, back in my day there was a lot more freedom and less bureaucracy about what adventurers were assigned to slay... as long as it was in need of slaying.
Well, back to work!
Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
Well, bad luck old [boy/gal/bean], you'll need to have a completely empty inventory and you can't be wearing any equipment before we can accurately test you.
Well, basically, you are stretched so thinly between dimensions that you effectively become invisible!
Well, be very careful out there! Those dratted slugs have been joined by giant lobsters!
Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.
Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe. Her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
Well, before all this I was a Judge in a very prestigious court.
Well, before you hand them over to me, as you have been nothing but truthful with me to this point, and I admire that in an adventurer, I will let you into the secret of our research.
Well, before you were simply reanimating the person within the rock. This time you need to unravel Morgan Le Faye's spell first.
Well, being a Slayer Master was already a form of retirement, but I reckon it might finally be time for me to leave that behind as well.
Well, being an attorney was an interesting experience.
Well, being so close to the shore, Rellekka provides a lot of seaweed alongside my sand.
Well, being the Teokan of Ralos, I do have the odd moment of wisdom from time to time. Now, I must get back to my work. Timoiva, my child, and may the sun light your way.

Well, below the very ground you stand upon lies an intricate network of tunnels that make up the abandoned Mort Ridge mines. These mines used to be a valuable resource to the inhabitants of Morytania.
Well, best of luck with that.
Well, best we get a move on then.
Well, best you get back to it then. This is a matter of national security and if I find out we are vulnerable I will hold you personally responsible!
Well, between you and me, Gordon is a good farmer but I wouldn't say he's a genius by any means. He also doesn't actually know what the beast looks like.
Well, between you and me, I'm not much of a witch. I'm much more into potions and herblore.
Well, blame whoever decided they should have the same spelling then.
Well, board the boat and let me take you there again quickly, before Zulrah becomes impatient!
Well, bring it here and let's take a look at it!
Well, business hasn't been doing great lately. Years ago there wasn't a person who didn't know of Zeke and his amazing scimitars!
Well, by helping us you'll become more recognized and as that happens we can offer you many benefits.
Well, by the sounds of it you said it's a tournament format right?
Well, can I at least have a look inside the tower?
Well, can I get a job here?
Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.
Well, can you he-
Well, can you teach me?
Well, can't argue with that! I'll return when I'm done!
Well, can't say I blame you compadre. I used to be a city boy myself, but have to admit it's a lot nicer living here nowadays. Brimhaven's certainly good for it.
Well, can't you just do my favour and forget about theirs?
Well, can't you just give me some chickens?
Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!
Well, clearly it slipped my mind.
Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.
Well, come and see me if you're ever in need of armour!
Well, come back and see me when you do.
Well, come back if you change your mind any time. I owe you for your trouble.
Well, come back if you change your mind.
Well, come back if you need any help with it, we may be able to work something out.
Well, come back when you can.
Well, come back when you do have some money!
Well, come back when you do.
Well, come back when you have one.
Well, come back when you have.
Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.
Well, come see me if ye ever do.
Well, come to me when you have it.
Well, congratulations I guess...
Well, considering I told you she was a seer, of sorts, I would imagine you would find her in Seers' Village. It is to the south of here, not far.
Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.

Well, dearie, I'm probably not the best person to ask about money, but I think the best thing would be for you to get a good trade. If you've got a trade you can earn your way, that's what my old father told me,
Well, desperate times...
Well, despite their age, they're actually of a remarkably similar design to the ones used by modern wizards. Isn't that amazing?
Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.
Well, did the stuff belong to you?
Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
Well, do get a move on! I need 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes, otherwise I'll be no use in a fight.
Well, do you know anything about poisons?
Well, do you know someone who does have a month's supply?
Well, do you know the VAGUE AREA you lost it in?
Well, do you know the VAGUE AREA you lost it?
Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?
Well, do you remember scoring out the names in the first place?
Well, do you want vengeance?
Well, don't be afraid to come back any time!
Well, don't expect your iron oxide any time soon then!
Well, don't forget that you can block the opposition whilst a team mate has the ball. Very useful if you want to stop or slow down anyone approaching him.
Well, don't forget that you'll be needing that book to do so. I'm sure Allanna over at the Farming Guild will have a copy.
Well, don't get any funny ideas! You promised you'd never cook another human if I helped My Arm grow goutweed.
Well, don't give up adventurer! The key must be nearby. Most likely the leader of those Zamorakians has it. I believe he's the one in the hood.
Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
Well, don't keep me waiting! I must hear what they think.
Well, don't take too long. This work won't do itself, will it?
Well, don't tell Mistag...
Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.
Well, due to a blow to the head he took in the fight, the surgeon cast that spell, thinking it was some sort of new healing spell.
Well, ehm... nice to meet you, Veldaban.
Well, either I'm going crazy, or theres been an intruder in Jones' room upstairs!
Well, either way, you seem perfect for me! I can't offer much, but I can promise we're gonna have the best adventures together!
Well, er sort of. I got to his camp and I encountered a spirit of some kind. I don't think it was a Ghast, it tried to communicate with me, but made no sense, it was all 'ooooh' this and 'oooh' that.
Well, er, I wouldn't have said it quite that way...
Well, er, she is dead.
Well, er...
Well, er... erm, I err....
Well, er... pleased to meet you, Zanik.
Well, erm...
Well, erm... you know.
Well, err....well, actually yes I do mind...it's my place and I don't want strangers going through my things.
Well, err...who are you, and what are all these bones doing here?
Well, everybody needs a hobby.
Well, everything was going to plan at the museum, the specialist examined the artifact and explained that it was actually part of an ancient and powerful, much larger stone.
Well, except for Fancy Dan, but that be another story.
Well, fair enough, but it's just one sandwich. He's not even in Varrock anymore. He's moved off to Edgeville.
Well, fair enough. If your passion for milk changes, let me know.
Well, feel free to come back if you change your mind.
Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [Fremennik name]. You are always welcome here!
Well, feel free to take your time. I need to gather some more ingredients for the final product.
Well, feel free to talk to me should you come across anything you can't figure out.
Well, fine!
Well, fine! Celebrate if you wish, but I will not leave my son behind!
Well, fire away and I'll give you an insight into the exciting world of animals.
Well, first I came to this city just for the adventure and excitement, but then I knocked over this statue, you see. Well, I didn't really knock it over myself, I was on this boat.
Well, first of all you are going to need an instrument. Like all true bards you are going to have to make this yourself.
Well, first of all, we need someone to go out the front and grow us some Blindweed.
Well, first things first, you need a pair of shears. I've got some here you can use.
Well, first up there's the normal bone club and bone spear. Good, solid frog-bone, and the spear has an iron tip. Can withstand a lot of punishment, if you know what I mean!
Well, first up, there are three types of combat: melee, ranged and magic. Melee uses close up weapons like swords and warhammers, whereas ranged uses things like bows, crossbows or throwing knives.
Well, first we have to... oh dear, that can't be right! Apparently we have to recharge the lead reindeer's nose?
Well, first you'll need to annoy it somehow. You'll need to have an axe with you when you do that, as you'll need it to attack the roots.
Well, firstly there were the monsters.
Well, firstly you must enter my house with no items, weapons or armour. Then it is a simple matter of entering through one door and leaving by the other.
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
Well, firstly you'll need to do a bit of work around the museum, then maybe we can talk.
Well, for Halloween last year, I was invited to a costume party.
Well, for a start off, come and see me when you don't have that thing on your head.
Well, for a start, undead feathers are much cleaner than living ones; no dust mites or anything. Secondly, I always think of Ernest when I see a chicken, so my nerves can't take killing them.
Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
Well, for it to have got caught in his teleport, it must be a place where there are many around...
Well, for the Window Tax, only those who use a building.
Well, for your sake I hope you're right. Killing people is such a chore.
Well, forge ahead then.
Well, friend, I'm Arls Lutwidge of the Moonlight Broadsword! Renowned all over Gielinor!
Well, from the smell I'd guess cooking some vile concoction.
Well, from what a neighbour overheard, the killer was likely known to the victim.
Well, frrriend, I take it you have-
Well, fruit and grain mostly. I try to give them a balanced diet, but their favourite treat is pineapple chunks.
Well, fun as that would be, I was wondering if you could help us get our brains back into the right bodies.
Well, get a mooooooooooove on.
Well, get a move on!
Well, get a move-on.
Well, get back to me when you have.
Well, get out of here then.
Well, get some more! Have a little initiative, would you?
Well, getting to Ape Atoll is quite a pain. Do you have a way of making it easier to get there?
Well, given we're almost certainly dead anyway, I don't see how it matters anymore.
Well, given you paid up, I guess I can remind you. The Phoenix Gang can be found east of here. Take the southern alley past the Blue Moon Inn and look for a building owned by the VTAM corporation.
Well, given you'd been gone for a while, I thought I'd best come make sure my brother hadn't found you.
Well, go ahead and wear your helmet! Won't protect your head if it's not on your head!
Well, go get a new one. And throw that... thing... away!
Well, go get it sailor! Heave to!
Well, go see if the zoo have one.
Well, good day traveller. And always do the right thing.
Well, good for him, never did like humans anyway.
Well, good job I found it again. Here you go. Take it to your Z.M.I. friend in Varrock. Hopefully he can tell us where it came from.
Well, good luck finding her.
Well, good luck getting a word in with that blacksmith!
Well, good luck then.
Well, good luck with it all.
Well, good luck with it.
Well, good luck with it. Oh, and try not to cause any problems that might affect us while you do so. The dwarves around here don't need a new reason to hate your kind.
Well, good luck with that!
Well, good luck with that.

Well, good luck with that...they're quite tricky to find.

Well, good luck with your business.
Well, good luck.

Well, great...
Well, hand it here then.

Well, have a careful look around at everything in the next cave and come back and tell me what you find.

Well, have a nice day.
Well, have fun, and don't forget to take your medication!
Well, have ye?
Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
Well, have you never noticed how well ghouls and demons get on?
Well, have you offered to take a drink order yet?
Well, have you?

Well, he actually got attacked on his way over here.
Well, he also got angry and filled my house with coal.
Well, he clearly just doesn't like poetry.

Well, he did...

Well, he give me mighty sore tummy later. I think I forget to wash his feet.
Well, he has his occasional quirks. In this case it means that when you enter this dimension you will be 'skulled' and your prayer will be drained.
Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.

Well, he occasionally delivers meat to clients if they are too far away to come and get it themselves. If I were inside a crate of meat then he'd be unable to smell me and you'd be able to get me past.
Well, he passes back to you and you've made an advantage. It's useful in a variety of situations!
Well, he presumably has a name, but that's what he's called now.
Well, he seems happy with that!
Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
Well, he told me it was his last one too, so I figured I'd give it a try.
Well, he wanted me to do something about it.
Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
Well, he wants to know if he can organise a glider ride down there.
Well, he was a great chef, and also my ancestor.
Well, he was one of the few who had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar. He also had access to the rat poison.
Well, he went and got himself killed by the Myreque. Vanstrom owed me a favour so he agreed to let me have his wife and child.
Well, he's alive, but otherwise, not great. He doesn't seem to remember anything.
Well, he's around here somewhere, just use your eyes, I'm sure you'll get there one day.
Well, he's clearly a busy man.
Well, he's dead!

texto: Well, he's down in the caves at the north of this island, and I need your help.
Well, he's drunk isn't he?
Well, he's taking a holiday.
Well, he's the only one who can grant you the right to wear rune platemail. He lives in a hut, by the cliffs west of Edgeville.
Well, head south to that bandit camp. I bet if there's anything out here, they'll know about it.
Well, hello adventurer! How are you?
Well, hello again Traveller! How are you?
Well, hello again m'hearty. How're yer fare?
Well, hello again, [player name]. What brings you back out here?
Well, hello again, and thanks for helping out the professor.
Well, hello again. Congratulations on your finds.

Well, hello there...
Well, hello to you too!
Well, hello traveller. I still can't understand why they would lie about the plague.
Well, hello! You must be [player name]? Sir Tiffy told me to expect you to call in on this frequency!
Well, help me come up with a plan to get you out of here. They don't seem very open minded about this whole situation.
Well, here I am... at the drunken dwarf's relative's residence, who is also drunken. I wonder what drunken tales he can tell me.
Well, here we are! Lots of pumpkins to look at!
Well, here we are! Welcome to Fortis!
Well, here we are. Likely going to our doom.
Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks. 0--> 100-->
Well, here's the sled but it will need to be waxed. The wax will need to both protect the sled as well as smoothen it.
Well, here's your chance!
Well, here, I happened to have a copy of it. Try not to lose it this time!
Well, his lair is very close to here. I suggest you look around for it.
Well, hopefully that doesn't have to be the case for much longer.
Well, hopefully they hid themselves. I need to make contact with the Myreque.
Well, hopefully, I'll be right back, but you never know, it might take longer!
Well, how about I become a member of your gang in return?
Well, how about we use the portal that Drakan's already made then?
Well, how can I help?
Well, how do you plan on doing that?

Well, hurry off then. You are of no use to me.
Well, hurry up and give it to her then!
Well, hurry up!
Well, if I find anything interesting I'll try and bring it back to the King. That might include animals, I suppose. I'd rather not kill it, though - most animals are more useful alive.
Well, if I keep following the trail, maybe I'll find out.

Well, if I were them, I would learn as much as I can about the Sinclair family history.

Well, if Safalaan wants to work with Vanescula, then he has my support.
Well, if Veliaf is here, someone must have seen him. We should ask around, and I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.
Well, if anyone asks... I'm dead!
Well, if he thinks the folk of Neitiznot can be intimidated by his threats, he best be ready to accept defeat.
Well, if it ain't the wannabe builder!
Well, if it is, that must mean you must kill it! Simple!
Well, if it isn't our very own sledder! What can I do for you today?
Well, if it needs a home.
Well, if it wasn't for me you would never have reached this place.

Well, if it wasn't for me, you might never have found the Myreque. On one hand, that might mean they'd not have ended up getting killed, but on the other, the Drakans might never have been overthrown.
Well, if it's sacred water you want, you'd do well to have a look around here.
Well, if memory serves me correctly, I think the hostilities began when they robbed one of our camels. A heinous crime.
Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
Well, if my father had had something to occupy him, he wouldn't have gotten bored and decided to argue with Queen Sigrid again.
Well, if nothing else, I suppose the odd blunder will keep you guessing.
Well, if she did it wasn't recently. We'd have noticed a councillor.
Well, if that does happen, there are other ways to defend yourselves.
Well, if the Knights of the Round Table can't manage it, I can't see how a commoner like you could succeed where we have failed.
Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.
Well, if there were, the dogs would have gotten to them already.
Well, if there's anything I can do to help with that, just let me know.
Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.
Well, if this isn't quite the swing in power.
Well, if this plan works out you will be able too, right?

Well, if trawlin's not yer style, laddie, ye' can always cast a rod o'er the side o' the boat and pray they be nibblin', but it's less effective than nets are an' it burns through yer' supply o' bait.
Well, if we increase the flux via some bigonometry we should be able to create a dipolar ordnance grabber, or D.O.G., to fetch your balls.
Well, if ya change your mind, I'll be right here.
Well, if ya change your mind, I'm gonna be here waiting for a drink, buddy!

Well, if yer gets any mole skin or mole claws off 'un, I'd trade 'em for bird nests if ye brings 'em here to me.
Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
Well, if yer want ye can hunt some more o' the birds an' wasps here. If ya don't fancy that, I 'eard lots o' funny coloured birds 'ave popped up recently in places not too far from 'ere.
Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
Well, if you INSIST.
Well, if you are carrying anything in there, then it might get damaged. Burned up, that kind of thing.
Well, if you are, do it in a bucket. This is a sterile environment, after all.
Well, if you are, you've come to the right plaice.
Well, if you bring me a Trouver Parchment and some coins, I can enchant some items so they won't disappear if you end up losing them deep in the Wilderness.
Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.
Well, if you can't be bothered then neither can I.
Well, if you cannot satisfy yourself in helping the event, perhaps you could satisfy yourself by partaking in it instead?
Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.
Well, if you come across some more, come find me again.
Well, if you could start learning how to open this cage that would be appreciated. I've got a job to do.
Well, if you do ever find yourself in need of the finest Hunter equipment available, then you know where to come.
Well, if you don't know the basics at all it'll take a long time to teach you...
Well, if you don't mind then, I'm busy and have to get back to work.
Well, if you ever fancy heading up there and killing more of those creatures, you won't find me complaining. Apart from that though, I think you've done all you can.
Well, if you ever find yourself in need of that innovative edge, you can always find me here.
Well, if you ever need rope that's the price. Sorry. An old sailor needs money for a little drop o' rum.
Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.
Well, if you get some, you know where to come.
Well, if you go to see the Shaman, please give him that Wampum belt I gave to you, it will give him more details about our situation down here.
Well, if you have an axe I'm sure when it swallows you, you'll be able to make short work of its roots.
Well, if you have some air runes and mind runes you can cast Wind Strike...
Well, if you have spoken to Rennard, then you will know that he had somehow managed to obtain a very valuable weapon, and was looking for buyers.
Well, if you have to know, we're making sure that no prisoners get out. -- The guard gives you a disapproving look. -- And to make sure that unauthorised people don't get in.
Well, if you haven't already, you should speak to Kellan in the pub. He knows everything there is to know about deep sea trawling.
Well, if you know who or what they are, you should go and see them, Solus must be nearby!
Well, if you look around for book called The Shield of Arrav, you'll find a quest in there.
Well, if you must know, I'm working all the hours that Saradomin sends, I have to in order to make enough money to pay that loan shark Hammerspike!
Well, if you pop over to a bank and leave all your heavy equipment behind then I'll take you out.
Well, if you really want my advice...
Well, if you see anyone who is, please send them my way.
Well, if you think it will do any good ... here goes then-
Well, if you think it will help I can tell you everything I remember about the feast...?
Well, if you think you stand a chance, sure. But remember, if he gives us an order, we have to obey.
Well, if you use a pestle and mortar on a raw cod that will grind it up nicely.
Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
Well, if you want to try getting something out of her, be my guest.
Well, if you wanted inspiration, you shouldn't have come up with a suicide mission. Now let's go.
Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.

Well, if you were to get me the other half of the shield, I could give you the other half of the reward certificate. It's rumoured to be in the possession of the infamous Blackarm Gang, beyond that I can't help you.
Well, if you'd like, I can make it so you respawn in our Enclave. It'll put you right in the heart of all the chaos that surrounds us.
Well, if you'd like, I know a few fire spells to warm you back up...
Well, if you're bored, you could do me a small favour and nip to see the jungle forester. I need a piece of red mahogany to resurface an antique wardrobe.
Well, if you're feeling brave, we've had one of the villagers, Keenan, go missing. We know he's not much of a sailor, so he'll be somewhere on the island.
Well, if you're in need of help, I'm open to contributing.
Well, if you're sure then.
Well, if you're sure! How do we do this then? What's the plan?
Well, if you're sure. You know where to come if you do!
Well, if you've kept to the recipe eggzactly, it wouldn't be empty now, would it.
Well, iknami, as luck would have it, someone came along trying to sell a sword that perfectly matches the one I gave you. He claimed he just found it on the ground!
Well, imagine that. You two must have a great bond. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two after all.
Well, in a day we've gone from wonderin' if the Mad Angel is even real, to learnin' she was, but that she's now gone an' left for good. I s'pose that makes it a new era for us 'ere.
Well, in a lot of these tales, it's only ever reffered to as someone's sword. Like, [player name]'s sword.
Well, in all honesty, you didn't actually retrieve it yourself, did you? You don't qualify as a master thief unless you actually steal it yourself, you know...
Well, in general you'll find that practice makes perfect. The best way to improve a skill is to quite simply keep working at it.
Well, in my considered opinion it must be David. The man is nothing more than a bully And I happen to know that poor Lord Sinclair and David had a massive argument in the living
Well, in my life I was nothing but a warrior. I had no hidden knowledge, I didn't especially care about the gods or their magics, and I certainly didn't respect them.
Well, in order to tell my crew from San Fan's I will need to give you a hat like mine.
Well, in simple terms, we're better! Any fool with a sword can manage to get into the White Knights, which is mostly the reason they are so very, very incompetent, what?
Well, in that case, I think I'll give it a miss.
Well, in that case, I think it may have something to do with Slayer abilities. After all, I did see [Turael/Aya] poking around the trees while I was moving in.
Well, in that case, I think you'll need to help your egg without me.
Well, in that case, I wish you good luck.
Well, in that case, any idea where I might get one, preferably free of charge?
Well, in that case, enjoy!
Well, in that case, it's only right that you both be rewarded. I will grant half of the reward to you and half to your companion. That means 600 coins for you. Enjoy it! You've very much earned it!
Well, in that case, what's not to trust. What challenges do you have available for me?
Well, in that case, you definitely do need to know the recipe.
Well, in that case, you should get stuck right in.
Well, in their conversations, it was revealed why they caused the new Sleeper Plague. Apparently, they did it to make it easier to take blood tithes.
Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
Well, in truth, I'm not really sure. I think you've managed to reach a point where my advice isn't really going to be useful any more. I'd say it's all on you now.
Well, indeed. I have also found though he was generally disliked by other gnomes - his moniker was 'Glouphrie the Untrusted'.
Well, individually they aren't that hard to do. The fires are always swapping between on and off. I think that if you run to where the fire just was you should be safe.

Well, is it ready?
Well, is there anything I can do for you?
Well, is there anything I can help you with, [player name]?
Well, isn't that here?
Well, it all seems to have gone smoothly so far!
Well, it all started after I freed Elena from West Ardougne. As you can imagine, she was still keen on helping the plague victims and asked me to help her find a cure.
Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby, funnily enough.
Well, it all starts with this albatross...
Well, it all starts with you buildin' a good ol' trawlin' net on yer boat. Rope will do, but linen, hemp and cotton are preferred. The better ye' net, the deeper ye'll be able t' lower it.
Well, it beats crawling around on the surface with nothing above your head!
Well, it can't be helped I suppose...
Well, it certainly makes for an interesting material, I can imagine it being used for all sorts in the future...
Well, it certainly will help!
Well, it certainly will help... -- The guard takes the five gold coins. -- Now then, what did you want to know?
Well, it commenced when I was merely a youth, and has proceeded uninterrupted ever since.
Well, it didn't go far - I found it in here. Take better care of it next time.
Well, it does take a special kind of camel to master the portal magic used for bank access.
Well, it is a competition, but I'd like to see someone win, and that isn't going to be me.
Well, it is a long and drawn-out process. Just east of this village there is an unusually musical tree that can be used to make very high quality instruments.
Well, it is a long story from the past... Many years ago, this Wizards' Tower was a focus of great learning, as we mages studied together to try and learn the secrets behind
Well, it is a lot easier to go this way to get past White Wolf Mountain than through those wolf filled passes.
Well, it is an amulet of duplication! It would be stupid not to have duplicates.
Well, it is appropriate, all things considered...
Well, it is my job as Duke to help oversee and manage the people of Lumbridge. Among them is an organisation known as H.A.M. which stands for 'Humans Against Monsters'.
Well, it is my job as Duke to help oversee and manage the people of Lumbridge. Among them is the H.A.M organisation which I believe you're familiar with already.
Well, it is nice to see you again. I hope you enjoy your time outside of Tirannwn.
Well, it is not quite as simple as that may sound.
Well, it is rather... Rather...
Well, it is relieving to know that my life is no longer in danger, but there is no shortage of work to be done.
Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
Well, it is.
Well, it isn't all bad. I did manage to kill the Prince.
Well, it just so happens that I have a lyre with me right here!

Well, often the best historians are the town gossips. I'd start there. Good luck, brave adventurer!
Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.
Well, oi s'pose oi've got 10 minutes to spare.
Well, ok then.
Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!
Well, okay then - 1250GP it is.
Well, okay then.
Well, okay then. Anyway, south of this encampment there is an area where few have ever been... It is a village of murderous bandits, and treacherous
Well, okay then. I'll have to find someone else.
Well, okay, but please don't lose this one.
Well, okay, but very quickly. I am a very busy person you know!
Well, okay. Can't say as I blame you for thinking that. I'll go take it there myself later I guess.
Well, okay...but could I have a little of that food first? I've had nothing but seaweed and biscuits for the past week.
Well, old Neddy is always here if you do. Tell your friends. I can always be using the business.
Well, on my way over to the hopper some big boy stole the bucket and ran away...
Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
Well, on that note, just one left to go. What do you know about the last thief?
Well, on the plus side, there was plenty of water to clean my clothing with afterwards...
Well, once it's finished, we can see about sorting out Wumty Scrumpty.
Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
Well, one of the best... A lot be liking the Pandemonium these days, and Brimhaven does have that fancy Agility Arena...
Well, one of the people who went missing was the local fletcher. In his absence, our already light supply of longbows has become even lighter.
Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.
Well, one side of the sigil is shaped like a basilisk. Spines down its back, and maw wide like a gate.
Well, only a little. The followers of Guthix make all sorts of wild claims where he is involved. Those of us who serve Saradomin know that these claims are mostly baseless.
Well, our legends say that on the surface there was a substance called 'wood', which grew out of the ground in towers.
Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!
Well, over the years, while out mapping the world, I have amassed a collection of.... rare and valuable items.
Well, oym goona pass owt now. Have one on me!

Well, pay me 100 Gold and I'll see if any rusty swords that you've found are actually worth anything. Some of them might be worth some money! If it's an antique item though, I reserve the right to purchase it
Well, people have been asking me for monkey skins all day!
Well, people tell me I have an honest face!
Well, people tell me I have an honest face.

Well, people will be able to visit this area, once construction has finished, by using the most advanced network of glider routes in the whole of Gielinor... in fact, the only network of glider routes!
Well, perhaps I can try a little harder. Guards, kill this infidel.
Well, perhaps a bit... but it's never stopped you doing things for me before.
Well, perhaps a little. It's nice of you to say so in any case though. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?
Well, perhaps it's not, but it's my way. If you want my vote at the council, I'm afraid you're going to have to drink me under the table.
Well, perhaps next time you'll ask a more direct question.
Well, perhaps you felt a murder mystery would have helped make this party interesting and memorable.
Well, perhaps. You should speak to Alec the Guildmaster, he sorts out that kind of thing. You'll find him up on a small island north of the guild.
Well, play the music that's on the sheet and that should do the trick.
Well, please bring it to me when you can. I'd be very interested to hear what they have to say.
Well, please do so as soon as possible. Remember: to get to Varrock, head due North, through Draynor Village, around Draynor Manor, and then head East when
Well, please don't be upset or anything... But you're the ghost!
Well, please return if you change your mind.
Well, possibly, but could I go to Mos Le'Harmless instead?
Well, probably best you work on that, given we'll surely soon be dead without it.
Well, probably not, to be honest.
Well, quite a few of us are working on making the town a bit nicer. Not that there's anything wrong with the work you did of course.
Well, quite simply, I wish to bring the kebab to Varlamore. Everyone here deserves a chance to taste their brilliance!

Well, recently we found a rather interesting island to the north of Morytania. We believe that it may be of archaeological significance. I suspect we'll be looking for qualified archaeologists once we have constructed our
Well, regardless of what it is, I do think it might be the one.
Well, regardless, I'm sure a bold, brave adventurer such as yourself won't have any problems.
Well, regardless, everything seems to be ready for you to call Rufus.
Well, regardless, you've more than earned this map. It was the last one my grandfather, Sven the Helmsman, ever made.
Well, reminding Carol of the past and improving her present didn't work... we need to convince her the future will be better if she changes her ways.
Well, run along and fetch it then.
Well, run along then. Don't forget to take his staff so you can kill that thingummywut!
Well, s'pose it ain't like ye' can get me killed again!
Well, see you around Tiffy.
Well, see, it's like this.
Well, see... the Consortium has commisioned me to rebuild the statue exactly the way it was.
Well, seeing as you are so devout in praising the gods, I could sell you a Skillcape of Prayer, which increases the amount of Prayer points restored when drinking potions.
Well, seeing as you haven't claimed a key yet, I reckon you've claimed a total of 0gp worth of loot.
Well, seeing as you put it so nicely...
Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
Well, seeing as you're hunting them, I thought you'd eat them too.
Well, she can't have gone too far. Perhaps you should ask if anyone has seen her around town.
Well, she does have an awful lot of cows to milk, I wonder if someone around town can help with this. Bob seems to have a lot of work cut out...
Well, she had access to the secret passage. She claimed not to know about it, but she did know about the history of the villa. She also had access to the rat poison.
Well, she hasn't killed us yet, which I consider a win. It seems she spoke the truth about wanting her brother dead.
Well, she sets a good example. You should probably be heading on in yourself.
Well, she started leaping about and pointing to Ardougne, shouting something about betrayal. She was really angry.

Well, she told me that she was working as an undercover agent of Saradomin amongst the followers of some 'Empty Lord', and when news of the theft of a god-weapon reached her, she passed the message on to
Well, she was always sickeningly obedient to Saradomin, so I would expect her to have run to some great place of worship of him if she was affected by the curse to try and gain his blessing.
Well, she's a murderer. What more could you need to know?
Well, she's not quite seaworthy right now...

Well, she's still alive at the moment. It was my mum, Marie. She's a better chemist than me, but she likes to do things practically. This time it didn't work out so well for her. Lucky I was on hand to help.
Well, should you need a replacement, I suggest you free up some inventory room first...
Well, show me what you do have then.
Well, since it's clearly no secret, yes. The former Councillor is a dangerous individual, so I want her back in a cell as soon as possible.
Well, since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
Well, since the penguin at the Zoo is the only one talking to you, maybe you should ask him.
Well, since you have come such a long way, you can have this. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.
Well, since you haven't shown me a defender to prove your prowess as a warrior,
Well, since you mention it, I'm looking for some festive holly.
Well, since you saved my life when we were fighting the Sea Troll Queen, I don't mind telling you... I trust you won't tell anyone about this?
Well, since you're so brave, would you be able to help me out by asking some of the locals about my melting chocolate issue?
Well, since you've helped my family out a couple of times, I'd be glad to build a sled for you.
Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten
Well, so what if I am? It's not a crime.
Well, some gold would be nice.
Well, some more colourful feathers might be useful. For some surreal reason, all I normally seem to get offered are large quantities of rather beaten-up looking chicken feathers.
Well, some of the MOST coveted prizes in thiefdom right now are in the pirate town of Brimhaven on Karamja.
Well, some of the people in the desert worship a god called Icthlarin.
Well, some people have gone mad from visiting their dreams.
Well, some people see it as a sport, although such a term does not really convey the amount of patience and dedication required to be proficient at the task.
Well, some say they got lost in the mountains. Others say they decided to go and live somewhere like Fortis instead of here. I'm not too sure myself. It is a large number of people who've vanished...
Well, someone drank it... that didn't turn out so well.
Well, something has happened at the lighthouse, and she has been locked out. I need you to give me her key.

Well, sometimes he'll fly right off the handle and just start, you know, 'raising the dead' to do his 'bidding'. That kind of activity is just so anti-social, so it tends to attract a lot of hero types, you know!
Well, sometimes the law is wrong!
Well, sooooorry...
Well, sorry to hear you say that old [boy/gal/bean], but I can't hold it against you.
Well, sort of, but ye'll need t' proper equipment to do it. Specifically, ye'll want to build a chum station on yer boat. They're what ye' use to spread t' offcuts.
Well, sort of. She's the unofficial leader of the Ratcatchers.
Well, sort of. That doll wasn't possessed at all. It was a clockwork toy. They're supposed to move.
Well, speaking to him may find a weakness he has. See if there's something that could stop him bothering us.
Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.
Well, spit it out! I can't wait here all day.
Well, stop playing around; I'm a busy man!
Well, stop talking and I'll stop answering.
Well, story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel here under the statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
Well, suit yourself then!
Well, suit yourself, I can always find other customers.
Well, take a look at these plans I found and see what you think.
Well, take care adventurer. You stand on the ruins of the old destroyed Wizards' Tower. Strange and powerful magicks lurk here.
Well, take care of yourself then.
Well, take care. You stand on the ruins of the old destroyed Wizards' Tower. Strange and powerful magicks lurk here.
Well, take your pick!
Well, take your time over it, why don't you.
Well, tha's a shame ain't it?
Well, thank you for helping to defend the Archive in spite of your doubts.
Well, thank you for the offer, but we've got this in hand.
Well, thank you for your time Captain, I'll see if anybody else noticed someone slipping away during the feast, or noticed someone behaving particularly badly towards any of the Moon Clan.
Well, thank you so much for all of that information Reeso. See you later.
Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.
Well, thank you, that was much better than the last jester.
Well, thankfully it's a fairly simple recipe!
Well, thanks I guess...
Well, thanks anyway.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
Well, thanks for that. You have been a great help.
Well, thanks for the help, but I don't think I'm any closer to solving this whole jinx mystery...
Well, thanks to the masks and uniforms, they're all anonymous. It's also very hard to keep track of how many there are.
Well, thanks to you, she'll live to see another day.
Well, thanks, I'll have a look.
Well, thanks. What will you do now?
Well, that I cannot answer myself. You will need to speak to each of them and see what they require of you as proof of your dedication.
Well, that Zamorakian mage mentioned that he had a strong magical aura, perhaps that is it?
Well, that and the fact you had that whole conversation within earshot.
Well, that book looks as if it's been through the wars...you're not going to return it in that condition. You take it back to the wizards at Yanille, they borrowed it, so it's their responsibility.
Well, that crazed spirit still terrorises the seas but wit' the 'elp of people like yeself, the Spirit Anglers are puttin' up a good fight!
Well, that depends on who you ask... Some try to rationalise it away as some accident in the forest, the river, or the mountains.
Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
Well, that depends upon your skill levels for each role.
Well, that depends.
Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
Well, that didn't go as planned.
Well, that didn't work. I should talk to someone and see what I'm doing wrong.
Well, that does seem a bit vague.
Well, that does seem to be a common career around here.
Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
Well, that doesn't sound too bad. What's the problem?
Well, that doesn't surprise me much.
Well, that is a slightly impertinent question to ask of your King, but I shall overlook it this time.
Well, that is a slightly impertinent question to ask of your king, but I shall overlook it this time.
Well, that is an interesting question. Let me let you into a little secret. If you make another offering to Fossegrimen you will learn a secret melody.
Well, that is good news, as I may have a proposition for you.
Well, that is impressive.
Well, that is impressive. How has he managed that?
Well, that is the most peculiar thing I've ever experienced. This mirror must somehow be dysfunctional. Strange how well it reflects the stagnant swamp behind me, but there is nothing of my own
Well, that is your prerogative.
Well, that largely depends on who you ask and when you ask it. The sword is not unique, but many like it have been referenced in folktales.
Well, that looks bad... what do you want me to do?
Well, that makes sense, but sorry I don't know anything about that.
Well, that makes sense.
Well, that may be, but I have a rush order for a top paying customer that's going to keep Hammerspike off my back for a bit.
Well, that may well depend on if the Zamorakians have already desecrated it. One step at a time though. First, why don't you try and get hold of some?
Well, that might save me a bit of time on my captain's log.
Well, that must have been the 'bad man' that the troll kid was on about... His parents must be up ahead somewhere.
Well, that seemed to fool them satisfactorily! Now that the silly pixies are back at work, you can go and pick up the presents.
Well, that seems simple enough.
Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
Well, that seems to have showed them Cap'n!
Well, that settles it, I'll send the order for all rabbits to cease jumping through the portal at once.

Well, that should still get you into the fortress, but I imagine you'll need a better disguise than that to reach King Arthur. He's a very important person and will be well guarded by the Black Knights.
Well, that sounds an awful lot to get past. It sounds like an impossible mission!
Well, that sounds easy enough!
Well, that sounds good. Can I have it then?
Well, that sounds like a nice plan. One big fight, no more trolls.
Well, that spy ruined what truth serum we had...
Well, that takes care of the Blindweed. What now?
Well, that there depends on how hard the job is. The more skills needed, the more money you're gonna need to part with.

Well, that very much depends. You see, when it comes to charting, there are quite a few different things you'll want to track. What you need to do is going to vary depending on what it is you're tracking.
Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
Well, that was a lot of fun, I'll have to thank My Arm for the idea!
Well, that was a weird one alright, you told me that they couldn't agree on what food they liked, so you ended up just mushing a bunch of stuff together somehow which seemed to do the trick.
