texto: Well, that was certainly more dramatic than I had hoped for.
Well, that was close! I should get this churn to the Easter Bunny before my hands freeze off...
Well, that was interesting...
Well, that was jolly charming, but I'm off now. Good bye.
Well, that was quite the adventure.
Well, that wasn't too bad! And as a bonus, I think I have something for your help!
Well, that wealth is needed to buy the food from Neitiznot at extortionate rates!
Well, that went down like a lead balloon.
Well, that went horribly wrong. So this year, I thought to myself, Harvey, how are you going to deliver goodies to all the kids?

Well, that would be helpful Bwana. If you're sure you want to go, you can take a Wampum belt to him for me. It will give the Shaman, Trufitus the story of our problems down here. Are you sure you want to go?
Well, that would be really great...I just hope he doesn't grind you into flour to make his bread, he's one of the most ruthless gangsters in the area.
Well, that would be why then.
Well, that would make sense. Hmm, one more thing.
Well, that's Fred taken care of for Christmas.
Well, that's a bit of a shame, I have to say...we all miss our Petra!
Well, that's a bit of a shame...I was looking forward to upgrading my glider!
Well, that's a good question! Who knows where his head's at most of the time? In the clouds, most likely!
Well, that's a nice crate, but unless you want me to sit under a layer of (heh heh) cats, I think it'll need a false bottom.
Well, that's a shame, but come back and see me if you change your mind.
Well, that's a shame. I was looking forward to visiting the ogres... Perhaps someday I will.
Well, that's a start I suppose You need [#] more signatures.
Well, that's a start!
Well, that's a stroke of luck.
Well, that's a waste of time.
Well, that's absolutely wonderful my friend! Many thanks!
Well, that's all besides the point. It's all your fault and I'm going to make sure the Captain fizzles your gizzard, or whatever it is you piratey types do to each other.
Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
Well, that's all of the items I'll need to get this situation fixed up.
Well, that's as maybe, but yous probably wants to drink ours blood! And you aint having it and you aint coming in!
Well, that's because you're not a man of the cloth are you?
Well, that's better than nothing right?
Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's! 56-->
Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?
Well, that's certainly one way to make it last forever.
Well, that's complicated...
Well, that's everyone here matched to a dog...
Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.
Well, that's exactly why I'm here. I know who these interlopers are and I know what they're after.
Well, that's friendly.
Well, that's good.
Well, that's great! You'd best take it to him then with all haste!
Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...
Well, that's just the adventuring way! If something isn't tied down, I'll grab it, and probably lose it at some point too!
Well, that's just the thing. Councillor Andrews was so impressed with my work, he put me in charge of this investigation.
Well, that's kind of what I wanted to ask you about...
Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
Well, that's me. Your turn.
Well, that's my price. If you change your mind, you can come back and talk to me. Good day.
Well, that's nice!
Well, that's no good! What if they come after our sweets instead?
Well, that's not exactly reassuring.
Well, that's not hard.
Well, that's not my problem is it? Also, I know that you slaves trade your items down here. I'm sure that if you're resourceful enough, you'll come up with the goods.
Well, that's not particularly good is it? You'll have to go back and ask him if he can rewrite the message for you.
Well, that's not something you hear everyday...
Well, that's not the point!
Well, that's not too helpful, there are lots of those around here; can you remember where you last had it?
Well, that's not very conclusive.
Well, that's not very nice...I mean, I'm a nice guy and I thought you were nice too! Why would you want to run me through? I mean, it's only a weather report.
Well, that's ok then.
Well, that's one way of putting it...
Well, that's one way to catch a chicken, I suppose.

Well, that's possible. These guards do like a drink. I would think it will take at least 3 beers to do it well. You would probably have to do it all at the same time too. The effects of the local beer wear off quickly.
Well, that's probably as close to a compliment I'm ever likely to get from you, so thanks!
Well, that's quite the honour.
Well, that's really none of your business.
Well, that's the life of an adventurer. Is it a deal, or not?
Well, that's the other funny thing... He never showed up, he sent some General or other instead.
Well, that's the problem, he doesn't dare to come into Rellekka. He's afraid he's going to get hurt.
Well, that's the problem... the most important pages are missing.
Well, that's the thing, she refuses to leave.
Well, that's the thing.

Well, that's the thing. It's different for everyone! Why do trees grow from stumps substantially faster than from seeds? Where do meteorites come from? Why do we have to hold our arms out to teleport successfully?
Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
Well, that's very good of you. But as you can see, I am very fine and well thanks! Now, please leave so that I can get back to my work.
Well, that's what Colonel O'Niall suggested. Best get on with it then.
Well, that's what altars like the one in this church are for!
Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
Well, that's what we're here to find out! Without the roots, the crystals are fully exposed for collection.
Well, that's where my preparations come in. While I can't say I'm too keen on ruling Kourend, I'm not sure if Lord Shayzien is the right man for the job either.
Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
Well, that's why I'm here! So many of you adventurers help yourself to any old book and never return the damn things!
Well, that's why he's in disguise. Duh.
Well, that's your decision, of course.. but you won't be able to complete the quest without it. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have other business to attend to.
Well, thats a relief.
Well, the Black Knights have started making strange threats to us; demanding large amounts of money and land, and threatening to invade Falador if we don't pay them.
Well, the Captain thinks it must be his fault!
Well, the Duke has heard that you may have been looking into methods to safely trap monkeys.
Well, the Duke says he will attack you unless the silverware is returned.
Well, the Easter Bunny needs to deliver some chocolate eggs to some adventurers deep in the desert.
Well, the Grail IS very elusive, it may take some perseverance.
Well, the Grove is normally for tortugans only, but if you just want to speak to Floopa, I suppose I can let you enter as long as you promise not to chop down any of the camphor trees.
Well, the Hueycoatl has awoken.
Well, the Kharazi would be forever in your debt. Return our shaman, and we will certainly be able to establish friendly relations with your Legends' Guild.
Well, the King hadn't heard from you for a few days. He sent me to make sure everything's okay.
Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!
Well, the Krakens destroyed m' ship, killed m' crew, the rum it's... all I 'ave left.
Well, the Mayor of Catherby has been, for a long time now, a fish.
Well, the Mayor of the town was first, then brother Maledict, and finally Colonel O'Niall.
Well, the Wise Old Man and I have discussed the situation, and he's come up with a plan...
Well, the Witch next door has been cooking some rather nice gingerbread, but I don't think that counts as gossip.
Well, the abbot was slain by a group of raiders. Apparently his faith was little protection against their repeated sword blows.
Well, the actors do often like to have a drink after a play, but I always ask that they do that outside so as to not risk any damage to the costumes.
Well, the apothecary figured they can't be afraid if they're unconcious...
Well, the bank is all fixed now, but it isn't going to serve people all on its own. You'll have to recruit someone!

Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.
Well, the big gaping hole in the hold is the problem. You'll need a few wooden planks hammered in with steel nails to fix it.
Well, the book says, that I need, and I quote:- 'Something with faith', 'something from nature' and 'something of the 'spirit-to-become' freely given'. Hmm, I know how to get something from nature.
Well, the bowls I make tend to shatter under pressure into razor-sharp shards of lethal, face shredding shrapnel.

Well, the consequences of your little piece of butchery are that the town is now even worse off. The bandits no longer have to waste time and energy fighting with the Menaphites and can direct all their attention
Well, the creatures there ARE particularly offensive...
Well, the current cook of Lumbridge obviously discovered an ancient manuscript of his ancestors, and believing it to be a recipe decided to recreate the spell that banished him.
Well, the doctor is downstairs, waiting for you. I think he said he needed some things before he could begin.
Well, the door to the next floor has already closed. Might as well take a break.
Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
Well, the field of natural history covers a wide range of sciences.
Well, the first barge had some serious design flaws... it didn't float.

Well, the first thing to remember with password security, which I can't stress enough, is to never tell your password, bank PIN or authenticator details to anyone, not even if they claim to be Jagex staff. Real
Well, the flask does still have some liquid left in it. Perhaps we should have it tested?
Well, the gold that you humans are so fond of has no real value in Zanaris, so I ask my patients to pay me in gems.
Well, the hours are good, but most of those hours are a drag.
Well, the hours are good.....
Well, the idea with this room is that we will set up a game for you, choosing some other people from within the room. If there are enough players around we will start a game for you.
Well, the kid droned on and on about artefacts, and I think he wanted me to give him items, but it made no sense... honestly, his voice drives me mad, and I can't cope with him anymore.
Well, the kingdom is fairly abundant with swords...
Well, the last I heard of my brother Johnathon, he was studying the magical arts, and trying to hunt some demon or other out in The Wilderness.
Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
Well, the long and short of it is that scroll boxes contain clue scrolls, but in a much easier to carry form factor.
Well, the main entrance is 'round the front. Just head west then north slightly, you can't miss it!
Well, the main problem is that I'm fresh out of giant eagle feathers. I've been meaning to get onto my supplier about that for some time.
Well, the more you know about the sea, the more you'll be able to take advantage of it. Specifically, learning about the seas will offer the discerning captain a shortcut or two.
Well, the most famous Gnomish Mage of all got into a bit of .... trouble.
Well, the only thing I can think to do is to go down there and look to see if there are any left.

Well, the only thing the journal says is that 'something with faith stands south of the spirit-to-become', but I'm so confused now I don't really know what that means. Oh, if only I had all my faculties!
Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
Well, the people of the village, my usual customers... are all affected by the emanations from some place to the North East. Ulsquire can give you the name.
Well, the poor gnome - Nobby was his name - was in terrible pain and fear as to what would happen to him next.
Well, the poor young lady has such family problems; I quite feel her pain. I'd be happy to help.
Well, the press is working now, but I still have to patch [the broken sections/[Amount] more bits of wall/the last piece of wall].
Well, the research you recovered has confirmed something I have long suspected.
Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
Well, the secret passage into the monastery is located in the gardens.
Well, the solution is obvious.
Well, the spinning machine is all ready now, except that it needs to be powered up.
Well, the stuff mixes into a real nasty gunk and I'll never be able to get it off the walls.
Well, the thing about cadava berries is that they're not the only part of the bush that's dangerous. If you're not careful, the bark can have quite a nasty effect on the skin.
Well, the truth is, I feel it in me bones.

Well, the vampyres aren't taking our blood anymore, and they've promised to help us rebuild the city. Still, it's going to take a long time to fix this place up. Most people have chosen to leave instead.
Well, the water of the Salve should still have enough power to work against the vampyre, even if the Zamorakians have desecrated it.
Well, the whole 'getting swallowed alive by a tree' thing isn't really selling this concept, but I think I know what I'm doing now.
Well, the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
Well, the zombies holed up in the main monastery must have at least one set of those items; otherwise, how did they perform the operation in the first place?
Well, then I had an even more clever idea!
Well, then I suppose there's no harm in telling you. There is a sacred pool, right at the centre of the Kharazi jungle.
Well, then I'd best get going. Where can I find these tunnels?
Well, then a miracle happened. Or luck. Or natural justice.
Well, then get lost and stop wasting my time.
Well, then get to it, you scallywag! Make sure you do it on your vessel as well. It's important to feel that sea air while trying a new drink.
Well, then it won't taste like wine, will it?
Well, then look at me boat and listen to wot's comin' out me gob!
Well, then we're on the same side. I'm part of an alliance defending this place. The danger is mostly gone though. We held off the attackers.

Well, then you should be glad you never had to see how we used to live. That festival is a perfect example of something that should have remained forgotten, but of course, my brother can't help but cling to the past.
Well, then you'd better get back there and sort it out.
Well, then, bring me enough smaller blocks to make thirty two kilograms, and I will deal with it.
Well, then, please come back when you do.
Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
Well, there are a lot of different things you can cook, but I don't like to overcomplicate things myself too much...
Well, there are a lot of ships going around the world all the time, and very seldom does anything like this happen!
Well, there are also many different kinds of weapons, and different ways of using them. Take melee for example. You have crushing attacks, slashing attacks and stabbing attacks.
Well, there are definitely plenty of those around here. So does that mean you'd be able to retrieve some things for me if I ever needed?

Well, there are four different Ardougne cloaks, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to

Well, there are four different Desert amulets, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to

Well, there are four different Explorer's rings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to

Well, there are four different Kandarin headgears, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you

Well, there are four different Varrock armours, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to

Well, there are four different Western banners, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to

Well, there are four different Wilderness Swords, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
Well, there are four different blessings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too...

Well, there are four different pairs of Fremennik sea boots, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards

Well, there are four different pairs of Morytania platelegs, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of

Well, there are four different shields of Falador, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
Well, there are no guarantees of course, but it will definitely improve your odds.
Well, there are no houses opposite the eastern bank, so it must be the one looking over the western bank.
Well, there are these two ladies who are looking for adventurers with cats.
Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.
Well, there are two. The first item should be nice and simple for you to get for me. I want a griffin feather. Now, this is not just any feather, this one is special.
Well, there aren't any penguins around now, so we can't try out the suit.
Well, there aren't too many weapons that people tend to craft, but there are a couple worth noting!

Well, there is a long standing rule of chivalry amongst the Varrockian aristocracy, where each noble family is in possession of a unique crest, which signifies the honour and lineage of the family. More than this
Well, there is one issue.
Well, there is one way... but I doubt it is of any interest to you.
Well, there is part of the answer. We know it's hot enough to melt the normal one!
Well, there is the case of the magic words of enchantment - repeat after me:

texto: Well, there isn't a whole lot more. They managed to trap the Mother Mallum behind a mystical prison where she was to wait for all time.
Well, there was a guy in here earlier saying the goblins up by the mountain are arguing again, about the colour of their armour of all things.
Well, there was a minor problem involving a sea snake...

Well, there was some chap in desert clothing. He said his name was Ali. He assured me they were giant eagle feathers, although when I come to think about it they were suspiciously similar to chicken feathers.
Well, there was that time he sold out his entire family for a sandpit and an umbrella.
Well, there were servants of Armadyl living down in the depths of the temple. They'd been there for generations, guarding the staff.
Well, there you go then.
Well, there you go.
Well, there's a certain gold artefact we're after. We dwarves are big fans of gold! This artefact is the first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
Well, there's a coffin with some sort of rod fused to the top of it.
Well, there's a lot that goes into it to drive the price up that high. But I understand why you feel that way.
Well, there's a pipe system, a pressure machine and a strange cage up at the top that needs finishing off. The alchemists couldn't explain what they were for.
Well, there's a simple solution there, don't you agree?
Well, there's a small island just west of here where you can find some.
Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
Well, there's all sorts to do. I need to observe its behaviour patterns and document its feeding habits. The discovery is only just the beginning you know.
Well, there's always something interesting going on here.
Well, there's an Inn in Varrock if you're desperate.
Well, there's giant krill, haddock, yellowfin, halibut, bluefin, and if yer up fer a challenge, the elusive marlin.
Well, there's my good friend Razmire Keelgan. He's a prominent shop owner in Mort'ton, at least he was before he was affected by the area.
Well, there's no pleasing some people. Here's your cut anyway.
Well, there's no room for dawdling on my crew!
Well, there's not all that much for me to do these days, you see.
Well, there's not much to tell really.
Well, there's nothing more we can teach you.
Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
Well, there's the cave exit I need to clear. Then My Arm can get into this cave.
Well, there's the inn. You could look there I suppose. The cellar would have been useful, but the trapdoor down to it is covered with rubble from a broken wall.
Well, there's the strange man being accused out in the centre, but personally I think he's innocent.
Well, there's the sword shop across the road, or there's also all sorts of shops up around the market.
Well, there's this horrible big... dog-like thing that's moved into the mausoleum outside. It's causing all kinds of problems. Could you get rid of it for me?
Well, these are the furs from a larupia. Caught the creature myself I did, and these make me blend in better, see?
Well, these associates of my nephew can be somewhat... overenthusiastic.
Well, these folks digging up the island need some of your everyday things, so I offered to come along and offer my wares.
Well, these look like pressure plates where I am. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.
Well, they are common enough ingredients, although I must admit the recipe I am following is very strange indeed...
Well, they are magical. Valuable as well...
Well, they are standard equipment for any slayer looking to kill Banshees...
Well, they can always come visit. Or perhaps we can arrange a loan?
Well, they could. But I imagine that would be considered quite rude.
Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.
Well, they do.
Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!
Well, they know best about plague issues.
Well, they only ran into problems because people kept insisting on trying to use them indoors.
Well, they said I was too young to swim with them, and I should be responsible and get a job. They're so old school.
Well, they say that comparison is the thief of joy, so how about we stop this line of thought.
Well, they say, 'We not want to fight,' so god punish them.
Well, they seemed friendlier than most goblins, and nothing was taken from the cellar.
Well, they tricked me into opening the prison that kept their Queen imprisoned.
Well, they used to be very rigorous in attending my services. Now they seem almost apathetic.
Well, they used to live in the big castle, but old Lord Sinclair gave it up so that those strange knights could live there instead. So the king built him a new house to the North.
Well, they were happy I was leaving the proverbial nest.
Well, they were still there last time I checked... go west through the jungle until you reach the see, then walk eastwards again with the barrier rocks to the north.
Well, they weren't the only ones to disappear. What if you're right? What if there are more people up there? And what if whatever took them comes back?
Well, they'll keep the sand off your feet at least...
Well, they're all richer than you'll ever be!
Well, they're certainly big enough to try.
Well, they're certainly decorative...what about them?

Well, they're kind of sneaky, really. You've got a tall post with what appears to be a little perch sticking out the side. Now, the bird will see this as somewhere to sit, but the perch is actually rigged such that when the bird
Well, they're not exactly exotic, they're just the basic ingredients of a cake.
Well, they're not in there now!
Well, they're supposed to look terrifying but I think they are rather cute.
Well, they're used to hurt people, aren't they? That's not considered very, y'know, respectable. Even though the guards use them, and the hunters, they're still considered a bit, y'know, dirty.
Well, things were quiet for a while, but then you dug up that Teumo business. The Highlord and the Highseer were both rather unhappy. The Highseer in particular. She now needs to find a new advisor.
Well, things you would expect every kitchen to have... Eggs, milk, flour... You know... But you don't.
Well, this CommOrb can use the scan function to find him, but its range is very limited.

Well, this cunning human told him that there was a better meal that would not run away in a house in the woods. As the brave young wolf could see that this human was not fully grown, he figured maybe he'd
Well, this dungeon was quite good to explore ...until I got captured, anyway. I was given a key to an inner part of this dungeon by a mysterious cloaked stranger!
Well, this fish seems hilariously small. Still, if it's the only fish, there's a chance I can win the contest. I should show it to Larry.

Well, this has certainly been exciting! The Sinclairs under house arrest, Morgan Le Faye attempting yet again to interfere with King Arthur and Merlin, and even the Black Knights sticking their noses into it.
Well, this is Kourend, so there's never any shortage of work to be doing. We've had three murders in the past couple of days alone.
Well, this is a very unusual job. This thing looks more suited to bashin' peoples heads in than securing a ship.
Well, this is a waking sleep.
Well, this is all quite exciting. It's an illustrious group that you've invited me to join.
Well, this is definitely more difficult than training on rooftop courses.
Well, this is definitely the most 'dialogue' I've had with the ents. Isadora here has been a great help as well!
Well, this is no good at all! You'll never survive in Morytania, you'll have to go back.
Well, this is not fur directly from an animal, look it has been prepared for sale...
Well, this is rather embarrassing, but I think there's some kind of monster in my house. Could you go upstairs and get rid of it, please?
Well, this is the guards' entrance. I might be new here but I can tell you're not a guard.
Well, this isn't the first time the Temple Knights have encountered the Mother Mallum.
Well, this place is new i'nt it? Bea's farm be a bee farm, just as soon as we set 'er up. Don't s'pose yer could give us an 'and with that, could yer?
Well, this thing we're doing with the altars seems to be working, so I say we just keep doing that.
Well, this won' do at all.
Well, this wouldn't be the first time! Let's take a look.
Well, those bandages aren't going to last forever, and unfortunately I don't think that book of yours can help... not unless you use the pages as replacement bandages.
Well, those look like very unusual moles indeed. Little 'uns.
Well, those posters aren't putting themselves on the notice board. You'll probably want to find whoever put them there.
Well, those white knights are far more complicated than you might imagine. Not the ‘goodie goodies' they claim to be. Just watch your back.
Well, thread is too light and rope is too heavy for this job... You could try some wool?
Well, time for me to get on with my work. Come back soon.
Well, time to see what the others have found!
Well, to be honest, I'm not really sure. You'll need to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle to find that out.
Well, to be honest, what I would really like is... a nice cup of tea!

Well, to be honest. We think he's not exactly as brave as he makes out. But we have to follow his orders. If someone called him a coward, or managed to trick him into a one-on-one duel many of us bet that he'd be
Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.
Well, to be perfectly honest with you, I am a little concerned.
Well, to tell the truth, I just came back to chat with you. Any news?
Well, to tell the truth, my lads are a little quicker off the mark, so it only happens occasionally.
Well, today's your lucky day!
Well, traveller, if you hadn't already noticed, a foul plague has beset this town. Not only that, but there is talk of a great evil stirring below...
Well, trawlin's the art of catchin' fish with yer boat. It's the best way to harvest the highest quality fish o' the sea. If ye' be wantin' to learn more, I can tell ye' all ye' need t' know.
Well, true, but you can't be too careful.
Well, truth be told, I would probably be here even if it wasn't where I worked. I very much like reading, not to mention sharing what I learn with all who are interested.
Well, truth be told, I'm not sure it's really a key that I need. I just need something that can open a crate.
Well, try to enjoy yourself.
Well, try your best to get him back here!
Well, uh, not exactly... Sir Vey Lance, our head of operations, is the only one of our order who has ever personally met Saradomin, but everything he tells us to do is done with
Well, um. Yes. Indeed. I'm sure Saradomin would be pleased.
Well, unfortunately I can't make the sled without all the materials.
Well, unfortunately I don't think you have the Sailing experience needed to attempt this trial. I'd suggest sailing elsewhere until you are ready.
Well, unfortunately no one in Catherby really wanted the job. In fact, there was only one candidate, and it was the one person we all definitely didn't want to be the mayor.
Well, unfortunately this is the only example of this particular language I have ever seen, but I might be able to make a rough translation, of sorts...
Well, unlike the rest of the traps I've seen so far, you have to deal with both an arrow trap and a fire trap at the same time.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
Well, usually something goes wrong at these events and you need someone like me to help!
Well, watch yourself. Those rocks that the trolls throw can take your arm off.
Well, watching that wheel go round and round and round...
Well, we all have to start somewhere!
Well, we all make mistakes sometimes.
Well, we all make mistakes.
Well, we also steal, start fights, and disrupt lives - but we do it with class! And the bandits definitely started it.
Well, we always need to rotate the crops we're growing to stop the soil from tiring due to lack of nutrients. It would be great if you could help out with that.
Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
Well, we at the Bank of Gielinor are keen to make sure that our services are always easily accessible. That includes making ourselves available in the more remote parts of the sea.
Well, we believe it may be some sort of nearby cave, it can't be very far away as the impressions we get are quite strong. We believe the cave is a home for some sort of creature or creatures.
Well, we can't give up on him yet.
Well, we certainly have a lot to think about.
Well, we could use some help with scouting a route into the Sanguinesti region. Are you interested in learning more details?
Well, we do stock a special book that you may be interested in, which provides a comprehensive guide to this training arena. It costs 200 coins. Would you like one?
Well, we don't all need to go to the Theatre. Veliaf and I can find Vanescula while you two head over there.
Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
Well, we eat yak milk products every day, from when we're born. So I suppose we're used to it. Anyway I should stop yakking - haha - and get on with my work.
Well, we explained how it does work and he then asked us to take him to Port Sarim...
Well, we find a lot of soaked pages in our nets. If you've got something we really want, I could swap it for 25 soaked pages.
Well, we got rid of the marauding zombies.
Well, we had better get out of here. Let's do it quietly.

Well, we have a ritual called 'The View of Self Dream'. It is a ritual that we all have to go through. You see the path to understanding magic is through understanding ourselves. It is a power innate to every
Well, we have a theory that lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
Well, we have made some progress there. We know that one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by Grip, the head guard, so we thought it might be good to get close to him somehow.
Well, we have nothing else to try, right? What will I have to do?
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
Well, we have the door completed, so now all that's left to do is to put it up in Draynor.
Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
Well, we have to do something to get the lighthouse working again! Also, as you may have noticed, the storm that knocked the bridge out
Well, we haven't really kept in touch... what with the dispute over the crest and all... I did hear from my brother Avan a while ago though.
Well, we haven't really seen much of you over the past year.
Well, we here. My Arm not enjoyed boat ride. Weiss must be up top of cliff, but My Arm not gonna be able to climb up.
Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
Well, we knew little about her or she would have been caught and exposed as a traitor and a spy, but Lucien did mention that he had evidence that she was a great fan of ball games...
Well, we look after all of the research in this section.
Well, we made it.
Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
Well, we managed to activate a statue in one of these rooms. My guess is we now need to activate the one in the other.
Well, we might be able to help ya out there... for a price of course!
Well, we mine it in this section, then someone scoops it into a barrel. The barrels are loaded onto a mine cart. Then they're deposited near the surface lift.
Well, we moved back here from our main office on Wester Island, but due to budget cuts, we can't afford the transport costs.
Well, we need something for me to make scary noises with.
Well, we need to survive this first, and with us now having no clear way back to Morytania, the odds of that happening are even slimmer than before.
Well, we realised when we met that we were all very similar, so we've been using it as a selling point! Everyone loves Snappy Sister, Stormy Sister, and of course me, Spirited Sister!
Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.

Well, we recently had a large chunk of funds donated to us, so we sent out all sorts of explorers - I'm sure you'll meet them as you go around the world. People like Simon down in the desert near the pyramid as well
Well, we sadly had a few who couldn't attend this time, so I'm actually quite glad you're here. Still, I wouldn't mind knowing how your employer managed to acquire an invitation...
Well, we seem to have more of these strange teleport tiles here... Maybe we should see where they lead?
Well, we teach our operatives the value of their equipment by making them pay for it, what?
Well, we thought some new and unique flavours might do it, so my son Chocco has been investigating but he's not been able to find the right flavours.

Well, we use a special combination of items which are used to gauge current weather movements and we're able to predict future weather patterns from these. Of course, it's strongly linked to the Seers' foresight ability.
Well, we were all in high spirits, but I certainly didn't see anything like that going on.
Well, we weren't all there. The Captain was at the high table, and the Bosun didn't trust their food and stayed on ship.
Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
Well, we'll just have to hope he makes the right choice. Anyway, now that you're here, we can get started.
Well, we'll just have to make it work somehow. Maybe then we can finally end this nightmare.
Well, we'll just wait till time is up.
Well, we'll need to dress it up anyway; if we use dirty clothes it'll smell human to the trolls.
Well, we'll see, it might be the only way.
Well, we're not going to get very far without it.
Well, we're not really sure what their proper name is. But they live in tents so we call them the 'Tenti's'.
Well, we're not very much closer to a solution then, are we?
Well, we're sat between two sets of mountains. Lots of places for accidents to happen.
Well, we're something of a mixed bag around here as I'm sure you've noticed, but...
Well, we're taking precautions, but you should be fine. Providing you don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong, that is.
Well, we've brought this sack along. It's specially designed to cancel out egg energy, or as we call it - eggnergy.
Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.

Well, we've got another one of those statues, and these altars around the edges also look important. The layout of the room seems quite specific as well. It's almost like a compass, or maybe even a clock!
Well, we've learned from our previous attempts that we need a sturdier type of wood to keep the barge afloat.
Well, well - a level 3 graduate! I'll keep your certificate safe for you. I feel I must reward you for your work...
Well, well my friend! I've lived in this great and glorious city all of my life. I'd be happy to share with you anything you'd like to know!
Well, well my friend! I've lived in this great and glorious house all of my life. I'd be happy to share with you anything you'd like to know!
Well, well, have you not been doing any studies? I am not giving you the answers, talk to the other students and remember the answers.
Well, well, look at this. My favourite: rock cake! Okay, we will let it through.
Well, well, looks like someone is fresh off the boat and no mistake!
Well, well, perhaps the morsel can help after all...
Well, well, the little t'ing has got it! Take dis to show little t'ing is a friend to da ogres. Hahahahaha!
Well, well, well, what do we have here?
Well, well, well, would you look at that! An adventurer who isn't just skin and bones! You did well handling those trolls.
Well, well, well, you seem to be in quite the rush. Do you have somewhere else to be?
Well, well, well. Back for more slaying?
Well, well, well. Here to bask in the warmth of my domain no doubt. Do not linger too long, you have much yet to do.
Well, well, well. Up for some more slaying?
Well, well, well. You're back again.
Well, well, well... we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel.
Well, well, you do know Glough. Sorry for the interrogation but I'm sure you understand.
Well, well. Safalaan Hallow.
Well, well... I have a visitor. What are you doing here?
Well, well...I think this Sandy needs a lesson, please bring me 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand.
Well, what I'll do is write down the details you have provided in a more easy to digest manner, along with my plans for using this building as a museum.
Well, what I'm struggling with right now is the meats needed for the potion to honour Guthix. I need the raw meat of four different animals for it, but not just any old meats will do.
Well, what about something to knock him out with?
Well, what about the dragon egg?
Well, what are we waiting for? Let's get this party started!
Well, what are you doing here? Get digging!
Well, what are you waiting for?
Well, what are you waiting for? Hop to it!
Well, what better to help the Lumbridge Guide than a 'Cake of Guidance'. Would you like to help?
paginas: Transcript:Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

texto: Well, what do penguins like?
Well, what do we have e're? Another laddie lookin' fer old Kellan's deep sea trawlin' expertise?
Well, what do you have?
Well, what do you know?
Well, what do you think is happening then?
Well, what do you want to know?
Well, what does he need now? Has he asked for any other things? What does it take to become a Nature Spirit?
Well, what have we here?
Well, what if I were to prove it to you? I unmasked the creatures at the Gnome Stronghold using a machine created by Oaknock the Engineer. Maybe I could do it again.
Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
Well, what is it? If you have news on the Council, we must let the people know at once.
Well, what is there to do around here?
Well, what kind of ruler would I be if I didn't make sure to treat our honoured allies with the highest of respect?
Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...
Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned?
Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned? Here you go.
Well, what proof of friendship did you bring?
Well, what some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.
Well, what would you do then?
Well, what would you like to know?
Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.
Well, what you'll find is that the wind typically blows in large circles. What you need to do is find the middle of this circle, or the eye as we often call it.
Well, what's it for then?
Well, what's to say. This place is falling apart.
Well, what's wrong with the whetstone?
Well, whatever it is, someone went to a lot of trouble to try and hide it.
Well, whatever the truth is, it seems I'm going to need to enter that cathedral. How do I get inside?
Well, whatever you call it, it's not normal. Maybe it's an illness caused by Glouphrie's magic.
Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...
Well, when I disrupted Surok's spell, he will have been sealed in the library, but we will still need to keep an eye on him, just in case.
Well, when I were a young man we used to take fishing trips over to Catherby; The fishing over there - now that was something!
Well, when he has, bring the boots to me with ten loaves of bread and ten cooked trout. I have to prepare for the winter, after all.
Well, when it comes to murder, there are a few things we generally look at. First, there's the body itself. Determining the cause of death is a good start for any investigation.
Well, when the day comes that a Fremennik can prove they have the patience and interest in learning our ways, then we will perhaps share our secrets.
Well, when you annoy it it'll shove you into it's mouth, and then you'll fall inside it.
Well, when you are a crew of successful pirates, it becomes more and more difficult to ever moor somewhere and spend your loot.
Well, when you do, please come to me and I'll reward you!
Well, when you do, tell him we'll be more than happy to see him again.
Well, when you do, try your best to persuade him to help.
Well, when you have crafted your lyre you will need the blessing of the Fossegrimen to tune your lyre to perfection before you even consider a public performance.
Well, when you hit the water you will start swimming. If you can't free up your hands by putting everything away then you will sink like a stone.
Well, when you only have one night in this world, you should make the best out of it!
Well, when you're ready, you know where to find me.
Well, whenever you want me to get you some diving gear, just come and see me with a fishbowl.
Well, where did you come from? Why do you wander around Gielinor? I've heard lots of rumours about your past!
Well, wherever it is that you have seen them, I would guess he is nearby!
Well, which will you choose this time?
Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
Well, while they're happy to give ya a helping hand, they are going to expect ya to take the lead.

Well, while us adventurers have been doing our best to fight against the Devourer's corruption, we've been neglecting what has been lost to achieve that goal. Namely, the four guardians we defeated along the way.
Well, whoever it belongs to, it's not coming on this ship!
Well, why didn't you raise the alarm?
Well, why shouldn't I do that?
Well, why would Zamorak want a temple? You said he needed weapons instead.
Well, will you help me with my art?

Well, with such a weapon, the plans we had been developing for a rebellion against our lord could finally be put into action, but we knew that we would have to act swiftly, before he heard that we had a weapon
Well, with the cult out of the way, we've been able to refocus on the recent opening of the kingdom. Signing the treaties was only the first step.
Well, without anyone else te help ye'll have te do some hard work if we don't want to end up walkin' home on the sea bed.
Well, without getting bogged down in all the details, my research led me to some information on a rare and unusual form of necromancy that was once practiced in these lands.
Well, without knowing what we're looking for, there's not much we can do.
Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.
Well, y'know, it's not the most reputable profession, is it? Selling weapons?
Well, ya wouldn't be the first, sailor! I reckon ya probably won't be the the last either. Don't worry though, we can help ya out... for a price of course!
Well, ya. Hey, bet you canna chop dem troys.
Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
Well, ye could maybe explore the ogre caves. Arsen says the ogres be fearsome, though, so watch yer step. An' there be places for ye to train yer skills, over to the west.
Well, ye look like ye might have the right stuff, tell me would ye like te be a pirate?
Well, ye see it works like this: I can sew yer eye patches onto yer pirate hats or pirate bandanas. Just pirate bandanas mind ye, I hate the feel of snakeskin.
Well, ye see it works like this; I can sew yer eye patches onto yer pirate hats or pirate bandanas.
Well, ye see them Jungle Horrors? Well down in the caves there be Cave Horrors.
Well, ye' know where t' find me when ye' are.
Well, ye'll be glad to know that after that little performance I'd be glad to have ye on me crew!
Well, ye'll need some fuse from the cannon locker below decks.
Well, ye'll need to silence their cannon before it sinks us. Before ye do that though, ye'll need to swing over to their ship.
Well, ye'll shoot holes in their hull with the cannon.
Well, ye've sorted out their cannon, but we're takin' on water.
Well, yeah, I need to talk to you about that...
Well, yeah, but it's all spooky fun!
Well, yes actually, as you asked so nicely. Here you go! Here's your 'stabbers'.
Well, yes actually... It's been a passion of mine for some years...
Well, yes of course. In a manner of speaking, yes. But...but that still doesn't give us the right to go around lopping people's heads off because they're not very nice!
Well, yes, I do. Are you any good at smithing?
Well, yes, I do. But I'm going to have to charge you 50,000 coins - these are precious, you know!
Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
Well, yes, I suppose you could say that.
Well, yes, I'm sure you've transported your arm every time you've used my boat. Isn't it always attached to the rest of your body?
Well, yes, actually. It's my favourite! I've been training with that axe since I started my profession as a jungle forester.
Well, yes, although I seem to have mislaid it.
Well, yes, but I don't think I can actually wear it.
Well, yes, but actually, no. It seems we've jumped ahead a bit. Let's go back to why I'm here.
Well, yes, but how did you know?
Well, yes, but that fish woman claims every warrior is needed to defeat the Nightmare and that everyone asleep here is at risk.
Well, yes, but there's some information you're going to want first.
Well, yes, but what else?
Well, yes, but you'll never find your way in!
Well, yes, if you wouldn't mind? Aggie the witch is a family friend and she's a pillar of the local community.
Well, yes, it did... when it bounced back onto the ground it did.
Well, yes, we don't just grow crops here, whatever most of our visitors seem to think. We have cow blood.
Well, yes, yes it is. If I knew something, I'd tell you.
Well, yes, you've got no space to put anything in there... it needs to be hollowed out a bit.
Well, yes.
Well, yes. Black cake would be burnt, which wouldn't be very nice.
Well, yes. I mean no, of course not. Still, Glouphrie has a lot to answer for! If I ever get my hands on him I'll... er... I'll give him a good talking to!
Well, yes. Of course, Sigrid was the one who insulted me first.
Well, yes. Possibly. Dead and come back to life for this one day a year. That's what they say anyway. Personally I think that sounds ridiculous.
Well, yes...
Well, you are in luck. I had been cooking a new batch of gumbo for my dinner. However, I've let it cook too long and it's become very thick and sticky.
Well, you are not yet officially a full fledged Temple Knight now, are you Initiate [player name]?
Well, you are supposed to be the gardener here, but I would say not. One had the soil imported from an extremely fertile area at great cost - watering should not be necessary one would have thought.
Well, you aren't mumbling jibberish any more. You seem much less...unstable.
Well, you brought him here, which was very brave. He's very grateful to you. It's remarkable, really. He has this inner calmness that I find so very affecting.
Well, you can come back and get one at any time from me.
Well, you can come back and get one from me at any time.
Well, you can decorate with things you like. People typically use fairy lights and stockings, to name a few.
Well, you can get some camel milk. I'm going to stay here where it's cooler. I'm still a big fluffy bunny.
Well, you can get to the swamp he lives in by going south through the cemetery.
Well, you can give me a try can't you?

Well, you can go to the Wilderness. That is the area for killing other players. Just keep heading north and eventually you will be bound to reach it. Be very careful, though. Player-killing is not for the unprepared.
Well, you can grow a crystal tree, if you've got the right kind of seed. Great for getting a few shards out of.
Well, you can make them, buy them or talk to the combat tutors just west of here.
Well, you can say no of course, but I really do think just a few more bones would take these displays from being good, to being fantastic!
Well, you can suit yourself my friend, but I have to tell you they're delicious!
Well, you can try picking the lock on your door. Watch out for the guards though.
Well, you can't have it! This museum never lets go of its treasures.
Well, you can't work here unless you have a white apron. Health and safety regulations, you understand.
Well, you can't. No repairs are getting done until the whetstone is fixed!
Well, you certainly know how to party. I like that. I will help you, [player name].
Well, you certainly seem to know what you are doing when it comes to rounding up cats. You must get a lot of practice!

Well, you could always have a nice picnic... oh.. but then there's the problem with the Shades... hmmm, not nice... not nice at all! Well, I'll be honest, I don't really know! But I bet Ulsquire will know.
Well, you could ask the Watchtower Wizard for one.
Well, you could give away your monkeys to people who would look after them. You could even start with me!

Well, you could go and speak to the fancy dress shop owner in Varrock. He can make anything if you give him the right materials. In fact you should probably get a couple of disguises, one for each of us.
Well, you could simply give me the potion...
Well, you could take that bedsheet through to Robin like I asked.
Well, you could try looking in the Earth Sciences section of the shelves over there, although the other students may have beaten you to it.
Well, you couldn't even break that pile of rock to get at me!
Well, you didn't deny anything.
Well, you didn't have to go to so much trouble...
Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard the Sinclair family have vamoosed! Just up and left the mansion.
Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
Well, you don't need any help from me then. How about you, adventurer?
Well, you don't need to be afraid of a little chocolate anymore.
Well, you don't need to worry about the details, you just do as I tell you and it will all work out for us both, what?
Well, you don't need to worry about them any longer. You're free now. Head through the tunnel we came through. You'll find a route leading towards Canifis. Head to Paterdomus once you get there.
Well, you don't sound too happy about it. What happened?
Well, you failed. She got the word out. It took 20 years, but thanks to her, your rule is at an end.
Well, you found me. I'm here. And I was just in the middle of a very important conversation!
Well, you go do whatever you need to do. I'll wait here for you until you're ready.
Well, you go kill things so I can stuff them, eh?
Well, you go to sea at north-west corner of Colony and catch nice fresh monkfish for Arnold, ja?
Well, you had better find a way, and fast! Oh, [Fremennik name] you seem like someone who gets things done. I now appoint you official tax collector of Jatizso!
Well, you had better hope it isn't your fault. If there's one thing I hate more than a stowaway, it's a jinx.
Well, you have both big and small points of interest, water currents, sea depths, weather patterns, and then there's also drink crates. They're a curious one that Steve likes people to track.
Well, you have come to the right person, then - I researched exotic plant diseases as part of my druidic training. What is the affliction that you need to cure?
Well, you have our thanks for all your efforts in finding it. Thank you, iknami.
Well, you have something that lets you speak to ghosts, and I am a ghost.
Well, you have stymphikes, bloodwood trees, leechfin, venators, and of course, the Maggot King.
Well, you have too many monkeys, don't you?
Well, you heard the man, [player name]. Shall we dance?
Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!
Well, you know actors. Very profitable once they're popular. I like to... make investments.
Well, you know how when you kill someone all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly?
Well, you know of me now. I will wring your neck if you do not show respect.
Well, you know of me now. You should also know that I will wring your neck if you don't show some respect.
Well, you know that this time of year Santa travels the multiverse, judging children and adults alike for their behaviour and rewarding them accordingly?
Well, you know what to do if something goes wrong.
Well, you know what to do! Get me another redberry pie and I'll consider it!
Well, you know what to do! Get me another redberry pie and I'll have a look at that axe of yours!
Well, you know where I am if you change your mind, iknami.
Well, you know where to find me if you get lost!
Well, you know where to find me when you change your mind.
Well, you know. It's fifty percent baseless gossip and fifty percent unfounded speculation.
Well, you know...
paginas: Transcript:The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

texto: Well, you let me know as soon as you do.
Well, you look and sound more lively.
Well, you look like a pretty smart cobber. Could you take a look at the display plaques and give 'em a runthrough?

Well, you made the serum yourself so I guess you'll experimentate with it. I'd say that the temple might be able to change the serum in some way. Well, yes, I guess it sounds superstitious, but what's to be lost?
Well, you may be aware of the previous attempts at this expedition?
Well, you may have picked up some things from the rest of the order.
Well, you mentioned something about a reward?
Well, you must be a new arrival. I am Erdan, a descendant of Uhld.
Well, you need to bring 'something from nature', 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given.'
Well, you need to talk to him first.
Well, you never know...
Well, you not have da flufsies den!
Well, you not have da scratchers den!
Well, you open it with your new key and sample the contents, of course.
Well, you really shouldn't worry yourself, [player name]. However, if you did want to go and find her, I would be very grateful.
Well, you robbed a bank, and I bet you're now planning something to do with that Tower!
Well, you said that you'd make the statue's head look like Icthlarin.
Well, you said yourself that this is quite a seldom occurance.
Well, you see, I just-
Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
Well, you see, it started when Bob went missing...and involved a big sphinx in Sophanem, the City of the Dead, and me taking care of Unferth...
Well, you see, it's about my dad. His house is really decrepit. I need someone to rip out the broken furniture and build him some better stuff. I'll pay you if you do it.
Well, you see, it's like this...
Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
Well, you see, there's value in sailors with skills like ours. Most common folk would avoid the storm, but that takes time, and as them merchants say, 'time is money.'
Well, you see, there's value in sailors with skills like ours. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time, and as them merchants say, 'time is money.'
Well, you see, this is only the beginning. Now you are in the arena, may the trials begin!
Well, you see...
Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
Well, you seem to have got away in one piece!
Well, you seem to meet our initial requirements, so you may now begin the tasks to earn membership in the Heroes' Guild.
Well, you should be able to plant the Yommi tree and keep it alive by watering it with the sacred water. After that, you can carve your totem pole!
Well, you should be glad that we offer you a step up then! Falador is clearly a far superior town to spend your time in!
Well, you should give it a try now, just in case there is anything else you need.
Well, you should have thought of that before you risked it for some advice from a crazy old Sphinx.
Well, you should know best... Anna killed her father. Poor man.
Well, you sometimes get these really big fish in the water just by the outflow pipes.
Well, you take the Ghost Buster here, right...and you load it with a white destabiliser.
Well, you tried your best I suppose. Come next door and talk to me.
Well, you were a bit out of it for a fair chunk.
Well, you were told wrong then!
Well, you were very worried about those Guthixian edicts, Aeonisig. Surely with this new alliance, we've managed to achieve the perfect balance those Guthixians always wanted!
Well, you will need all of your inventory space for the ingredients, and all of the other things I'll need you to haul about.
Well, you will need to enter the domain of the ice trolls! This is an area full of wicked beasts and biting cold. From there you will find a way down a slope to a plateau where the Trollweiss grows.
Well, you will not be able to turn this tree into one of the more reliable canoes just yet.
Well, you won't find him. No one who disappears on this island ever shows up again.
Well, you would be well advised to get another.
Well, you would get one from around by the lift area. But why would you want one of those?
Well, you'd best go get another one! Be off with you!
Well, you'd best hope that changes soon.
Well, you'd best start piecing it all together. We need to work out where the killer is. If we can't, then I needn't remind you that you're still the prime suspect.
Well, you'd better hop back onto your raft then. Unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
Well, you'll be able to adopt any puppies you bring back.
Well, you'll find a vat, wheel, washing line and wooden pole in the rubbish pile around the back. Zeke the scimitar merchant should be able to help you find some mixers.
Well, you'll find out in time... Let's make a game out of this, ey?
Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
Well, you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
Well, you'll likely spot some interesting things in the sea and on some of the less explored islands that you find whilst out sailing.
Well, you'll need three of them.
Well, you'll need to be a legendary citizen of Gielinor.
Well, you'll need to complete a quest for us as proof that you've got what it takes to be a Legend. How do you fancy mapping the Kharazi Jungle? It's the unexplored southern part of Karamja Island.
Well, you'll need to complete the following quests: [Heroes' Quest], [Family Crest], [Shilo Village], [Underground Pass] and [Waterfall Quest].
Well, you'll need to find one.
Well, you'll need to free up space for three items in your backpack first.

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
Well, you'll not have to worry about Mi-Gor any more. I defeated his creation and he seems to have slipped away.
Well, you're Itzla's father and she's his mother, but the two of you don't seem too close.
Well, you're a braver [man/woman] than I!
Well, you're a braver man than I!
Well, you're a human. How can you teleport?
Well, you're a magical creature aren't you? Surely I get some wishes for capturing you, or releasing you, or something?
Well, you're all finished here now. I'll give you a reasonable number of runes when you leave.
Well, you're clearly a noob then.
Well, you're god damn right there. Whatever it is you think the truth is, we don't accept it. Now give us Safalaan!
Well, you're going to need a stake, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I just happen to have one with me.
Well, you're gonna have to do something pretty amazing.
Well, you're half way there already! You have a set of shears in your inventory. Just use those on a Sheep to shear it.
Well, you're in sector [one/two/three/four/five/six], but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
Well, you're in sector one, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
Well, you're just no fun, iknami.
Well, you're keen, I'll give you that. Okay, I'll give you a go. Have you got your own white apron?
Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
Well, you're more than welcome to take it. It's not like we can sell it anyway.
Well, you're not having it for free. Cough up.
Well, you're not wrong there.
Well, you're not wrong there... I normally just let myself in.
Well, you're obviously trustworthy, I guess I could tell you...
Well, you're off to a good start - I see you have a Jagex Account, so you should have the latest protection.
Well, you're paying lots of attention, aren't you? Honestly, you adventurers.
Well, you're pretty handy with an axe!
Well, you're probably going to have to kill him for it. But...but a big strong adventurer like yourself shouldn't have any trouble whatsoever with that, I'm sure!
Well, you're welcome to come back if you change your mind.
Well, you're welcome to try talking to Councillor Catherine yourself. You'll find her in the Council Office north east of here. I warn you though, it will probably be an uphill struggle!
Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?

Well, you've been a great help, so I'll tell you a bit about this, shall I? Several weeks ago, a dwarven explorer, named Nestor Peregrine, discovered the entrance to an ancient cave complex while exploring the
Well, you've been doing a wonderful job so far, so I'm sure if the villain is still loose, you'll catch them.
Well, you've been sitting here looking at the bank ever since you moved into this house. Now someone's robbed the bank, and suddenly your house is full of expensive stuff!
Well, you've been to Zanaris. I met a fairy years ago who said she lived there. She was an incredible warrior, considering that she wasn't even a metre tall.
Well, you've come to the right place, m'hearty! What do you need to know?
Well, you've completed the tasks I set you. That map of the Kharazi jungle will be very helpful for future expeditions.
Well, you've found your man.
Well, you've got a nerve showing up around here again!
Well, you've got a nice crop of weeds.
Well, you've got me in a pickle now.
Well, you've helped me before! You helped me find the Myreque!
Well, you've helped me before! You said something about symbols? To find the Myreque!
Well, you've lived here long enough. Is there some way I can smuggle you past?
Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
Well, your best bet would be somewhere on the east side of Varrock. It's rough around there though, be careful.
Well, your best bet would probably be to find someone who isn't a member of the Black Arm Gang and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Phoenix Gang for you.
Well, your friend on the docks gave me permission to stick around until you were feeling better.
Well, your idea of time and mine are too different for either of us to understand the other.
Well, your surname is Halen. It matches the name of an elder called Marv Halen.
Well, your task is to take this fox, this chicken and this bag of grain across that bridge there to the other side of the room.
Well,I don't really know yet.
Well-met!
Well.
Well. I must find a way to re-attach my head. I don't suppose you could help me?
Well. That's an experience I shall never forget!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
Well.. maybe, you see Bert found this hand and it might belong to.. a wizard!
Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
Well.. what with all these warriors around, there's not much chance of my bank being robbed is there!
Well.. yes. I promise I didn't write this though.
Well...
Well... As you wish.
Well... Don't be so sure of that.
Well... Err... No.
Well... Go on, then!
Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.
Well... I am, I suppose, anyway... we're very busy here, hurry up, what do you want?
Well... I can't say for sure, but I think the containers on this table contain small amounts of runic energy.
Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.
Well... I can't stop you, I suppose. I don't have the authority to do so... or the ability to, I guess. But make no mistake, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.
Well... I can't.
Well... I didn't want to ask the other wizards about it, because frankly it's embarrassing! That's why I came out here alone.
Well... I do.
Well... I don't know. I'm open to any ideas you have.
Well... I don't know... This doesn't really sound like my kind of thing...
Well... I don't really understand. The Council rule Kourend. We can't just take over.
Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
Well... I don't.
Well... I err...
Well... I found four diamonds...
Well... I guess nobody is really going to lose out on anything, and we don't even know if there is any treasure...
Well... I guess not.
Well... I guess so.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...
Well... I guess that's okay, get on your way though.
Well... I guess that's your answer. Head to the Mind Altar and craft some runes. That essence you have should capture some of the runic energy released. Take an uncharged cell with you as well.
Well... I guess we could do it now...
Well... I have this note, which will guarantee payment once Santa returns. Will that do?
Well... I have vision too. Chosen commander say me big general!
Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
Well... I know things about myself. I know I like hot chocolate!
Well... I like a nice reward as much as the next person, but without any reason to trust you, I'm going to have to decline.
paginas: Transcript:Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

texto: Well... I like talking to those attempting my challenge. I also run a very lucrative gravestone business.
Well... I may be able to help there.
Well... I may require your services again. Are you interested in hearing more?
Well... I reckon that somebody from the landing party that went to Lunar Isle did something to offend the Moon Clan, and as retaliation they have placed a jinx upon the
Well... I remain unconvinced that it would be wise to allow an outerlander to join us in such dangerous battle, but your enthusiasm seems genuine enough...
Well... I seem to have lost it.
Well... I suppose so.
Well... I suppose that's that then.

Well... I suppose we don't really have any magical capabilities. That's more an Arceuus thing. Though of course, they're mostly pacifists. Apparently they didn't even properly fight in the War of the Five Houses.
Well... I suppose you do at least seem to somewhat care.
Well... I suppose you have proven yourself to be a loyal servant to Hazeel. Still, I must warn you, our lord won't take kindly to being summoned unnecessarily.
Well... I suppose you've proved yourself.
Well... I think it's quite nice! I prefer a warm cup of Saradomin's Wisdom, a special recipe of mine.
Well... I think the Royal Accord of Twill is a good starting point, but we'll need to make some changes for it to work.
Well... I thought I saw this shadow in the room, just for a moment. Surely it was just a trick of the light though...
Well... I was thinking I could get our poets drinking, at the very least.
Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
Well... I was wondering if you could vote for me to become a Fremennik.
Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take [him/her/them] to the cells.
Well... I went to the temple like you asked me to... and I spoke to someone inside...
Well... I would if I had space to carry one.
Well... I'm alive, which I must be honest, I wasn't really expecting after that!
Well... I'm sure I saw an old man in White armour walk by earlier wearing the hat you described.
Well... I've only gone and killed him, haven't I?
Well... I've only gone and killed him, haven't I? Look, I'm even wearing his silly hat!
Well... I... In that case well done, I think. And it just so happens I can help, I'm short of staff right now so I'll hire everyone I can get.
Well... In a way, but the move to direct tests has come with... complications.
Well... It looks like I am indebted to you!
Well... It smells a bit.

When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
When everyone is unconscious, they are going to come in and take you away for brain-swaps!
When first man came to these lands all were Fremenniks, and followed our ways. We lived a happy life, and never settled in one place for long.
When goblin high priest die, they buried in temple crypt in special magic way.
When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
When has that ever stopped an intrepid adventurer such as yourself?
When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
When he arrived, he brought a lot of damp coal dust. He intends to give the dust as spiteful Christmas presents, since it burns very badly, and it would cause much disappointment to the recipients.
When he first moved here, he didn't bring much. From the window you could see he just had some old furniture and a few dusty ornaments.
When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.
When he realised neither of us had an army, he was ever so angry!
When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.
When he was little he used to want to go into Edgeville dungeon. You know how kids are, always wanting to be dungeon adventurers! But he didn't want to be a hero, he wanted to be a monster!
When he went missing, I feared the worst. It was a nice surprise when you not only brought him back, but the Accord as well.
When he's not chewing on some poor soul's bones or raining terror on an unsuspecting village, he can be found in his nest, atop White Wolf Mountain.

When planted, all three of these plants have a unique impact on the Anima Mundi. Their effects will likely be very useful to you when farming.

When reinitialisation has been completed, you are to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name] and accompany [him/her/them] on the mission.
When she became the Devourer, many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. After all, destruction was key to being the goddess of rebirth, so it was something we were comfortable with.

When she has been buried, you must build a cairn on top. It is our tradition to build these cairns in the shape of our longboats that we use when we need to cross the seas. You can use rocks for this purpose, about five or so should be enough.
When she was still in power, the ruler of Hallowvale, Queen Efaritay Hallow, had this mausoleum built. It was constructed to one day house her and her human husband, King Ascertes Hallow.
When she was younger, she experimented a lot with her drinks, and invented a cocktail so alcoholic and tasty that it has become something of a legend to all who enjoy a drink.

When that failed the Evil Chicken grew angry with its brethren and swore to kill any human or chicken that it ever encountered again!

texto: When that failed, Baxtorian and the other clan elders made one final ditch attempt to save Prifddinas. They sung the song of inversion to revert the entire city to a crystal seed.
When the Devourer first emerged, Icthlarin himself taught us an incantation to free an individual from her control. I would suggest you use it, rather than risking harm to the High Priest.
When the God Wars ended, Seren was lost to us. For the first time, we were alone. To lead us through those difficult times, Baxtorian Cadarn was named the first king of the elves.

When the Kurasks finded new treasures, many humans come to the Slayer cave to hunt them... No Kurasks left for Jelly to train on, so Jelly makes a private area just for training. These be Jelly's very own Kurask!
When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.

When the Queen got back here, she was clearly weakening fast. It appears as if the magic force that is her life essence is slowly unravelling.
When the Salve was blessed, a small number of vampyres were left trapped on this side of it. They were heavily weakened, but still posed a dangerous threat.
When the Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all of Kourend would be lost. Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.

When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
When the barbarians came, many tried to fight. I should have fought with them, but I turned away. I had a duty to my people, but I abandoned them.
