texto: When the beans are planted and watered, they will grow into an enormous plant of some sort. I'm not sure what exactly. At the top of this plant is our prize.
When the cave goblins find that the dwarven train has killed their hero, there will be war between them! Saradomin's chosen children can watch as two vile underground races wipe each another out!
When the darkness falls upon you, do you see the spires of the eternal city? When you look upon it, do you hear the songs from within?
When the dragon on Crandor Isle remains undefeated? I think you should prove yourself a dragon-slayer before you can wear a dragon symbol!
When the foeman bares his.. peels?

When the gods bless me with success. You may join me on my next hunt, but you may not take part.
When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.
When the meal was done, he decided it was my job to tidy up, so tidy I did. I took Lord Jovkai's cup and washed it in poison.
When the moment is right, freeze them both, take cover behind the tree and stay out of their line of sight to complete the challenge!
When the people eventually revolted against his repressive rule and banished Scabaras, it is said his blood washed over the scarabs and transformed them into the kalphites we know today.
When the plague first started, Menaphos, our neighbouring city, closed their gates as well. Many of our citizens became trapped there when they did.
When the seal ebbs we shall begin.

When the sun sets, it is he that will guide us. He will lead us through the Gates of Mictl to where we may finally rest. The duty of the Sect of Ranul is to ensure that all are prepared for that journey.
When the time comes, I will be the one to kill him. He will pay for what he has done to me and my family.
When the time comes, you are to pretend you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and that you are seeking an alliance.
When the time comes, you'll know.
When the time is right.
When the time is right?
When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.
When the war was over, my father was tasked with hiding those weapons, lest they fall into nefarious hands. Two of them were buried with him. They will be what the Devourer seeks.
When their group split off from Rellekka, they stole one of the ancient relics of the Fremennik. Our ancient rock.
When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
When there is a will, there is a way. For me, you already embody everything a knight stands for!
When there's too bleedin' many of 'em!
When they attack, ghasts will devour any food you have. If you have no food, they'll draw their nourishment from you!
When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
When they hide in their shells, snails secrete a special type of slime, which dries to cover the entrance of their shells like a 'trapdoor'. This is called an operculum.
When they say you're going off the rails, they're jealous that you can fly.
When they talk about 'the silence of the desert', this must be what they mean.
When they took her from me... I was torn apart. I vowed I would get her back no matter the cost. That vow destroyed my people... I destroyed my people. In the end... I became just like Lord Iorwerth.
When this Tower was burnt down the secret of creating runes was lost to us for all time... except it wasn't. Some months ago, while searching these ruins for information from the old days,

When treated in the correct manner, the creatures' remains can be used to make fine battleworthy armour!
When using the portals, you'll find that each crystal near me has a pair of them near it. Both will send you to the same location.
When war came to the city, the king ordered that every able-bodied man take up arms against the enemy. The two brothers had to leave their home behind, to fight for a king they'd never met.
When was the last time you saw a builder cry?
When was this?
When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
When we came to the temple, that fountain was frosted with ice.
When we decided to come here and thwart your Humans Against Monkeys operation, we made sure to obtain some amulets of humanspeak so that we could better intimidate you all.
When we do, you should return here. We may well have a place for you.
When we examined the sword you dug up, we found that the blade is covered in tiny symbols.
When we finished fighting those sea trolls, you said you'd finished with adventuring, didn't you?
When we get out of here I'll buy you a drink!
When we have finished here, I would like you to try the Fire of Nourishment. Although Boulder made two herb patches as we told him, crops will not grow without such a fire to strengthen them.
When we heard of a magical presence in the Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.
When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.
When we sink, can I have yer stuff?

When we took Hallowvale, Lowerniel said it would be a new beginning for us, but it only took him a few hundred years to grow bored of that.
When we were done, this client spoke through Veos himself. The things he said were... strange.
When we're sailing I'll be very busy you know! I'm probably the single most important person on board when we're sailing!
When we've found Zanaris you'll... GAH! I mean, we're not here for any particular reason at all.

When ye have a bit o' experience, yer best bet is the Hunter Guild in Varlamore, I reckon. Else, there are a few big 'untin' grounds to try...
When ye've grabbed them, jam 'em in the barrel in the attic and pressurise 'em.
When yer quite done flappin' yer lips, go down into the basement and whack spiders until ye find a fever spider body.
When yer quite done runnin' away lad ye've got a load of plunder to be grabbin'!
When yer've got me bees from the bloke in the Grand Exchange, just pop back.
When you aim for perfection, you discover it's a moving target.
When you are done, come back and talk to me to give your report. I will make sure the King is informed.

When you are ready to begin, climb the stairs. Your first trial awaits.
When you are ready to begin, go and pick up a keg from that table over there, and come back here.
When you are ready, it may be that you will be unable to keep yourself away.
When you are ready, report back to Rat and he will reward you.
When you are wielding your sword you will then be able to see the correct options in the combat interface.
When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled, or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
When you cut onions they release a gas that makes you cry.
When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.
When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.
When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
When you eatsh them, they take over your mind, they do! An army of mindlesh kebab eating dwarvesh!
When you find all 5 pages, put them in the folder and bring them back to me!
When you find the ruined altar, use the talisman on it to be transported to a temple where you can craft your runes.
When you get it, handle it with care, those things are dangerous.
When you get to Lumbridge, look for this icon on your minimap. That's where you'll find the Lumbridge Guide.

When you grow weary of violence and seek a more enlightened path, please pay me a visit
When you have a combat spell available, click on it once, then select your target. A good target would be a monster that is below your combat level.
When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank.

When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank. Look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top. There are numerous banks around the world, all marked with that symbol.
When you have a full inventory of logs, you have a choice. You can take it to the bank, there's one on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge, or you can burn them.
When you have a full inventory of meat or fish, find a range. Look for this icon on your minimap.
When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank. There's a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
When you have a full inventory, you can cook it or take it to the bank. You can find a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge and a cookin' range in the castle kitchen.
When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
When you have all of it, bring it to me and I'll explain what to do next. Any questions?
When you have all of these you should find the tree stump outside of my hut. You will be able to hammer together the shield.
When you have all the equipment I asked for, come and see me so we can begin the procedure.
When you have been a wizard as long as I have, you tend to learn a thing or two about magic.
When you have crafted your lyre and been blessed by Fossegrimen, then you will finally be ready to make your performance to the revellers at the longhall.
When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
When you have done that, come back here and speak to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood which you will then crush some garlic into, and then add some spices to hide the garlic.
When you have done that, your task is complete.
When you have finished, click the 'Save' button to confirm the transaction.
When you have finished, perhaps you will come back here, and we can share a drink over tales of the outside world?
When you have made the vessel, bring it to me. I will help but you need to ensure that you are devout and have faith. Your Prayer will be thoroughly tested.
When you have mixed the potion correctly, then I can empower the potion with magic and the ogre shamans can be destroyed.
When you have the wood, you will need to use a knife to craft it into a Lyre. When you have an unstrung lyre, you will need to string it before you can play it.
When you have them, I will still be here.
When you have your bars, bring them to an anvil to open the smithing interface. If the item name is in black, this means you do not have the level to smith the item.
When you have your talisman, right-click on it and select the Locate option. It will point you in the direction of the ruined altar.

When you helped Lucien obtain the Staff of Armadyl, you set him on a path to unimaginable power. After all, Zamorak himself was once a Mahjarrat, until he used the Staff of Armadyl to attain godhood...
When you introduce a large scale operation like the Fishing Platform, it takes away the business from the little guy.
When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.

When you kill a player you will receive any items they have on their person and you will also be given a key. You can use this key on Deadman chests found in various banks across the map. Within the chest you will
When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higher value crate.

When you leave Tutorial Island you'll be placed in Death's office. You can talk to Death and trade bonds with other players there. You'll be able to leave Death's office when you're on a Hardcore world.
When you live in salt water, all food is soup.
When you outside, you turn left an' go long way south-east along path.
When you pick up runes from the ground, if you're carrying a rune pouch that contains matching runes, I can make the runes you've picked up go straight into the pouch, provided there's space.
When you play as an Iron[man/woman], you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
When you play as an Ironman, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
When you put it like that, chaos does start to sound like an okay alternative.
When you return I shall ask you a few questions about what you have learned.
When you said you had a new act you were lying weren't you?
When you say above board, where would making new rings by combining the icons with ancient vestiges from a long forgotten empire sit?
When you say conquer, I'm on your team, right?
When you say there were high spirits... You don't think perhaps you accidentally offended the Moon Clan somehow do you?
When you see a likely looking tree, appreciate its beauty, then simply click on it to chop it down.

When you see other people wandering around the PvP Arena, you can challenge them directly, and they can challenge you. This would be an unranked Duel, so neither of you would gain rank or earn rewards.
When you see someone on top of the glowing mark, then hit the button on the right hand panel, as this will send the claw down to pick them up.
When you solve the sequence you may enter our hideout where our leader, Alomone, awaits you.
When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
When you took the book from the shelf, did you say the words?
When you travel with logs in storage as well as your inventory, which would you like to use? This can be changed at any of the storage crates.
When you try and go through a guard will stop you and ask for the password.
When you want to buy or sell an item, talk to the clerks in the middle. They'll tell you how to set up a trade offer.
When you want to buy something, you tell us what you want, and give us the cash you're willing to spend on it.
When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!
When you want to move onto the next room you need to find the correct door first.
When you want to sell something, you give us the items and tell us how much money you want for them.
When you wear them you will burn lobsters, sharks and swordfish a lot less. It will be a permanent modification however, so make sure this is what you want.
When you weave your words and make your schemes, you are not getting the better of me.
When you were telling me about the man you cooked who talked about goutweed, there was loads of valuable stuff on the floor. Can I have it? PLEASE!
When you're done making the suit, we'll head back to the iceberg and try it out.
When you're done there's a human with your name on it!!
When you're finished pack them up carefully.
When you're finished painting them drop them off in the box I gave you.
When you're ready to start, click Start to summon your awaiting fighters. You'll need to be on a PvP Arena world to start your Tournament.
When you're ready, [player name], just lower the salvaging hook and let's see what we can find!
When you're ready, [player name].
When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!
When you're ready, stand next to me!
When you're ready, we can fight again. Or, if you think you're capable, you can face me at full strength.
When you've been in the Wilderness as long as I have, you learn that not all monsters show themselves on the outside.
When you've filled the mine cart, we'll think about it.
When you've got 5 iron sheets, hammer them onto the damage wall.
When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
When you've made something, put it on the buffet tables, and you'll gain experience based on how much the soldiers appreciate them.
When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.
When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.
When your grapes are ready, pick them and clear the patch so you can grow a new vine.
When your husband was killed, did you see anything unusual?
When your own body is consumed to nourish the Nexus, and an army of scions arises from your corpse, I trust you will not take it personally either.
When?
Whenever I thought about giving up, I'd ask myself who I'd be replaced with. Even if things weren't perfect, I was in the best place to improve them.
Whenever a decision needs to be made, the seven members of the Dorgeshuun Council meet here. The last meeting was when they decided to open up the city to surface-dwellers.
Whenever new tasks are added to the list, there are more points available to earn, so the threshold needed for each rank will increase. Keep completing tasks to maintain your rank!
Whenever one does, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
Whenever one occurred, the festival would take place. It was a whole night of killing. The one with the most kills by the end was said to embody the blood moon.

Whenever that happens, it is a chance for us current elders to consider if the time has come to take a step back. Soon, it will be time for me to hand over my duties, but until then, my work continues.

Whenever yer ready, [lad/lass].

Whenever you're ready, we'll go around Varrock together to collect the mementos.
Whenever your own fear leads you to shun or maltreat a stranger, you lead them to fear you in turn. Thus my ideology spreads from mind to mind, and I reign eternal over you all.

texto: You haven't been here long I take it.
You haven't come to free me at all have you? You're one of her servants!
You haven't completed any laps of the advanced agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
You haven't completed any laps of the basic agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
You haven't completed the task yet.
You haven't deposited any eggs yet.
You haven't gathered any information in this category yet.
You haven't got 200,000 coins to pay for that. I can take coins from your inventory, or from my Coffer.
You haven't got a clue who I am do you?
You haven't got a tinderbox! What if your light goes out?
You haven't got any PvP protection. Doom is already upon you.
You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
You haven't got anything suitable for cooking! The master chef can help you out with that.
You haven't got anything to fill the hopper with.
You haven't guessed? This talisman you brought me... it is the key to the elemental altar of air! When you hold it next, it will direct you towards
You haven't heard about that until now?
You haven't heard of...
You haven't heard the last of this!
You haven't listened to a single word I've been saying, have you?
You haven't lost it, have you? You're lucky I have another...
You haven't lost it, you just need to look for it more closely.
You haven't managed to defeat me yet. Are you sure you wish to leave?
You haven't put any chocolate kebbits in the chute! Hurry up and get on with it, we've got a holiday to save here!
You haven't put any frags in that nursery yet. Do so and I might agree to look after it for you.
You haven't seemed like the quitting type so far.
You haven't seen the last of me!
You haven't started that dream I created for you. Can I help you with something?
You haven't told me about yourself yet.
You haven't unlocked that. You can do so by reading a Trailblazer reloaded death scroll.
You haven't... heard of... That's madness!
You havent seen the last of me!
You head due South, see what you can find out about this tablet.
You head off for the night and come back the next day.
You head over to the new hives, excited to finally introduce some bees to their new homes...
You head upstairs with Elias.
You hear Gary following you through the portal... ... and someone else too.
You hear Thorkel muttering to himself under his breath.
You hear a click from the nearby entry.
You hear a click from the skull above the door.
You hear a commotion out to sea...
You hear a conversation taking place in the next room...
You hear a disembodied voice fading away into the distance, 'May you perish in the fires of Zamorak's furnace! Rashiliyia's curse is upon you!'
You hear a disembodied voice laughing at you....Poor puny mortal. I'm going to have fun with you.
You hear a ghostly wailing sound coming from the corpse and a whispering voice says,'Let me rest in a sacred place and assist you I will'
You hear a loud crash as the boulder reaches the bottom.
You hear a muffled groan. The sack wriggles slightly.
You hear a quiet humming from the strange shape.
You hear a satisfying 'click' as you tumble the lock mechanism.
You hear a strange sound coming from the central chamber.
You hear a suspicious munching sound from the direction of Burntmeat.
You hear a voice inside your head...
You hear a whisper in your ear. 'Return... to Veos. My thanks...'
You hear an unearthly moaning sound as you see an apparition materialise right in front of you.
You hear him clumsily attach the lock to the coffin.
You hear laughter in the background.
